## `src/tianluo/templates/prompts/` — Directory holding the Markdown prompt templates that drive SE3's LLM-run pipeline steps, currently containing doc-sync.md, the template instructing the agent to reconcile all published documentation (README, docs tree, localized variants) against the CLI, specs, structure, and version while reporting gaps rather than authoring files or bumping the version. <!--#3fa46512f0f5b34d|309a3ddb0ce4df7d-->

### `src/tianluo/templates/prompts/doc-sync.md` (markdown) — The prompt template for SE3's documentation-sync step, instructing the agent to reconcile all published docs (README plus any docs tree and localized variants) against the CLI, specs, structure, and version, while reporting undocumented surfaces as gaps rather than authoring new files and never bumping the version. <!--#8723ca11146a5778|8e0db45353f552da-->
  - `Scope` (heading) — Defines what counts as in-scope documentation — every doc the project actually publishes (README always, plus any docs tree if present) — rather than a fixed required path. <!--#f1b304b8bedd824d-->
    - `README reconciliation (baseline — preserved in full)` (heading) — States the baseline README contract for the doc-sync prompt — reconcile the README and its localized siblings with the actual CLI/public interface, capabilities (per code, `tianluo/charter.md`, and `luo code-index`), directory structure, and displayed version — and declares that the broader all-docs scope extends rather than supersedes it. <!--#4e4f69d3b322ab53-->
    - `Reporting documentation gaps (report only — never create)` (heading) — Directs the agent to report undocumented user-facing surfaces as gaps for human triage rather than authoring new doc files to fill them. <!--#9c9e901db2527ddb-->
  - `Localized documentation alignment` (heading) — Requires every language variant of a document to stay structurally one-to-one aligned with its siblings and to follow the BCP 47 dotted-suffix naming convention (`README.zh.md`, `docs/<name>.<lang>.md`), regional forms only when needed. <!--#5dc7fcf4517eca0a-->
  - `Constraints (scope discipline)` (heading) — Bounds the doc-sync step to editing existing documentation only — no source/test edits, no version bumps, no new doc files (uncovered subsystems are reported as gaps), and existing rationale prose preserved unless factually wrong. <!--#82a4a83daa1e54cd-->

## `tests/` — The repository's full pytest/node test suite for tianluo (SE3), spanning per-subsystem packages for the flow engine, CLI commands, core utilities, daemon history pipeline, WebUI/relay server, browser-free frontend app.js harness, and the runtime-free e2e isolation layer, plus shared fixtures/ replay data and a set of markdown diagnosis/verification reports for WebUI chat-history delivery defects (freeze at step boundaries, head-record loss). <!--#7d41790f65fc6f0b|bed0da6d0b68057e-->

### `tests/DISCOVERY_ANALYZE_BOUNDARY_VERIFICATION.md` (markdown) — Verification write-up documenting two fixed WebUI live-chat delivery bugs — the issue #260 discovery→analyze WebSocket freeze (stale daemon cache read) and the issue #278 worktree multi-round discovery chat loss (daemon read-path identity collision) — each with reproduced symptom, root cause, layered daemon/server/frontend fixes, automated acceptance and full-suite results, and manual browser checklists. <!--#4ed3143b8e497ff2|e8b4a5b2189b8ada-->
- `Discovery→Analyze WS-Freeze — Root Cause, Fix & Verification (issue #260)` (heading) — Top-level verification write-up for issue #260 documenting the reproduced discovery→analyze WebSocket freeze, its confirmed root cause, the daemon/server/frontend fixes that landed, and the acceptance/manual-check results (status: FIXED). <!--#af46afb9cee62cab-->
  - `Symptom (as reported)` (heading) — Describes the reported bug: crossing the discovery→analyze boundary stopped an open WebUI chat from receiving live `/ws/ui` content, with the prior 5s progression-grace fallback (8a128eb3) surfacing only a lone `analyze` label and scrolling up, requiring chat re-entry to recover. <!--#81bb01c5ff4e79d6-->
  - `Harness & five-hop instrumentation` (heading) — Documents the reproduction harness (`test_discovery_analyze_ws_delivery.py`) driving the real daemon reader, signature-gated push loop, and real server broadcast to a subscribed `_UiWS` client, plus five-hop DEBUG (`hist-diag`) instrumentation for end-to-end tracing. <!--#4e52c8a8a0356a54-->
  - `Final root cause — the freeze hop` (heading) — Identifies the freeze as a daemon-side stale read during the dense steps-first-write rewrite window (stale `disk_json_cache` head+tail-window parse, missing forced-fresh fallback in `_is_still_active`, and a server `requires_full` stuck-state that made the freeze persist). <!--#11eda9ca1a58663a-->
  - `Fixes that landed` (heading) — Summarizes the four fixes: whole-content hashing + `force_fresh` in `disk_json_cache` (G2), a forced-fresh drop-path rescue in `_is_still_active` (G2), a one-shot recovery full-pull on discarded appends in the server relay (G3), and self-re-arming periodic frontend fallback (G4) plus bottom-follow scroll intent (G5). <!--#0c9b2064571f8f7c-->
  - `Script-level acceptance results` (heading) — Records the passing acceptance-criteria suites for the issue #260 discovery→analyze WS-freeze fix — boundary e2e, daemon cache/transition, server relay self-heal, and frontend fallback/scroll tests — plus a clean full-suite integration run (7327 passed) confirming no regressions. <!--#ba3f1f6b2ef472bb-->
  - `Manual browser verification (not an automated gate)` (heading) — Documents the by-hand WebUI checklist for the #260 discovery→analyze boundary fix (incremental analyze rendering, scroll anchoring, append-seq growth, WS-severed fallback), performed manually because this host lacks libnspr4.so for the Chromium e2e. <!--#42d4c1e033c9aae6-->
- `Worktree Multi-Round Discovery — Live Chat Loss After Round 1 (issue #278)` (heading) — Introduces issue #278 (now FIXED): in `luo run --worktree` flows, discovery chat records after round 1 vanished from the live web console and were only reachable via the show-details adjudication affordance. <!--#88ebffce5e77ad3b-->
  - `Symptom (as reported)#2` (heading) — Quotes the original user report (in Chinese) that in worktree tasks all discovery chat after round 1 disappeared, visible only through the adjudication show-details view. <!--#81464b9f74e8bb2a-->
  - `Root cause — an identity collision in the daemon read path` (heading) — Explains the root cause as a daemon read-path identity collision: multiple physical files folded under one step_id produced duplicate stepId#ordinal keys, reinforced by largest-copy-wins selection thrash desyncing the by-name cursor and a server cache self-heal that never re-queried the daemon. <!--#65972d2de8e837c1-->
  - `Fixes that landed (G1 daemon · G2 server · G3 frontend)` (heading) — Summarizes the three-layer fix: G1 gives each physical file its own stable frontend step id, prefers the worktree copy, and cleanly re-reads on copy switches; G2 relays the disambiguated identity verbatim and adds a running-worktree self-heal re-pull; G3 makes the frontend recordKey consume the disambiguated id and de-dup only byte-identical discovery records. <!--#130e49efe798db2f-->
  - `End-to-end acceptance (G4)` (heading) — Lists the automated acceptance coverage per hop (daemon read-path, server relay, frontend reconcile test suites) plus the new G4 end-to-end seam test chaining the real daemon reader, real server relay, and a faithful app.js reconcile port to prove every multi-round discovery round reaches the frontend losslessly. <!--#035778dee1a5abf3-->
  - `Full-suite regression run` (heading) — Records the full-suite regression result (7923 passed, 1 deselected, exit 0 in ~355s) confirming no #260 regression, with the deselected Chromium e2e and known environment-conditional failures explained as pre-existing. <!--#8090998ed34fc747-->
  - `Manual browser verification (not an automated gate)#2` (heading) — Documents the manual WebUI checklist for #278: run a real worktree discovery flow across several rounds and confirm every round's chat renders live (no show-details needed), the verdict appears as a normal bubble, and no round is doubled. <!--#64757af654f652c4-->

### `tests/ISSUE_209_FREEZE_DIAGNOSIS.md` (markdown) — G1 diagnosis document for issue #209 (WebUI conversation freeze on discovery→analyze and retry boundaries) that, grounded in a full-stack reproduction, localizes the root cause to the daemon's `_push_loop` being starved under large/busy roots by per-tick synchronous `engine.json` parsing and heavy awaited reads, then records candidate G2 fixes, G3 regression hooks, and the gated `SE3_HISTORY_DIAG` instrumentation G4 should remove. <!--#ce31c8fcf5960605|937cf4d0e4488f7a-->
- `issue #209 — WebUI console freeze on discovery→analyze / retry — G1 diagnosis` (heading) — Title/intro section stating the diagnosis is grounded in real reproduction and localizing the bug to the daemon push side rather than the frontend or server cache. <!--#5570eb393f47dc39-->
  - `Symptom (recap)` (heading) — Describes the observed symptom: the polled status bar keeps advancing while the WS-pushed conversation freezes until the session is exited and re-entered. <!--#c7aa4c30e5d9233d-->
  - `How it was坐实ed (reproductions, in order)` (heading) — Walks through the ordered chain of real reproductions and instrumentation proving each layer except the daemon push is correct. <!--#61b108926b1ebca6-->
  - `Root cause` (heading) — States the root cause: the daemon's `_push_loop` is starved under large/busy roots by per-tick synchronous engine.json parsing and per-iteration heavy awaited reads. <!--#124f112be7c6ef89-->
    - `Why specifically discovery→analyze and retry` (heading) — Explains why these two pause→resume boundaries manifest the freeze — the loaded daemon falls behind during the pause so the one post-resume incremental push never lands. <!--#4d5ac9e1a5a2edb3-->
  - `Trigger boundaries (the two the task asks to distinguish)` (heading) — Distinguishes the two triggers (new analyze jsonl vs. retry append to same jsonl) and notes a latent truncate/rewrite bug in `read_flow` not actually exercised by #209. <!--#c5a827852a521f2d-->
  - `Implications for G2 (fix) — recorded, not implemented here` (heading) — Lists candidate fix directions for the G2 group (cheapen per-tick change detection, decouple per-flow pushes, or a frontend poll-triggered reload workaround). <!--#12ed624429be8ce5-->
  - `Reproduction / regression hooks for G3` (heading) — Points to the repro script and fixtures G3 can use as before/after regression guards for the fix. <!--#faaf39a73b7ae25d-->
  - `Temporary instrumentation added in G1 (remove / demote in G4)` (heading) — Inventories the gated `SE3_HISTORY_DIAG` Python and frontend diagnostic logging added in G1 that G4 should remove or demote. <!--#fd95ca978ebdd59f-->

### `tests/WEBUI_HISTORY_HEAD_LOSS_DIAGNOSIS.md` (markdown) — A Chinese-language root-cause diagnosis report for the WebUI chat-history "head record permanently lost" bug in flow `20260714-122542_d4e052c5`, which rules out stale deployments, issue 288, and the renderer, pins the fault on a delivery-path chain (discarded appends still broadcast, silent bundle self-heal, cursor-less `history_data` frames) that lets the progress token reach `o == total` so `not_modified` becomes an absorbing state, then lists the D1–D7 fix backlog, the forensic repro scripts, and G3's actual server-side fix log. <!--#5e6bf5d6693b5993|d04b6ba2bbfe361e-->
- `WebUI 聊天历史「头部记录永久丢失」根因诊断（G1）` (heading) — Root-cause diagnosis report (produced by the read-only G1 group, later extended with G3's fix log) for a WebUI bug where the first chat-history record of flow `20260714-122542_d4e052c5` is permanently invisible and never self-heals. <!--#d96f1148940bca69-->
  - `0. 结论摘要` (heading) — Executive summary table: this is a new defect (not stale code), issue 288 is unrelated and already fixed, the head record does exist server-side, and `not_modified` acts as an absorbing state that welds the gap in permanently. <!--#b4860b0ec271707d-->
  - `1. 部署面排查（任务 1）` (heading) — Deployment-surface audit proving all three delivery surfaces (daemon process, daemon-bundled app.js, and the app.js actually served from the remote host 192.168.1.10:4573) already carry commit e41a6a31, with no stale browser cache. <!--#10077380b99e1e13-->
    - `issue 288 的修复状态证据` (heading) — Evidence that issue 288's `tagStepType` InvalidCharacterError is already fixed by `sanitizeDomToken` and replays cleanly over the live flow's real records, so it has no causal link to the head-loss fault. <!--#d352d390bfef6589-->
  - `2. 投递路径根因诊断（任务 2）` (heading) — The core root-cause analysis of the delivery path, walking from ruling out the renderer through to the single causal chain that explains every piece of on-site evidence. <!--#5ccaecf9588f4d6b-->
    - `2.1 先排除「渲染丢失」` (heading) — Rules out the renderer: feeding the five real records into production `renderConversation` renders the head record correctly, so the head is genuinely absent from the client's record array rather than mis-displayed. <!--#1ef429ae24731958-->
    - `2.2 服务器侧确有头部` (heading) — Shows the server bundle really holds both records — `apply_history_frame` drops records and cursor together on a gap, and the on-site `cursor`/token `o=2` agree — so the head is retrievable and the daemon needs no change. <!--#c2ad15208231faf4-->
    - `2.3 协议的语义错位（核心）` (heading) — Identifies the central semantic mismatch: the progress token `o` is the server's self-signed count of what it sent, the client never reads `cursor` at all, and both WS append and REST early-return paths let the token advance without records actually landing. <!--#d59834c5bbdd1d20-->
    - `2.4 两个已确认的投递面缺陷（服务器侧）` (heading) — Documents three confirmed server-side delivery defects rooted in the inverted `suppress_broadcast` rule (ws.py:1417): discarded appends are still broadcast, the bundle-healing full frame is suppressed, and `history_data` frames carry no cursor or signature. <!--#4c35325010c2879c-->
    - `2.5 单一因果链（可解释现场全部证据）` (heading) — Lays out the single five-step causal chain — head leaves the delivery surface, bundle self-heals silently, client grows a headless tail, token advances to `o == total`, and the `not_modified` gate locks shut forever. <!--#e3bded1b93d224f1-->
    - `2.6 用生产代码实证的吸收态` (heading) — Empirically drives production `mergeHistoryResponse` to contrast scenario A (an offset-0 delta heals the hole) with scenario B (the on-site `not_modified` shape locks it in), proving the merge layer works and only gap *detection* is missing. <!--#5ede6619328ec9e8-->
  - `3. `/api/auth/me` 401 的影响（任务 3）` (heading) — Explains that the bootstrap 401 prevents `connect()` from ever opening the WS, so it is not the root cause but widens the loss window — and mandates that self-healing must work on the polling path alone. <!--#e41aa0abf871508a-->
  - `4. 待修项清单` (heading) — The fix backlog table assigning seven defects (D1–D7) to the client group G4 or the server group G3, noting the daemon needs no change, plus a non-blocking side finding about a stale test fixture assumption. <!--#362ab0800d0f9af7-->
  - `5. 复现与取证脚本` (heading) — The copy-pasteable shell and node commands used to gather the deployment evidence and to reproduce the absorbing state against the production app.js without a browser. <!--#05783db6f2c483ea-->
  - `6. 对修复设计的确认` (heading) — Endorses the decided fix (client-side self-audit via `recordKey = stepId#ordinal` against the cursor, backfilling missing ordinals) while insisting D4/D5/D6 be genuinely fixed rather than papered over by backfill traffic. <!--#13ea05c986dd3c7e-->
  - `7. G3 实修记录（投递路径）` (heading) — Log of G3's actual server-side fixes for the three delivery defects D4/D5/D6, plus the re-confirmation that the daemon side needs no change. <!--#8d649b5b2a22c77b-->
    - `7.1 D6 — 被 DISCARD 的 append 仍被广播（**头部丢失的产生点**）` (heading) — Fix for the defect that actually creates the hole: `suppress_broadcast` now also requires `applied`, so records the server itself rejected are no longer pushed to the UI, with named regression tests. <!--#cf82076bb4670de8-->
    - `7.2 D5 — 修好 bundle 的 full 帧被抑制，UI 无人知晓` (heading) — Fix that keeps suppressing the recovery full frame's records but adds a record-free `history_cursor` advisory (`_push_history_cursor`) so the UI learns the bundle changed and can backfill without a full rebuild. <!--#21331377ec57e662-->
    - `7.3 D4 — `history_data` 帧不含 cursor` (heading) — Fix making `_push_history_data` attach the post-apply authoritative `cursor` and `signature` sourced from the new `ServerState.get_history_bundle_meta`, so the push and polling surfaces can never disagree about what the client should hold. <!--#5101b991af4936b3-->
    - `7.4 daemon 侧：已核实无需改动` (heading) — Positive evidence — not mere reliance on backfill — that the daemon never loses the head: cursor and records are discarded atomically, the on-site signals agree, and an end-to-end test shows the recovery full reply carries `[HEAD, TAIL]`. <!--#7457df2f79ab95b1-->

### `tests/WEBUI_HISTORY_HEAD_LOSS_VERIFICATION.md` (markdown) — Verification report (G6) for the WebUI chat-history head-loss defect in flow `20260714-122542_d4e052c5`, laying out the root cause (a discarded first-seen `append` frame plus a self-attested progress token that makes `not_modified` permanent), how the fix in `ws.py` / `state.py` / `app.py` / `static/app.js` cuts that chain via authoritative cursors and client-side backfill, the deployment-surface audit ruling out stale code, the full test results (8169 passed) and new regression suites, the unrelated status of issue 288, the remaining user-side field re-test, and the change manifest. <!--#1cb855ec9895069f|f39141214114207d-->
- `WebUI 聊天历史「头部记录永久丢失」修复验证报告（G6）` (heading) — Top-level verification report (G6) for the WebUI chat-history "first record permanently lost" defect seen in flow `20260714-122542_d4e052c5`, stating conclusions, evidence index, and test results while deferring raw forensics to the sibling `WEBUI_HISTORY_HEAD_LOSS_DIAGNOSIS.md`. <!--#6ee8d4f53bcee207-->
  - `0. 结论摘要` (heading) — A summary table answering the key questions: the fault is a new delivery-surface defect (not stale code), the head record does exist server-side, the loss is permanent because progress tokens are self-attested and `cursor` was never read, and issue 288 is unrelated. <!--#fd93f239c2bd50f2-->
  - `1. 根因结论` (heading) — Root-cause section holding the causal chain, the mapping to on-site evidence, how the fix cuts the chain, and the finding that the daemon side needs no change. <!--#abfbd1274ee6d145-->
    - `1.1 因果链（可解释现场全部证据）` (heading) — Four-step causal chain: `ws.py:1417` broadcasts a first-seen `append` that `apply_history_frame` DISCARDed, the repairing recovery `full` frame is then suppressed, the client unconditionally swallows the progress token without storing records, and the resulting `token.offset == total` state makes `not_modified` a permanent absorbing state. <!--#a997bdcc2cafca11-->
    - `1.2 逐条对上现场证据` (heading) — Maps each observed artifact (invisible first message, `cursor: 2`, progress token `{g:1,o:2,v:1}`, `not_modified`, the `/api/auth/me` 401) onto a step of the causal chain, and rules out the renderer by replaying the flow's 5 real records through production `renderConversation`. <!--#27a7b586f050f191-->
    - `1.3 修复如何切断它` (heading) — Describes the fix at both the origin and the permanence mechanism — never broadcasting unapplied frames, adding a `history_cursor` announcement for suppressed fulls, carrying authoritative cursor+signature on `history_data` via `get_history_bundle_meta`, and moving the sync verdict to a client-side per-ordinal cursor self-check with `missing=`-keyed backfill, all keyed by `(view, flow, generation)` with `unfillable` retirement, unkeyable-bundle full upgrades, and a bounded backfill budget. <!--#6d531e1a244d8260-->
    - `1.4 daemon 侧：已核实无需改动` (heading) — Argues from evidence (append-branch discards record and cursor together, `cursor = 2` and token `o = 2` agree, and the end-to-end push-cursor test returning `[HEAD, TAIL]`) that the head was never lost in the daemon's read/assembly path, so `src/tianluo/daemon/` needs no change. <!--#00598e4defa105f6-->
  - `2. issue 288 修复状态结论` (heading) — Concludes that issue 288's `tagStepType` / `InvalidCharacterError` crash was already fixed by commit e41a6a31 (via `sanitizeDomToken`, covered by `step_type_token_safety.test.mjs`) and is causally unrelated to this head-loss defect, leaving the issue's status change to the user. <!--#1ccefb22dc0d05de-->
  - `3. 部署面排查结果（区分「旧代码未生效」与「新缺陷」）` (heading) — Deployment-surface audit showing the daemon process, its bundled `app.js`, the remote tianluo-server at `192.168.1.10:4573`, and browser ETag caching all already carry e41a6a31, proving the failure is a new defect rather than stale code. <!--#7726eb4f73523afd-->
  - `4. 测试范围与结果` (heading) — Test section listing the exact commands run and their raw results across new regression tests, regression subsets, the full suite, and known environmental failures. <!--#3dc6098da632ddf0-->
    - `4.1 新增回归测试` (heading) — Enumerates the new coverage — `history_cursor_backfill.test.mjs` (frontend cursor self-check, backfill, generation/surplus/unfillable/unkeyable fallbacks), `test_history_backfill.py` (server `missing` parsing and `backfill` delivery), and `test_history_push_cursor.py` (push-surface cursor parity) — with 27 passed and 914 node checks. <!--#a4c430be1f8ff78d-->
    - `4.2 回归子集` (heading) — Reports targeted regression runs (server/daemon, history/frontend/auth selections, 16 history & WS delivery modules, and `test_steps.py`) all passing, confirming the existing #209 / #287 / #288 defenses remain intact. <!--#43d5055212160dba-->
    - `4.3 全量套件` (heading) — Records the full-suite run `pytest tests/ src/tianluo/engine/ -q` finishing at 8169 passed, 1 skipped, 1 deselected in 371s with zero failures or errors. <!--#091320a042a501f1-->
    - `4.4 已知环境性失败（不计为回归）——本轮实际情况` (heading) — Notes that the known Chromium e2e case is deselected via `pyproject.toml` `addopts` and that the four usually-environmental `test_steps.py` failures did not reproduce this round, so no known-failure exemption was needed. <!--#935832c87598342f-->
  - `5. 待用户现场复测确认` (heading) — Lists the one acceptance item the task cannot close itself — the user must redeploy this branch to the daemon and tianluo-server, reopen the flow, confirm the first message renders first, and expect a single `missing=…` → `delivery: "backfill"` request before steady state. <!--#6914bd212f7020c6-->
  - `6. 变更清单` (heading) — Change manifest listing each touched file and its role — `ws.py`, `state.py`, `app.py`, `static/app.js` for the fix, three new test modules plus two updated ones, and the two markdown reports — noting `src/tianluo/daemon/` is unchanged. <!--#103ddef594b2a75d-->

### `tests/_authsrv.py` (python) — Shared pytest helpers for exercising the multi-tenant, fail-closed se3 server: build an app pre-seeded with an admin owner and issued daemon key (authed_app), log a TestClient in as that admin (login), craft an authenticated daemon HELLO frame (authed_hello), and read the next substantive server→daemon protocol frame past MSG_VIEWERS presence frames (recv_daemon_frame). <!--#8fc9765909c75440|1159119ad40ed780-->
- `authed_app` (function) — Test helper that builds a server app via create_app pre-seeded with an admin owner (local identity, password) and an issued daemon key, using a non-secure session cookie, and returns (app, daemon_key) while stashing the key and owner id on app.state for convenience. <!--#88c44d486c9bd0c0-->
- `login` (function) — Logs a TestClient in as the seeded admin via the login endpoint, persisting the session cookie in the client's jar. <!--#98934d9f117043f0-->
- `authed_hello` (function) — Test helper that constructs a JSON-encoded daemon HELLO message signed with the app's issued test daemon key, optionally overriding the advertised `protocol_version` so tests can exercise the server's legacy-peer branch. <!--#43c5fdfbe59d025e-->
- `recv_daemon_frame` (function) — Test helper that decodes the next substantive server→daemon protocol frame from a TestClient socket, skipping over MSG_VIEWERS presence frames so assertions can target a specific dispatched frame (SPAWN/RESPOND/INTERJECT/…). <!--#645c878b571ac89f-->

### `tests/conftest.py` (python) — Root pytest configuration for the test suite, providing autouse fixtures that isolate tests from the real environment — pinning the UI language to en-US, clearing config warning dedup state, stubbing out code-index refreshes, redirecting chat-history writes and the daemon home to temp dirs — plus browser-library path wiring for the headless-browser test. <!--#b4aae5ed93b6045e|23b804b5a1e9546a-->
- `_wire_browser_test_libs` (function) — Prepends the gitignored `.browser-libs/lib` directory to `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` (when present) so a child Chromium process can find userspace-installed system libraries during the headless-browser test. <!--#2fe4dfbf7269486e-->
- `_force_en_us_ui_language` (function) — An autouse fixture that pins the i18n UI language to en-US (via SE3_LANG plus singleton/cache resets) for every test so t()-rendered strings are deterministic English regardless of the repo's zh-CN config or host locale. <!--#92c74303da2ce623-->
- `_reset_config_warning_dedup_sets` (function) — A fixture that dynamically discovers and clears all `_warned_*_for` dedup sets in tianluo.config before and after each test so warning-deduplication state never leaks between tests. <!--#e94113238acf5f70-->
- `_pin_ui_language_en` (function) — A fixture that pins tianluo.i18n's process-wide active language to en-US (without touching SE3_LANG/locale env vars) so CLI-output substring assertions stay deterministic, resetting the singleton afterward. <!--#0d13e40e1283ecd2-->
- `_no_real_code_index_refresh` (function) — A fixture that monkeypatches context_builder.ensure_code_index_fresh to a no-op so unit tests never trigger a real, flock-taking, LLM-summarising incremental code-index build against the live repo. <!--#d84ac4c91871a192-->
- `_real_history_roots` (function) — Returns the set of real repository/CWD root paths that chat-history writes must never leak into, used as the reroute trigger for the history guard. <!--#ab53de7897d04069-->
- `_install_chat_history_guard` (function) — A helper that monkeypatches chat_history._history_dir (and state_machine's import-time copy) to reroute any chat-history read/write targeting a real repo root into a per-test tmp dir, covering all record_* writers at their single path-resolution point. <!--#a358414a82331644-->
- `_no_chat_history_leak_to_real_repo` (function) — A fixture (twin of the engine-package conftest one) that installs the chat-history guard so no test can append into the committed tianluo/history/ directory. <!--#eb58972c78bcface-->
- `_isolate_se3_daemon_home` (function) — A fixture that redirects the daemon's SE3 home via SE3_DAEMON_DIR to a tmp dir and sets SE3_EXTERNAL_SCAN_IGNORE=1 so tests and their subprocesses never touch the real ~/.se3/ and their fake `se3 run` stubs stay invisible to a fixed resident daemon's external scan. <!--#8525207b50b34e7c-->

### `tests/repro_issue_209_freeze.py` (python) — A standalone, self-run acceptance harness (not collected by pytest) that reproduces the issue-#209 WebUI freeze by standing up a real isolated se3 server/daemon/project/fake-agent plus a /ws/ui WebSocket client, driving the discovery→analyze transition under selectable daemon load (--clean/--loaded/--heavy-root), and asserting whether the analyze append reaches the browser to prove the freeze is daemon push-loop starvation under load. <!--#5750566fbee0e238|886835cc487d4d30-->
- `_free_port` (function) — Helper that grabs an unused TCP port by binding to port 0 and returning the OS-assigned number. <!--#171e93bcd41a6242-->
- `_poll` (function) — Generic retry helper that repeatedly calls a function until it returns truthy or attempts are exhausted, swallowing exceptions between tries. <!--#e08f25e336db03f8-->
- `_synth_heavy_root` (function) — Test fixture helper that synthesises a deliberately heavy tianluo project root under `base` (a ~1MB `engine.json`, a busy multi-MB active flow, and ~300 history-only dirs) to recreate the daemon push-loop starvation load behind the issue-#209 WebUI freeze. <!--#a802339a8be63d55-->
- `run` (function) — The harness's main driver that stands up a fully isolated live stack (server, daemon, `tianluo init` project, fake agent), optionally adds a heavy root when `loaded`, connects a `/ws/ui` WebSocket browser stand-in, and collects `history_data` frames to assert whether the discovery→analyze append crosses the wire, returning an exit code. <!--#a1d7733a5461e7b1-->
- `main` (function) — CLI entry point that parses --clean/--loaded/--heavy-root/--wait-after flags and invokes run() with the chosen daemon-load configuration. <!--#745c2467c7705ab4-->

### `tests/test_active_flow_signature_group_status.py` (python) — End-to-end tests verifying that appending a group_status NDJSON line to a flow's per-step history jsonl shifts DaemonHistoryReader.active_flow_signature's change-detection token (via the byte-size component of its (name, mtime, size) fingerprint) for active flows but not terminal ones, locking in the behavior that drives live per-group status pushes to the web console. <!--#5572a9a25c9edb88|796bce7e264dcc62-->
- `_make_reader` (function) — Helper that constructs a DaemonHistoryReader whose project-roots provider yields the given test root. <!--#642397a307e5d24c-->
- `_write_active_engine` (function) — Test helper that writes a minimal active `tianluo/state/engine.json` (with `flow_id` and `status`) under the given root so the flow registers as active. <!--#6ff9050138bf3327-->
- `_seed_step_jsonl` (function) — Test helper that seeds a per-step history jsonl at `tianluo/history/<flow_id>/<step_id>.jsonl` with one assistant chat line and returns its path. <!--#0ab13c7be379ba6c-->
- `test_group_status_append_shifts_active_flow_signature` (function) — Asserts that recording a group_status line changes the active flow's signature token. <!--#9df023d23d7f3597-->
- `test_group_status_shifts_signature_via_size_even_without_mtime_change` (function) — Asserts the signature still moves on a group_status append when mtime is pinned back, proving the byte-size fingerprint component alone shifts the token. <!--#bbf0217bbee97ef4-->
- `test_first_group_status_creates_jsonl_and_shifts_signature` (function) — Test asserting that the first `record_group_status` call creates the previously-absent implement-step jsonl, causing the flow's `active_flow_signature()` to change from its file-absent state. <!--#acd240c7a1806316-->
- `test_terminal_flow_excluded_from_signature` (function) — Asserts a terminal (COMPLETED) flow is excluded from the signature, documenting that live-status pushes only apply to active flows. <!--#8b76e41afd914635-->

### `tests/test_adjudicate_integration.py` (python) — End-to-end integration tests for the fix-loop adjudication ("警察") mechanism, driving the real state machine and the real SELF_CHECK/ADJUDICATE handlers (only the LLM mocked) to prove that self-contradictory task descriptions oscillate into ADJUDICATE within two rounds, that the opt-in human confirmation gate lands or rejects a ruling's staged description/plan/ledger effects and reflows to a converging SELF_CHECK, that benign rulings are transparent no-ops, that the fingerprint ledger survives a --resume State round-trip, that the periodic backstop forces adjudication every N iterations, and that one ruling's covered_surfaces sweep resolves homomorphic sister surfaces at once while leaving uncovered surfaces to trigger their own adjudication. <!--#dfe2cac3af373380|183576cf2494e76c-->
- `_clear_test_running_env` (function) — Pytest fixture that pops SE3_TEST_RUNNING for the duration of a test and restores it afterward, honoring the recursion-guard convention for failure-asserting flows. <!--#6d9e285d42211f37-->
- `_cfg` (function) — Helper that builds a WorkflowConfig tuned for adjudication tests (defer-off, immediate fix) with optional field overrides. <!--#c999c4979f32a059-->
- `_make_sm` (function) — Test helper that constructs a `StateMachine` with `PersistenceManager` patched out and stubs `_get_workflow_config`/`_get_self_check_passes_required` so tests can drive it with a fixed config and single self-check pass. <!--#1de83af53718c3a0-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Helper that builds a RUNNING FlowInstance parked just past a COMPLETED IMPLEMENT+TEST and ready for SELF_CHECK, returning the flow and those two steps. <!--#a237c9e492503f7f-->
- `_issue` (function) — Helper that builds a SELF_CHECK issue dict (severity, expected/actual behavior, verbatim task-description quote, evidence lines) for driving oscillation scenarios. <!--#ada8f1bd38022c9b-->
- `_new_self_check` (function) — Helper that assembles a fresh PENDING SELF_CHECK step via the real input assembler, injects the changed-file set, and makes it the flow's current step. <!--#2a81a3987e666df4-->
- `_run_self_check` (function) — Test helper that invokes `self_check_handler` with `LLMCaller` mocked to return a canned issues/summary (and optional prior resolutions) payload, then mirrors the executor by writing the returned status back onto the step. <!--#41dec7e4fea03526-->
- `_run_adjudicate` (function) — Test helper that invokes `adjudicate_handler` with `LLMCaller` mocked to return a canned ruling, then writes the returned status back onto the step. <!--#7242d79f7253190b-->
- `TestConfirmationGate` (class) — Test class proving that an unregistered adjudicate confirmation (no `confirmation.steps.adjudicate` entry) auto-passes without inserting a CONFIRM gate, reflowing straight to SELF_CHECK against the adjudicated text. <!--#c04272d1e29f37d6-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate._drive_to_desc_ruling` (method) — Helper that drives the state machine through two oscillating SELF_CHECK rounds into ADJUDICATE, applies a description-rewrite ruling, and returns the COMPLETED ADJUDICATE step with its gate still unresolved. <!--#a594e861e96a87f0-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_unregistered_adjudicate_auto_passes_without_confirm` (method) — Test that a description-rewriting ruling with `resolve_confirm_inputs` returning None auto-passes: no CONFIRM step is ever inserted, the adjudicated text takes force at self-check pass #1, and the staged ledger abolition is applied. <!--#b573c1d127cace28-->
- `TestContradictionConverges` (class) — Test class verifying that two oscillating SELF_CHECK rounds route to ADJUDICATE and that an approved (or rejected) human-gated ruling correctly lands (or withholds) its ledger side effects and converges the flow. <!--#f5a946d610f94857-->
  - `TestContradictionConverges.test_oscillation_triggers_adjudicate_within_two_rounds_and_converges` (method) — End-to-end test that a same-position expectation flip across two SELF_CHECK rounds triggers ADJUDICATE, a human-approved ruling stages then applies its abolition, the dead clause is dropped by the source-pool switch, and the flow converges through COMMIT to terminal COMPLETED. <!--#f292c722fae5f47b-->
  - `TestContradictionConverges.test_still_valid_issue_after_ruling_stays_in_fix_loop` (method) — Test that a post-ruling issue grounded on the surviving clause stays in the normal IMPLEMENT→TEST→SELF_CHECK fix loop, proving the landed ruling stripped its inserted ADJUDICATE/CONFIRM slots so the cycle doesn't crash or re-enter a spurious adjudication. <!--#1aae4fc28e03defd-->
  - `TestContradictionConverges.test_rejected_ruling_does_not_land_ledger_effects` (method) — Test that a human rejection re-runs the SAME ADJUDICATE without landing the rejected ruling's abolition on the ledger, and that only a subsequent approved re-ruling applies the staged side effects. <!--#400664efc0960a73-->
- `TestResumeContinuity` (class) — Test class verifying the cross-round adjudication ledger survives a --resume State serialization boundary. <!--#0d6d56621780c6b3-->
  - `TestResumeContinuity.test_ledger_accumulates_across_resume_boundary` (method) — Test that records one oscillation round, round-trips State through to_dict/from_dict, and confirms a second post-resume round at the same position still trips the adjudicator with round_count==2. <!--#48dbc4077dd5760e-->
- `TestPeriodicBackstop` (class) — Test class covering the every-N-iteration periodic backstop that forces ADJUDICATE (and the below-period case that does not). <!--#d8bf9e7e38b6cb48-->
  - `TestPeriodicBackstop.test_backstop_forces_adjudicate_every_n_iterations` (method) — Test that with no oscillation signal but the fix-iteration counter at the configured period, a SELF_CHECK REVISION_NEEDED routes to ADJUDICATE and rebases the period baseline. <!--#5447c195fd67a736-->
  - `TestPeriodicBackstop.test_below_period_stays_on_fix_loop` (method) — Test that below the configured adjudicate period a single non-oscillating issue stays on the normal IMPLEMENT fix loop without inserting ADJUDICATE. <!--#ee98d61d6bfc7c28-->
- `TestBenignNoop` (class) — End-to-end integration test class verifying that when an oscillation trips ADJUDICATE but the LLM rules the flagged position benign (a review_divergence, not a real spec contradiction), ADJUDICATE acts as a transparent no-op that passes the triggering round's fix_instructions untouched into IMPLEMENT. <!--#92e237cea93403ce-->
  - `TestBenignNoop.test_oscillation_then_benign_ruling_passes_through_to_implement` (method) — Drives a two-round self-check oscillation into ADJUDICATE and asserts that a benign ruling leaves the flow as if ADJUDICATE never ran — pending fix_instructions flow straight to IMPLEMENT, no extra fix iteration, issue left intact, supersede/override outputs absent — with only two mechanical effects surviving: the ADJUDICATE slot is stripped and the benign position lands in the ledger's rejected_positions (baseline reset unchanged). <!--#585657a88d42690a-->
- `_make_cold_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a RUNNING FlowInstance on the hot/cold-split task, pre-populated with COMPLETED PLAN/IMPLEMENT/TEST steps so it sits parked in the fix loop just before SELF_CHECK. <!--#fa6cb58254fd5353-->
- `_new_cold_self_check` (function) — Test helper that constructs and registers a fresh PENDING SELF_CHECK step (built via the state machine's step inputs) whose changed-file set spans all three contended surfaces, making it the flow's current step. <!--#3758df24250ec945-->
- `_complete_implement` (function) — Test helper that marks an IMPLEMENT step COMPLETED with all surface files listed as changed. <!--#83aef1ba116ca7c7-->
- `_adjudicate_steps` (function) — Test helper returning every ADJUDICATE step recorded in a flow's state, used to assert how many rulings were actually inserted. <!--#701d566b053e4e5d-->
- `TestHomomorphicSurfaceSweep` (class) — Integration tests for the "homomorphic surface sweep" property: a single ADJUDICATE ruling on one oscillating clause pair covers every surface the boundary clause claims (recording them in `covered_surfaces`), so the swept sister surface never triggers a second adjudication, while surfaces the sweep did not claim still raise their own independent ruling. <!--#87fd6de5174fa6f3-->
  - `TestHomomorphicSurfaceSweep._oscillate_cold_surface` (method) — Suite helper that drives two SELF_CHECK rounds with opposing issues on the cold-step-file surface to provoke — and return — the resulting ADJUDICATE step. <!--#ffb049f75094499a-->
  - `TestHomomorphicSurfaceSweep.test_one_ruling_covers_both_surfaces_and_sister_never_retriggers` (method) — Drives a full oscillate → ADJUDICATE → reflow cycle to assert that one swept ruling rewrites the effective description, records both covered surfaces with justifications, drops later contradicting issues on the sister surface as ungrounded quotes (never reaching the ledger), and lets the flow converge to COMMIT with exactly one ADJUDICATE step. <!--#2493d2f7a8ead79e-->
  - `TestHomomorphicSurfaceSweep.test_uncovered_surface_still_triggers_its_own_adjudication` (method) — Test that a surface the sweep did NOT claim (the engine.json cache/freshness pair) is self-healing: its own evidence oscillates and raises a SECOND independent ADJUDICATE that lands through the unchanged patch path. <!--#7c7d0cd127fc96e8-->
  - `TestHomomorphicSurfaceSweep.test_uncovered_surface_benign_ruling_passes_through` (method) — Test the no-op branch of the self-healing path: when the un-swept surface's ruling is a review_divergence, it writes no boundary clause or covered_surfaces, the triggering round's fix_instructions flow straight into IMPLEMENT, and the position is merely recorded rejected. <!--#f9e8b445d167455d-->

### `tests/test_agent_config.py` (python) — Unit tests for tianluo.config's agent-configuration loading, covering load_agents() resolution of built-in defaults, the agents registry, legacy claude_commands migration, project-over-global precedence, ordering/priority deprecation, and the backward-compatible load_claude_commands() shim. <!--#ace80bfad80e89d9|f6494d298abfc18b-->

- `TestLoadAgents` (class) — Test class exercising load_agents() across config scenarios: built-in defaults, the agents registry with explicit/implicit llm_caller.defaults, legacy claude_commands migration, project-over-global override, written-order preservation, priority deprecation warnings, string-entry normalization, default type, and unknown-name errors. <!--#f4c55e0e07dcdfc2-->

  - `TestLoadAgents.test_agents_takes_priority_over_claude_commands` (method) — Verifies that when both agents and claude_commands are present, the modern agents registry wins (and a warning is emitted). <!--#1e4e681baade6c17-->

  - `TestLoadAgents.test_registry_without_defaults_uses_built_in` (method) — Verifies a registry with no explicit defaults and no legacy claude_commands falls back to the PATH-probed built-in candidates (pinned to just 'claude'). <!--#b7b9e250a9e24525-->

### `tests/test_agent_registry.py` (python) — Unit test module for tianluo.config's agent registry, covering the modern `agents:` mapping form, entry-level global/project merging, rejection of non-mapping `agents:` values, migration of the deprecated `claude_commands:` list (with deprecation warnings and cmd-collision suffixing), the `_slugify_cmd` name helper, and the `AgentDef` model's defaults, serialization, and preservation of `provider`/`model` through chain resolution. <!--#fcbb0439ecd669fc|f1331f8ca98023d7-->
- `_reset_module_caches` (function) — Autouse fixture that clears tianluo.config's one-time warning-dedup caches before and after each test for isolation. <!--#30213047cfc78bde-->
- `_no_global` (function) — Test helper returning a `patch` context manager that stubs `tianluo.config.Path.home` to `tmp_path`, isolating the call under test from the host's global config. <!--#1b173b609bafd55d-->
- `TestDictForm` (class) — Test class covering the modern mapping (`agents:`) form of the registry: basic dict entries, bare-string entries treated as `cmd`, entries lacking `cmd` being skipped with a warning, and empty registries falling back to the probed built-in chain. <!--#64aeba8c5a9ec176-->
  - `TestDictForm.test_basic_dict_registry` (method) — Asserts that a two-entry `agents:` mapping loads both agents with correct `cmd`/`priority` and the default `type` of `claude-code`. <!--#b66610b8e773de60-->
  - `TestDictForm.test_registry_with_string_entry` (method) — Asserts that a bare-string agent entry is interpreted as its `cmd` with a default `priority` of 0. <!--#f8de4bf1fd4fee27-->
  - `TestDictForm.test_entry_without_cmd_is_skipped` (method) — Asserts that an agent entry lacking a `cmd` is dropped from the registry and logs a "no usable 'cmd'" warning while valid entries remain. <!--#760657fe34d1c70d-->
  - `TestDictForm.test_empty_registry_does_not_raise` (method) — Asserts that an empty `agents: {}` yields an empty registry without error and that `load_agents` falls back to the probed built-in chain (pinning `shutil.which` to only find `claude`). <!--#02da136b2ff49e69-->
- `TestEntryLevelMerge` (class) — Test class verifying entry-level merging of global and project agent configs. <!--#23284e8f30b92324-->

  - `TestListFormIgnored.test_list_agents_warned_and_ignored` (method) — Asserts that a list-form `agents:` produces an empty registry and an "'agents' is a list" warning. <!--#449c01a49e641985-->
  - `TestListFormIgnored.test_scalar_agents_warned_and_ignored` (method) — Asserts that a scalar `agents:` value produces an empty registry and a "not a mapping" warning. <!--#ae8cbc1ab854a24a-->
- `TestClaudeCommandsLegacyMigration` (class) — Test class covering migration of the deprecated `claude_commands:` list into the new `agents` registry, including deprecation warnings, cmd-collision suffixing, chain ordering, and precedence when both keys are present. <!--#21bf139c69154f99-->
  - `TestClaudeCommandsLegacyMigration.test_legacy_migration_creates_registry_and_defaults` (method) — Asserts that legacy `claude_commands` are migrated into named registry entries and that a deprecation warning emits the new-schema equivalent (`agents:`, `llm_caller:`, `defaults:`). <!--#60e4e3191031fb81-->
  - `TestClaudeCommandsLegacyMigration.test_legacy_cmd_collision_adds_suffix` (method) — Asserts that duplicate legacy `cmd` values are de-duplicated into distinct registry keys via numeric suffixes (`claude`, `claude_2`, `claude_3`). <!--#aa4c713d9f9af31d-->
  - `TestClaudeCommandsLegacyMigration.test_legacy_defaults_chain_feeds_load_agents` (method) — Asserts that with only `claude_commands` present, `load_agents` builds the chain in legacy list order, ignoring `priority`. <!--#28aa67ddc0c70352-->
  - `TestClaudeCommandsLegacyMigration.test_claude_commands_ignored_when_agents_present` (method) — Asserts that when both `agents` and `claude_commands` exist, the legacy list is ignored (with a warning) and only the modern `agents` entries load. <!--#a69eaaaa41dace69-->
- `TestSlugify` (class) — Tests the _slugify_cmd helper used to derive agent names from command strings. <!--#3d00f16e0b92713e-->
  - `TestSlugify.test_preserves_alphanum_hyphen_underscore` (method) — Asserts alphanumerics, hyphens, and underscores are preserved unchanged by slugification. <!--#e3a4e98edaecda12-->
  - `TestSlugify.test_replaces_other_chars` (method) — Asserts spaces and other characters are replaced with underscores during slugification. <!--#42c4604224c7f919-->
  - `TestSlugify.test_empty_fallback` (method) — Asserts an empty cmd string slugifies to the fallback name 'agent'. <!--#583df70d959c668c-->
- `TestAgentDef` (class) — Test class covering the `AgentDef` model — its `to_agent_dict()` serialization shape, field defaults, and the survival of `provider`/`model` fields through registry loading and agent-chain resolution. <!--#98d6cd86b5b5416e-->
  - `TestAgentDef.test_to_agent_dict_shape` (method) — Asserts AgentDef.to_agent_dict produces a dict with name, type, cmd, and priority keys. <!--#3ee0413101234f5c-->
  - `TestAgentDef.test_defaults` (method) — Asserts that an `AgentDef` built with only `name` and `cmd` defaults to `type="claude-code"`, `priority=0`, and `None` for `provider` and `model`. <!--#48cf8c3a43a83a35-->
  - `TestAgentDef.test_provider_and_model_survive_registry_resolution` (method) — Writes a `tianluo.yaml` with an agent declaring `provider` and `model`, then checks that both `load_agent_registry()` and `load_agents()` preserve those fields (including an unexpanded `$ANTHROPIC_MODEL` placeholder) in the resolved registry and agent chain. <!--#62452ce4c7e26387-->

### `tests/test_agent_runner.py` (python) — Unit tests for the `tianluo.agent_runner` module's interface contract, covering the `InfraErrorType` enum values, `RunResult` dataclass defaults and custom fields, and the `AgentRunner` ABC's abstract-method enforcement plus `get_startup_metadata()` derivation from declared runner attributes. <!--#cd6670ffc2d38b7e|2c3e3764c8007040-->
- `TestInfraErrorType` (class) — Test class covering the InfraErrorType enum's values and membership. <!--#6f87c3f3e6eacbc9-->

  - `TestInfraErrorType.test_enum_has_five_members` (method) — Asserts InfraErrorType defines exactly five members. <!--#1ef05bdb298b4936-->
- `TestRunResult` (class) — Test class covering the RunResult dataclass's defaults and custom field assignment. <!--#36166d0b48937901-->
  - `TestRunResult.test_default_values` (method) — Verifies RunResult's default field values when only returncode is given. <!--#2e04b19b76440033-->
  - `TestRunResult.test_custom_values` (method) — Verifies RunResult correctly stores explicitly provided field values. <!--#9896ea77bd63e724-->
- `TestAgentRunnerABC` (class) — Test class verifying the `AgentRunner` abstract base class contract — that it cannot be instantiated directly, that subclasses omitting any of `run`, `run_with_monitor`, or `detect_infra_error` raise `TypeError`, that a complete subclass instantiates, and that `get_startup_metadata()` returns `RunnerStartupMetadata` from the subclass's declared `startup_provider`/`startup_model`. <!--#88de824b3dcd3a8e-->
  - `TestAgentRunnerABC.test_cannot_instantiate_directly` (method) — Asserts the abstract AgentRunner cannot be instantiated directly. <!--#8faf204ab902152d-->
  - `TestAgentRunnerABC.test_subclass_missing_run` (method) — Asserts a subclass omitting run() cannot be instantiated. <!--#ab88f109c715b0aa-->
  - `TestAgentRunnerABC.test_subclass_missing_run_with_monitor` (method) — Asserts a subclass omitting run_with_monitor() cannot be instantiated. <!--#041cb90baf849ed3-->
  - `TestAgentRunnerABC.test_subclass_missing_detect_infra_error` (method) — Asserts a subclass omitting detect_infra_error() cannot be instantiated. <!--#a09e8ebac4c62bbb-->
  - `TestAgentRunnerABC.test_complete_subclass_can_instantiate` (method) — Asserts that a subclass implementing all required `AgentRunner` methods (`run`, `run_with_monitor`, `detect_infra_error`, `build_call_args`) can be instantiated and is an instance of `AgentRunner`. <!--#1bbf36b8470eba92-->
  - `TestAgentRunnerABC.test_startup_metadata_uses_explicit_runner_contract` (method) — Asserts that a concrete runner declaring startup_provider/startup_model class attributes has get_startup_metadata() return exactly the matching RunnerStartupMetadata. <!--#91b49016e9c1b9c7-->

### `tests/test_aggregator_calls.py` (python) — Regression tests for DaemonAggregator._enumerate_calls verifying that only genuinely-unanswered confirm calls in tianluo/calls/ are reported as pending while answered calls and their .response/.response.json answer files are filtered out, plus the missing-directory case. <!--#d1f161459f7f85db|a69303f91454009e-->
- `_write` (function) — Test helper that creates parent directories and writes a JSON-serialized payload to the given path. <!--#65d03e595cacafc0-->
- `_make_calls_dir` (function) — Test helper that builds a project root with a populated `tianluo/calls/` directory containing one unanswered confirm call and two answered ones (with `.response` and `.response.json` siblings) for exercising pending-call filtering. <!--#dd01b84d67de7aa7-->
- `test_enumerate_calls_skips_answered_and_response_files` (function) — Asserts that only the unanswered call is returned, with the correct 'call' kind and project_root. <!--#5d161e6fb870febe-->
- `test_enumerate_calls_does_not_emit_response_files` (function) — Asserts that no .response or .response.json answer files are ever returned as pending calls. <!--#96cb5212249b1b59-->

- `test_enumerate_calls_missing_dir` (function) — Asserts that enumeration returns an empty list when the tianluo/calls/ directory does not exist. <!--#8a0dab84a09c040d-->

### `tests/test_analyze_step_config.py` (python) — Regression tests verifying that analyze._update_flow_steps preserves the summarize step (whether a default or configured via tianluo.yaml steps.append), placing it exactly once at the end of selected_steps after rebuilding the step sequence. <!--#db1a4543201309d5|1a55266e3b3b7f8b-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a feature FlowInstance whose change_path.parent resolves to the given project_root so _update_flow_steps can derive the project root. <!--#623346f26f38582c-->
- `test_update_flow_steps_keeps_appended_summarize` (function) — Regression test asserting that a `summarize` step configured via `tianluo.yaml`'s `steps.append` survives `analyze._update_flow_steps`' step-sequence rebuild and remains appended at the end. <!--#18372a8b76b457b5-->
- `test_update_flow_steps_no_duplicate_append` (function) — Verifies that `_update_flow_steps` adds the appended `SUMMARIZE` step exactly once, never duplicating it after the analyze rebuild. <!--#d8930db4414fa220-->
- `test_update_flow_steps_summarize_present_without_config` (function) — Asserts summarize, being a default step, still survives the rebuild as a single trailing entry even with no steps.append config. <!--#02fb3a7d0f8f45ec-->
- `test_update_flow_steps_append_summarize_noop` (function) — Confirms that, now that `summarize` is a default step, configuring `steps.append: [summarize]` is a no-op, leaving a single `SUMMARIZE` entry at the end of the selected steps. <!--#8919ccc9555135d5-->

### `tests/test_annotation_resolvability.py` (python) — A defensive test module that guards every `*.py` file in the package against unresolvable type annotations, combining static AST checks (no annotation references an unbound name; no eagerly-evaluated annotation needs a newer Python than the `requires-python` floor) with subprocess-based runtime probes that import modules and force-evaluate their real `__annotations__`, plus meta-guards ensuring the skip list can't hollow out the coverage and that `tianluo-server` start-up-path modules are spot-checked. <!--#fded132f82c84475|388207761defb41c-->
- `_ast_nodes` (function) — Helper that resolves a list of `ast` node-class names to the subset that actually exists on the running interpreter, so newer-grammar node types can be referenced without breaking on older Pythons. <!--#1a30a19f23d29350-->
- `_python_files` (function) — Helper returning every `*.py` file under the package directory, sorted, as the file set all the guards iterate over. <!--#6ad6ff3f415bccc3-->
- `_declared_python_floor` (function) — Reads the `(major, minor)` lower bound out of `requires-python` in `pyproject.toml` by regex (not `tomllib`, which is 3.11+) so the guard runs on the floor it polices. <!--#dae23dd2e027d7e4-->
- `_subprocess_env` (function) — Builds the environment for the probe subprocesses, prepending the repo's `src` directory to `PYTHONPATH`. <!--#a02afe206074984d-->
- `_bound_names` (function) — Walks a parsed module and collects a deliberately over-broad set of every name it binds anywhere (assignments, imports, defs, args, handlers, match captures, type params), trading scope precision for zero false positives. <!--#6f09ee3dd5865f15-->
- `_annotation_expressions` (function) — Collects every annotation expression in a module at any nesting depth — including function-local `AnnAssign`, which never reaches `__annotations__` and so is invisible to the runtime layer. <!--#5292a9ca9704b116-->
- `_referenced_names` (function) — Extracts `(lineno, name)` pairs for the names an annotation expression looks up, taking only the leftmost part of dotted paths and ignoring string literals. <!--#3b857b8038ee3045-->
- `test_ast_annotations_reference_only_bound_names` (function) — Static guard asserting that no annotation in the package names something the module never binds and builtins don't provide, which would raise `NameError` when evaluated. <!--#b7def2c29ad180fc-->
- `_eagerly_evaluated_annotations` (function) — Collects only the annotations Python actually evaluates at import/definition time (signature and non-function-local `AnnAssign`, including class bodies nested in functions), the complement of the layer that policies names. <!--#6c787155691ea5fc-->
- `_required_version` (function) — Reports the minimum Python version each version-gated construct inside an annotation needs — PEP 604 `X | Y` unions (3.10) and PEP 585 builtin generics (3.9). <!--#333c5ead19b6ccf8-->
- `test_annotations_are_evaluable_on_declared_python_floor` (function) — Asserts no eagerly-evaluated annotation requires a newer Python than the declared `requires-python` floor, catching installs that pip allows but that raise `TypeError` on first import. <!--#b454c58071e3f9c2-->
- `test_runtime_annotations_evaluate_without_nameerror` (function) — Runs the `_RUNTIME_PROBE` subprocess to actually import every module and force-evaluate its real `__annotations__`, failing on any `NameError` or on import errors unrelated to a missing optional extra. <!--#3049697fcc6dac7f-->
- `test_runtime_layer_actually_covered_core_modules` (function) — Meta-guard asserting the runtime probe skipped fewer than half the package's modules, so an ever-growing skip list can't leave the suite green while checking nothing. <!--#8cbd01bf86fb8497-->
- `test_hot_path_module_annotations_evaluate` (function) — Parametrised spot-check that imports each `tianluo-server` start-up-path module in a subprocess and forces module- and class-level annotations, since a `NameError` there takes the whole entry point down. <!--#9e724274a4184f07-->

### `tests/test_breakglass_bootstrap.py` (python) — Tests for the break-glass bootstrap escape hatch (`tianluo.server.bootstrap` and the `tianluo-server bootstrap-token` CLI), covering one-time/reissuable/TTL'd token issuance that persists only the hash, the security baseline that the plaintext never reaches disk or logs, dependency isolation so the command works on a core-only install without the `[server]` extra, and the end-to-end seam where a CLI-minted token is consumed by a live server on the same sqlite file. <!--#7b8174d16bd59268|2122393ba9c40629-->
- `test_issue_returns_plaintext_and_persists_only_the_hash` (function) — Asserts issuance returns a `bg_`-prefixed plaintext plus id while storing only the hash, verified by consuming via the hash of the plaintext. <!--#60127117962037ca-->
- `test_issued_token_is_one_time` (function) — Asserts a token consumes successfully once and is rejected on replay. <!--#bccb5e6a317d68e8-->
- `test_issue_is_reissuable_with_distinct_tokens` (function) — Asserts repeated issuance yields distinct plaintexts/ids that remain independently consumable (re-issue does not revoke prior tokens). <!--#f3e8600a8526c4ec-->
- `test_issue_honours_ttl_expiry` (function) — Asserts a token with a past (negative) TTL is rejected by consume while a generously-TTL'd token is accepted. <!--#d7417d2f903eb507-->
- `test_print_reveals_token_once_to_the_stream` (function) — Asserts `print_breakglass_token` reveals the real, consumable secret exactly once on the provided console stream. <!--#256e30385ee1d555-->
- `test_plaintext_token_never_written_to_the_store_file` (function) — Asserts the plaintext token never appears in any sqlite artifact (db/WAL/SHM) on disk — only its SHA-256 hash. <!--#fd7f66b43c1af758-->
- `test_issuance_never_logs_the_plaintext` (function) — Asserts the plaintext reaches the console stream but never the logging output at DEBUG level. <!--#f3653838c1c5f487-->
- `test_cli_bootstrap_token_prints_token_and_exits_zero` (function) — Asserts `se3-server bootstrap-token --db-path` prints a `bg_`-prefixed break-glass token and exits 0, and that the minted token is consumable via `Store.consume_breakglass` on the same db file. <!--#74739c1ab396f74d-->
- `test_cli_bootstrap_token_is_reissuable` (function) — Verifies running `bootstrap-token` twice mints two distinct tokens, each independently consumable from the shared store. <!--#f30e84bafad39a09-->
- `_run_python` (function) — Helper that runs a Python snippet in a fresh subprocess with this worktree's `src` prepended to `PYTHONPATH`, capturing output. <!--#7c663f38919d0739-->
- `test_bootstrap_token_works_without_server_extra` (function) — Runs `bootstrap-token` in a subinterpreter that blocks importing fastapi/uvicorn/argon2/bcrypt, confirming the subcommand mints a token (exit 0, no traceback, no fastapi leak) on a core-only install. <!--#df8a723f8083afb0-->
- `test_server_version_works_without_server_extra` (function) — Confirms `se3-server --version` prints the version and exits 0 even when fastapi/uvicorn imports are blocked, since it is intercepted before the `[server]` extra import. <!--#c3dbe01bd26c44e7-->
- `test_core_modules_import_clean` (function) — Parametrized test asserting that importing core modules (e.g. `tianluo.cli` / `tianluo.daemon`) succeeds in a subinterpreter with no server extra present. <!--#0b5b0135a2114335-->
- `test_cli_token_is_consumable_by_a_server_on_the_same_db` (function) — Exercises the CLI→live-server seam: a CLI-minted token authenticates against a `TestClient` server on the same db via `POST /api/auth/breakglass` (200, admin session) and cannot be replayed (401). <!--#b150c5b5bbfef92f-->

### `tests/test_builtin_default_chain.py` (python) — Unit tests for tianluo.config's built-in agent-chain fallback, verifying that the default chain is built by probing PATH for supported agent commands (with priority renumbering, declared ordering, an informative error when none are installed, and exclusion of the opt-in claude-interactive variant), that probing never filters explicitly configured agents, and that the legacy claude-commands view never surfaces a non-Claude binary from the built-in chain. <!--#d5ded29225ddcc0e|d65ac39d0b99fdbc-->
- `_reset_module_caches` (function) — Test helper that clears tianluo.config's module-level 'already warned' caches so each test sees fresh deprecation/unknown-key warnings. <!--#0d4baf75d508c40f-->
- `_which_only` (function) — Test helper returning a patch of `tianluo.config.shutil.which` that resolves only the given command names to fake paths and returns None for all others, simulating a controlled PATH. <!--#8a6478f8c0c8fba7-->
- `_no_global` (function) — Test helper returning a patch of `tianluo.config.Path.home` to point at a temp dir, isolating tests from any real global (`~`) config. <!--#c0f125d562f6cd7a-->
- `TestBuiltinDefaultChain` (class) — Test class covering `_builtin_default_chain()`, verifying which built-in agents are selected based on which CLI commands are on PATH, that priorities are renumbered from 0, that declared order is preserved, that a helpful ValueError listing supported agents and both escape hatches is raised when none are available, and that `claude-interactive` is excluded from auto-selection. <!--#0db467636d66374d-->
  - `TestBuiltinDefaultChain.test_only_claude_available` (method) — Asserts that when only the `claude` command is on PATH, the built-in default chain contains exactly the single `claude` / `claude-code` / `anthropic` agent entry at priority 0. <!--#d1b7929a6765b60d-->
  - `TestBuiltinDefaultChain.test_only_codex_available` (method) — Asserts that when only `codex` is available, the chain contains just that `codex` / `openai` entry renumbered to priority 0 rather than left at its declared priority 1. <!--#6c93f3bd5aea12b7-->
  - `TestBuiltinDefaultChain.test_both_available_preserves_declared_order` (method) — Asserts that when both commands exist the chain keeps declared order claude-then-codex with priorities 0 and 1. <!--#12263a63d39d6bf3-->
  - `TestBuiltinDefaultChain.test_none_available_raises_listing_supported_agents` (method) — Asserts that with no agent command on PATH the chain raises a ValueError naming every supported agent and both escape hatches (install, or configure llm_caller.defaults). <!--#cf822fa6e7310402-->
  - `TestBuiltinDefaultChain.test_interactive_variant_is_not_a_builtin_candidate` (method) — Asserts claude-interactive is absent from the built-in candidate list because it needs a PTY and must be opted into explicitly. <!--#eb62b051d4165322-->
- `TestProbeAppliesToBuiltinBranchOnly` (class) — Test class asserting that PATH-based command probing filters only the level-4 built-in default chain, while explicitly-named default agents are always returned verbatim. <!--#361dbbdd753d6e04-->
  - `TestProbeAppliesToBuiltinBranchOnly.test_no_config_falls_through_to_probed_builtin` (method) — Verifies that with empty config the built-in chain probes PATH, yielding only `codex` when claude is absent and both `claude`+`codex` when both are present. <!--#9e5f32b21a6152e1-->
  - `TestProbeAppliesToBuiltinBranchOnly.test_explicit_defaults_are_never_probe_filtered` (method) — Verifies a user-named default agent is returned as written even when its command is nowhere on PATH, guarding against silently substituting a different agent. <!--#154e9fa389e0235c-->
- `TestLegacyClaudeCommandsNeverGetANonClaudeAgent` (class) — Test class ensuring `load_claude_commands` (Claude-CLI-only consumer) never emits a non-claude command from the built-in probe chain while still passing explicitly-named agents through. <!--#e437bbb5b4212532-->
  - `TestLegacyClaudeCommandsNeverGetANonClaudeAgent.test_builtin_codex_only_yields_no_claude_command` (method) — Verifies that when only `codex` is on PATH the legacy `load_claude_commands` view returns empty while the real `load_agents` chain still picks up codex. <!--#3cf3d48b4a432f4d-->
  - `TestLegacyClaudeCommandsNeverGetANonClaudeAgent.test_builtin_both_available_yields_claude_only` (method) — Verifies that with both commands available the legacy view yields only the claude command at priority 0. <!--#cfac299b8027caf6-->
  - `TestLegacyClaudeCommandsNeverGetANonClaudeAgent.test_explicit_codex_default_still_passes_through` (method) — Verifies an explicitly-configured codex default passes through `load_claude_commands` verbatim, confirming levels 1-3 are not filtered. <!--#c33abf3d5fde06ab-->

### `tests/test_charter.py` (python) — Unit tests for the code-index/charter subsystem, covering CodeIndexConfig defaults/overrides/exclude-parsing/fault-tolerance, charter loading and template rendering, the warn-not-block altitude admission gate, and the charter/code-index context-injection surface. <!--#e5efa04f459564c8|13d6941d8e41d456-->

### `tests/test_charter_anchored_patch.py` (python) — A unit-test matrix exercising the pure anchored-patch validator and applier in charter_freshness, covering accept paths (empty, unique replace, insert_after, multi-op, order-independence) and rejection paths (non-verbatim/ambiguous quotes, missing anchors, unknown ops, budget/removal/op-count bounds, overlaps, and type errors). <!--#1d7faedd561d9756|4f50bd375f8eb715-->
- `test_empty_patch_is_valid_and_candidate_equals_original` (function) — Asserts an empty op list validates successfully and applying it returns the charter unchanged. <!--#44369af0a82ecb5c-->
- `test_unique_replace_generates_candidate` (function) — Verifies a single unique-match replace op swaps the target line while leaving all other charter text intact. <!--#642de5288bef3b4e-->
- `test_insert_after_pure_insertion` (function) — Checks that an insert_after op anchored on the last line purely appends new text without removing any original content. <!--#06ea48cb20e30664-->
- `test_multiple_nonoverlapping_ops_apply_in_one_pass` (function) — Confirms multiple non-overlapping replace and insert ops all apply correctly in a single validation/apply pass. <!--#658daaba504b1283-->
- `test_apply_patch_is_order_independent_for_adjacent_insert_and_replace` (function) — Regression test ensuring a zero-width insert adjacent to a same-start replace yields identical output regardless of op order and never duplicates the removed span. <!--#bd1415b3ec022ade-->
- `test_replace_quote_not_on_disk_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures a replace whose old_text is absent from the charter is rejected with a verbatim-quote error. <!--#be43e4fcf937fde6-->
- `test_replace_quote_matching_multiple_places_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures a replace whose old_text matches more than one location is rejected for non-uniqueness. <!--#30ab01e6f74c4aa5-->
- `test_insert_after_anchor_not_found_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures an insert_after op whose anchor text does not exist is rejected with an anchor error. <!--#6f5c71ea852d79c2-->
- `test_insert_after_ambiguous_anchor_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures an insert_after op whose anchor matches multiple places is rejected for non-uniqueness. <!--#e2030ef3813af834-->
- `test_unknown_op_kind_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures an op with an unrecognized kind (e.g. 'delete') is rejected as an unknown op. <!--#aeb2c0a04b1f3e85-->
- `test_missing_old_text_on_replace_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures a replace op lacking the required old_text field is rejected. <!--#8f8c2e9ec8748e18-->
- `test_over_char_budget_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures new_text exceeding the maximum added-character budget is rejected for adding too much text. <!--#f8d9e121644547dc-->
- `test_mass_removal_behind_short_replacement_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures a replace that deletes a huge region behind a tiny replacement is caught by the removed-character bound. <!--#20d47c5711869e53-->
- `test_too_many_ops_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures a patch exceeding the maximum allowed number of operations is rejected. <!--#e8360f98d6d7a928-->
- `test_overlapping_ops_are_rejected` (function) — Ensures two ops whose target spans overlap the same region are rejected. <!--#019a9ac99c61fa7a-->
- `test_patch_not_a_list_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures a patch passed as a non-list (e.g. a dict) is rejected with a list-type error. <!--#4fed5007aaf77d53-->
- `test_non_string_new_text_is_rejected` (function) — Ensures an op whose new_text is not a string is rejected with a new_text type error. <!--#4531435007134309-->

### `tests/test_charter_freshness.py` (python) — Test suite for the CHARTER_FRESHNESS flow-end advisory step, covering the cheap no-diff pass, non-blocking LLM verdicts and failures, the oversize-admission monitoring trigger, the admission-gate prompt builder and in-memory check_admission path, the propose→gate→apply closed-loop write path with its preconditions/retries/fail-closed guards, and summarize's aggregation of charter and why-comment guard results. <!--#fa1ff7414f8aa779|606037d329b4f717-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a FlowInstance with a given task and a change_path under the project root. <!--#32ffecb7d316c431-->
- `_make_step` (function) — Test helper that constructs a CHARTER_FRESHNESS Step from a given inputs dict. <!--#b10efb4585914365-->
- `_install_fake_caller` (function) — Test helper that monkeypatches charter_freshness.LLMCaller with a fake that records prompts/init kwargs and pops scripted responses (raising on unexpected extra calls), returning the shared state dict. <!--#72f9911297cf1ca5-->
- `_with_completed_invariant_check` (function) — Helper that attaches a COMPLETED invariant_check step to a flow so the closed-loop charter-update precondition is satisfied. <!--#4f3505ea448782a6-->
- `_propose` (function) — Helper that builds a JSON propose-stage LLM response encoding whether a charter update is needed, the touched classes, reason, suggested text, and patch. <!--#174db0cef10d9d7e-->
- `_gate` (function) — Helper that builds a JSON admission-gate LLM verdict encoding admitted plus optional violations and weakened_removals. <!--#693a8a5e996879e1-->
- `_write_charter` (function) — Test helper that writes the given text to `tianluo/charter.md` under a project root, creating the `tianluo` directory as needed. <!--#04393442229440e6-->
- `test_no_diff_passes_cheap_without_llm` (function) — Asserts an empty diff completes with no LLM call, charter_update_needed=False, and skipped_reason='no_diff'. <!--#d25c71c8982fd47a-->
- `test_untouched_charter_completes_without_prompt` (function) — Asserts a diff the LLM deems charter-irrelevant completes with one LLM call, no update needed, and empty touched_classes. <!--#731d97a0c6aaeee6-->
- `test_touched_charter_surfaces_update_prompt` (function) — Asserts that when a change touches source files the handler surfaces the LLM's charter_update_needed proposal (touched_classes, suggested_update) in step outputs while remaining non-blocking (COMPLETED). <!--#08a973b48cc633cb-->
- `test_llm_failure_is_non_blocking` (function) — Asserts an LLM exception degrades to a non-blocking COMPLETED with charter_update_needed=False and skipped_reason='llm_error'. <!--#5b4ca1b6951c2bbc-->
- `test_unparsable_response_is_non_blocking` (function) — Asserts an unparsable LLM response degrades to a non-blocking COMPLETED with skipped_reason='parse_error'. <!--#9a1f867c66ad9a13-->
- `test_admission_check_not_run_when_charter_untouched` (function) — Asserts the admission check is skipped (no admission_checked output) when the diff does not edit tianluo/charter.md. <!--#98dd57850b8a2af7-->
- `test_admission_check_runs_and_warns_when_charter_oversized` (function) — Verifies that editing `tianluo/charter.md` while the charter exceeds the 32 KiB threshold runs the admission check and emits a non-blocking monitoring-threshold warning in step outputs. <!--#033afd41f0b27eb6-->
- `test_admission_check_runs_no_warn_when_charter_small` (function) — Verifies that editing a small charter runs the admission check but reports admission_over_threshold=False and emits no admission_warning. <!--#e67c997bd00a8ef4-->
- `test_admission_gate_prompt_includes_standard_and_removal_question` (function) — Asserts build_admission_gate_prompt embeds the full admission standard, the removal-weakening question, the candidate text, diff summary, and JSON verdict schema keys. <!--#0f2b02c4cc1f4d0f-->
- `test_admission_gate_prompt_pure_insertion_states_no_removal` (function) — Asserts an empty/None replaced_texts (pure-insertion patch) yields prompt wording of 'PURE INSERTION' with no verbatim replaced-passage block. <!--#a0d4c8dd179e6cff-->
- `test_admission_gate_prompt_lists_each_replaced_text_verbatim` (function) — Asserts each removed passage is rendered verbatim and numbered ('replaced passage #1/#2') so the gate can judge removals individually. <!--#9f6d2516c8c83cb3-->
- `test_admission_gate_prompt_filters_blank_replaced_entries` (function) — Asserts blank/non-string replaced entries are dropped, degrading the prompt to pure-insertion wording when none survive. <!--#ca81b7bcc0ed36a6-->
- `test_check_admission_in_memory_candidate_under_threshold` (function) — Asserts check_admission accepts an in-memory candidate string and reports over_threshold False (with no warning, correct byte size, standard) for a small candidate. <!--#7c24255c26e8c237-->
- `test_check_admission_in_memory_candidate_over_threshold` (function) — Asserts an oversized candidate sets over_threshold True with a monitoring warning and correct byte size, without raising or blocking. <!--#8e95a05f27749d8c-->
- `test_check_admission_respects_custom_threshold_for_candidate` (function) — Asserts a tiny custom threshold_bytes flips a normally-small candidate to over_threshold, confirming the in-memory path honours the threshold argument. <!--#9ef35f9ff11badae-->
- `test_precondition_missing_stays_advisory_and_never_writes` (function) — Asserts that without a COMPLETED invariant_check step the handler makes only the propose LLM call, stays advisory (degraded_reason=invariant_check_not_completed), and leaves the on-disk charter byte-for-byte unchanged. <!--#9e44efc69bac6a4a-->
- `test_gate_pass_writes_charter_atomically_with_diff` (function) — Asserts the happy path where propose+gate both pass, the charter is atomically rewritten on disk with a diff, gate verdicts are recorded, and LLM sub-calls stay read-only (force_read_only). <!--#7a50210048bc2871-->
- `test_gate_reject_twice_degrades_without_writing` (function) — Asserts that two consecutive gate rejections (four LLM calls) degrade to a no-op (charter_auto_updated=False, llm_admitted=False) and leave the charter unchanged, preferring stale over degraded. <!--#8bf38c74652a3e23-->
- `test_gate_malformed_response_fails_closed_without_writing` (function) — Asserts that a gate response with string-typed fields is not coerced into a pass but fails closed (llm_malformed), degrading without writing the charter. <!--#071cdcdd7ce8999c-->
- `test_gate_reject_then_retry_succeeds` (function) — Asserts that a first-round gate rejection feeds back into the second-round propose prompt (carrying "REJECTED") and the corrected patch passes the gate and is applied to disk. <!--#81949e1d4f372648-->
- `test_mechanical_reject_then_retry_succeeds_without_extra_gate_call` (function) — Asserts a patch quoting off-disk text fails the mechanical check with no LLM gate call, and the retried valid patch is applied. <!--#d5f8871958864cb2-->
- `test_size_red_light_is_gating_and_blocks_write` (function) — Asserts that when the candidate charter exceeds the size threshold the size gate blocks the write and short-circuits before any LLM gate call (size_over_threshold=True, only propose calls made). <!--#28f52d3f692ea614-->
- `test_resume_reentry_is_idempotent` (function) — Asserts that on resume, with the charter already updated on disk, propose judges it fresh and no gate call or write occurs (idempotent re-entry). <!--#3491b27afba08da5-->
- `test_propose_prompt_uses_on_disk_charter_not_frozen_anchor` (function) — Asserts the propose base is the on-disk charter text, never the frozen invariant anchor passed via step.inputs['charter']. <!--#344c79225b5f1f8e-->
- `test_closed_loop_llm_failure_is_non_blocking` (function) — Asserts that a propose LLM exception degrades to a soft no-op (skipped_reason=llm_error, still COMPLETED) leaving the charter untouched. <!--#7444153a2d338de2-->
- `_flow_with_guard_steps` (function) — Helper that builds a flow with optional COMPLETED charter_freshness and/or invariant_check steps carrying given outputs, for exercising the summarize aggregation. <!--#173a8ad421680167-->
- `test_summarize_aggregates_charter_auto_update` (function) — Asserts that summarize's knowledge-guards section and deterministic fallback report both include a "Charter Auto-Update" block embedding the charter diff excerpt. <!--#d3322c4b0c6e2b71-->
- `test_summarize_aggregates_charter_advisory_and_reason` (function) — Asserts the summarize section reports a 'Charter Update Advisory' with the suggested update text and the degraded reason when auto-update was declined. <!--#86722fe43ecd7109-->
- `test_summarize_aggregates_why_comment_losses` (function) — Asserts the summarize section surfaces 'Why-Comment Losses' from invariant_check outputs, including the comment text and file. <!--#f913f8414a44343f-->
- `test_summarize_no_guard_activity_adds_nothing` (function) — Asserts that with a fresh charter and no why-comment losses the knowledge-guards section is empty and the base report omits 'Knowledge Guards'. <!--#d4b7cc4e08a188a1-->

### `tests/test_chat_history.py` (python) — Pytest suite for `tianluo.engine.chat_history`, exercising `ChatMessage`/`ChatSession` serialization roundtrips (including `agent_name`/`model_name` and legacy JSONL without them), NDJSON parsing helpers such as `_extract_model_from_ndjson` and `parse_usage_from_ndjson`, spec-folding and prompt-segmentation utilities, and the flow/step history recording, listing, and rendering APIs against a temporary `tianluo/history` project fixture. <!--#d0430d9eac6ad64c|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->
