  - `TestRecordGroupStatus.test_explicit_timestamp_is_preserved` (method) — Asserts an explicitly passed timestamp is written through unchanged. <!--#9b1990dc429de761-->
  - `TestRecordGroupStatus.test_appends_multiple_status_transitions` (method) — Asserts successive calls append records preserving the ordered sequence of status transitions. <!--#9b13584e12d59cb4-->

  - `TestRecordGroupStatus.test_agent_and_model_fields_written` (method) — Asserts passing both `agent_name` and `model_name` writes both fields into the record. <!--#62fe4b70af29c63a-->
  - `TestRecordGroupStatus.test_all_none_record_is_byte_identical_to_legacy` (method) — Asserts that with both optional fields unset, the record's key set matches the pre-extension legacy schema exactly. <!--#be8e285ecbb6e4c4-->

  - `TestOnConfirmWiring.test_unrecognized_output_is_noop` (method) — Asserts JSON and ordinary prose output never invoke the on_confirm handler and the run completes normally. <!--#294723f4eaf0facf-->
  - `TestOnConfirmWiring.test_run_with_monitor_passes_on_confirm` (method) — Asserts the public run_with_monitor entry point accepts and threads through the on_confirm keyword argument without raising. <!--#ea1fb8f532c0348d-->

### `tests/test_code_index.py` (python) — Test suite for the code-index subsystem, exercising gitignore-respecting file enumeration, deterministic AST/structural symbol extraction with per-symbol fingerprints, and the incremental bottom-up build_index lifecycle (first-build summarises all, unchanged rebuilds skip the LLM, only changed symbols re-summarise, human corrections and checkpointed partials survive, deletions prune and additions summarise) using a RecordingSummarizer test-double instead of a real LLM. <!--#aa1e13ea8eb8fc34|e4e3f933ba56d660-->
- `_git` (function) — Helper that runs a git subcommand in a given root directory, failing the test on nonzero exit. <!--#a44a1342750ce397-->
- `_init_git_project` (function) — Helper that initializes a git repo in a directory with a test user identity. <!--#6aabffa4b0cbf3dc-->
- `_commit_all` (function) — Helper that stages and commits all files in a test repo with an optional message. <!--#244569aab0134277-->
- `RecordingSummarizer` (class) — A test-double summariser that records each batch of target ids and returns deterministic `S:<name>` summaries without ever calling the LLM, with helpers (`all`, `last`, `call_count`, `reset`) to assert what work a build performed. <!--#b2000ca60427e31b-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.__init__` (method) — Initializes the recorder's list of per-call batches. <!--#2eb12aaa30d04499-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.__call__` (method) — Records the batch's target ids and returns a deterministic summary per target. <!--#69dbd4374dad21fb-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.all` (method) — Property returning the union of all target ids across every recorded batch. <!--#c9050c58a5dd1c51-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.last` (method) — Property returning the ids from the most recent batch (empty if none). <!--#c2e6d1003cf9f412-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.call_count` (method) — Property returning how many batches the summariser has been invoked with. <!--#da34ef5d0cc65b1d-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.reset` (method) — Clears the recorded batches (but not the on-disk md) so a test can isolate the work of a subsequent incremental build. <!--#1a52be09125e131c-->
- `project` (function) — A pytest fixture that scaffolds a temporary git-initialized project (with .gitignore, a src/mod.py module, README.md, and gitignored/ignored files) and commits it, providing a realistic tree for code-index tests. <!--#493aa8b7c38777c7-->
- `TestFileEnum` (class) — Test class for file_enum, verifying gitignore-respecting enumeration, tianluo/ runtime exclusion, untracked-file pickup, explicit exclude lists, glob/dir exclude matching, and binary-file detection. <!--#29feef3396abb449-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_enumerate_respects_gitignore_and_excludes_se3` (method) — Asserts enumerate_index_files includes tracked source (src/mod.py, README.md) while omitting gitignored paths and any tianluo/ runtime content. <!--#ec77ac44cfc914fc-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_new_untracked_file_picked_up` (method) — Asserts a brand-new uncommitted, non-ignored file is enumerated via git --others. <!--#347b72b0ab6ec767-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_explicit_exclude_list` (method) — Asserts an explicitly passed exclude path is omitted while other files remain. <!--#fd34608a273ac211-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_matches_exclude_dir_and_basename` (method) — Asserts matches_exclude handles glob basenames and directory-name patterns with/without trailing slash. <!--#e84d1255bd7877c3-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_is_binary` (method) — Asserts is_binary flags null-byte blobs as binary while text and empty files are not. <!--#f7ff6773910afa02-->
- `TestExtraction` (class) — Tests for deterministic structural/AST symbol extraction across Python, Markdown, YAML, and JSON. <!--#f4abb939fe6ee0af-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_python_drills_to_function_method` (method) — Asserts Python extraction yields top-level functions, classes, and methods but not nested inner functions. <!--#f70bde78ac49b386-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_markdown_headings` (method) — Asserts Markdown extraction yields headings with correct depth levels. <!--#9654d6c0a895e72e-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_yaml_top_keys` (method) — Asserts YAML extraction yields only top-level keys. <!--#12c5004656279e68-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_json_top_keys` (method) — Asserts JSON extraction yields only top-level keys. <!--#37c939c5af9329a7-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_structured_keys_carry_value_content` (method) — Asserts JSON/YAML top-level key symbols carry their nested value content for the summariser, not just the key. <!--#2a5f6f66a19a9830-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_make_target_summarizes_json_key_from_value` (method) — Asserts _make_target feeds a JSON key's value content to the summariser even when its line range is zero. <!--#f0c6a123355c1dfb-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_symbol_fingerprint_changes_with_content` (method) — Asserts a symbol's sha256 fingerprint changes when its body content changes. <!--#e14d1e4323c9ee2c-->
- `TestBuild` (class) — Test suite verifying the incremental build_index lifecycle: first-build summarises everything, unchanged rebuilds skip the LLM, only changed symbols are re-summarised, human md corrections survive, deleted files are pruned and new ones added, --force re-summarises all, summaries are synthesised bottom-up from children, and a mid-build crash leaves a resumable partial md. <!--#42efd8fed55117a9-->
  - `TestBuild.test_first_build_summarizes_all` (method) — Asserts a first build writes the authoritative md and summarises every file node and symbol, with a complete symbol map. <!--#bd85cd75a3c97668-->
  - `TestBuild.test_unchanged_rebuild_skips_llm` (method) — Asserts an unchanged rebuild produces no targets and does not re-invoke the summariser. <!--#5982a0bf9875c125-->
  - `TestBuild.test_changed_symbol_only_resummarized` (method) — Asserts a body-only edit re-summarises ONLY the edited symbol, since files/dirs gate on their symbol-roster list-fp (unchanged), leaving untouched siblings reused. <!--#5f050dd08968911b-->
  - `TestBuild.test_human_correction_preserved` (method) — Asserts a human-edited summary in the authoritative md survives a subsequent rebuild. <!--#45312508a4c3c2a0-->
  - `TestBuild.test_deleted_file_pruned_new_added` (method) — Asserts a deleted file is pruned from the index and a newly added module (with its symbols) is summarised. <!--#86523e7dd2a7c086-->
  - `TestBuild.test_force_resummarizes_everything` (method) — Asserts `force=True` ignores fingerprints and re-summarises every node. <!--#ee4d534a8d89d440-->
  - `TestBuild.test_summary_is_bottom_up` (method) — Asserts each node is summarised from its children's summaries — a file from its symbols' summaries (not raw source) and a directory from its child files' summaries — by capturing the content fed to the summariser. <!--#fcd5f8d30f57aec2-->
  - `TestBuild.test_checkpoint_flushes_partial_md_for_resume` (method) — Asserts a crash mid-build flushes a partial md with real fingerprints so already-summarised nodes are reused (not re-summarised) when the build resumes with a working summariser. <!--#b9b4a0ccd40fecc3-->
  - `TestBuild.test_checkpoint_flush_preserves_unchanged_file_fingerprints` (method) — Asserts a checkpoint flush preserves both fingerprints of an unchanged file not yet reached before the crash, so an interrupted build never blanks it and forces a needless re-summarisation. <!--#82a17fc3e15d60c9-->
  - `TestBuild.test_binary_file_is_file_level_only` (method) — Asserts a binary file is indexed file-level only (kind `binary`, no symbols, a 'binary' summary) and is never sent to the LLM. <!--#038d71b5868cd8f6-->
  - `TestBuild.test_load_or_build_alias` (method) — Asserts load_or_build builds and returns a populated index like build_index. <!--#1cb8b3fcc38e6c60-->
- `TestListFp` (class) — Test suite for the list-fingerprint reuse semantics: body edits touch only the symbol, roster changes (add/rename/re-kind) touch the file but not ancestor dirs, reorders touch nothing, dir membership changes touch only that dir, symbol-less files fall back to content-fp, --force cascades everything, and legacy single-fp md migrates for free. <!--#a230e3645d4aa301-->
  - `TestListFp.test_body_only_change_resummarises_symbol_only` (method) — Acceptance (a): a body-only edit re-summarises only the edited symbol while its file and all ancestor dirs reuse their cached summaries. <!--#d38332c56a3e13a5-->
  - `TestListFp.test_new_symbol_resummarises_symbol_and_file_not_dir` (method) — Acceptance (b): adding a symbol re-summarises that symbol and its file (roster grew) but not the parent dir (dir roster unchanged). <!--#364e99ebacf433b6-->
  - `TestListFp.test_renamed_symbol_resummarises_file_not_dir` (method) — Acceptance (b): renaming a symbol changes the file roster so the file and renamed symbol are re-summarised, but the parent dir is left untouched. <!--#b9c0b8820332d908-->
  - `TestListFp.test_kind_change_same_name_resummarises_file` (method) — Acceptance (b) kind component: changing a symbol's kind while keeping its name flips the roster's (kind,name) entry so the file is re-summarised, locking in the kind half of the list-fp while ancestors reuse. <!--#863a259a97a483e9-->
  - `TestListFp.test_reorder_symbols_no_resummary` (method) — Asserts the file list-fp is order-insensitive: reordering unchanged symbols leaves the sorted (kind,name) roster identical, so the file is not re-summarised. <!--#7a442e60e5fef6fb-->
  - `TestListFp.test_dir_membership_change_resummarises_dir_not_ancestors` (method) — Acceptance (c): adding a file to a subdir re-summarises only that subdir while ancestor dirs (unchanged direct rosters) reuse. <!--#8892d8b43ac45c46-->
  - `TestListFp.test_dir_child_removal_resummarises_dir_not_ancestors` (method) — Acceptance (c): removing a direct child re-summarises only that dir, with ancestors reusing their cached summaries. <!--#2e756c050505c2e9-->
  - `TestListFp.test_symbolless_file_content_edit_resummarises_file` (method) — Asserts a symbol-less file (whose constant empty list-fp would freeze it) falls back to the content-fp so a body rewrite re-summarises the file node without cascading to its parent dir. <!--#ab7ae377cb1104bf-->
  - `TestListFp.test_force_cascades_whole_content` (method) — Acceptance (d): --force ignores list-fps and re-summarises every node (symbols, files, all dirs) — the whole-content cascade. <!--#833cdfa38c84ef6f-->
  - `TestListFp.test_lazy_migration_reuses_old_md_zero_llm` (method) — Acceptance (e): a legacy single-fp md is reused for free (zero LLM) on the first rebuild, carrying old summaries forward while mechanically backfilling list-fps into the rewritten md. <!--#beefd5d4321255bc-->
- `TestDegrade` (class) — Test class for degrade-mode handling, checking the three-condition eligibility gate, chunk-with-marker output for large structureless files, and file-level drop for oversized structured files. <!--#929a5cb674f4bd30-->
  - `TestDegrade._cfg` (method) — Helper returning a CodeIndexConfig with small degrade/chunk line thresholds so tests can trigger degrade behavior cheaply. <!--#ca49cda07f948e68-->
  - `TestDegrade.test_gate_requires_all_three` (method) — Asserts is_degrade_eligible only triggers when the file is large AND structureless under the configured thresholds. <!--#63f3e02c31203b39-->
  - `TestDegrade.test_large_structureless_file_chunks_with_marker` (method) — Asserts a large structureless file is chunked into degraded symbols and rendered with the degraded marker. <!--#2b74dcef5ab6f24d-->
  - `TestDegrade.test_oversized_structured_file_drops_to_file_level` (method) — Asserts an oversized but structured module is dropped to a single file-level entry rather than enumerated or chunked. <!--#1d8fcdfeec24c916-->
- `TestSummaryFlatten` (class) — Tests that multi-line summaries collapse to a single line and survive the md round-trip. <!--#b2bde80acac06f04-->
  - `TestSummaryFlatten.test_flatten_collapses_newlines` (method) — Asserts _flatten_summary collapses newlines and surrounding whitespace into single spaces. <!--#ab6d2246457f511d-->
  - `TestSummaryFlatten.test_newline_summary_survives_md_round_trip` (method) — Asserts a multi-line LLM summary becomes one md line and is fully recoverable when parsed back. <!--#5a7a705238559cd1-->
- `TestRender` (class) — Test class for code_index_render, covering the adaptive root view (files not symbols), directory summaries, md round-trip persistence, incremental summary reuse vs re-summarisation, --force cascade, and path drill-in rendering. <!--#73ad3ce9c2b0d220-->
  - `TestRender.test_adaptive_lists_files_not_symbols` (method) — Asserts the adaptive root view lists file paths but omits function-level symbol bullets. <!--#3a9f305d5f06945b-->
  - `TestRender.test_adaptive_shows_directory_summaries` (method) — Asserts directory nodes carry a one-line summary in both the index and the rendered adaptive view. <!--#8866e3dbd8fb098f-->
  - `TestRender.test_dir_summary_survives_md_round_trip` (method) — Asserts directory summaries are recovered when loading the index from md for display. <!--#ee68cec64066e110-->
  - `TestRender.test_unchanged_sibling_dir_summary_reused` (method) — Asserts directory reuse is independent: adding a root-level file re-summarises only the root dir while an untouched sibling dir reuses its cached summary. <!--#74db031d2bd31040-->
  - `TestRender.test_dir_summary_not_refreshed_on_member_content_change` (method) — Asserts a pure content edit inside a file does not re-summarise ancestor directories in normal mode (dir list-fp unchanged), while --force restores the content-fp cascade. <!--#9cdc786c3b7e6d2a-->
  - `TestRender.test_render_path_file_shows_symbols` (method) — Asserts rendering a file path drills in to show its symbols. <!--#f9f2651ef457e2b5-->
  - `TestRender.test_render_path_directory_lists_files` (method) — Asserts rendering a directory path lists its files but not symbols. <!--#103aa80577e34bba-->
  - `TestRender.test_render_path_unknown` (method) — Asserts rendering an unknown path returns a no-entry message. <!--#4189b5fab8c22573-->
  - `TestRender.test_load_for_display_reads_md_round_trip` (method) — Asserts load_for_display reconstructs files, symbols, and summaries from the md. <!--#a6777337f0918b65-->
  - `TestRender.test_md_is_self_sufficient_for_incremental_rebuild` (method) — Verifies the committed md alone carries fingerprints so an unchanged-tree rebuild does zero LLM work with no json sidecar, and still renders correctly. <!--#54315bf5d6f97ced-->
  - `TestRender.test_md_embeds_node_fingerprints` (method) — Asserts every rendered file/dir line carries a 16-hex content-fp (plus optional list-fp) comment that is stripped from the parsed summary, with list-fps present on file nodes but never on symbol bullets. <!--#61a973974e58fdfc-->
- `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip` (class) — Test suite for the trailing fingerprint-comment format: parsing/emitting the content-fp plus optional list-fp for file/dir lines, staying byte-compatible with the legacy single-fp form, and round-tripping both fps through render→parse without leaking list-fps onto symbol or unsummarised nodes. <!--#9a78389cb4fd1b33-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_split_fp_legacy_single_fp` (method) — Asserts _split_fp parses a legacy single-fp comment into the bare line, its content-fp, and a None list-fp. <!--#0a284f89a1837f08-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_split_fp_double_fp` (method) — Asserts _split_fp parses a double-fp comment into the bare line plus both the content-fp and list-fp. <!--#ac47db626361c765-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_split_fp_no_comment` (method) — Asserts _split_fp on a line with no fp comment returns the line unchanged and both fingerprints as None. <!--#6fa04f77e6cf5f79-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_fp_comment_round_trip` (method) — Asserts _fp_comment emits the legacy shape for a content-fp alone and the double shape when a list-fp is given, with an empty list-fp falling back to the legacy single-fp shape. <!--#243d087196d48359-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_render_parse_round_trip` (method) — Asserts render_full→_parse_md restores both fingerprints for every summarised file/dir node while symbol nodes carry only a content-fp and never a list-fp. <!--#e08ee95555fe3faa-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_unsummarised_node_embeds_no_fp` (method) — Asserts a node with no summary embeds neither fingerprint, keeping a partial md a safe resume point (treated as stale next build). <!--#dc911f1aee89a427-->
- `TestCodeIndexCLI` (class) — Test class exercising the `code-index` CLI subcommands (index, bare invocation, show, rebuild --force, inspect, --help) via Typer's CliRunner with get_project_root monkeypatched to a built fixture project. <!--#91ea05b644ccadfe-->

  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_index_no_arg_renders_literal_root_level` (method) — Asserts `index` with no path shows the literal root level (collapsed top dirs + root files) and not one level deeper. <!--#edc365a4d57e8902-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_bare_invocation_renders_adaptive_map` (method) — Asserts bare `code-index` renders the adaptive root map (expanding code roots) instead of Typer's 'Missing command' error. <!--#6ddcb755282417b4-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_bare_invocation_unbuilt_errors_without_missing_command` (method) — Asserts bare invocation on an unbuilt project exits 1 with a rebuild hint, not a Typer 'Missing command' error. <!--#ac7cc4197dcec319-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_index_with_path_drills_into_file` (method) — Asserts `code-index index <file>` drills into the file and shows its symbols. <!--#4f69a162e138f230-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_index_with_directory_lists_files` (method) — Asserts `code-index index <dir>` lists the directory's files but not symbols. <!--#4f5c778c008153a0-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_show_pulls_function_level` (method) — Asserts `code-index show <file>` surfaces function/method-level symbols. <!--#7230267ab2ce3244-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_index_unbuilt_errors` (method) — Asserts `code-index index` on an unbuilt project exits 1 with a rebuild hint. <!--#7aea579c8081593f-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_rebuild_force_full_rebuild` (method) — Asserts `code-index rebuild --force` runs a full rebuild that re-summarises every node (via a faked summariser, no LLM) and writes the authoritative md. <!--#8f3b32f146c53608-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_inspect_reports_stats` (method) — Asserts `code-index inspect` reports file and symbol counts. <!--#33f9ddf5a766d99e-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_help_mentions_md_authoritative_product` (method) — Checks that `code-index --help` names tianluo/code-index.md as the authoritative product. <!--#d17b3d526e2ac370-->
- `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety` (class) — Test class ensuring the incremental rebuild serializes across processes via an advisory lock, writes atomically through unique temp files, degrades gracefully without fcntl, and locates the lock under the gitignored cache. <!--#5e421861e63ed82c-->
  - `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety.test_atomic_write_uses_unique_temp_no_fixed_leftover` (method) — Asserts the atomic md write leaves no fixed-name or stray `*.tmp` scratch files behind. <!--#7261ab11746a1c58-->
  - `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety.test_build_lock_serializes_concurrent_builds` (method) — Runs two builds on background threads and asserts both complete and the resulting map remains intact and parseable under the advisory lock. <!--#6faa511b8c7c9996-->
  - `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety.test_build_proceeds_unlocked_when_fcntl_unavailable` (method) — Monkeypatches _HAVE_FCNTL to False and asserts the build still runs best-effort, producing files and the md. <!--#8297f83ccea6f941-->
  - `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety.test_lock_path_lives_under_gitignored_cache` (method) — Asserts lock_path resolves to code-index.lock inside the project's tianluo/cache directory. <!--#60216e4afcedb4fe-->

### `tests/test_codex_runner.py` (python) — Unit test suite for the `CodexRunner` agent adapter — covering `CodexEventConverter`'s mapping of `codex exec --json` events into Claude NDJSON (both the real 0.147.0 ThreadItem schema and the converter's legacy fallback shapes), `build_call_args` sandbox/context/stdin routing, `detect_infra_error` classification, mocked `run`/`run_with_monitor` subprocess lifecycle, and registration through `LLMCaller._create_runner`. <!--#20555bab162f1df1|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/test_commit_step.py` (python) — Unit tests for the COMMIT step handler (commit_handler), covering graceful recovery from versionless/unparseable version files, verbatim writing of the LLM-supplied suggested_version (bypassing bump_type recomputation), and FAILED-with-guided-error behavior when suggested_version is missing or blank. <!--#70a4e8f69760baf6|646b03b8544ffc07-->
- `temp_dir` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding a fresh temporary directory Path that serves as the project root for each test. <!--#aa41b08e2a7ac2e1-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal FlowInstance whose change_path parent equals the given temp_dir, with a configurable task_type. <!--#df77e370fec9d9e9-->
- `_make_step` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal COMMIT Step pre-populated with task_description, suggested_version, and bump_type inputs. <!--#40c0069baf1d4540-->
- `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile` (class) — Test class verifying commit_handler recovers gracefully (initializing the version system rather than crashing) when a version file exists but lacks a readable version, while still working normally for valid version files. <!--#b9f89c9875e41342-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile.test_initializes_version_when_read_raises_value_error` (method) — Asserts that a pyproject.toml without a version field causes commit_handler to initialize the version system and complete (version_bumped=True) instead of failing. <!--#11716c5cd7d35ad6-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile.test_version_is_readable_after_recovery` (method) — Asserts that after recovering from a versionless pyproject.toml, the file contains a readable, bumped version via TomlVersionHandler.read_version. <!--#25b02e4013720ac9-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile.test_init_py_without_version_does_not_crash` (method) — Asserts that a Python project with a versionless __init__.py does not crash commit_handler, which completes successfully for a bugfix task. <!--#2b7aea51aff32738-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile.test_normal_version_file_still_works` (method) — Asserts that a pyproject.toml with a valid version (1.2.3) is handled normally, completing with a bumped version recorded in step.outputs. <!--#e9443e0084e9b8e6-->
- `TestCommitHandlerSuggestedVersionDriven` (class) — Test class verifying commit_handler writes the LLM-supplied suggested_version verbatim to pyproject.toml, bypassing any bump_type-based recomputation, including large/major version jumps. <!--#5c2ba1f8acb29d1f-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerSuggestedVersionDriven.test_suggested_version_written_verbatim_to_pyproject` (method) — Asserts suggested_version='9.4.2' is written exactly to pyproject.toml even when bump_type='patch' would recompute a different value, confirming the LLM version is authoritative. <!--#1b9b26727e532272-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerSuggestedVersionDriven.test_suggested_version_supports_major_jump` (method) — Asserts a suggested_version can skip versions (e.g. 1.2.3 → 3.0.0) and is written verbatim to pyproject.toml. <!--#ca18b85e0b98fdaa-->
- `TestCommitHandlerMissingSuggestedVersion` (class) — Test class verifying commit_handler halts with StepStatus.FAILED and a guided error message (referencing current version and human intervention) when suggested_version is absent or blank. <!--#495b3a3437d89463-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerMissingSuggestedVersion.test_missing_suggested_version_raises_with_current_version` (method) — Asserts that with no suggested_version and no version_analyze step in flow history, commit_handler returns FAILED with an error mentioning suggested_version, current version state, and human-intervention guidance. <!--#191423430d805ef3-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerMissingSuggestedVersion.test_empty_string_suggested_version_raises` (method) — Asserts a whitespace-only suggested_version is treated as missing, yielding FAILED with an error message referencing suggested_version. <!--#ab058462082a7d58-->

### `tests/test_compact_history_script.py` (python) — Pytest suite for the `compact_history_jsonl.py` maintenance script, covering dry-run vs `--apply` behaviour, the strict 1:1 line/ordinal/terminator rewrite invariants, tool-chip and token-usage preservation, idempotency, `--flow-id` and merge-back sidecar targeting, scratch-file safety, and failure/guard paths that abort or fall back to the verbatim line. <!--#c1024ea85c8e316e|91c59bbdcc7e6ae7-->
- `_small_record` (function) — Test helper that builds a tiny under-budget history record dict with a trivial `raw_json` event list. <!--#64b0920dedec17e9-->
- `_oversized_record` (function) — Test helper that fabricates a pathologically large record — N `tool_use`/`tool_result` chip pairs with huge bodies, interleaved zero-render telemetry, and a terminal `result` event — mirroring the real over-budget lines. <!--#508155cd51dae8d7-->
- `_dump` (function) — Test helper that serialises a record to a single-line JSON string the way the history writer does. <!--#8a733c55a646543e-->
- `_chip_ids` (function) — Test helper that extracts `(kind, tool_use_id)` for every tool chip in a record's `raw_json`, in document order, so chip preservation can be asserted. <!--#028c0758f5db6662-->
- `history` (function) — Pytest fixture creating a history dir with one step `.jsonl` mixing small, oversized, empty, unparseable and trailing-newline-free lines — the shape matrix the whole module exercises. <!--#164e30cb0320c756-->
- `_read_lines` (function) — Test helper that splits a file's raw bytes on `\n` so physical line positions and terminators can be compared exactly. <!--#bd6687f7968d3898-->
- `_step_file` (function) — Test helper returning the single step `.jsonl` inside a history dir. <!--#e12095dbe91105b4-->
- `_temp_files` (function) — Test helper listing every scratch file under the history dir matching `compact_mod._TMP_PREFIX`, used to assert no temp residue is left. <!--#ec9680cc5cdc11b6-->
- `test_no_args_is_dry_run_and_writes_nothing` (function) — Asserts the script defaults to dry-run: bytes, mtime and temp-file set are all unchanged when `--apply` is absent. <!--#6914367eb0b40418-->
- `test_dry_run_reports_accurate_statistics` (function) — Checks the dry-run report's line/byte counters and that its predicted `saved_bytes` exactly matches what a real `--apply` pass achieves. <!--#c1a5606134add14f-->
- `test_explicit_dry_run_overrides_apply` (function) — Asserts `--dry-run` wins over a simultaneously passed `--apply`, leaving the file untouched. <!--#440e0a8bcb2e2538-->
- `test_apply_preserves_line_count_order_and_ordinals` (function) — Verifies the 1:1 rewrite invariant — line count, ordinals, empty/unparseable lines and the missing trailing newline all survive while only oversized lines shrink. <!--#df88ee59964f583b-->
- `test_apply_keeps_every_line_valid_json` (function) — Asserts every non-empty, originally-parseable line remains a valid JSON object after `--apply`. <!--#c587083800683a1a-->
- `test_apply_preserves_all_tool_chips_and_usage` (function) — Asserts compaction keeps all tool chips in order, preserves `token_usage` and the terminal `result` event, and brings the record within the record-budget ceiling. <!--#04ed17108b3c0db5-->
- `test_apply_is_idempotent` (function) — Asserts a second `--apply` pass produces byte-identical output to the first. <!--#d0916b43769b8996-->
- `test_file_without_oversized_lines_is_never_touched` (function) — Asserts a wholly under-budget file is reported but never rewritten — bytes and mtime unchanged. <!--#1a71c5d0cde5df82-->
- `test_flow_id_restricts_the_pass` (function) — Asserts `--flow-id` scopes the pass to one flow directory, leaving other flows' oversized files untouched. <!--#6a71f8a5fbf955a5-->
- `test_merge_back_sidecars_are_targets` (function) — Asserts `iter_targets` also picks up `*.jsonl.from-<branch>` merge-back sidecars (scoped and unscoped), ordering the primary file before its sidecars to match reader order. <!--#a97fe3aec61e56b4-->
- `test_apply_compacts_a_sidecar_in_place` (function) — Asserts a sidecar is compacted in place with its report, 1:1 line count, chips and trailing newline intact, and no scratch file left behind. <!--#973a671d25642bde-->
- `test_temp_file_is_never_discoverable_as_a_history_stream` (function) — Asserts scratch names from `_tmp_path` are same-directory, injective, unmatched by the daemon's `*.jsonl` / `*.jsonl.from-*` globs, and inert as orphans. <!--#34446b64c14404a2-->
- `test_iter_targets_tolerates_a_missing_dir` (function) — Asserts `iter_targets` returns an empty list rather than raising for a nonexistent history dir, scoped or not. <!--#4580411f25988dfb-->
- `test_line_count_guard_blocks_replacement` (function) — Monkeypatches `compact_line` to split a record across two lines and asserts the line-count guard aborts with nonzero exit, leaving the file and temp set untouched. <!--#250484fc01ef4fcc-->
- `test_line_count_guard_blocks_dropped_line` (function) — Monkeypatches `compact_line` to emit an empty product and asserts the guard likewise rejects the rewrite. <!--#2e33f9803dcd41e3-->
- `test_compaction_failure_writes_the_line_back_verbatim` (function) — Makes `record_budget.compact_record` raise and asserts failures are counted, the file is left byte-identical, and the run still exits 0. <!--#f42ed396a991e922-->
- `test_multiline_product_is_rejected` (function) — Asserts `compact_line` discards a compaction product containing an embedded newline, returning the original line marked `failed`. <!--#6a349b0cf466a5d4-->
- `test_compact_line_preserves_terminators` (function) — Asserts `compact_line` reproduces the input's trailing-newline state exactly, with or without a terminator. <!--#cf1f920b154be71d-->
- `test_small_line_takes_the_fast_path_untouched` (function) — Asserts an under-budget line is returned as the identical object with `oversized`/`compacted` both false. <!--#9f3c2900df74f7ec-->
- `test_count_physical_lines_matches_ordinal_numbering` (function) — Asserts `count_physical_lines` matches ordinal numbering across trailing-newline, partial-last-line, empty and blank-line files. <!--#a099098416a9afc9-->
- `test_missing_history_dir_exits_nonzero` (function) — Asserts `main` exits 1 when the given `--history-dir` does not exist. <!--#5bf7c99cf8b0bd08-->

### `tests/test_config.py` (python) — Unit tests for `WorkflowConfig.from_dict`, exercising the `workflow` config section end-to-end: default values when keys or the whole section are missing, string/bool coercion, sentinel handling for `max_fix_iterations` (0/null = unlimited) and `adjudicate_period` (null = disabled), fail-fast `ConfigError` on out-of-range or wrong-typed values, warn-and-fall-back paths for invalid types, and the once-per-process deprecation warning that forces `self_check_convergence_enabled` to `False`. <!--#877fd90b5136bf3f|4cd75a3dd60e15cd-->
- `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict` (class) — Test class covering `WorkflowConfig.from_dict` parsing of the `workflow` section — defaults when keys/sections are absent, string/bool coercion, fail-fast `ConfigError` on out-of-range `self_check_passes_required`, and once-per-process deprecation warning for `self_check_convergence_enabled`. <!--#1b4b2ed6a5e6dd38-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_empty_dict_returns_defaults` (method) — Asserts an empty dict yields all default config values. <!--#f2ed21774898e0f8-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_none_returns_defaults` (method) — Asserts an empty/None-equivalent dict yields all default config values. <!--#c2ad610b1e7169e0-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_default_values_when_workflow_section_missing` (method) — Asserts defaults apply when the dict has no 'workflow' section. <!--#15e675a2ced50a43-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_custom_max_fix_iterations` (method) — Asserts a custom max_fix_iterations is honored while other fields stay default. <!--#5a25d68d37314388-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_custom_self_check_passes_required` (method) — Asserts a custom self_check_passes_required is honored while other fields stay default. <!--#ed7135967921a9a6-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_deprecated_convergence_true_normalizes_false` (method) — Asserts that a `self_check_convergence_enabled: True` config is normalized to `False` and logs a deprecation message, resetting the process-level warning guard first so the assertion is order-independent. <!--#5f3ae7141acb0c17-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_deprecated_convergence_warns_once_per_process` (method) — Asserts that parsing `self_check_convergence_enabled` twice still yields `False` both times but emits the deprecation warning only once per process. <!--#1e71ed90a91ad292-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_deprecated_convergence_string_true_normalizes_false` (method) — Asserts that the string value `"true"` for the deprecated `self_check_convergence_enabled` key is likewise normalized to `False`. <!--#22e83684464c14ba-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_convergence_enabled_string_false` (method) — Asserts the string 'false' coerces to boolean False. <!--#2aadf16e22dca0bc-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_string_coercion` (method) — Asserts a string-shaped integer for self_check_passes_required coerces to int. <!--#e555ed9a9ae873c0-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_zero_raises` (method) — Asserts self_check_passes_required of 0 raises ConfigError ('must be >= 1'). <!--#4b93eb514cd94333-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_negative_raises` (method) — Asserts a negative self_check_passes_required raises ConfigError ('must be >= 1'). <!--#6b51b557010e4e4b-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_zero_string_raises` (method) — Asserts the string '0' for self_check_passes_required raises ConfigError ('must be >= 1'). <!--#4f89af59c2ac1d76-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_float_falls_back_to_default` (method) — Asserts float self_check_passes_required values warn and fall back to the default. <!--#15fdd6b2fe525fa5-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_bool_falls_back_to_default` (method) — Asserts boolean self_check_passes_required values warn and fall back to the default instead of coercing to int. <!--#e79094dbfe5e558e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_all_fields_custom` (method) — Asserts that a fully populated `workflow` section sets `max_fix_iterations` and `self_check_passes_required` as given while the deprecated convergence flag is still forced to `False`. <!--#a224017a49f1801c-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_invalid_max_fix_iterations_falls_back_to_default` (method) — Asserts a non-integer max_fix_iterations falls back to the default. <!--#3dad8d50f53cb303-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_default_value_is_100` (method) — Asserts DEFAULT_MAX_FIX_ITERATIONS and the field default are both 100. <!--#bcb1193b0c9929db-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_zero_sentinel` (method) — Asserts max_fix_iterations of 0 is preserved as the 'unlimited' sentinel. <!--#e98ef8da6de8af0b-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_null_sentinel` (method) — Asserts None for max_fix_iterations is normalized to the sentinel 0. <!--#0ffc86aaa7abe97a-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_string_zero_preserved` (method) — Asserts the string '0' for max_fix_iterations coerces to the sentinel int 0. <!--#05b0bd12de2822c5-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_negative_raises` (method) — Asserts a negative max_fix_iterations raises ConfigError ('must be >= 0') rather than acting as the sentinel. <!--#6c0a33384d93e6fc-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_negative_string_raises` (method) — Asserts a string-shaped negative max_fix_iterations raises ConfigError ('must be >= 0'). <!--#562caffaf9d8cc9e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_bool_warns_and_falls_back` (method) — Asserts boolean max_fix_iterations values warn and fall back to the default. <!--#51945d355efd2e1e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_default_is_10` (method) — Asserts adjudicate_period defaults to 10 via the constant, the default constructor, and from_dict({}). <!--#95e3bb60a5796557-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_custom_adjudicate_period` (method) — Checks that an explicit adjudicate_period value in the workflow section is honored. <!--#4941e01eb0fb8b70-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_null_disables` (method) — Verifies a null/None adjudicate_period normalizes to 0, disabling the periodic safety net. <!--#5a29de33fbe35610-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_zero_preserved` (method) — Confirms an explicit adjudicate_period of 0 is preserved as-is. <!--#d3c56a42687d9afd-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_string_coercion` (method) — Checks that a string-shaped integer for adjudicate_period is coerced to an int. <!--#94dc22b1062a2136-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_negative_raises` (method) — Asserts a negative adjudicate_period raises ConfigError with a 'must be >= 0' message. <!--#1a6e314c937ef178-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_invalid_raises` (method) — Asserts a non-numeric adjudicate_period string raises ConfigError rather than silently defaulting. <!--#28cd77849de8f13f-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_bool_raises` (method) — Asserts a boolean adjudicate_period raises ConfigError with a 'must be an integer' message. <!--#ebe4251519365a1e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_float_raises` (method) — Asserts a float adjudicate_period raises ConfigError with a 'must be an integer' message. <!--#ebd53d2fc1097259-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_float_warns_and_falls_back` (method) — Asserts float max_fix_iterations values warn and fall back to the default. <!--#533c023e2283a721-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_workflow_section_is_non_dict` (method) — Asserts a non-dict 'workflow' section causes all defaults to be used. <!--#860612c696ec353a-->
- `reset_strategy_deprecation_warning` (function) — Pytest fixture that monkeypatches `tianluo.config._implementation_strategy_deprecation_warned` back to `False` so the per-process deprecation guard is isolated per test. <!--#4ca760c5cb39e571-->
- `TestPlanDecompositionAndGranularity` (class) — Test class asserting that `workflow.plan_decomposition` and `workflow.plan_granularity` accept only their legal values, default to `capability`/`auto` with `*_explicit` flags unset, and raise `ConfigError` naming the config path on invalid input. <!--#ae2d22dc589c6720-->
  - `TestPlanDecompositionAndGranularity.test_plan_decomposition_accepts_all_legal_values` (method) — Parametrized test verifying each legal `plan_decomposition` value (`capability`, `granular`) round-trips through `from_dict` and marks `plan_decomposition_explicit` as True. <!--#75fbfc2eaae4af79-->
  - `TestPlanDecompositionAndGranularity.test_plan_granularity_accepts_all_legal_values` (method) — Parametrized test verifying each legal `plan_granularity` value (`auto`, `single`, `conservative`) round-trips through `from_dict` and marks `plan_granularity_explicit` as True. <!--#870a15778e132d63-->
  - `TestPlanDecompositionAndGranularity.test_defaults_are_capability_and_auto` (method) — Asserts an empty config yields `plan_decomposition=capability` and `plan_granularity=auto` matching the module-level defaults, with both `*_explicit` flags False. <!--#20364e6d18ec882e-->
  - `TestPlanDecompositionAndGranularity.test_dataclass_defaults_match_module_defaults` (method) — Asserts a bare `WorkflowConfig()` instance carries the same `capability`/`auto` defaults as the module constants, guarding against dataclass/constant drift. <!--#da472b876b192077-->
  - `TestPlanDecompositionAndGranularity.test_invalid_plan_decomposition_names_config_path` (method) — Parametrized test that invalid `plan_decomposition` values (wrong name, wrong case, empty, None, int) raise `ConfigError` whose message names the config path and lists the legal values. <!--#5e922f26e438ddee-->
  - `TestPlanDecompositionAndGranularity.test_invalid_plan_granularity_names_config_path` (method) — Parametrized test that invalid `plan_granularity` values raise `ConfigError` whose message names the config path and lists the legal values. <!--#4322cc8a9f60255b-->
- `TestRetiredImplementationStrategyMapping` (class) — Test class covering the one-version compatibility shim that maps the deprecated `workflow.implementation_strategy` onto `plan_decomposition`/`plan_granularity` — including precedence of the new keys, once-per-process warning, fail-fast on bad values, and removal of the old API surface. <!--#b35d896a7695ea97-->
  - `TestRetiredImplementationStrategyMapping.test_legacy_values_map_onto_new_keys` (method) — Parametrized test asserting legacy `implementation_strategy` values (`direct`, `planned`, `auto`) map to their expected `plan_decomposition`/`plan_granularity` pairs. <!--#90936454a37bbc90-->
  - `TestRetiredImplementationStrategyMapping.test_explicit_new_keys_beat_the_legacy_key` (method) — Asserts explicitly configured `plan_decomposition`/`plan_granularity` take precedence over a conflicting legacy `implementation_strategy` value. <!--#7b3fee82d322447e-->
  - `TestRetiredImplementationStrategyMapping.test_mapping_warns_once_per_process` (method) — Asserts the `implementation_strategy is deprecated` warning is logged only once even when `from_dict` parses the legacy key repeatedly. <!--#97b4417b19acd7a2-->
  - `TestRetiredImplementationStrategyMapping.test_invalid_legacy_value_still_fails_fast` (method) — Parametrized test that invalid legacy `implementation_strategy` values raise `ConfigError` naming the config path rather than being silently ignored during the deprecation window. <!--#d070d8ba394dcfe8-->
  - `TestRetiredImplementationStrategyMapping.test_retired_api_surface_is_gone` (method) — Asserts `WorkflowConfig` no longer exposes the retired `implementation_strategy`, `implementation_strategy_explicit`, or `resolve_implementation_strategy` attributes. <!--#b7b98ff9c329b9ec-->

  - `TestBaselineFixMaxAttempts.test_negative_string_raises` (method) — Asserts a string-shaped negative baseline_fix_max_attempts raises ConfigError ('must be >= 0'). <!--#32e99cf1ee76293e-->
  - `TestBaselineFixMaxAttempts.test_bool_warns_and_falls_back` (method) — Asserts boolean baseline_fix_max_attempts values warn and fall back to the default. <!--#b7ff53b6697aa768-->
  - `TestBaselineFixMaxAttempts.test_float_warns_and_falls_back` (method) — Asserts float baseline_fix_max_attempts values warn and fall back to the default. <!--#296f96d12e1eb29c-->
  - `TestBaselineFixMaxAttempts.test_non_numeric_string_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a non-numeric string for baseline_fix_max_attempts falls back to the default. <!--#70da29e4fc9a5424-->
- `TestWorkflowConfigLoad` (class) — Unit tests for `WorkflowConfig.load()`, covering reading `tianluo.yaml` from a directory, defaults when no config file exists, fail-fast `ConfigError` on invalid values, and the INFO log naming the effective config source (including `tianluo.local.yaml` shadowing and per-path log dedup). <!--#eb25a9f590ee95e3-->

- `TestInvestigationConfig` (class) — Unit-test class covering `InvestigationConfig.from_dict` parsing of the `investigation.max_iterations` setting — defaults, the 0/None "unlimited" sentinel, string coercion, and lenient fallback or `ConfigError` for bad types. <!--#228d48a8f176591d-->

### `tests/test_config_merge_registry.py` (python) — Pytest module verifying tianluo.config's global+project config merge semantics: the agents registry merges per-entry (project wins on name conflicts, non-conflicting entries coexist) while llm_caller.defaults and per-step overrides are wholesale-replaced, using helpers to write fake global/project config files and an autouse fixture that clears warning-dedup caches for isolation. <!--#443d936a43bfc72d|5aa37f6b6a737e54-->

- `_write_project` (function) — Test helper that writes the given YAML text into a project-level `tianluo.yaml` file under `tmp_path`. <!--#861b970c44de76b0-->
- `TestRegistryEntryLevelMerge` (class) — Test class verifying that global and project agent registries merge at the per-entry level — same-name entries are overridden by the project while non-conflicting entries from both sources coexist. <!--#7055314202eafe99-->
  - `TestRegistryEntryLevelMerge.test_agents_merge_entry_level` (method) — Asserts that `load_agent_registry` lets a project entry fully override the same-named global entry while preserving distinct global and project entries. <!--#cb649c1e5645824f-->
  - `TestRegistryEntryLevelMerge.test_registry_merge_preserves_non_conflicting_global_entries` (method) — Asserts that a global agent entry not redeclared by the project survives the merge, yielding a registry containing both the global and project-only entries. <!--#d3b64dda53d31d39-->
- `TestDefaultsWholesaleReplace` (class) — Test class verifying that a project's `llm_caller.defaults` list wholesale replaces (rather than appends to) the global defaults, while the global defaults are used when the project omits them. <!--#2e9b18c9d66ebe12-->
  - `TestDefaultsWholesaleReplace.test_project_defaults_wholesale_replace` (method) — Asserts that when both configs define `llm_caller.defaults`, `load_agents` uses only the project's chain and order without appending global defaults. <!--#1b20932de8230d55-->
  - `TestDefaultsWholesaleReplace.test_global_defaults_used_when_project_omits` (method) — Asserts that when the project omits `llm_caller.defaults`, `load_agents` resolves the global defaults against the merged registry preserving their written order (ignoring deprecated priority). <!--#e71ba1ec20083a1b-->
- `TestStepOverrideWholesaleReplace` (class) — Test class verifying that per-step `llm_caller.steps` overrides are wholesale-replaced by the project and that distinct step keys from global and project configs are independently honored. <!--#bab10cfdabe64d81-->
  - `TestStepOverrideWholesaleReplace.test_step_override_wholesale_replace` (method) — Asserts that a project's step override for `implement` completely replaces the global override for the same step via `load_step_agents`. <!--#cd70f18eb3d7a670-->
  - `TestStepOverrideWholesaleReplace.test_step_override_per_step_independent` (method) — Asserts that a global `plan` step override and a project `implement` step override are both honored as independent keys by `load_step_agents`. <!--#f2b10245dc761671-->

### `tests/test_confirm_answer_interpretation.py` (python) — Test module locking in how free-text CONFIRM-gate replies (English and Chinese approval/rejection words, plus ambiguous text like '1') are interpreted into (approved, feedback) and how the structured daemon response envelope drives the CONFIRM step state machine end-to-end. <!--#71eb8aea6c7c7b5f|16085516fae4e547-->
- `test_approval_words` (function) — Parametrized test asserting that recognized approval words are interpreted by `_interpret_confirm_answer` as approved=True with no feedback. <!--#8987324c3a4c5a94-->
- `test_rejection_words` (function) — Parametrized test asserting that rejection words yield approved=False while preserving the operator's original stripped text as feedback. <!--#7de2fd2cb6be74e7-->
- `test_unrecognized_text_is_conservative_revision` (function) — Parametrized test asserting unrecognized text is never silently approved but becomes a revision request (approved=False) carrying the original stripped text as feedback. <!--#94b887475ea0679a-->
- `test_empty_answer_defaults_to_not_approved` (function) — Asserts an empty answer defaults to approved=False with no feedback. <!--#e191b4aff296d79c-->
- `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd` (class) — End-to-end test class verifying that `_check_confirm_response` unwraps the daemon's `{"response": {...}}` CONFIRM envelope — structured `{approved, feedback}` dicts and free-text strings (incl. Chinese "同意" approval and conservative "1"→revision fallback) — and drives the flow step to COMPLETED or REVISION_NEEDED. <!--#288760bf22d0abdc-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.setup_method` (method) — Per-test fixture that builds a temp project root with a `tianluo/calls` dir and a PAUSED FlowInstance holding a completed PLAN step and a PAUSED CONFIRM step (confirm-001) awaiting review of the plan. <!--#d5e16fe030ad4e42-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.teardown_method` (method) — Fixture that removes the temporary project directory after each test. <!--#9a000d928b0a886c-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd._write_call_and_response` (method) — Helper that writes the CONFIRM call file and its `<stem>.response.json` sidecar (with the given response payload) into the temp `tianluo/calls` dir to simulate the daemon's answer. <!--#e0e97d97c47ed0e8-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.test_inner_dict_approved_drives_completed` (method) — Asserts a nested `{approved: True}` response drives the CONFIRM step to COMPLETED with matching review outputs and null revision feedback. <!--#3cd529ec030459c4-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.test_inner_dict_rejected_drives_revision` (method) — Asserts a nested `{approved: False, feedback: "fix X"}` response drives the step to REVISION_NEEDED and propagates the feedback into review_result and revision_feedback. <!--#0efaf3bb1a2c8047-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.test_inner_free_text_chinese_approval_drives_completed` (method) — Asserts a nested plain-string Chinese approval word ("同意") is recognized and drives the step to COMPLETED with approved=True. <!--#dc6ad6e184def0dd-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.test_inner_free_text_one_drives_revision_with_original_text` (method) — Asserts the ambiguous free-text "1" is not silently approved but drives REVISION_NEEDED with the original text preserved as revision feedback. <!--#e457d1bc0ef0e139-->

### `tests/test_confirm_call_payload.py` (python) — Test module covering the confirm-gate call payload — it builds minimal feature flows with plain or adjudicate confirm steps and asserts the written call file's kind/prompt/review-target fields, the baseline-vs-ruling diff anchor across adjudication rounds, robust degradation of malformed or absent `covered_surfaces`, the CLI gate's printing of each swept surface with its justification, and that the enriched file remains consumable by run.py's approval/rejection response handling. <!--#2a436c146eb96de1|be17601f7b6553d2-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Builder that constructs a minimal feature FlowInstance whose change_path.parent resolves back to the given project root, with a configurable task description. <!--#1a5f6332813bd1da-->
- `_add_confirm_step` (function) — Builder that adds a PENDING CONFIRM step (reviewing a given step id/type by a human reviewer) to a flow and marks it as the current step. <!--#33fd834cfb5ebb89-->
- `_add_adjudicate_step` (function) — Test builder that appends a completed ADJUDICATE step to a flow with the given description/rationale, optionally omitting `covered_surfaces` entirely so legacy pre-sweep state files stay covered. <!--#10e7547ec4e896d9-->
- `tmp_project` (function) — Pytest fixture that creates a temporary project directory with a `tianluo/calls/` subtree, yields it, and cleans it up afterward. <!--#a3d4c7448f633920-->
- `_read_call` (function) — Helper that reads and JSON-parses a confirm call file into a dict. <!--#0b6b67b12a012be9-->
- `test_plain_confirm_payload_has_kind_and_prompt` (function) — Asserts a plain (non-adjudicate) confirm call file carries kind='confirm', the legacy `type` discriminant, a non-empty prompt, review-target context, and none of the adjudicate-only fields. <!--#00306982906e4243-->
- `test_plain_confirm_payload_matches_by_step` (function) — Asserts the confirm call file still includes the 'step' key that the resume/consumer path matches on. <!--#11405ad155e6ac10-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_first_round_baseline_falls_back_to_original` (function) — Asserts that for a first-round adjudicate confirm the baseline falls back to the original task description while the post-ruling description/rationale come from the ruling. <!--#564dc97c803cc8c2-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_multi_round_baseline_is_prior_ruling` (function) — Asserts that in a two-round adjudication the baseline is the prior round's ruling (the reviewed round excluded) and the description is the current round's, locking the diff-anchor direction. <!--#d82060db096e01b2-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_prompt_mentions_ruling` (function) — Asserts the generated prompt for an adjudicate confirm mentions adjudication. <!--#f53b18c0325c48bf-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_payload_carries_covered_surfaces` (function) — Asserts an adjudicate confirm call file passes the ruling's `covered_surfaces` (surface + justification) through verbatim to the human gate. <!--#0dc7b5efd1be6987-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_payload_degrades_malformed_covered_surfaces` (function) — Parametrized test asserting malformed or legacy `covered_surfaces` values degrade to an empty list rather than breaking the confirm payload. <!--#57eac6a847f19c72-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_payload_covered_surfaces_absent_from_outputs` (function) — Asserts an adjudicate ruling that never wrote `covered_surfaces` still yields an empty list in the payload instead of a missing key. <!--#aabfddcbd1b6be16-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_payload_drops_only_the_bad_entry` (function) — Asserts per-entry validation of `covered_surfaces` — an invalid entry is dropped while valid siblings survive. <!--#1f6fb5e8879ac216-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_prompt_mentions_covered_surfaces` (function) — Asserts that `build_confirm_prompt` includes covered-surface ('cover') language for the `adjudicate` review type but omits it for `plan`. <!--#294053c3db83b5f9-->
- `_drive_cli_confirm` (function) — Test helper that stubs interjection draining and user-choice prompting to drive `_handle_confirm_pause` past its interactive confirmation prompt (approve or reject). <!--#a17724f536fc5a71-->
- `test_cli_confirm_prints_each_surface_and_justification` (function) — Asserts the CLI confirm gate prints every covered surface together with its justification, since a bare surface list would hide a wrong sweep from the approver. <!--#0d46fe4773b03a75-->
- `test_cli_confirm_reports_when_nothing_was_swept` (function) — Asserts the CLI confirm gate handles an empty `covered_surfaces` list by printing a 'nothing swept in' message instead of crashing. <!--#d63639abc023b847-->
- `test_cli_non_adjudicate_confirm_prints_no_surfaces_section` (function) — Verifies that CLI confirmation output for a non-adjudicate (plan) step does not print the adjudicate 'covered surfaces' section title. <!--#72b72991778c603c-->
- `test_enriched_call_file_still_consumable_by_check_confirm_response` (function) — Checks that a structured `{approved, feedback}` approval wrapped in the daemon's `{response: {...}}` envelope is unwrapped by `_check_confirm_response` into a `review_result` and yields COMPLETED. <!--#ae7451ea13b5a003-->
- `test_enriched_call_file_structured_rejection_routes_to_revision` (function) — Checks that a structured rejection (`approved: False` with feedback) makes `_check_confirm_response` return REVISION_NEEDED and record the feedback in `review_result`. <!--#98bb40e429800083-->

### `tests/test_confirm_noninteractive.py` (python) — Test suite pinning the daemon-spawned (non-interactive, --output-format json) CONFIRM-pause fix, verifying the noninteractive confirm helper fail-safes the flow to PAUSED and persists engine.json's top-level status so the daemon can re-spawn it, while guarding the interactive TTY path (exit 130 on user-exit, approval writes a .response) from regressing. <!--#9dd572c58a25c077|2b5e878908278f1d-->

- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a lightweight SimpleNamespace stand-in for a flow with a given flow_id and status. <!--#440c7c77761732c0-->

  - `_RecordingPersistence.__init__` (method) — Initializes the saved-count to zero. <!--#128bbcc83bb6f82f-->
  - `_RecordingPersistence.save_flow` (method) — Records a save by incrementing the saved counter instead of writing anything. <!--#904c49a19a341084-->
- `test_helper_with_call_file_pauses_and_saves` (function) — Asserts the noninteractive confirm helper, given an existing call file, returns _CONFIRM_AWAITING, sets the flow to PAUSED, and persists once. <!--#65bda7efa0f4fd0f-->
- `test_helper_missing_call_file_still_pauses_failsafe` (function) — Asserts that _handle_confirm_pause_noninteractive still persists the flow as PAUSED (returning _CONFIRM_AWAITING) and only warns when no call_file exists in the step outputs, guaranteeing the flow is never left un-resumable. <!--#ebc07fb888c91ce8-->
- `test_helper_call_file_path_but_not_on_disk_warns` (function) — Asserts the noninteractive helper logs a warning yet still parks the flow at FlowStatus.PAUSED when a call_file path is recorded in outputs but the file is missing from disk. <!--#0a0daa54a7b3fd89-->
- `_make_real_flow` (function) — Test helper that constructs a genuine FlowInstance with PLAN/CONFIRM/IMPLEMENT steps parked at a PAUSED CONFIRM step for end-to-end persistence tests. <!--#fa7f37841e68b44b-->
- `test_helper_persists_engine_json_top_level_status_paused` (function) — Verifies the noninteractive helper writes engine.json with a top-level status of "PAUSED" (the key the daemon reads to re-spawn) using a real PersistenceManager and flow. <!--#ce3e58731cc7ab27-->
- `test_interactive_confirm_pause_user_exit_returns_none` (function) — Guardrail test confirming the interactive _handle_confirm_pause returns None when the user picks "Exit (pause flow)" (choice index 2), the None the run loop maps to a return-130 exit. <!--#5d97c119775423c8-->
- `test_interactive_confirm_pause_approve_writes_response` (function) — Guardrail test confirming interactive approval (choice index 0) returns True and writes a .response sibling file with approved=true next to the call file. <!--#b54fa5fb8d9ed30c-->
- `_FakeStateMachine` (class) — Minimal StateMachine stand-in whose run_step returns a preset result, letting the run loop reach the CONFIRM-PAUSED dispatch without a real state machine, git commit, or LLM call. <!--#ad900038f3d69701-->
  - `_FakeStateMachine.__init__` (method) — Stores the canned step result and initializes the run_step call counter. <!--#70b4bfd7939f68c2-->
  - `_FakeStateMachine.register_handler` (method) — No-op stub for handler registration. <!--#dca32cce72312cfd-->
  - `_FakeStateMachine.init_flow` (method) — No-op stub for flow initialization. <!--#7fb48acd14ccd8f3-->
  - `_FakeStateMachine.run_step` (method) — Increments the call counter and returns the preset step result. <!--#5f1580d39e38c669-->
  - `_FakeStateMachine.transition_to_next` (method) — No-op stub for step transition. <!--#da80c2e5de2aaac6-->
- `_prepare_persisted_confirm_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds and persists a real flow parked at a PAUSED CONFIRM step with its confirm call file written to disk, returning the flow and PersistenceManager. <!--#87c620de94e65784-->

### `tests/test_console_real_daemon_e2e.py` (python) — Isolated end-to-end acceptance test that stands up a real tianluo-server and luo daemon from the current worktree on a private temp dir and dedicated loopback port (with strict guards against touching the user's real daemon), then proves the web-console rendering paradigm works on real daemon-produced history records over HTTP, the production app.js/node renderer, and headless Chromium, and that a CLI `luo run --discover` pause can be answered from the web console to advance the same live process. <!--#52481cc9cb83b2ec|0b6b9e6dee2a71d2-->
- `_server_deps_available` (function) — Capability probe returning True only when the optional server extra (fastapi/uvicorn/websockets) is importable, used to skip the whole module otherwise. <!--#7101c53861230d2b-->
- `_node_available` (function) — Capability probe returning whether the `node` binary is on PATH (for the app.js node-render sub-case). <!--#bae13743c6fd1b27-->
- `_free_port` (function) — Allocates and returns an ephemeral free 127.0.0.1 TCP port so the harness never collides with the user's real daemon. <!--#b7c34f218ce22bed-->
- `_http_get` (function) — Tiny helper that issues an HTTP GET and returns the parsed JSON body. <!--#5bdc3b21b2123641-->
- `_http_post` (function) — Tiny helper that POSTs a JSON payload and returns the parsed JSON response. <!--#1be85a426842a5f8-->
- `_poll` (function) — Generic retry helper that repeatedly calls a function until it returns a truthy value or the attempt budget is exhausted. <!--#ace3ca934d426f44-->
- `_IsolatedConsole` (class) — A test helper that stands up a fully isolated instance — a private temp SE3_DAEMON_DIR, a free loopback port, a seeded admin owner + daemon key in a dedicated sqlite store, and real se3-server + se3 daemon subprocesses launched from the worktree — with hard isolation guards that keep it away from the user's real .se3-stable daemon. <!--#bcfd219347ed48a9-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.__init__` (method) — Constructs the isolated instance state: temp tree, daemon/project dirs, free port, base URL, log paths, sqlite store path, and auth placeholders. <!--#5901e9cfd3a58651-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._env` (method) — Builds the subprocess environment that pins PYTHONPATH to the worktree src and redirects SE3_DAEMON_DIR/HOME into the temp tree to guarantee isolation. <!--#32fbdc659182b915-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.assert_isolation_guards` (method) — Asserts every invariant that keeps the harness away from the user's real daemon (temp daemon dir, non-forbidden port, no stable-instance host/marker, loopback-only). <!--#7cf9e7c7ce2535e5-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._seed_admin_and_key` (method) — Seeds one admin owner (password + issued daemon key, via tianluo.server.crypto and Store) into the explicit sqlite file before the server subprocess opens it, so the daemon can HELLO and the HTTP/browser clients can authenticate. <!--#4f189b37e03b2976-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._install_cookie_opener` (method) — Installs a urllib opener with a cookie jar so every HTTP call automatically carries the owner session cookie. <!--#6e0847d18b06bdb7-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._login` (method) — Logs the REST/browser client in as the seeded admin and captures the resulting `se3_session` cookie value. <!--#835418c232c683eb-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.start` (method) — Boots the isolated stack end to end: asserts isolation guards, runs se3 init on a throwaway project, seeds the admin/key and cookie opener, launches se3-server (non-secure loopback cookie) and polls it healthy, logs in the admin, then launches the daemon (flow discovery disabled) and polls until it connects. <!--#cd31a32fd3560386-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._machine_online` (method) — Polls `/api/machines` and returns True once this harness's machine_id appears as online. <!--#b6a4f68c5d6728da-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.stop` (method) — Tears down both subprocesses (terminate then kill) and closes the log file handles. <!--#7965f2d2bbf6aaf4-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.logs` (method) — Returns the tail of the server and daemon log files for failure diagnostics. <!--#74fe8a28fd12ba6b-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.flow_history` (method) — Method that fetches one flow's history records as a browser would — hitting GET /api/history first to force discovery/index re-push of the freshly written bare *.jsonl flow, then returning the records from the cheap indexed GET /api/history/{flow_id} lookup. <!--#4f1df4815b676473-->
- `console` (function) — Pytest fixture that starts an `_IsolatedConsole`, yields it to the test, and guarantees clean teardown (subprocesses stopped, temp tree removed). <!--#fb9d06e084afa325-->
- `_write_real_history_flow` (function) — Writes a real-shaped multi-step history flow (discovery, a step_completed analyze event, a _G1 group-suffixed implement, and an underscore-bearing version_analyze) whose message records carry no step_type — mirroring exactly what the engine's chat-history writer produces so the daemon must derive step_type from file names. <!--#75f0f2c56b5c814e-->
- `test_harness_is_isolated_and_connected` (function) — Task 1 test asserting the instance is isolated (temp dir + dedicated port, no real-daemon bleed-through) and the worktree daemon/server are connected. <!--#32c1e5204237077c-->
- `test_real_daemon_injects_paradigm_step_type` (function) — Task 2 HTTP-layer test proving the real daemon injects the authoritative file-name-derived `step_type` onto each record while the inner message keeps its real (no-`step_type`) shape. <!--#9e6ec6e4ea397a6c-->
- `test_render_paradigm_via_appjs_on_real_records` (function) — Task 2 rendering test that feeds the real records through the production app.js renderer via a node helper and asserts paradigm step headers and a structured discovery card. <!--#6b843971d495bbf1-->
- `test_render_paradigm_in_headless_browser` (function) — Critical acceptance test that drives real headless Chromium to load the console and run the production app.js renderConversation over real GET /api/history records, asserting the rendered-DOM message paradigm (paradigm step headers, structured discovery card, progressive-disclosure user turn, uncapped report card) via the shared render_in_browser.mjs judgement, failing loudly rather than skipping when Playwright/Chromium is missing. <!--#6e5095d04fa41309-->
- `_write_fake_agent` (function) — Writes a deterministic fake Claude CLI agent that logs each invocation and returns a confirmation response for DISCOVERY prompts (pausing at the gate) and a no-op otherwise. <!--#3a39aa21c6042ed4-->
- `test_cli_discovery_pause_answered_from_web` (function) — Acceptance test that runs a CLI se3 run --discover under a PTY until it pauses at the confirmation gate, verifies the web console sees the pending discovery_confirm chip, answers it via POST /respond, and asserts the same live process consumes the answer and advances while the stale chip clears. <!--#28fc8e14759a944d-->

- `TestEnsureVerbosePytest` (class) — Tests that `_ensure_verbose_pytest` appends `-v` to pytest commands only when critical tests require parseable per-test output. <!--#f68c9283accacfaa-->

- `TestDetectCriticalFailures` (class) — Tests that `_detect_critical_failures` classifies critical tests as skipped vs missing without false positives. <!--#904082e324908cc4-->
  - `TestDetectCriticalFailures.test_skip_hit_records_critical_skipped` (method) — Asserts a critical pattern matching a skipped test is reported as critical_skipped. <!--#b5592d9ac813e863-->

  - `TestDetectCriticalFailures.test_not_parseable_no_false_positive_missing` (method) — Asserts unparseable (no ran/skipped) output never falsely flags missing. <!--#e89a59664855cba1-->
  - `TestDetectCriticalFailures.test_skip_takes_precedence_over_run` (method) — Asserts a pattern matching both a skipped and a run test is reported as skipped. <!--#9c8b8b53bff6f4dd-->
- `TestCriticalTestsConfigLoading` (class) — Test class verifying that TestConfig.load correctly parses the `critical_tests` field from tianluo.yaml — defaulting to an empty list, accepting string lists, coercing elements to str, and falling back to empty on non-list values. <!--#cd7b525da8153aeb-->

  - `TestCriticalTestsConfigLoading.test_loads_string_list` (method) — Asserts that a YAML list under `test.critical_tests` is loaded verbatim into `cfg.critical_tests`. <!--#bdf0e3257c7c00a6-->
  - `TestCriticalTestsConfigLoading.test_non_list_falls_back_to_empty` (method) — Asserts that a non-list `critical_tests` value (a bare string) falls back to an empty list. <!--#3aef43c2ea4e0cb7-->
  - `TestCriticalTestsConfigLoading.test_elements_coerced_to_str` (method) — Asserts that non-string `critical_tests` elements (e.g. integers) are coerced to strings. <!--#b98d29c1954e65ef-->

- `_mock_process` (function) — Test helper creating a mock subprocess with a given returncode and communicate() output. <!--#5653e84933f924f1-->
- `TestHandlerCriticalGate` (class) — Test class exercising run_test_step's critical-acceptance gate: mocking TestConfig.load and subprocess.Popen to verify that skipped or missing critical tests trigger REVISION_NEEDED, while unparseable output, ordinary skips, and unconfigured critical_tests leave the step COMPLETED. <!--#5a45b77d64424a17-->

  - `TestHandlerCriticalGate.test_non_verbose_unparseable_no_false_missing` (method) — Asserts non-verbose unparseable output yields COMPLETED with no false missing detection. <!--#71d6776021a2d7b3-->
  - `TestHandlerCriticalGate.test_ordinary_skip_stays_completed` (method) — Asserts a passing critical test plus an unrelated skip stays COMPLETED. <!--#1f108fb7a9c57d2f-->
  - `TestHandlerCriticalGate.test_no_critical_config_unaffected` (method) — Asserts that with no critical_tests configured, a would-be-critical skip is ignored and stays COMPLETED. <!--#e572b516eb482bcb-->

- `_run_summarize` (function) — Helper that runs summarize_handler with a patched LLMCaller (stubbed return text) and extracts both the step result and the prompt string passed to the LLM. <!--#2810ff568d899956-->
- `TestSummarizeCompletionGate` (class) — Tests that the summarize step suppresses completion/all-green claims when verification did not pass. <!--#88a3331aea473f3b-->

  - `TestSummarizeCompletionGate.test_llm_path_no_gate_when_verified_true` (method) — Asserts no gating text appears in the prompt when verified is True. <!--#f4d2b379294eb11d-->
  - `TestSummarizeCompletionGate.test_fallback_path_summary_not_complete_when_verified_false` (method) — Asserts the fallback basic-summary path omits completion/all-green claims when verified is False. <!--#e794a60ab1f55921-->
  - `TestSummarizeCompletionGate.test_basic_summary_text_gate_direct` (method) — Asserts `_create_basic_summary_text` gates wording on the verified flag (NOT PASSED vs Completed). <!--#0e1e51798b3b1853-->
  - `TestSummarizeCompletionGate.test_completion_section_gate_only_when_verified_false` (method) — Asserts `_build_completion_section` emits gating text only when verified is False, else empty. <!--#0793a9bc1f8865f5-->
- `TestSummarizeGatedTestStatus` (class) — Tests that the session report derives test status from the gated `overall_passed` rather than the raw `passed` key. <!--#e4b0dfad4d7bc806-->
  - `TestSummarizeGatedTestStatus.test_gated_prefers_overall_passed_false` (method) — Asserts `overall_passed` False overrides `passed` True in gated status and formatting. <!--#bd21f21793a5751b-->
