- `TestSummarizeNoIssueDiscovery` (class) — Test class verifying the summarize step performs no issue-discovery injection — its prompt omits `discovered_issues`, produces no such output, and summarize is not whitelisted by get_issue_discovery_injection. <!--#e9227b8063fbd888-->
  - `TestSummarizeNoIssueDiscovery.test_no_injection_in_prompt_and_no_discovered_issues_output` (method) — Asserts the prompt has no issue-discovery injection and the step produces no discovered_issues. <!--#1cbb3aae68dc3679-->
  - `TestSummarizeNoIssueDiscovery.test_summarize_default_not_whitelisted` (method) — Asserts that get_issue_discovery_injection returns an empty string for the `summarize` step by default. <!--#90f20ce1ea218eb0-->

### `tests/test_daemon.py` (python) — Unit tests for the daemon layer — DaemonSupervisor registration/discovery/reaping/liveness under concurrency, the `_cmdline_is_se3_run` predicate that must match genuine `luo run` launch shapes while rejecting inline `python -c` ghost sessions, `_scan_external` discovery with the SE3_EXTERNAL_SCAN_IGNORE opt-out, and `_resolve_se3_command`'s console-script-next-to-sys.executable resolution — with helpers that spawn real child processes and fabricate engine.json / resumable snapshots under a fake project root. <!--#2d061bf741834f67|d8c23a12737d0564-->
- `_spawn_sleeper` (function) — Helper that starts a long-lived child sleep process for liveness/reaping tests. <!--#9f707aff1ef992dd-->
- `_make_engine_json` (function) — Test helper that writes a minimal engine.json under a fake project root's tianluo/state/ directory and returns its payload for aggregator/lifecycle tests. <!--#b8224174a6cc01ac-->
- `_make_resumable_snapshot` (function) — Test helper that writes a per-flow resumable snapshot to tianluo/state/resumable/<flow_id>.json, used to test resume fallback when engine.json has been overwritten. <!--#0ab33390a27dbfa2-->
- `_FakeClient` (class) — Minimal stand-in for DaemonClient exposing connected/last_error attributes. <!--#46848e89149937c9-->
  - `_FakeClient.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake client with given connected flag and last_error. <!--#4deadea26b6f64b5-->
- `TestSupervisor` (class) — Test class for DaemonSupervisor registration, discovery, reaping, liveness, and concurrency. <!--#ef5c28dcbde01cdf-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_register_and_get` (method) — Verifies register returns a record retrievable by pid with correct fields and count. <!--#a67e9126cba05c15-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_register_idempotent` (method) — Verifies re-registering the same pid updates fields without increasing count. <!--#e227d8b554d1347f-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_discover_and_reap_dead_process` (method) — Verifies a dead process is discovered then reaped, clearing it from the supervisor. <!--#2da4f921db7e0e79-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_exit_callback_fires_on_reap` (method) — Verifies an on_exit callback fires with the pid when a process is reaped. <!--#ff89adde164ac1f7-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_is_alive` (method) — Verifies is_alive reports true for the current process and false for an invalid pid. <!--#324adc33dfb0d39a-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_concurrent_registration` (method) — Verifies concurrent registrations from multiple threads are all recorded without loss. <!--#6df556ae1fe213cf-->
- `_wait_until_psutil_observes` (function) — Test helper that blocks until psutil reports the given pid with a populated cmdline, ensuring `_scan_external` regression assertions scan an actually-observable process rather than passing vacuously. <!--#80edf2d300619c7e-->
- `_write_fake_se3` (function) — Test helper that writes an executable `se3`-named shebang script running a given body so psutil observes the real console-script cmdline shape. <!--#bc7ead67114993be-->
- `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run` (class) — Test class verifying _cmdline_is_se3_run matches only genuine `se3 run` launch shapes (console-script, shebang, module form) and rejects inline-code stubs that produce ghost-session false positives. <!--#429ecd6bb624f926-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_inline_code_form_is_not_se3_run` (method) — Asserts a `python -c <code> se3 run` inline-code cmdline is not recognized as an se3 run (the ghost-session false positive). <!--#a380bcc197a06202-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_direct_console_script_argv0` (method) — Asserts the direct console-script forms `luo run --worktree` and `/venv/bin/luo run` (se3 at argv[0]) match. <!--#5a0569a3c34856c9-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_shebang_rewritten_console_script_argv1` (method) — Asserts the shebang-rewritten shape `python3 /venv/bin/luo run` (se3 at argv[1], psutil's real observation) matches. <!--#a7a0b142921f7106-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_module_form` (method) — Asserts the module form `python -m luo run` matches. <!--#c55cededece09adf-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_console_script_with_change_option` (method) — Asserts console-script `luo run -c my-change ...` still matches, ensuring the CLI's own -c/--change option is not mistaken for an interpreter inline-code -c. <!--#278b56d3e4949801-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_module_form_with_change_option` (method) — Asserts the module form `python -m luo run -c my-change` matches, treating the trailing -c as the CLI option rather than interpreter inline code. <!--#59822652ba0bf299-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_inline_code_carrying_module_tokens_is_not_se3_run` (method) — Asserts `python -c <code> -m luo run` is rejected because the interpreter-mode -c disqualifies the stray module-form tokens in the script's argv. <!--#f517a836550e1cb3-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_se3_run_as_script_arguments_only` (method) — Asserts se3/run appearing only as trailing script arguments (no -m se3, no se3 program token) is not recognized as an se3 run. <!--#7c508aa55fa653d1-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_other_se3_subcommand_with_trailing_run_is_not_se3_run` (method) — Asserts `luo migrate run` (across console-script, shebang, and module shapes) is rejected because `run` must be the immediate subcommand, not a nested one. <!--#ddeb2b005af70f90-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_empty_cmdline` (method) — Asserts an empty cmdline list returns False. <!--#e4b9f0686cf32343-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_module_form_without_run` (method) — Asserts `python -m se3` without a trailing `run` subcommand returns False. <!--#ca974ef32391e0a0-->
- `TestScanExternalDiscovery` (class) — Test class verifying `_scan_external`'s tightened cmdline predicate and scan-ignore marker: inline `python -c` stubs are rejected, genuine console-script se3 processes are registered, and default supervisors honour the SE3_EXTERNAL_SCAN_IGNORE marker. <!--#0731bd670654b7c0-->
  - `TestScanExternalDiscovery.test_inline_code_se3_run_not_registered` (method) — Asserts that a `python -c ... luo run` inline-code process, though observed by psutil, is rejected by the cmdline predicate and never registered as a flow. <!--#bc6855b45832740d-->
  - `TestScanExternalDiscovery.test_console_script_se3_run_registered` (method) — Asserts that a genuine console-script se3 stub (opted back into scanning) is discovered and registered as a flow once psutil observes its shebang-rewritten cmdline. <!--#92c469f6d31aa00f-->
  - `TestScanExternalDiscovery.test_scan_ignored_stub_not_registered_by_default_supervisor` (method) — Asserts a default `DaemonSupervisor()` honours the SE3_EXTERNAL_SCAN_IGNORE marker and skips registering a marked stub, guarding the `_proc_opted_out_of_scan` skip branch against regressions. <!--#8c4f04311406173f-->
- `TestResolveSe3Command` (class) — Test class verifying _resolve_se3_command prefers a console script (luo/tianluo/legacy se3) sitting next to sys.executable over PATH's which(), falling back to the module form. <!--#00799e922df57665-->
  - `TestResolveSe3Command.test_prefers_sys_executable_prefix` (method) — Asserts _resolve_se3_command prefers the `luo` script next to sys.executable over an unrelated one returned by shutil.which. <!--#f44c78ff6e8fc84e-->
  - `TestResolveSe3Command.test_prefers_legacy_se3_script_over_module_form` (method) — Asserts an old install shipping only the legacy `se3` sibling script still resolves to it rather than the module-form fallback. <!--#a15d1db9dc9f41fd-->
  - `TestResolveSe3Command.test_falls_back_to_module_form` (method) — Asserts _resolve_se3_command falls back to [sys.executable, '-m', 'tianluo'] when no sibling console script exists next to the interpreter. <!--#d869681a3cf9c4f8-->
- `fake_se3` (function) — Pytest fixture replacing the se3 command with a fake NDJSON-emitting script. <!--#9b8accbde61020dd-->
- `TestSpawner` (class) — Unit tests for `DaemonSpawner`, asserting that spawning a child `se3` process builds the correct argv — `--output-format json`, optional `--discover`/`--worktree`/`--from-issue`, and the `--plan-decomposition`/`--plan-granularity` plan-mode options — and that the child is waited on and reaped. <!--#840c7c6c9b7405ca-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_starts_child` (method) — Verifies spawn launches a child with a valid pid and JSON output-format args. <!--#5a6b943bd6acf725-->

  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_omits_discover_flag_by_default` (method) — Verifies spawn omits --discover by default. <!--#ff960bb0bc38ae9d-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_appends_worktree_flag` (method) — Verifies spawn appends --worktree when worktree=True. <!--#2c2c153a9867f293-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_omits_worktree_flag_by_default` (method) — Verifies spawn omits --worktree by default. <!--#1cb4d5a659485f0b-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_from_issue_appends_worktree` (method) — Verifies a from-issue spawn includes both --from-issue and --worktree flags. <!--#ddf39e96950885d6-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_from_issue_builds_from_issue_argv` (method) — Verifies from-issue spawn builds --from-issue argv and excludes the task description and --type. <!--#76cf42595cf1f679-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_from_issue_appends_discover` (method) — Verifies a from-issue spawn includes both --from-issue and --discover flags. <!--#285baa8a9ee53073-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_appends_plan_mode_options` (method) — Asserts that passing both `plan_decomposition` and `plan_granularity` to `DaemonSpawner.spawn` puts `--plan-decomposition capability` and `--plan-granularity single` on the child argv. <!--#22b82ea4af19079c-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_omits_plan_mode_options_by_default` (method) — Asserts that a plain spawn omits both plan-mode flags so the CLI falls back to project config or defaults. <!--#228f05b6ebdf1ec3-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_appends_only_the_selected_plan_mode_axis` (method) — Asserts that supplying only one plan-mode axis emits just that flag and leaves the other axis off the argv rather than guessing a value. <!--#1e5e0ebd548a8811-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_from_issue_appends_plan_mode_options` (method) — Asserts that plan-mode options are still forwarded on the `--from-issue` spawn path. <!--#f50d7642b9aacddf-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_plan_mode_with_worktree_combined` (method) — Asserts that `--worktree` and both plan-mode options can be combined on a single spawn without interfering with each other. <!--#1597b71ffad4164c-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_iter_events_parses_ndjson` (method) — Verifies iter_events parses the child's NDJSON output into step/flow events. <!--#f191a845008c5479-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_registers_with_supervisor` (method) — Verifies a spawned child is registered with the supervisor and cleared on reap. <!--#f6684f8f9efdf1b5-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_terminate_sends_sigterm` (method) — Verifies terminate sends SIGTERM and stops a running child. <!--#d732720acabc44ba-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_high_volume_output_does_not_deadlock` (method) — Regression test that a child emitting >64KB of output finishes without pipe-buffer deadlock by logging to files. <!--#32c3418ef523636a-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_orphans_and_reap` (method) — Verifies a finished child stays tracked until reaped, then leaves no orphans. <!--#e3da9707158349c7-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_resume_builds_resume_argv` (method) — Verifies resume builds argv with --resume, --flow-id, the flow id, and JSON output. <!--#257e95e14cf61007-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_resume_registers_with_supervisor` (method) — Verifies a resumed flow's process is registered with the supervisor. <!--#84d48f635eb079b0-->
- `TestEnsureSe3Project` (class) — Test class for the pre-spawn auto-init hook (ensure_se3_project) used by the web New Task form, covering skip, init, and error paths. <!--#3fab0d26ab39afed-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_skips_init_when_already_se3_project` (method) — Asserts ensure_se3_project skips subprocess init when tianluo/charter.md already exists. <!--#e70ef23589b103d5-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_runs_init_on_empty_directory` (method) — Asserts ensure_se3_project runs `se3 init -p <root>` on an empty directory and reports initialized=True. <!--#76a84e9ca8784f06-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_returns_error_on_nonzero_exit` (method) — Verifies a non-zero init exit code surfaces as an error string without raising. <!--#221109b29c4a6f35-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_returns_error_when_marker_missing_after_init` (method) — Verifies init exiting 0 but leaving no marker file is treated as a failure. <!--#a54aa8f08798dc50-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_empty_project_root_returns_error` (method) — Verifies an empty project_root argument returns an error without initializing. <!--#1e7177e189d933fc-->

  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_spawn_omits_plan_mode_by_default` (method) — Asserts that `Daemon.request_spawn` leaves both plan-mode flags off the argv when no plan mode is requested. <!--#446048644601c5c4-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_resume_paused_flow_spawns_resume` (method) — Verifies _resume_paused_flow spawns a --resume process for a paused flow and registers its root. <!--#e06dd0efafff9675-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_resume_skips_non_paused_flow` (method) — Verifies _resume_paused_flow does nothing for a running (non-paused) flow. <!--#2ce3ae28c0c32cc4-->

- `TestProjectRootsRegistryHelpers` (class) — Test class for the project_roots.json registry helpers (_read_project_roots / _append_project_root) covering missing/corrupt reads, roundtrip, dedup, realpath normalization, atomic write, and config path. <!--#6000278cbf5ec3fa-->

- `TestProjectRootsSelfHeal` (class) — Test class verifying the project-roots registry self-heals: nonexistent roots are filtered on read, erased from disk by `_sanitize`, and never appended, with safe handling of missing/corrupt files. <!--#fc6b5dfe9432d787-->

  - `TestProjectRootsSelfHeal.test_sanitize_erases_nonexistent_root_from_disk` (method) — Asserts `_sanitize_project_roots` physically removes a deleted root from the on-disk document so the self-heal survives a restart. <!--#2c83b7dcc4cb3d74-->
  - `TestProjectRootsSelfHeal.test_sanitize_no_change_when_all_roots_exist` (method) — Asserts `_sanitize_project_roots` leaves the file untouched (unchanged mtime) when every root still exists, avoiding needless rewrites. <!--#18869386de801e35-->
  - `TestProjectRootsSelfHeal.test_sanitize_missing_file_is_safe` (method) — Asserts `_sanitize_project_roots` neither raises nor creates the file when the registry is absent. <!--#1b6358233f9ab5b1-->
  - `TestProjectRootsSelfHeal.test_sanitize_corrupt_file_is_safe` (method) — Asserts `_sanitize_project_roots` tolerates invalid-JSON registry content without raising or blocking startup. <!--#54ef38fa10800828-->

  - `TestProjectRootsSelfHeal.test_append_new_root_prunes_persisted_stale_root` (method) — Asserts appending a new live root also prunes a previously persisted stale root from disk rather than carrying it forward until the next restart. <!--#e9d7bf1eef4e45f7-->
- `TestRegistryWriteThrough` (class) — Test class verifying add_project_root / request_spawn / _poll_once persist roots to the on-disk registry. <!--#8c314cacf5aa4aea-->

### `tests/test_daemon_aggregator.py` (python) — Unit tests for DaemonAggregator's snapshot pipeline — per-flow filtering of pending calls (including legacy top-level flow_id folding and the retry_decision-on-failed-step stale exemption), flowless/archived-root and completed-flow snapshot behaviour, MachineStatus project_roots merging/caching of active plus historical roots, and issue collection from open/ and closed/ YAML directories. <!--#440576d33e3e6052|1af8439925dd0cf3-->
- `_write` (function) — Helper that JSON-serializes a payload to a file path, creating parent directories as needed. <!--#65d03e595cacafc0-->
- `_call` (function) — Factory building a PendingCall with an optional context.flow_id (sentinel '__missing__' omits the field entirely). <!--#9e798695f2db895a-->
- `test_filter_keeps_matching_flow_id` (function) — Asserts _filter_calls_for_flow keeps calls whose context.flow_id matches the target flow. <!--#2965e2e6a9b55908-->
- `test_filter_drops_non_matching_flow_id` (function) — Asserts _filter_calls_for_flow drops calls belonging to a different flow_id. <!--#16a407315ef3fa27-->
- `test_filter_drops_unattributed_calls_when_flow_id_known` (function) — Asserts unattributed (missing/empty flow_id) calls are dropped when the current flow_id is known. <!--#e6da64573e9a6581-->
- `test_filter_passthrough_when_flow_id_unknown` (function) — Asserts the filter passes all calls through unchanged when the target flow_id is None or empty. <!--#0fe641b806ffa666-->
- `_make_root` (function) — Test helper that builds a project root with an engine.json plus a set of call files (from (call_id, context) specs and optional raw payloads) for exercising the aggregator's flow-scoped call filtering. <!--#3424560847d782b3-->
- `test_snapshot_filters_pending_calls_by_flow_id` (function) — End-to-end test that _snapshot_for_root surfaces only calls matching the engine's flow_id, dropping other-flow/unattributed/legacy ones. <!--#1f216e1fbd3b7191-->
- `test_snapshot_folds_legacy_top_level_flow_id` (function) — Asserts that legacy call files carrying a top-level flow_id (no context field, as _write_discovery_call writes) are folded into context.flow_id so they survive the per-flow filter, while other-flow calls are dropped. <!--#0aa813f78af59dd1-->
- `test_snapshot_no_engine_json_yields_no_flow` (function) — Verifies that a root with no active engine.json yields None from _snapshot_for_root rather than a flowless '(untitled flow)' card. <!--#de3698fa65f90a63-->
- `test_snapshot_completed_flow_reports_total_and_full_progress` (function) — Checks that a COMPLETED engine.json with current_step_index equal to the step total reports total_steps/current_step_index of 3/3 and progress 1.0. <!--#61669d41d09a192f-->
- `test_run_fallback_completion_advances_index_to_total` (function) — End-to-end test that run._complete_flow_via_fallback (taken when get_current_step() is None due to a dangling step) advances current_step_index to len(selected_steps) so the aggregator reports total/total and progress 1.0. <!--#c7cef96622a0516c-->
- `test_machine_status_project_roots` (function) — Asserts MachineStatus exposes and serializes its registered project_roots (empty list when none). <!--#907ec55ff3436564-->
- `test_get_snapshot_copies_root_set_before_iterating` (function) — Asserts get_snapshot iterates a copy of the project-root set so a concurrent add_project_root doesn't raise a 'set changed size' error. <!--#3eff3ecf8e3f2b9f-->
- `test_machine_status_project_roots_includes_historical` (function) — Verifies get_snapshot().project_roots merges active registrations with historical roots discovered via on-disk archive/history artifacts, without duplicates after re-registration. <!--#aeefb3cddb5a0447-->
- `test_machine_status_project_roots_sorted_and_unique` (function) — Asserts the merged project_roots list is sorted and de-duplicated even when a root is both active and picked up by historical enumeration. <!--#dfa56c96f995e10b-->
- `_stale_call` (function) — Factory building a PendingCall tagged with kind, step_id, and a fixed flow_id for stale-filtering tests. <!--#c7eed47c3e390a47-->
- `_state_with_step_status` (function) — Helper producing a minimal engine state dict whose single current step carries a given status. <!--#dab21fe4a4398f0e-->
- `test_filter_stale_keeps_retry_decision_on_failed_current_step` (function) — Asserts a retry_decision call on the FAILED current step is exempt from stale filtering and stays pending. <!--#534b668a6d8e8000-->
- `test_filter_stale_drops_plain_call_on_failed_step` (function) — Asserts non-exempt (kind=call) calls still follow the FAILED-as-stale rule and are dropped. <!--#ca5fb00f0338d0d0-->
- `test_filter_stale_drops_retry_decision_on_non_failed_processed_status` (function) — Verifies the retry_decision exemption applies only to 'failed', not completed/partial/revision_needed statuses. <!--#844a90b7067b7b10-->
- `test_filter_stale_drops_retry_decision_when_flow_moved_past_step` (function) — Asserts the retry_decision exemption is scoped to the current step and drops it once the flow advances past that step. <!--#3a71135fad2c9f75-->
- `test_filter_stale_mixed_kinds_on_failed_step` (function) — Asserts that in a mixed batch on a failed step the retry_decision survives while a plain call is filtered out. <!--#453ddaec70d0a347-->
- `test_machine_status_pending_calls_unfiltered` (function) — Verifies flow snapshots are strictly flow-scoped while MachineStatus.pending_calls retains the unfiltered machine-wide aggregate. <!--#3380fa4499f6a42d-->
- `test_all_project_roots_caches_historical_enumeration` (function) — Confirms the disk-history walk (enumerate_historical_project_roots) runs at most once within the TTL window across repeated all_project_roots() calls. <!--#dcf745f8eb88cba0-->
- `test_all_project_roots_active_root_visible_immediately` (function) — Ensures a newly add_project_root'd active root appears in all_project_roots() immediately (cache invalidated), not only after the TTL elapses. <!--#3a2e6857273da166-->
- `test_readd_existing_root_keeps_history_cache_warm` (function) — Asserts that idempotently re-adding an already-tracked root does not bust the historical cache (avoiding a per-tick disk walk), while a genuinely new root does re-enumerate. <!--#fb9eca7a232eb89b-->
- `test_all_project_roots_reenumerates_after_ttl` (function) — Verifies that once HISTORICAL_ROOTS_TTL elapses (via a monkeypatched monotonic clock), the disk history walk runs again. <!--#7141b95f8e555282-->
- `test_all_project_roots_reenumerates_on_base_change` (function) — Checks that a changed base fingerprint (set_project_roots with new roots) forces re-enumeration even within the TTL. <!--#559e339e9ab4c69e-->
- `_write_issue` (function) — Test helper that writes an issue YAML file (id, title, description, status, priority, type, tags, source) into tianluo/issues/<subdir>/ for aggregator issue-collection tests. <!--#0626f90f223ec128-->
- `test_get_snapshot_archived_root_no_flowless_flow` (function) — Regression test that an archived root (issues on disk but no engine.json) contributes no flowless entry to status.flows while its issues still reach MachineStatus.issues via _collect_issues. <!--#b80efdd2d1b36ab9-->
- `test_collect_issues_reads_open_and_closed` (function) — Verifies _collect_issues reads issue YAMLs from both the open/ and closed/ subdirectories. <!--#f696992b342ebf94-->
- `test_collect_issues_snapshot_fields` (function) — Asserts each IssueSnapshot carries all webui-relevant fields (id, project_root, title, description, status, priority, type, tags, source) and that the retired 'scope' field is neither exposed nor serialized. <!--#f7bc7c4482d2e104-->
- `test_collect_issues_skips_malformed` (function) — Checks that malformed issue YAML files are silently skipped while valid ones alongside are still collected. <!--#bd970a320a4bd0fa-->
- `test_collect_issues_returns_empty_when_no_dir` (function) — Verifies _collect_issues returns an empty list when the issues directory does not exist. <!--#e27cb42be212612f-->
- `test_machine_status_includes_issues` (function) — Confirms get_snapshot() populates MachineStatus.issues (and its serialized to_dict payload) from on-disk issue YAMLs. <!--#1b1887cc5ae5131a-->
- `test_issue_snapshot_to_dict_omits_none_optional_fields` (function) — Asserts IssueSnapshot.to_dict omits the title, priority, and type keys when those optional fields are None. <!--#912054d9a290b654-->
- `_make_worktree_run` (function) — Test helper that writes a `se3 run --worktree` isolation subdir (engine.json plus a history jsonl) under <main_root>/tianluo/worktrees/, mirroring a live worktree-mode flow. <!--#64e29b432d6a1260-->
- `test_active_worktree_run_root_is_observable` (function) — Asserts a live --worktree run's subdir is surfaced by all_observable_roots but excluded from the dropdown-facing all_project_roots. <!--#840f408c0d6d593f-->
- `test_snapshot_includes_worktree_flow_but_not_in_project_roots` (function) — Verifies get_snapshot reports the worktree flow as a live card while keeping its sandbox path out of project_roots. <!--#079d21409d94798d-->
- `test_dag_impl_worktree_not_observed` (function) — Verifies a DAG implement-step isolation worktree (lacking is_worktree_mode) is excluded from all_observable_roots() and its flow never appears in the snapshot. <!--#59c90f3914c560a4-->
- `test_worktree_run_observed_from_registry_without_active_root` (function) — Asserts a registry-only main root (no active registration) still has its worktree runs discovered as observable. <!--#30623fe25a2c6b68-->
- `test_snapshot_surfaces_waiting_for_lock_true` (function) — Asserts a RUNNING engine.json with waiting_for_lock=True surfaces that flag on FlowSnapshot (and survives to_dict serialization) even with no step records. <!--#d627677cca422e1d-->
- `test_snapshot_waiting_for_lock_defaults_false` (function) — Verifies an engine.json without the waiting_for_lock flag reads as False on the snapshot and in its serialized form. <!--#d7305822c8df6f13-->
- `_make_worktree_dir` (function) — Test helper that creates a bare worktree isolation copy directory under <main>/tianluo/worktrees/. <!--#89ff9a85dc4269d5-->
- `test_add_project_root_normalizes_worktree_into_active_set` (function) — Confirms feeding a worktree path to add_project_root registers only its main root in the active project_roots set, not the worktree path. <!--#1d55c75ae91d6404-->
- `test_add_project_root_normalizes_worktree_into_registry_callback` (function) — Verifies the registry_persist callback receives the normalized main root rather than the worktree path. <!--#5d485c5da0f851d4-->
- `test_all_project_roots_never_lists_a_worktree_path` (function) — Asserts no /tianluo/worktrees/ path ever appears in the dropdown-facing all_project_roots() view, even when fed in directly and present in the registry. <!--#cc3b939f1ff040e7-->
- `_registry_backed_aggregator` (function) — Test helper that builds a DaemonAggregator whose load/load_raw/persist/remove registry callbacks all read and mutate a plain in-memory list of root paths, standing in for the on-disk project registry. <!--#b79c2b9514d4ea5a-->
- `test_registered_projects_marks_vanished_entry_as_stale` (function) — Asserts registered_projects() sources from the raw registry view so a registered root whose directory no longer exists is still listed, flagged exists=False rather than silently filtered out. <!--#39996c4eab53d3ad-->
- `test_registered_projects_flags_active_and_registry_only_roots` (function) — Checks that registered_projects() merges in-memory and persisted roots, marks active=True only for in-memory ones, sorts rows by path, and emits exactly the path/exists/active keys. <!--#7848e377ca8773d8-->
- `test_registered_projects_degrades_to_active_set_without_raw_callback` (function) — Verifies that with no registry_load_raw callback wired, registered_projects() falls back to reporting just the aggregator's in-memory active roots. <!--#c5375e6410597e62-->
- `test_registered_projects_swallows_callback_failure` (function) — Verifies a raising registry_load_raw callback is caught so registered_projects() still returns the in-memory roots instead of propagating the error. <!--#222cc8b2799e709b-->
- `test_snapshot_carries_registered_projects` (function) — Checks that get_snapshot().to_dict()['registered_projects'] lists a registry-backed project with its path, exists, and active flags. <!--#53c0dac1b60ffe66-->
- `test_unregister_clears_persisted_memo_so_readd_writes_through` (function) — Regression guard that unregister_project_root() clears both _persisted_roots and _project_roots, so a later re-add actually writes through to the registry instead of being skipped as already-persisted. <!--#d33e36dbb523dd2a-->
- `test_unregister_drops_root_from_all_project_roots` (function) — Verifies unregister_project_root removes a root from all_project_roots() and that the root's own on-disk history does not resurrect it. <!--#6fb2c2d2d313d54d-->
- `test_unregister_folds_worktree_spelling_to_main_root` (function) — Asserts unregister_project_root accepts a worktree-spelled path, folds it to the main root, and clears that root from both the registry and project_roots. <!--#88b8be54710633e4-->
- `test_unregister_unknown_root_reports_false` (function) — Asserts unregister_project_root() returns False for a path that was never registered. <!--#64e2e9e6f81541ac-->
- `test_unregister_raises_on_registry_callback_failure` (function) — Asserts a failing registry_remove callback raises ProjectRegistryError (not a False "nothing registered" result) and leaves the in-memory root list unchanged so it stays in lockstep with the untouched registry file. <!--#9e08382186451110-->
- `test_unregister_registry_failure_keeps_persisted_bookkeeping` (function) — Asserts that after a failed durable delete the persisted-roots memo and the backing list both stay intact, matching the unmodified registry file. <!--#eae510bb7d4757b8-->
- `test_remove_project_root_leaves_registry_file_alone` (function) — Pins the legacy remove_project_root() as an in-memory-only operation that must not invoke the registry remove callback or alter the persisted roots. <!--#8a7776d8a8f57160-->

### `tests/test_daemon_client.py` (python) — Pytest suite for the daemon-side WebSocket client (`tianluo.daemon.client`), covering `_normalize_ws_url` scheme/port/IPv6 normalization against `protocol.DEFAULT_SERVER_PORT`/`DEFAULT_SERVER_TLS_PORT`, `_format_exc` producing non-empty readable reasons, and `DaemonClient.run` recording `last_error` on dial failures and WELCOME rejections, plus integration with `Daemon`/`DaemonConfig` and `_default_respond_handler`. <!--#07f416144cd79708|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/test_daemon_cursor_resume.py` (python) — Regression test suite for the G3 fix ensuring the daemon retains a terminal (e.g. FAILED) flow's history cursor across a final flush and fail→resume so resume continues with an append delta rather than a full re-read, while still pruning drained-and-archived flows. <!--#451d5af6b6d2eca6|12875848d82db8b5-->
- `_make_client` (function) — Helper that constructs a DaemonClient wired to a given history provider and stub snapshot provider for testing. <!--#f19f94c6130c7b3c-->
- `_FakeWS` (class) — Minimal in-memory WebSocket stand-in that decodes and records every frame the client sends. <!--#4bcd88a41b8c0413-->
  - `_FakeWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake WebSocket's list capturing sent (decoded) messages. <!--#b8b92aad379d234c-->
  - `_FakeWS.send` (method) — Decodes the outgoing payload and appends it to the captured sent-messages list. <!--#7d44362527b3e749-->
- `_ScriptedHistoryProvider` (class) — Test double history provider whose per-round reads and live-flow set are scriptable, recording the cursor maps it receives so tests can assert append-continuation. <!--#d460b8347a7f3ef4-->
  - `_ScriptedHistoryProvider.__init__` (method) — Initializes the scripted provider's reads list, live-flow set, and seen-cursors log. <!--#9576faf525691821-->
  - `_ScriptedHistoryProvider.build_index` (method) — Returns an empty index (no-op stub for the provider interface). <!--#c4f69f683d154763-->
  - `_ScriptedHistoryProvider.active_flow_signature` (method) — Returns an empty signature dict (no-op stub for the provider interface). <!--#d5e6eba440e59874-->
  - `_ScriptedHistoryProvider.live_flow_ids` (method) — Returns a copy of the scripted set of live (resumable) flow ids. <!--#23771304885724d8-->
  - `_ScriptedHistoryProvider.read_active_flows` (method) — Snapshots the cursor map it was handed and returns the scripted FlowRead list for the round. <!--#01ccc7af1db29b29-->
- `_data_frames` (function) — Filters a fake WebSocket's captured messages down to history-data frames. <!--#47b939ac7698c1bb-->
- `test_terminal_flush_retains_cursor_for_live_flow` (function) — Asserts a FAILED flow still in engine.json keeps its cursor through the final flush and the subsequent record-less round. <!--#0a532ed50662e298-->
- `test_resume_continues_with_append_not_full_reread` (function) — Asserts that after resume the retained cursor is passed to the read, yielding an append delta carrying only the new record rather than a full re-read. <!--#ef4df2f2e57fb2ec-->
- `test_drained_archived_flow_cursor_is_pruned` (function) — Asserts a drained terminal flow no longer in engine.json is pruned from the cursor map while the live flow's cursor is retained. <!--#0dca867b14b922af-->
- `test_provider_without_live_flow_ids_falls_back_to_prune` (function) — Asserts a legacy provider lacking live_flow_ids retains the old prune-on-drain behavior (empty resumable set). <!--#fa516d7bd6da98c5-->
- `_write_engine_json` (function) — Test helper that writes a minimal tianluo/state/engine.json under a given root recording a flow_id and status, simulating the live/resumable-flow marker. <!--#b866908ae460134d-->
- `test_live_flow_ids_includes_failed_engine_flow` (function) — Asserts DaemonHistoryReader.live_flow_ids counts a FAILED engine.json flow as live/resumable. <!--#56e6bf31823b865e-->
- `test_live_flow_ids_bounded_to_one_per_root` (function) — Asserts each project root contributes at most its single current engine.json flow to live_flow_ids. <!--#0b05c7ceca5703fe-->
- `test_live_flow_ids_empty_without_engine_json` (function) — Test asserting DaemonHistoryReader.live_flow_ids() returns an empty set when a root has a state dir but no engine.json, so no spurious cursor retention occurs. <!--#90d236ee99346fa5-->

### `tests/test_daemon_event_loop_spin.py` (python) — Regression tests ensuring the daemon avoids event-loop spin by TTL-caching expensive index builds and historical-root walks, verifying build_index/read_active_flows caching, invalidation, stale-flow detection, and bounded disk enumeration across poll/push loop ticks. <!--#0235d1d302f294fa|953e5d61cd695620-->
- `_write_jsonl` (function) — Test helper that writes a list of objects as JSONL to a path, creating parent directories as needed. <!--#382769e0f0931aaa-->
- `_msg` (function) — Test helper that builds a simple role/content message dict. <!--#bfbb3b9d14c45ada-->
- `_write_engine` (function) — Test helper that writes a minimal engine.json (flow_id + status) under <root>/tianluo/state/ to simulate an active flow's daemon state. <!--#1d4f2ea6d3f9b0fd-->
- `test_build_index_caches_within_ttl` (function) — Asserts that repeated DaemonHistoryReader.build_index() calls within the TTL window perform only one disk walk and return the same cached object, the core defense against the daemon's per-tick event-loop spin. <!--#727183ee4c46bd5a-->
- `test_build_index_rebuilds_after_ttl` (function) — Verifies that build_index() re-walks the disk (index_count increments) once the cache timestamp is advanced past BUILD_INDEX_TTL. <!--#bf495914ce8faa2d-->
- `test_build_index_cache_invalidation` (function) — Checks that invalidate_index_cache() forces the next build_index() call to rebuild from disk instead of serving the cache. <!--#66692255046a036d-->
- `test_build_index_cache_returns_fresh_data_after_invalidation` (function) — Confirms that after invalidate_index_cache() a rebuilt index reflects newly added history-only flows (f1 then f1+f2). <!--#a4e1202f233c465c-->
- `test_is_still_active_rejects_stale_flow_when_different_flow_is_active` (function) — Asserts _is_still_active returns False for a stale meta whose flow_id no longer matches the engine.json's active flow, and True only for the current flow. <!--#d78a01fee66f5d76-->
- `test_is_still_active_returns_false_for_non_active_source` (function) — Asserts _is_still_active never re-checks archived/history-only metas as active. <!--#762a82f09c02f03a-->
- `test_is_still_active_returns_false_when_engine_json_missing` (function) — Asserts _is_still_active returns False when the project's engine.json is absent. <!--#f5d0a20e41fff33e-->
- `test_read_active_flows_drops_stale_flow_after_flow_change` (function) — Ensures read_active_flows() reports the newly active flow (f2) and drops the completed one (f1) after the engine state changes and the TTL elapses. <!--#4662ad80ad52faad-->
- `test_all_project_roots_historical_walk_bounded_per_ttl` (function) — Asserts the aggregator's all_project_roots runs historical-root enumeration at most once per HISTORICAL_ROOTS_TTL window despite many calls. <!--#4b2c44773174313a-->
- `test_combined_poll_push_cadence_bounded` (function) — Simulates 30 daemon ticks of aggregator poll + client push loops and asserts expensive disk operations (historical-root enumeration and build_index rebuilds) stay bounded rather than growing linearly with tick count. <!--#625ccd63c6dee210-->

### `tests/test_daemon_history.py` (python) — Pytest suite for the daemon-side history reader (`tianluo.daemon.history`), building temporary project trees of active `engine.json`, archived, and history-only flows to verify `DaemonHistoryReader.build_index` metadata (source, active status, step counts, inferred plan_mode), `SessionMeta`, `enumerate_historical_project_roots`, and the `HISTORY_MODE_FULL`/`HISTORY_MODE_APPEND` jsonl reading paths. <!--#45d32895876697fa|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/test_daemon_history_index_delta.py` (python) — A pytest suite locking the daemon client's incremental HISTORY_INDEX traffic-reduction contract, verifying that full index frames are sent only as reconciliation baselines (connect/request/legacy peer) while steady-state changes ship per-flow delta upserts/removals, that updated_at-only 'liveness' ticks are throttled to the status heartbeat, and that index deltas coexist with metered incremental HISTORY_DATA cursor pushes. <!--#32a2c083d8b13848|bb3082123d434a96-->
- `_FakeWS` (class) — A minimal async WebSocket stand-in that captures and decodes every protocol frame the daemon client sends, for assertion in tests. <!--#419a56ffe2a5b3eb-->
  - `_FakeWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake WebSocket with an empty `sent` list to accumulate captured frames. <!--#b8b92aad379d234c-->
  - `_FakeWS.send` (method) — Async send override that decodes the outgoing frame and appends it to the captured `sent` list. <!--#7d44362527b3e749-->
- `_IndexProvider` (class) — A stub history provider whose returned session index and active-flow reads are set per test to drive the client's history-push logic. <!--#02665c0bc7fb68f4-->
  - `_IndexProvider.__init__` (method) — Initializes the provider with empty `metas` (index) and `reads` (active flows) lists. <!--#45e87bde89ae83e5-->
  - `_IndexProvider.build_index` (method) — Returns a copy of the configured session-meta list as the current history index. <!--#474a9aa1feea4e55-->
  - `_IndexProvider.read_active_flows` (method) — Returns a copy of the configured active-flow reads, ignoring the passed cursors. <!--#3ee216e300d899fd-->
  - `_IndexProvider.active_flow_signature` (method) — Returns an empty signature dict, stubbing out active-flow change detection. <!--#d5e6eba440e59874-->
- `_make_client` (function) — Factory that builds a DaemonClient wired to a given provider and forces the peer-reduction flag to simulate a rev-3 (or legacy) server. <!--#a6dfa0b04e6b7ea0-->
- `_meta` (function) — Helper that constructs a SessionMeta with overridable flow_id, updated_at, status, and step_count for building test index entries. <!--#859733252d6e0a39-->
- `_frames` (function) — Helper that filters a fake WebSocket's captured frames down to those of a given message type. <!--#3070312c78e68fc4-->
- `test_meta_change_is_throttleable_updated_at_only` (function) — Asserts that a meta change touching only `updated_at` is classified as throttleable. <!--#3e8ec2ce613c30de-->
- `test_meta_change_is_throttleable_substantive_change_is_not` (function) — Asserts that a meta change including a status change (alongside updated_at) is not throttleable. <!--#daf3c15f016520ff-->
- `test_meta_change_is_throttleable_identical_is_false` (function) — Asserts that identical metas (no delta) are reported as not throttleable since there is nothing to throttle. <!--#35fb7e51ff1b4314-->
- `test_force_index_sends_full_baseline_and_primes` (function) — Verifies that a forced push emits a single full HISTORY_INDEX baseline with all flows, primes the client, and emits no delta frame. <!--#214193799c1917ee-->
- `test_single_flow_change_emits_only_that_flow_upsert` (function) — Verifies that after a baseline, a substantive change to one flow emits a delta containing only that flow's upsert and no full re-push or removals. <!--#13ac22e5adc09f0a-->
- `test_vanished_flow_emits_removal` (function) — Verifies that a flow disappearing from the index produces a delta frame with an empty upserts list and the flow id in `removed`. <!--#3e1697f16f94aa1b-->
- `test_unchanged_index_emits_no_frame` (function) — Verifies that a push with no index change since the baseline emits neither a HISTORY_INDEX nor a delta frame. <!--#e2001dcc93e70275-->
- `test_history_index_request_resends_full_baseline` (function) — Verifies that a HISTORY_INDEX_REQUEST forces a full baseline re-push (never a delta) even for a reduction-capable peer. <!--#a71bec7c8031630f-->
- `test_updated_at_only_change_is_throttled_off_heartbeat` (function) — Verifies that an updated_at-only change is held back on a non-heartbeat tick and flushed as a delta on the next status heartbeat. <!--#7ab1804f0e892a44-->
- `test_substantive_change_is_not_throttled_off_heartbeat` (function) — Verifies that a substantive (status) change is delivered as a delta immediately even on a fast non-heartbeat tick. <!--#68b19830c48e9480-->
- `test_legacy_peer_always_gets_full_index_not_delta` (function) — Verifies that for a legacy (non-reduction) peer a change re-pushes a full HISTORY_INDEX rather than a delta frame. <!--#69ddaf46bff14f88-->
- `test_index_push_frames_are_metered_by_type` (function) — Verifies that full-baseline and delta index frames are each counted and byte-metered under distinct message-type keys, with the delta smaller than the baseline. <!--#1a343682734689bf-->
- `test_active_flow_cursor_push_coexists_with_index_delta` (function) — Verifies that when a flow's meta changes and it emits new records, both an index delta and an incremental HISTORY_DATA frame go out and cursors advance. <!--#985589a95f95cdae-->

### `tests/test_daemon_history_ordinal.py` (python) — Test suite pinning the DaemonHistoryReader's stable per-record `ordinal` (the 0-based physical line index used as `step_id#ordinal` identity) — verifying ordinals are per-step not global, survive full→append deltas unchanged, re-map to new content across equal-length/grown/shrunk retry rewrites, and stay distinct for empty marker records. <!--#f318caea3d64dc7d|350e42b5980942cf-->
- `_write_jsonl` (function) — Test helper that writes a list of dicts as a newline-terminated jsonl file, creating parent directories as needed. <!--#de06c26baee321d6-->
- `_make_reader` (function) — Test helper that constructs a DaemonHistoryReader whose project-roots provider returns the given root paths. <!--#808724bfc5456a05-->
- `test_records_carry_zero_based_ordinal` (function) — Asserts each record read from a single step's jsonl file carries an ordinal equal to its 0-based physical line index, preserving content order. <!--#450bd655b1df5521-->
- `test_ordinal_is_per_step_not_global` (function) — Asserts ordinals are per-step line positions that restart at 0 for each step file rather than accumulating globally across steps in a flow. <!--#e13b23ba443239ec-->
- `test_marker_records_with_empty_content_get_distinct_ordinals` (function) — Asserts marker records with identical empty content stay individually addressable via distinct ordinals, guarding against the old content+timestamp key collapsing them into one. <!--#a756bf85ceceaa64-->
- `test_same_logical_line_same_ordinal_across_full_and_append` (function) — Asserts an append delta assigns newly written lines the same physical ordinals a fresh full read would, so appends never re-key already-rendered lines. <!--#39ab62690272c15a-->
- `test_retry_equal_length_rewrite_maps_ordinal_to_new_content` (function) — Asserts an equal-length in-place step rewrite (retry) is detected and re-maps each ordinal to the new line content at that position. <!--#1c512cb9f76b7c4a-->
- `test_retry_grown_rewrite_maps_ordinal_to_new_content` (function) — Asserts a retry rewrite that grows the step file re-maps every consumed ordinal, including newly added lines, to their new content. <!--#13c62651dc0cb117-->
- `test_retry_shrunk_rewrite_maps_ordinal_to_new_content` (function) — Asserts a retry rewrite that shrinks the step file re-maps surviving ordinals and leaves no stale high-ordinal survivors from the longer prior batch. <!--#2c6979a5f8b9ce16-->
- `test_ordinal_stable_across_repeated_discovery_rewrites` (function) — Asserts repeated PAUSE->resume step rewrites keep each ordinal mapped to the latest round's current content, mirroring the multi-round discovery rewrite symptom. <!--#cdbd8dad7eec7adb-->

### `tests/test_daemon_history_readpath_cache.py` (python) — A regression-lock test module for the daemon history read-path disk-JSON cache (#243/#260/#209) that verifies oversized legacy engine archives are recovered via bounded head+tail degraded reads without ever being fully parsed, unchanged files are full-parsed at most once via stat- and whole-content-hash-keyed caching (including catching same-(mtime,size) middle rewrites and honoring force_fresh), and unextractable degraded reads are warn-once skipped rather than fatal. <!--#b9cd78f558851747|d7f583776e13951f-->
- `_isolate_module_state` (function) — A fixture that clears the process-wide disk JSON cache and history warn-dedup set before and after each test so caches never leak across tests. <!--#dff4b11ad2fe0def-->
- `_count_full_parses` (function) — A helper that monkeypatches the disk cache's whole-file `_parse_json` seam with a counting wrapper, returning a dict that tracks how many full-file JSON parses occur. <!--#00fd47cb56c9c1ed-->
- `_write_oversized_archive` (function) — A helper that writes a legacy-format, >5 MiB `engine_*.json` archive with hot keys at the head, a multi-MB `state` blob in the middle, and legacy `is_worktree_mode`/`project_root` keys in the tail, to exercise bounded head+tail degraded reads. <!--#97c4b66551ab32bc-->
- `test_oversized_archive_never_fully_parsed_but_project_root_extracted` (function) — Asserts that enumerate_historical_project_roots recovers a tail-positioned project_root from an oversized legacy archive via a bounded head+tail degraded read, while never triggering a full JSON parse (parse counter stays 0). <!--#0e3c73685d1a2eae-->
- `test_oversized_archive_degraded_read_recovers_legacy_tail_key` (function) — Direct-call test that disk_cache.read_engine_header extracts head keys plus the tail-positioned is_worktree_mode from an oversized archive, proving the degraded read scans the tail window and not just the head. <!--#adea844336e9a9eb-->
- `test_unchanged_meta_json_parsed_once_across_enumerations` (function) — Verifies the stat-keyed read-path cache full-parses an unchanged _meta.json exactly once across two back-to-back enumerations, collapsing the repeated per-tick parse into a cache hit. <!--#7b473419686350a0-->
- `test_degraded_extraction_failure_is_skipped_and_warned` (function) — Ensures an oversized file with no extractable keys degrades to None, is warned-once and skipped (never fully parsed nor fatal), and the enumeration still returns other artifact-bearing roots. <!--#58836c9d8131b808-->
- `_build_large_engine` (function) — Test helper that builds a >128 KiB indent=2 engine.json whose only varying bytes are a marker buried in the true middle of a 3000-entry steps table—outside the former 64 KiB head and tail windows—so a same-size middle rewrite is undetectable to a head+tail-only freshness check. <!--#80f0681ed72bafa1-->
- `test_active_engine_middle_rewrite_same_stat_returns_fresh_parse` (function) — Regression test that a middle-only rewrite of a large active engine.json sharing an identical (mtime, size) is caught by the whole-content freshness hash, so read_engine_header(active=True) returns the fresh middle rather than a stale parse (the #260 primary daemon-side fix). <!--#92328b631e759c09-->
- `test_active_engine_unchanged_parsed_once_across_ticks` (function) — Test that an unchanged >128 KiB active engine.json read ten times is fully json-parsed exactly once—the content hash matches each tick, bounding cost to a read + digest and preventing re-introduction of the #209 per-tick parse sink. <!--#d4f77411aeb833d3-->
- `test_active_engine_small_file_middle_rewrite_returns_fresh_parse` (function) — Test that the under-128 KiB small-file path still catches a same-(mtime, size) middle rewrite, locking that the whole-content hash preserves the pre-existing whole-file-read correctness for the degenerate small case. <!--#f3af2f40b151f92e-->
- `test_oversized_active_engine_degrades_unchanged` (function) — Test that an oversized (> MAX_PARSE_BYTES guard) active engine.json is never fully parsed—the size guard runs before the verify path, forcing the always-fresh degraded head+tail scan regardless of active=True, unchanged by the whole-content freshness fix (the #209 guard). <!--#4a5bd4ffa87a8c6d-->
- `test_force_fresh_bypasses_stale_same_stat_cache` (function) — Test that force_fresh=True re-reads and re-parses disk truth even on a (mtime, size) + content-hash cache hit—verified by pre-seeding the cache then hiding a same-stat middle rewrite—backing the active-flow drop decision's true-value fallback. <!--#bc21c1da86be296b-->

- `test_retry_truncate_replace_same_step_jsonl_delivers_new_records` (function) — Asserts an in-place retry that truncates the step jsonl to a shorter batch delivers all replacement records rather than skipping them against the stale line-count cursor (issue #209). <!--#74d55976441e6d7f-->
- `test_retry_rewrite_equal_size_delivers_new_records` (function) — Asserts an in-place retry rewriting the step jsonl to the same byte size but different content is detected via fingerprint and delivers the full replacement instead of seeing 'no new bytes' (issue #209). <!--#89361356232f3890-->
- `test_retry_rewrite_equal_size_preserved_boundary_delivers_new_records` (function) — Asserts an equal-size rewrite that changes an earlier record while keeping the trailing boundary record identical is still detected by whole-prefix fingerprinting (issue #209 iteration 5). <!--#c291d05f80ce3edd-->
- `test_retry_rewrite_equal_size_preserved_head_delivers_new_records` (function) — Asserts an equal-size rewrite that changes a later record while keeping the leading head record identical is still detected by whole-prefix fingerprinting (issue #209 iteration 6). <!--#2385623c2df6fefe-->
- `test_retry_rewrite_larger_size_delivers_full_replacement` (function) — Asserts an in-place retry rewriting the step jsonl larger than the old offset delivers the full replacement from the start rather than a stale-offset partial suffix slice (issue #209). <!--#14202aaa3eef0362-->
- `test_retry_rewrite_larger_size_preserved_head_delivers_full_replacement` (function) — Asserts a grow-case rewrite that preserves the leading head record still falls through to whole-prefix fingerprinting and delivers the full replacement rather than a suffix-only slice (issue #209 iteration 7). <!--#b59092b2be527bb9-->
- `test_retry_rewrite_larger_size_preserved_head_and_boundary_delivers_full_replacement` (function) — Asserts a grow-case rewrite preserving both the head and boundary windows but changing a middle record is caught by whole-prefix fingerprinting, defeating two-bounded-window detection (issue #209 iteration 8). <!--#2c5f3e84199de126-->
- `test_retry_new_attempt_file_picked_up_as_delta` (function) — Asserts a retry that writes a brand-new attempt jsonl (instead of appending) is still picked up incrementally as a delta. <!--#640e49c21ef703fd-->
- `test_history_changed_fires_on_retry_resend` (function) — Asserts _history_changed fires when a retry appends to a step jsonl because the byte-size signature component moves even with a byte-identical body and coarse mtime. <!--#46725328f8fbc9de-->
- `test_push_history_resend_is_append_not_full_reread` (function) — End-to-end test through DaemonClient._push_history asserting a retry resend ships an APPEND frame carrying only the new record, with no duplicate re-read of the prior attempt. <!--#e700ca281f2f7ded-->
- `_write_engine_status` (function) — Test helper that writes a more realistic active engine.json including a steps table, current_step_index, task_description, and worktree flag alongside the status. <!--#45c8d82538e74024-->
- `test_is_still_active_stable_across_paused_running_flip` (function) — Asserts that a discovery flow flipping RUNNING→PAUSED→RUNNING at its confirm gate stays classified as active by DaemonHistoryReader._is_still_active the whole time, guarding against the #260 freeze. <!--#0b87cde03e316acd-->
- `test_header_keeps_flow_active_return_values` (function) — Unit-tests the three-way liveness classifier _header_keeps_flow_active, checking it returns True for live/mine, False for terminal, and None for ambiguous (unreadable or mismatched flow_id) headers. <!--#dcf70fd53a40e4fe-->
- `test_is_still_active_rescues_flow_on_transient_cache_drop` (function) — Verifies that when a cached engine-header read returns a mismatched flow_id (a same-(mtime,size) collision), _is_still_active re-confirms with exactly one forced fresh read and rescues the still-live flow. <!--#a83f84b568e91a78-->
- `test_is_still_active_genuine_terminal_drop_pays_no_extra_read` (function) — Verifies that a cleanly terminal (COMPLETED) flow is dropped on the cached read alone, without triggering the forced-fresh re-confirm fallback. <!--#7ac95be5116d3570-->
- `test_read_active_flows_advances_cursor_on_steps_first_write_and_new_jsonl` (function) — Test asserting that at the dense boundary of a steps-table first-write plus PAUSED→RUNNING transition and a freshly-created analyze jsonl, read_active_flows still delivers the analyze append delta and advances the per-file cursor, with a following idle poll yielding nothing new. <!--#9f6972d7b2ba756c-->

### `tests/test_daemon_history_step_type.py` (python) — Test module for the daemon's step_type file-name parser (`parse_step_type_from_step_id`) and `DaemonHistoryReader.read_flow`, covering sequence prefixes, underscore-bearing and unknown type names, `_Gk` group suffixes, hex-hash and legacy names, and verifying envelope step_type injection without mutating the underlying message content. <!--#b865295940748e18|41717400128adbe5-->

- `test_parse_legacy_name_falls_back_to_stem` (function) — Checks legacy names without a sequence prefix or hex hash fall back to the full stem rather than raising. <!--#41ced5117fbee5b3-->
- `test_parse_unknown_but_conforming_returns_middle` (function) — Verifies unknown but convention-conforming names parse to their middle segment, including multi-word ones. <!--#13372c2666174d4f-->
- `test_parse_empty_and_non_string` (function) — Asserts empty, whitespace, None, and non-string inputs all return an empty string instead of raising. <!--#33179ca1b8d3ad40-->
- `test_parse_is_pure_no_side_effects` (function) — Confirms the parser is deterministic across repeated calls and leaves its input unchanged. <!--#363b8064e9e40108-->
- `test_read_flow_injects_step_type_envelope` (function) — Verifies DaemonHistoryReader.read_flow injects an authoritative envelope-level step_type parsed from each history file name (discovery, version_analyze, implement with _Gk suffix). <!--#b6e97803a1918ed7-->
- `test_read_flow_does_not_mutate_message_content` (function) — Asserts the injected step_type/step_id envelope fields are added as siblings while the original message dict is preserved byte-for-byte. <!--#310738e49428d4fc-->
- `test_read_flow_legacy_step_completed_event_not_broken` (function) — Ensures envelope injection does not overwrite or corrupt a message body that already carries its own step_type (e.g. a HistorySink step_completed event). <!--#d878d23922427c2e-->
- `test_read_flow_legacy_filename_envelope_falls_back` (function) — Checks that a legacy non-conforming file stem falls back to using the raw stem as step_type without raising. <!--#1d98631b8231c4f8-->

### `tests/test_daemon_history_worktree_merge.py` (python) — Tests for DaemonHistoryReader's worktree-aware flow-history handling, covering resolution of a flow's candidate history directories across worktree and main-repo roots (including legacy/missing/unknown fallbacks), merged and incremental read_flow behavior that dedups cloned discovery records and stably prefers the worktree write-root copy, and index building that records the authoritative worktree root for split active flows. <!--#6896403e02d0b528|6babc026b44d9623-->

- `_make_reader` (function) — Helper constructing a DaemonHistoryReader whose project-roots provider returns the given roots as strings. <!--#f5fb70620f9f4765-->

- `_make_worktree` (function) — Test helper that creates a `<main>/tianluo/worktrees/<name>` isolation dir (plus the `tianluo` marker) so `resolve_worktree_main_root` attributes it back to the main repo. <!--#8e238c082de75e77-->
- `test_resolve_flow_dirs_worktree_returns_both_roots` (function) — Asserts `_resolve_flow_dirs` for an authoritative worktree root returns two dirs — the worktree's history dir first, then the owning main repo's. <!--#9097b7d84b138b50-->
- `test_resolve_flow_dirs_main_root_only_self` (function) — Asserts a plain non-worktree root resolves to just its own single history directory. <!--#1597327029625398-->
- `test_resolve_flow_dirs_skips_missing_main_dir` (function) — Asserts that when the main repo lacks the flow's history, `_resolve_flow_dirs` keeps only the worktree directory. <!--#59af10c1c3f27a10-->
- `test_resolve_flow_dirs_empty_project_root_legacy_heuristic` (function) — Asserts that an empty `project_root` falls back to the legacy single first-match registry-walk behavior. <!--#f417eac5de3a0bf3-->
- `test_resolve_flow_dirs_unknown_flow_empty` (function) — Asserts that an unknown flow id resolves to an empty candidate list without error. <!--#e2d13ab37c6c8ba5-->
- `test_read_flow_merges_split_history_dedups_discovery` (function) — Asserts read_flow merges main discovery with worktree steps, deduplicating the cloned discovery file into a single ordered conversation. <!--#c4e1336176352d28-->
- `test_read_flow_backfills_discovery_only_in_main` (function) — Asserts that discovery held only in the main repo is back-filled ahead of the worktree's later steps. <!--#5fc76d4574d70d9d-->
- `test_read_flow_prefers_worktree_write_root_copy_stably` (function) — Verifies that when the same-named history file exists in both the main root and a worktree, the reader stably prefers the worktree (write-root) copy even while the main copy is transiently larger, so incremental appends across rounds are read in full without the selection flipping mid-flow. <!--#b42fb539c8a814cb-->
- `test_read_flow_incremental_across_merge` (function) — Asserts the incremental read cursor advances correctly over the merged file set, returning only newly appended records. <!--#71bb51107a4ae21d-->
- `test_read_flow_missing_one_root_does_not_raise` (function) — Asserts the read still succeeds when the main repo has no history directory at all. <!--#ec4e728608bd8517-->
- `test_read_flow_dedups_discovery_with_differing_hash` (function) — Asserts a discovery clone stored under a different per-step hash still dedups to a single discovery by logical step identity. <!--#329625ba501cbd3e-->
- `_write_engine` (function) — Test helper that writes a `tianluo/state/engine.json` with a flow_id, status, and optional `is_worktree_mode` flag. <!--#fa9d4291bb1bd73a-->
- `test_index_records_worktree_root_for_split_active_flow` (function) — Asserts `build_index` records the active worktree root (not the main repo's history-only clone) for a split active flow and that the recorded root reaches the worktree's later steps. <!--#0026fc90d22d2308-->
- `test_read_flow_main_root_forward_expands_into_worktree` (function) — Asserts that even when the index recorded the main root, `read_flow` forward-expands into the worktree to include its later steps, keeping the merge complete. <!--#6e4167cb69067af2-->
- `test_read_flow_authoritative_root_beats_registry_first_match` (function) — Asserts the passed authoritative project_root governs the read (yielding the full merged set) over the legacy registry first-match heuristic. <!--#d691b16372f10cda-->

### `tests/test_daemon_key_hello.py` (python) — Test suite for the daemon-side HELLO `key` credential (group G5), verifying the additive optional key field in protocol.make_hello, that DaemonClient carries the key in HELLO while never logging it and halts reconnection on auth-rejected WELCOME, that DaemonConfig/`luo daemon start --daemon-key`/SE3_DAEMON_KEY thread the credential to the client without status ever echoing it, and end-to-end wire-compatibility of the field against a live auth server. <!--#5b79e91376c02429|5f84981131cf8e10-->
- `test_make_hello_includes_key_when_set` (function) — Asserts make_hello embeds the supplied key in the HELLO payload alongside machine_id. <!--#e17ed1f0e4e814de-->
- `test_make_hello_omits_key_when_empty` (function) — Asserts an empty or absent key leaves the HELLO payload byte-identical to the legacy four-field structure. <!--#76d1f31e81838ada-->
- `test_make_hello_does_not_bump_protocol_version` (function) — Asserts the additive key field does not change the protocol_version in the HELLO payload. <!--#37ba0c99b622bb41-->
- `test_hello_with_key_decodes_roundtrip` (function) — Asserts a key-bearing HELLO survives encode/decode roundtrip with the key preserved for old servers to ignore. <!--#0df7d18b32ca7d6a-->
- `_make_client` (function) — Test helper that constructs a DaemonClient with default connection params and overridable kwargs. <!--#6a90ceaf2230f869-->
- `_SessionWS` (class) — Fake WebSocket stand-in that records sent messages and blocks forever on receive. <!--#f9763dd64019932b-->
  - `_SessionWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake WebSocket's empty sent-message list. <!--#b8b92aad379d234c-->
  - `_SessionWS.send` (method) — Decodes and appends each outgoing message to the captured sends list. <!--#7d44362527b3e749-->
  - `_SessionWS.__aiter__` (method) — Returns self so the fake WebSocket can be async-iterated. <!--#015f3ec29184096d-->
  - `_SessionWS.__anext__` (method) — Blocks forever to simulate an idle receive stream until the session is cancelled. <!--#634859912bf87bc5-->

  - `_FakeConn.__init__` (method) — Stores the fake WebSocket to be returned on context entry. <!--#837596bb3f64d60e-->
  - `_FakeConn.__aenter__` (method) — Returns the stored fake WebSocket when entering the async context. <!--#95814d21ab06066e-->
  - `_FakeConn.__aexit__` (method) — No-op async exit that suppresses nothing. <!--#552946396ec260ce-->
- `_FakeWebsockets` (class) — Minimal stand-in for the websockets module whose connect returns a _FakeConn. <!--#cb19a33404b9b630-->
  - `_FakeWebsockets.__init__` (method) — Stores the fake WebSocket to hand to connections. <!--#837596bb3f64d60e-->
  - `_FakeWebsockets.connect` (method) — Returns a _FakeConn wrapping the preset fake WebSocket, ignoring URL and kwargs. <!--#2fc1c4e2e48510af-->
- `_run_one_session` (function) — Test helper that runs exactly one DaemonClient._session which unwinds immediately via a pre-set stop event. <!--#63a116f8fd32f116-->
- `test_session_hello_carries_configured_key` (function) — Asserts a session sends a single HELLO carrying the configured daemon_key. <!--#dd6bb87706050465-->
- `test_session_hello_omits_key_when_unconfigured` (function) — Asserts an unconfigured client sends a single HELLO with no key field. <!--#d271412f5465df71-->
- `test_daemon_key_is_not_logged` (function) — Test asserting that running a daemon client session never emits the daemon key into any `tianluo.daemon.client` log record. <!--#470e6d71cfb1e180-->
- `test_handle_welcome_accepted_is_noop` (function) — Asserts an accepted WELCOME leaves the auth-rejected flag and event unset. <!--#026276052ec2a101-->
- `test_handle_welcome_rejected_flags_and_signals` (function) — Asserts a rejected WELCOME sets the auth-rejected flag, records the reason, and signals the event. <!--#544426d3f294d15b-->
- `test_handle_welcome_rejected_without_reason_has_fallback` (function) — Asserts a reasonless rejection still flags auth-rejected and yields a non-empty fallback last_error. <!--#faa59c23114bf15e-->
- `test_dispatch_welcome_reject_does_not_leak_key` (function) — Test verifying that a rejected welcome message logs the server's reason and sets `_auth_rejected` without leaking the daemon key into logs. <!--#5fe1d04cb93cb540-->

- `test_run_loop_keeps_reconnecting_on_transient_failure` (function) — Asserts a transient (non-auth) failure does not set the auth-stop flag and yields a formatted last_error. <!--#08c78fcdc21cb794-->

- `test_cli_daemon_start_flag_overrides_env` (function) — Asserts the `--daemon-key` flag takes precedence over the SE3_DAEMON_KEY env var. <!--#c470766ebe352c89-->

- `test_old_daemon_without_key_rejected_by_live_server` (function) — Verifies that an old daemon whose HELLO carries no `key` field is fail-closed by an authenticated live server (WELCOME accepted=false with a reason) and registers no machine in the admin operator view. <!--#9c1ddbaa93b365ae-->
- `test_live_server_tolerates_unknown_key_bearing_hello_field` (function) — Verifies wire compatibility of the additive `key` field: a valid key-bearing HELLO connects cleanly (WELCOME accepted=true), proving the server parses rather than chokes on the field. <!--#4826b8200b8d7acd-->

### `tests/test_daemon_readpath_cache.py` (python) — Regression-lock test suite for the issue #243 (group G2) daemon read-path hardening, asserting that the stat-keyed `disk_json_cache` parses each unchanged active/worktree/resumable engine.json at most once per push tick, that all such parses are offloaded off the event-loop thread to prevent the WebUI freeze, and that oversized (>5 MiB) engine.json files fall back to a degraded head+tail header scan that still keeps runs visible without full-parsing. <!--#59c7b4de7c3aa3a1|8863b7d4b5eabefd-->
- `_write_engine` (function) — Test helper that writes a small active `engine.json` (flow_id/status/state/is_worktree_mode) under `<root>/tianluo/state/`, optionally flagged as a worktree run. <!--#df8e22f86d42041c-->
- `_write_resumable` (function) — Test helper that writes a per-flow paused/resumable snapshot JSON under `<root>/tianluo/state/resumable/<flow_id>.json`. <!--#d6895837ff692e3d-->
- `_count_djc_parses` (function) — Test helper that monkeypatches `disk_json_cache._json_loads` to record every actual JSON parse, so tests can count the expensive parse operations the read-path fix collapses. <!--#01672804ecbef6b9-->
- `test_unchanged_engine_json_parsed_once_across_push_ticks` (function) — Asserts that across 10 push-loop-equivalent rounds with files unchanged, each distinct engine.json-shaped file (active + worktree + resumable) is parsed at most once via the stat-keyed disk cache, not re-parsed per tick. <!--#73bb529b330c8240-->
- `test_changed_engine_json_is_reparsed` (function) — Verifies the `(path, mtime, size)` cache serves unchanged reads without re-parsing but re-parses after a genuine engine.json rewrite so stale content is never returned. <!--#83cc91ecce5df4cb-->
- `_patch_all_parse_seams` (function) — Test helper that patches the unified disk_json_cache parse seams (`_json_loads` and `_parse_json_file`) to record the calling thread ident on every daemon disk-JSON parse. <!--#ca43e023250819ed-->
- `test_signature_checks_are_genuine_disk_parse_points` (function) — Pins the premise that `DaemonClient._calls_changed`/`_history_changed` genuinely trigger disk JSON parses, so the off-loading guard elsewhere can't pass vacuously. <!--#b0f25f0ecfddd03c-->
- `test_push_loop_never_parses_json_on_event_loop_thread` (function) — Runs the real `DaemonClient._push_loop` against a live aggregator/history reader and asserts every triggered disk JSON parse happens on a worker thread, never on the event-loop thread (the #243/#209 freeze). <!--#4ef2aac6a4918ec8-->
- `_write_oversized_engine` (function) — Test helper that writes a >5 MiB indent=2 `engine.json` with head keys (flow_id/status) and a tail key (is_worktree_mode) around a giant `state`, exercising the degraded head+tail scan. <!--#b6a1ca3d1af5bbcd-->
- `test_oversized_engine_json_uses_degraded_scan_no_full_parse` (function) — Verifies a >5 MiB engine.json is served via `read_engine_header`'s degraded head+tail scan — recovering head keys and the tail `is_worktree_mode` — without ever full-parsing or caching it. <!--#77c8b0ef47fda698-->
- `test_oversized_worktree_run_stays_visible_via_degraded_scan` (function) — Confirms the aggregator's worktree scan (`_active_worktree_run_roots`) still discovers an active worktree run whose legacy engine.json is oversized, proving the file is degraded rather than skipped. <!--#163298be038aad1f-->
- `test_oversized_unextractable_file_warns_once_and_skips` (function) — Verifies a giant file yielding no extractable header keys is skipped by `read_engine_header` (returns None) with exactly one degraded-scan warning. <!--#39e2eb675b5d1d98-->

### `tests/test_daemon_spawner_path.py` (python) — Test module for the daemon spawner's login-shell PATH handling, unit-testing the pure merge_path_env and resolve_login_shell_path helpers and integration-testing that DaemonSpawner-spawned (and resumed) children inherit the merged PATH while degrading gracefully on resolution failures. <!--#fec3223f884a566b|923f7bdb83c0c5d8-->

  - `TestResolveLoginShellPath.test_success_with_normal_output` (method) — Asserts a valid PATH is parsed from shell output even when preceded by noise lines. <!--#cb79ed06cbc9811f-->

  - `TestResolveLoginShellPath.test_nonzero_exit_returns_none` (method) — Asserts a non-zero shell exit causes resolution to return None. <!--#863cfea1c5d7dc9a-->
  - `TestResolveLoginShellPath.test_timeout_returns_none` (method) — Asserts a shell that hangs past the timeout causes resolution to return None. <!--#bd39f3c32fd13db8-->
  - `TestResolveLoginShellPath.test_empty_output_returns_none` (method) — Asserts empty shell output causes resolution to return None. <!--#969f25c9f6b707ba-->
  - `TestResolveLoginShellPath.test_output_without_pathsep_returns_none` (method) — Asserts shell output lacking a path separator causes resolution to return None. <!--#c0faf97151dc02be-->
  - `TestResolveLoginShellPath.test_missing_shell_env_falls_back_to_bash` (method) — Asserts that with $SHELL unset, resolution falls back to /bin/bash and returns a string or None without crashing. <!--#7aab126988fa6193-->
  - `TestResolveLoginShellPath.test_nonexistent_shell_returns_none` (method) — Asserts a $SHELL pointing to a missing binary causes resolution to return None. <!--#1e79ddd07c205949-->
- `TestSpawnerPathMerge` (class) — Integration-test class verifying that DaemonSpawner-spawned children inherit the merged login-shell PATH. <!--#0f298523ed544212-->
  - `TestSpawnerPathMerge._make_fake_se3` (method) — Helper that creates and patches in a fake se3 child script which reports its own PATH as an NDJSON event. <!--#8be292cdea943d13-->
  - `TestSpawnerPathMerge.test_bare_path_spawn_gets_merged` (method) — Asserts a child spawned under a sparse (systemd-like) PATH receives login entries plus the original bare entries. <!--#219379b7ab655307-->
  - `TestSpawnerPathMerge.test_full_path_spawn_is_idempotent` (method) — Asserts that when the daemon already has a full PATH, the merged child PATH has no duplicates and retains all entries. <!--#bf27f5561c41fe59-->
  - `TestSpawnerPathMerge.test_login_shell_path_none_preserves_current` (method) — Asserts that with login_shell_path disabled (None), the child PATH is left unmodified. <!--#da302d77d9db73bc-->
  - `TestSpawnerPathMerge.test_explicit_env_path_overrides_merge` (method) — Asserts a caller-supplied explicit env PATH overrides the merge result for the child. <!--#a2d8f17e14c8c418-->
  - `TestSpawnerPathMerge.test_resume_also_gets_merged_path` (method) — Asserts the spawner.resume() code path also merges login-shell PATH into the child environment. <!--#28650103db9a0281-->
- `TestSpawnerPathFailurePath` (class) — Test class verifying that when login-shell PATH resolution fails, DaemonSpawner logs a warning, still constructs without raising, and falls back to spawning normally with login_shell_path=None. <!--#ad17a6e2251c2873-->
  - `TestSpawnerPathFailurePath.test_constructor_warns_on_resolution_failure` (method) — Test asserting that when resolve_login_shell_path returns None (SHELL points to a nonexistent shell), the DaemonSpawner constructor sets _login_shell_path to None and logs a 'Could not resolve login-shell PATH' warning. <!--#6d26a83a3faf883b-->
