- `TestAssessGitDiff` (class) — Test class verifying _assess_git_diff parses subprocess git output to count changed files with and without changes. <!--#8bcf4e92ee1eeee4-->
  - `TestAssessGitDiff.test_assess_with_changes` (method) — Asserts git status output of two modified files is counted and listed correctly. <!--#cd4da7006cbeede3-->
  - `TestAssessGitDiff.test_assess_no_changes` (method) — Asserts empty git output yields a zero changed-file count. <!--#aba684164a40391d-->
- `TestCommitChanges` (class) — Test class checking _commit_changes skips when no changes and otherwise commits, returning the short hash and a '[salvage]'-tagged task-bearing message. <!--#e0c671058b9ac0ee-->
  - `TestCommitChanges.test_skip_when_no_changes` (method) — Asserts _commit_changes returns None when there are no changed files. <!--#29cf9b0d72c2bfa4-->
  - `TestCommitChanges.test_commit_with_changes` (method) — Asserts a successful add/commit/rev-parse sequence returns the short commit hash. <!--#2b170a211240ccf9-->
  - `TestCommitChanges.test_commit_message_contains_task` (method) — Asserts the generated commit message includes the [salvage] tag and the task description. <!--#3ca001eb162a4a28-->
- `TestCreateSalvageIssues` (class) — Test class for _create_salvage_issues across flow/no-flow and changes/no-changes combinations. <!--#ee7537a090d27a6a-->
  - `TestCreateSalvageIssues.test_creates_issue_with_flow` (method) — Asserts a flow plus changes produces one medium-priority 'Incomplete' issue tagged auto-discovered and source:salvage. <!--#27e32ef779b51fd2-->
  - `TestCreateSalvageIssues.test_creates_issue_without_flow` (method) — Asserts changes with no flow still produce one source:salvage-tagged issue. <!--#2d8c7d8fe8235505-->
  - `TestCreateSalvageIssues.test_no_issue_when_no_flow_and_no_changes` (method) — Asserts no issue is created when there is neither a flow nor any changes. <!--#1f638d980642972b-->
  - `TestCreateSalvageIssues.test_issue_includes_step_history` (method) — Asserts the created issue's description includes the flow's step history (e.g. 'implement'). <!--#b6edefcd45285d85-->
- `TestArchiveSession` (class) — Test class verifying _archive_session moves engine.json into an archive dir, skips when absent, and clears the per-flow resumable snapshot. <!--#d42a485c0db08afb-->
  - `TestArchiveSession.test_archives_existing_session` (method) — Asserts _archive_session removes engine.json and writes exactly one archived .json into tianluo/state/archive. <!--#41e205fc31aa4a0c-->
  - `TestArchiveSession.test_skip_when_no_session` (method) — Asserts _archive_session returns False when no session state exists. <!--#fa4c2bac434c9abd-->
  - `TestArchiveSession.test_clears_resumable_snapshot` (method) — Asserts _archive_session deletes the PersistenceManager resumable snapshot so a dispositioned flow isn't re-advertised as resumable. <!--#571100fb408de6ee-->
- `TestSalvageFullPipeline` (class) — Test class exercising the end-to-end salvage() command across valid, missing, per-step-fault-tolerant, and corrupted-session scenarios. <!--#a3ce5bd312c92ce2-->
  - `TestSalvageFullPipeline.test_salvage_with_valid_session` (method) — Asserts salvage() exits 0 for a valid session with no git changes. <!--#9d233cd544ee0617-->
  - `TestSalvageFullPipeline.test_salvage_with_no_session` (method) — Asserts salvage() exits 0 when there is no session and no changes. <!--#3cffe2b924ae2b7f-->
  - `TestSalvageFullPipeline.test_each_step_independent` (method) — Asserts salvage() is per-step fault-tolerant, returning exit code 1 when only the session-load step raises while other steps succeed. <!--#7bc7eda20b156fee-->
  - `TestSalvageFullPipeline.test_salvage_with_corrupted_session` (method) — Asserts salvage() still succeeds (exit 0) on corrupted engine.json by falling back to git-diff-based commit salvage. <!--#ca7aec46b9cceaa5-->

### `tests/test_scope_mode_wording.py` (python) — Cross-surface wording regression suite asserting that the review-scope prompt, CLI/WebUI i18n catalogs, `history show` rendering, `app.js` fallback strings, and the English/Chinese configuration docs all consistently describe both `full` and `incremental` rounds as diff-scoped, name the implementation and fix baselines (with incremental anchored at the earliest unreviewed fix, never the "latest fix baseline"), and attribute scope fallbacks only to the recorded `scope_fallback_cause`. <!--#5f01ee1995ffbe11|861cef9c5e2d12bb-->
- `_load` (function) — Test helper that reads a JSON file (an i18n catalog) from the given path and returns it as a dict. <!--#eb01756586fd2559-->
- `_scope_inputs` (function) — Test helper building a minimal review-scope input dict (baseline id, changed paths, causal anchors, diff) for the given `scope_mode`, used to render the review-scope prompt block. <!--#cb269e737940e742-->
- `test_prompt_states_both_modes_are_diff_scoped` (function) — Asserts the rendered review-scope prompt labels both `full` and `incremental` as diff-scoped while still reporting the raw persisted `scope_mode` token. <!--#fe607d54d65a7b40-->
- `test_full_round_purpose_names_the_implementation_baseline` (function) — Asserts the `full` round's purpose line names the implementation baseline and explicitly denies being an unscoped read of the tree. <!--#2d085741aefe482b-->
- `test_incremental_round_purpose_names_the_fix_baseline` (function) — Asserts the `incremental` round's purpose line is labelled diff-scoped and names the fix baseline. <!--#c2679ea34265d5f5-->
- `test_incremental_wording_does_not_promise_a_single_latest_fix` (function) — Asserts the incremental mode annotation and purpose line say the diff starts at the earliest unreviewed fix (possibly spanning more than one), never at the "latest fix baseline". <!--#5382f8167218dc5c-->
- `test_scope_mode_hint_does_not_say_latest_fix` (function) — Asserts neither the CLI nor WebUI scope-mode hint string, in either language, still says "latest fix baseline" / "最近一次 fix 基线". <!--#b1aed20775edc8c5-->
- `test_en_docs_describe_the_incremental_baseline_as_the_earliest_unreviewed` (function) — Asserts the English configuration docs describe the incremental baseline as the earliest unreviewed fix rather than the latest fix's own delta. <!--#16772c8fbdc6b762-->
- `test_zh_docs_describe_the_incremental_baseline_as_the_earliest_unreviewed` (function) — Asserts the Chinese configuration docs describe the incremental baseline as 尚未被审查的最早一次 fix. <!--#673e80f5cf57b982-->
- `test_fallback_note_names_the_baseline_it_falls_back_to` (function) — Asserts the incremental-to-full fallback note names the implementation baseline it falls back to instead of vaguely saying "a full review". <!--#c12fe79b4fae45bf-->
- `test_fallback_note_blames_only_the_domain_that_failed` (function) — Asserts the fallback note attributes the failure to the recorded `scope_fallback_cause` only — not blaming a fix baseline that rebuilt cleanly, and not promising an implementation-baseline diff that is itself unavailable. <!--#b4ec794425b06e10-->
- `test_fallback_note_without_a_recorded_cause_stays_generic` (function) — Asserts that with no `scope_fallback_cause` persisted (older state) the fallback note stays generic about the combined incremental evidence domain instead of blaming one half. <!--#19875581ad6705a8-->
- `test_cli_and_webui_scope_mode_labels_are_identical` (function) — Asserts the CLI and WebUI i18n catalogs give byte-identical labels for each `scope_mode` value in every language. <!--#b52dd2ea7285f08b-->
- `test_scope_mode_labels_say_diff_in_both_modes` (function) — Asserts every CLI and WebUI scope-mode label, in both languages, reads as a diff mode by containing "diff". <!--#b853234b7641bc5c-->
- `test_scope_mode_hint_names_both_baselines` (function) — Asserts the CLI and WebUI scope-mode hint strings mention the implementation baseline, the fix baseline, and diff in both languages. <!--#f65319adeaa2e619-->
- `test_en_us_holds_the_new_keys_as_the_baseline_language` (function) — Asserts the new `history.field.scope_mode_hint` and `scope.modeHint` keys exist in the en-US base catalogs so lookups can always fall back. <!--#4d2e040d33f15bce-->
- `test_zh_cn_translates_the_new_keys_rather_than_copying_en` (function) — Asserts the zh-CN catalogs actually translate the two new hint keys rather than copying the English text verbatim. <!--#b78293c585752d74-->
- `_detail` (function) — Test helper returning a fake flow-detail payload whose `review_scope.active_round` carries the given `scope_mode`, for driving `history show` rendering. <!--#ac8b60703530a7e3-->
- `_history_show` (function) — Test helper that runs `history show f1` under a pinned `SE3_LANG` with patched project root and flow detail, returning the CLI output and restoring the en-US default afterwards. <!--#6beddf60313587bb-->
- `test_history_show_renders_diff_scoped_labels_en` (function) — Parametrized check that `history show` prints the expected English diff-scoped label for each `scope_mode`. <!--#f14cefdb10861a56-->
- `test_history_show_renders_diff_scoped_labels_zh` (function) — Parametrized check that `history show` prints the expected Chinese diff-scoped label for each `scope_mode`. <!--#ecb62ad9c152bfc8-->
- `test_history_show_carries_the_baseline_hint` (function) — Asserts `history show` output carries the baseline hint naming both the implementation and fix baselines, tolerating Rich's column wrapping. <!--#58052dd58e67b187-->
- `test_scope_mode_label_still_passes_unknown_values_through` (function) — Asserts `history_cmd._scope_mode_label` remains presentation-only: unrecognised values render raw and `None` renders as "-". <!--#05f52bd01f730712-->
- `test_app_js_attaches_the_scope_mode_hint_to_both_renderers` (function) — Asserts `app.js` wires the `scope.modeHint` tooltip into both scope renderers (flow sidebar and history detail) and defines the `SCOPE_MODE_HINT_EN` fallback. <!--#098f71ee81eb666d-->
- `_app_js_scope_hint_fallback` (function) — Test helper that parses `app.js` literal-by-literal to reconstruct the concatenated `SCOPE_MODE_HINT_EN` fallback string (avoiding a naive cut at the sentence's own semicolon). <!--#9b1dfeb4e15a588c-->
- `test_app_js_fallback_hint_matches_the_localized_string` (function) — Asserts the `app.js` no-dictionary fallback hint is identical to the en-US WebUI `scope.modeHint` so it cannot drift stale. <!--#29dfec6a45523439-->
- `test_app_js_fallback_hint_does_not_say_latest_fix` (function) — Asserts the `app.js` fallback hint says "earliest fix not reviewed yet" and not "latest fix baseline". <!--#13bb4e33ef670b3c-->
- `test_app_js_still_resolves_labels_by_persisted_scope_mode_value` (function) — Asserts `app.js` still resolves scope labels via `I18N.resolve("scope.mode." + ...)` on the raw persisted value in both renderers, so the wording change introduced no key rename. <!--#d60eebb3ef1642b0-->
- `test_en_docs_clarify_both_modes_are_diff_scoped` (function) — Asserts the English docs state both round modes are diff-scoped, name the diff baseline, and deny an unscoped whole-tree read. <!--#df67ee48ec13a87b-->
- `test_zh_docs_clarify_both_modes_are_diff_scoped` (function) — Asserts the Chinese docs state 两种 round 模式都是 diff 审查 and name both the implementation and fix baselines. <!--#3f34c47c88a6a1a1-->
- `test_docs_keep_the_persisted_scope_mode_values` (function) — Parametrized check that both language docs still document the literal `scope_mode` key and its `full` / `incremental` values. <!--#d093b576de02dde7-->

### `tests/test_se3_local_yaml.py` (python) — Test suite for `tianluo.local.yaml` config resolution, covering `get_project_config_path` precedence (local wins over `tianluo.yaml`), per-section loaders (`VersionConfig`, `LanguageConfig`, `_TestConfig`, `ConflictResolverConfig`, `ImplementConfig`, `StepConfig`) reading from local, the wholesale-replace (non-merge) semantics that make unset local keys fall back to defaults, deprecation-warning source labels, `is_se3_project_root` detection of local-only roots, and command-layer parent-walk helpers finding such roots from nested subdirectories. <!--#52f25e974908fb54|ed0a0bcec28dd3a6-->
- `isolated_global_home` (function) — Pytest fixture that monkeypatches Path.home() to a clean temp dir so tests don't read the real ~/.se3/config.yaml. <!--#2710907cd4f6608c-->
- `make_worktree` (function) — Pytest fixture that builds a real git repo plus a linked worktree, yields (main_root, worktree_root), and cleans up the worktree afterward (skips if git is unavailable). <!--#c4d9c6aee19fd0a4-->
- `TestGetProjectConfigPath` (class) — Test class verifying get_project_config_path resolves to tianluo.yaml or tianluo.local.yaml across the four combinations of the two files existing, with local winning when both are present. <!--#b005447f2d4ddf03-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPath.test_neither_exists_returns_se3_yaml` (method) — Asserts that when neither config file exists, get_project_config_path returns the canonical tianluo.yaml path. <!--#bf9a608ddc64f657-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPath.test_only_se3_yaml_exists` (method) — Asserts get_project_config_path returns the tianluo.yaml path when only tianluo.yaml is present. <!--#45674c6765bfdf0b-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPath.test_only_local_exists` (method) — Asserts get_project_config_path returns the tianluo.local.yaml path when only the local file is present. <!--#a0122d4c9ad5a74a-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPath.test_both_exist_local_wins` (method) — Asserts get_project_config_path prefers tianluo.local.yaml over tianluo.yaml when both exist. <!--#26011f17fb626a40-->
- `TestLoadersReadLocal` (class) — Test class confirming per-section config loaders (VersionConfig, LanguageConfig, _TestConfig, ConflictResolverConfig, ImplementConfig) read their values from tianluo.local.yaml when present. <!--#b6472501032545f8-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_version_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies VersionConfig.load reads enabled and confidence_threshold from tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#58fd611f277d1da3-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_language_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies LanguageConfig.load reads language and spec_language from tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#652e4bbb7a25a1d6-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_test_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies _TestConfig.load reads command, timeout, and timeout_multiplier from tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#48e6a8ebb7149028-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_conflict_resolver_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies ConflictResolverConfig.load reads strategy from tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#cd7b8542f04cec23-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_implement_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies ImplementConfig.load reads group_loc_threshold from tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#e317515c5b6ad825-->
- `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml` (class) — Test class enforcing that tianluo.local.yaml wholesale replaces (does not deep-merge with) tianluo.yaml, so unset local keys fall back to defaults rather than leaking yaml values. <!--#2e4023b94d4f2d04-->
  - `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml.test_version_config_not_merged` (method) — Asserts VersionConfig uses local's version values wholesale without merging tianluo.yaml's version values. <!--#13590a18cc05c9c3-->
  - `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml.test_language_yaml_shadowed_completely` (method) — Asserts a language key absent from local (spec_language) does not leak from tianluo.yaml and stays None. <!--#3cf49baef9199364-->
  - `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml.test_implement_yaml_shadowed_when_local_missing_section` (method) — Asserts that when local omits the implement section entirely, ImplementConfig uses the built-in default rather than tianluo.yaml's value. <!--#dfcb546b58214eec-->
  - `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml.test_conflict_resolver_not_merged` (method) — Asserts ConflictResolverConfig strategy comes from local, not merged with tianluo.yaml. <!--#b960f4403a2a475f-->
- `TestOnlySe3YamlRegression` (class) — Test class regression-checking that loaders still read correctly from tianluo.yaml when no local file is present. <!--#05e17284fef08931-->
  - `TestOnlySe3YamlRegression.test_version_config_from_se3_yaml` (method) — Verifies VersionConfig.load reads enabled and confidence_threshold from tianluo.yaml alone. <!--#2774a87b64e24bf2-->
  - `TestOnlySe3YamlRegression.test_test_config_from_se3_yaml` (method) — Verifies _TestConfig.load reads timeout from tianluo.yaml alone. <!--#e352e08cc726c112-->
- `TestConfirmationSourceLabel` (class) — Test class checking that deprecation warnings from load_confirmation_config name the file actually read (tianluo.local.yaml when present, else tianluo.yaml). <!--#944bc643fe87a1e1-->
  - `TestConfirmationSourceLabel.test_source_label_is_local_when_local_exists` (method) — Asserts confirmation deprecation warnings reference tianluo.local.yaml (not tianluo.yaml) when local exists and fully replaces yaml's steps. <!--#3291dd34f462864d-->
  - `TestConfirmationSourceLabel.test_source_label_is_yaml_when_only_yaml_exists` (method) — Asserts confirmation deprecation warnings reference tianluo.yaml when only that file exists. <!--#11a77fd7556c4a1a-->
- `TestIsSe3ProjectRootLocalOnly` (class) — Test class verifying is_se3_project_root recognizes a directory as an SE3 project root when it holds only tianluo.local.yaml, only tianluo.yaml, or neither. <!--#9d245ab58f362086-->
  - `TestIsSe3ProjectRootLocalOnly.test_detects_project_with_only_local` (method) — Asserts is_se3_project_root returns True for a directory containing only tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#850fde72ff95fac3-->
  - `TestIsSe3ProjectRootLocalOnly.test_detects_project_with_only_yaml` (method) — Asserts is_se3_project_root returns True for a directory containing only tianluo.yaml. <!--#365f85dce4b9041c-->
  - `TestIsSe3ProjectRootLocalOnly.test_rejects_directory_without_markers` (method) — Asserts a dir with no SE3 markers is not detected as a project root. <!--#77639b59a1490907-->
- `TestParentWalkFindsLocalOnlyRoot` (class) — Integration test class exercising the command-layer parent-walk helpers finding a local-only project root from a nested subdirectory. <!--#3f8d7646c57b7f67-->
  - `TestParentWalkFindsLocalOnlyRoot.test_salvage_find_project_root_walks_up_to_local_only_parent` (method) — Asserts salvage_cmd._find_project_root walks up from a nested subdir to a parent whose only marker is tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#0329d7a14efd2dae-->
  - `TestParentWalkFindsLocalOnlyRoot.test_run_get_project_root_walks_up_to_local_only_parent` (method) — Asserts run.get_project_root walks up from a nested subdir to a parent whose only marker is tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#1d71076fce9a7667-->
- `TestStepConfigLocal` (class) — Test class verifying StepConfig and apply_step_config read step-append configuration from tianluo.local.yaml, with local replacing yaml. <!--#23db0c768b87dd3d-->
  - `TestStepConfigLocal.test_step_config_loads_append_from_local` (method) — Asserts StepConfig.load reads steps.append from tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#42b750b7654d8994-->
  - `TestStepConfigLocal.test_step_config_local_replaces_yaml` (method) — Asserts StepConfig's append list from local fully replaces yaml's, without leaking yaml's entry. <!--#8a88e9e82d17a018-->
  - `TestStepConfigLocal.test_apply_step_config_uses_local` (method) — Asserts the apply_step_config entrypoint appends steps (e.g. SUMMARIZE) declared in tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#0c4e51b0f0626d50-->
- `TestMaxFixIterationsLocal` (class) — Test class verifying get_max_fix_iterations reads workflow.max_fix_iterations from tianluo.local.yaml, with local overriding yaml. <!--#e10188df32b95ab7-->
  - `TestMaxFixIterationsLocal.test_get_max_fix_iterations_reads_local` (method) — Asserts get_max_fix_iterations returns the value from tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#e303940b5477e2e5-->
  - `TestMaxFixIterationsLocal.test_get_max_fix_iterations_local_replaces_yaml` (method) — Asserts get_max_fix_iterations takes local's value and does not leak tianluo.yaml's. <!--#b8d2eafd1a90f42a-->
- `TestContextBuilderLocal` (class) — Test class verifying that `get_issue_discovery_injection` honours `tianluo.local.yaml`, checking that a step absent from `ISSUE_DISCOVERY_DEFAULT_STEPS` yields no injection by default but does once added to `issue_discovery.steps` in the local config file. <!--#5fe48a5e1c42b699-->
  - `TestContextBuilderLocal.test_issue_discovery_injection_reads_local` (method) — Asserts get_issue_discovery_injection returns non-empty once a step is whitelisted via issue_discovery.steps in tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#8921cc9044b8649f-->
- `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings` (class) — Test class ensuring a malformed/non-mapping tianluo.local.yaml falls back to defaults (not yaml) and logs a deduped shadow warning, while a valid-empty local is silent. <!--#50aa7464cb980f88-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings._reset_warned_set` (method) — Helper that clears the one-shot malformed-local warning dedup set before each test. <!--#2b3ac40f31cb8273-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_loader_logs_when_local_is_malformed_yaml` (method) — Asserts broken YAML in local yields built-in defaults plus a 'shadowing' warning naming tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#ef8120a12cdb1429-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_loader_logs_when_local_is_non_mapping` (method) — Asserts a top-level list in local yields built-in defaults plus a shadow warning. <!--#9ff6e20e9df59e03-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_load_agent_registry_logs_when_local_is_falsy_non_mapping` (method) — Asserts the _read_yaml path treats a falsy non-mapping (empty list) local as malformed, blocking yaml's agents from leaking and emitting a shadow warning. <!--#3c08c3837e9f50df-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_valid_empty_local_yaml_no_warning` (method) — Asserts a valid-but-empty local ('{}') applies defaults with no shadow warning while still fully replacing yaml. <!--#4b13c4234e036b0f-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_warning_dedup_only_once_per_path` (method) — Asserts the malformed-local shadow warning fires only once per path across repeated loader calls. <!--#834453305cd0673e-->
- `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile` (class) — Test class covering non-regular-file cases at the tianluo.local.yaml path (directory, symlink, dangling symlink, unreadable file) and how resolution/loaders handle them. <!--#0b85e1b9ac7c506b-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile.test_directory_at_local_path_falls_back_to_yaml` (method) — Asserts a directory at the local path is skipped and get_project_config_path falls back to tianluo.yaml. <!--#c419f94074f61323-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile.test_symlink_to_real_file_is_accepted_as_override` (method) — Asserts a symlink at the local path pointing to a real file is accepted and its target's values drive the loaded config. <!--#bc081fe3dea950d4-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile.test_dangling_symlink_at_local_path_falls_back_to_yaml` (method) — Asserts a dangling symlink at the local path is skipped in favor of tianluo.yaml. <!--#16ac64608fb9ec46-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile.test_unreadable_regular_file_still_selected_and_readers_fall_back` (method) — Asserts an unreadable (chmod 0) local file is still selected but its OSError makes loaders fall back to defaults with both a 'failed to read' and a shadow warning. <!--#eedbda8beb761da9-->
- `TestGlobalPlusLocalAgentMerge` (class) — Test class verifying ~/.se3/config.yaml and tianluo.local.yaml combine under the same merge rules as tianluo.yaml — entry-level agent merge with local as a drop-in project-layer replacement, not a bypass of the global layer. <!--#0c9e02e5eae14a9a-->
  - `TestGlobalPlusLocalAgentMerge.test_agents_merge_entry_level_global_plus_local` (method) — Asserts the merged registry contains both a global-declared and a local-declared agent (local does not erase global's agents). <!--#53669fd5eb32c261-->
  - `TestGlobalPlusLocalAgentMerge.test_local_overrides_global_for_same_agent_name` (method) — Asserts local wins when global and local declare the same agent name. <!--#26859c373fef02b7-->
  - `TestGlobalPlusLocalAgentMerge.test_load_agents_uses_global_defaults_when_local_omits_them` (method) — Asserts the global llm_caller.defaults chain remains in effect when local omits that section. <!--#a7a110bc1375fc48-->
  - `TestGlobalPlusLocalAgentMerge.test_local_llm_caller_defaults_replace_global` (method) — Asserts a local-declared llm_caller.defaults list whole-replaces the global list rather than appending. <!--#0275d3ba90c863db-->
- `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority` (class) — Test class exercising the four-tier config lookup used inside git worktrees: worktree-local > main-repo-local > worktree-yaml > main-repo-yaml, plus _resolve_main_repo_root edge cases. <!--#0ca6bb74007a261a-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_resolve_main_repo_root_returns_none_for_non_git` (method) — Verifies _resolve_main_repo_root returns None for a plain directory. <!--#d1b52ecedc3435a0-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_resolve_main_repo_root_returns_none_for_regular_git_repo` (method) — Verifies _resolve_main_repo_root returns None for a normal (non-worktree) git repo. <!--#8bffa0c17c908a38-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_malformed_git_output_returns_none` (method) — Asserts _resolve_main_repo_root returns None when git rev-parse emits an unexpected number of output lines. <!--#6137c224bcbda896-->

  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_clear_main_repo_root_cache_invalidates_stale_results` (method) — Asserts clear_main_repo_root_cache invalidates the lru_cache so the next lookup re-runs the git probes. <!--#4e439e325b50c901-->

- `TestWorktreeWarningDedup` (class) — Test class verifying warning dedup keys collapse worktree-prefixed project labels (e.g. main_repo/tianluo.local.yaml) to one project token so a deprecated key warns only once across label transitions. <!--#ccc2d8fb2f933f92-->

### `tests/test_se3_module_system.py` (python) — Standalone test script that verifies the SE3 module system's `luo init` command by running it in a temporary directory and asserting the expected .claude/CLAUDE.md/SE3.md files are created with correct checksums and placeholder substitution, complete with subprocess helper and a manual pass/fail runner. <!--#c943c3119483f070|825df9f3f361bcd4-->
- `run_command` (function) — Helper that runs a shell command via subprocess and returns its (stdout, stderr, returncode) tuple. <!--#94ffb83c947b0865-->
- `test_initialization` (function) — Test that runs `luo init` in a temp dir and asserts the .claude directory, CLAUDE.md, and SE3.md are created with proper checksum metadata and substituted placeholders. <!--#a7738a951d389134-->
- `main` (function) — Manual test runner that executes the initialization test, tallies pass/fail counts, prints a summary, and returns overall success. <!--#8eab7242377c129d-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter17.py` (python) — Regression tests locking in the four issue #243/#244 self-check fixes: the disk_json_cache parse cache is LRU-bounded and evicts stale-path entries, orphaned cold steps partitions are pruned while live/snapshot-referenced ones are preserved, ENGINE_JSON_SCHEMA fully describes the emitted new-format header, and load_archived_flow_by_id selects the newest archive by mtime across both naming schemes. <!--#f1bd8da6c47e7517|717b1c2a1bf1db36-->
- `_clean_cache` (function) — Autouse pytest fixture that clears the disk_json_cache module-level cache before and after each test for isolation. <!--#30e926bcec897f26-->
- `test_cache_evicts_deleted_path_entry` (function) — Verifies read_json_cached returns None and drops the stale cache entry when the backing file no longer stats after deletion. <!--#6dae7c31c248fb57-->
- `test_cache_is_lru_bounded` (function) — Asserts the parse cache never exceeds its configured max-entries cap when many distinct files are read. <!--#baf000bb4666d84e-->
- `test_cache_lru_keeps_recently_used` (function) — Confirms LRU eviction discards the least-recently-used entry while preserving a freshly re-touched one on insertion past the cap. <!--#e6234b9959509b60-->
- `_paused_flow_with_cold` (function) — Helper that creates and saves a PAUSED flow with a large step output (forcing a cold steps partition) and returns it. <!--#268d250dd4b6473c-->
- `test_end_session_prunes_orphaned_partition` (function) — Checks that clear_state keeps a snapshot-referenced cold partition but clear_resumable_snapshot reclaims it once orphaned, with archive fidelity retained. <!--#de64fac26cfb3ace-->
- `test_new_run_prunes_prior_completed_partition` (function) — Verifies a fresh run overwriting engine.json reclaims a prior COMPLETED flow's now-unreferenced partition while keeping the new flow's partition. <!--#3f7ae283b2f5c577-->
- `test_prune_preserves_live_partition` (function) — Asserts _prune_cold_partition_if_orphan does not delete a partition still referenced by the live engine.json flow. <!--#bd8d5c8134566d44-->
- `test_engine_schema_covers_emitted_header` (function) — Ensures every top-level and state key the serializer emits (including worktree and iteration/token fields) is described by ENGINE_JSON_SCHEMA. <!--#0413a0dec15fbe4f-->
- `test_load_archived_prefers_newest_by_mtime` (function) — Confirms load_archived_flow_by_id selects the newest archive by mtime across the timestamped and slug naming schemes, not by lexical sort. <!--#7e2c65fd78b39be6-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter18.py` (python) — Regression tests for the iteration-18 self-check fixes (issues #243/#244) that lock in cold-storage persistence robustness — transient cold-read failures degrade steps to empty without destroying intact cold files, damaged/null/non-dict headers and contexts degrade tolerantly instead of raising across eager and lazy load paths, the size-guarded snapshot-header scanner recovers head/tail identity from oversized files without seam-spanning garbage, colliding archives atomically stamp their suffixed cold_partition, and resumed new-format flows hydrate predecessor cold outputs through to COMPLETED. <!--#912460bcce42a0d8|02b852ca48135863-->
- `_clean_cache` (function) — A pytest fixture that clears the module-level engine cache both before and after each test. <!--#30e926bcec897f26-->
- `test_apply_cold_failed_read_leaves_step_unloaded` (function) — Asserts that applying a None (failed) cold read degrades a step's in-memory IO to empty but leaves it marked not-loaded so a later persist re-emits the cold_ref verbatim. <!--#ca957907a04e957e-->
- `test_apply_cold_successful_read_marks_loaded` (function) — Asserts that applying a successful cold-read payload populates the step's inputs/outputs and marks it as loaded. <!--#6c9dc68933cd1680-->
- `test_transient_cold_read_does_not_destroy_intact_file` (function) — End-to-end test that a transient cold-read failure during hydration does not let the next save overwrite the intact cold file with empties, with data still recoverable once the error clears. <!--#98a733a302ae2c6f-->
- `test_null_cold_context_degrades_on_both_loaders` (function) — Verifies that a cold context file holding explicit JSON nulls degrades gracefully to empty context/fix_history across both eager and lazy load paths instead of raising TypeError. <!--#2a76b061503e7e64-->
- `test_load_flow_tolerant_never_raises_on_nondict_steps` (function) — Asserts that a corrupt header whose 'steps' is a string is tolerated by load_flow_tolerant, returning warnings without raising AttributeError. <!--#7f685d249118b266-->
- `test_load_flow_tolerant_never_raises_on_nondict_step_entry` (function) — Asserts that a header whose individual step entry is a non-dict is tolerated by load_flow_tolerant without raising. <!--#6a33f3faa2382972-->
- `test_save_flow_survives_corrupt_prior_header` (function) — Verifies that a non-dict 'state' in the prior on-disk header degrades cold-hash computation gracefully so the next persist still succeeds and round-trips. <!--#ab24262e687935ab-->
- `_write_oversized` (function) — Test helper that writes a multi-MiB indent=2 JSON snapshot with identity keys in the head, a giant nested state block, and a tail is_worktree_mode to exercise the seam-scanning header reader. <!--#10803600d286c20f-->
- `test_read_snapshot_header_degraded_head_and_tail` (function) — Asserts the snapshot-header reader recovers head keys and the tail is_worktree_mode from an oversized file without fully parsing the giant state block or misreading a nested copy. <!--#026d39eb491fe363-->
- `test_read_snapshot_header_missing_flow_id_returns_none` (function) — Asserts the snapshot-header reader returns None for an oversized file that lacks a flow_id. <!--#c2892538093758a0-->
- `test_read_snapshot_header_under_guard_parses_whole` (function) — Asserts that a small under-guard file is fully parsed by the snapshot-header reader, preserving its 'state'. <!--#a69a342665611c41-->
- `test_engine_scanner_no_seam_spanning_garbage` (function) — Verifies the engine header reader recovers identity from an oversized file with a huge task_description without producing seam-spanning garbage across the head/tail window. <!--#f03d48cc39da5450-->
- `test_daemon_scanner_no_seam_spanning_garbage` (function) — Verifies the daemon's read_engine_header recovers identity and is_worktree_mode from an oversized file without seam-spanning garbage in the truncated description. <!--#a695db364010dc08-->
- `test_clear_state_collision_stamps_partition_before_publish` (function) — End-to-end test that archiving into a colliding cold partition routes to a suffixed partition and stamps cold_partition into the published header atomically so archived cold_refs resolve to the correct data. <!--#dc2ad44471e3e9c7-->
- `test_resume_new_format_feeds_prior_cold_outputs_to_completion` (function) — Full resume integration test proving keyed-access hydration feeds a resumed step its predecessor's cold-file-resident outputs (not empties) and runs the flow to COMPLETED. <!--#22d9bd7a6fedea64-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter22.py` (python) — Regression test module locking in the iteration-22 self-check fixes for issue #243/#244 part A — covering hot/cold persistence robustness (a failed lazy read of externalized `_context.json` degrades to empty without being persisted over the intact cold file, mixed str/int key payloads hash without raising via `_canonical_json`, and successful cold loads still round-trip edits) plus daemon concurrency safety (`pending_calls_signature` snapshotting project roots and `_handle_end_session` dispatching its blocking handler off the websocket event loop via `asyncio.to_thread`). <!--#0ed4d9966537b374|3d4eff2f728ccda3-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a PAUSED feature FlowInstance seeded with N completed IMPLEMENT steps carrying large duplicated payloads in step inputs, context, and a fix-iteration entry, for exercising hot/cold persistence splitting. <!--#c7e9a912f82a18da-->
- `_cold_context_path` (function) — Test helper that builds the on-disk path to a flow's cold `_context.json` under `tmp_path/tianluo/state/steps/<flow_id>/`. <!--#64e39ce65042f9e5-->
- `test_failed_context_read_is_not_persisted_over_intact_file` (function) — Verifies that a transient cold-context read failure degrades to an empty context without marking it loaded, so a subsequent save re-emits the context_ref and never overwrites the (restored) intact cold file with `{}`. <!--#a4caf7c9ab4c26cc-->
- `test_loaded_context_still_round_trips` (function) — Verifies that a successfully loaded cold context is flagged `cold_context_loaded` True and that genuine edits persist back to the cold `_context.json` file. <!--#ad3528ab4d1a88ed-->
- `test_canonical_json_handles_mixed_key_types` (function) — Checks that `_canonical_json` falls back to stringifying keys for mixed-type-key dicts (instead of raising TypeError) and that `_content_hash` stays deterministic across equal inputs. <!--#2be1aa149438f77f-->
- `test_save_flow_with_mixed_key_step_payload` (function) — Verifies that saving a flow whose step outputs contain mixed int/str dict keys does not raise in content-hashing/splitting and round-trips correctly (int keys coerced to strings by JSON). <!--#0432ac37a65ccf51-->
- `test_pending_calls_signature_snapshots_roots` (function) — Verifies that `DaemonAggregator.pending_calls_signature()` iterates over a list-copy snapshot of project roots so a concurrent root registration cannot trigger a 'Set changed size during iteration' error. <!--#10dd952b601ff5e7-->
- `test_end_session_handler_dispatched_off_loop` (function) — Verifies that `DaemonClient._handle_end_session` dispatches a blocking end-session handler via `asyncio.to_thread` (running it on a worker thread, not the event-loop thread) while passing through the correct flow_id/project_root/reason args. <!--#07be9671cf0ff919-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter23.py` (python) — Regression tests for the iteration-23 self-check fixes (issue #244 phase-B3-i) that lock in two per-step cold-body data-loss guards—ensuring a re-executed step's freshly produced body persists rather than being wiped by later keyed access, and that both the lazy and eager (load_flow/load_flow_tolerant) reconstruct paths mark a failed cold-read step not-loaded and re-emit its cold_ref instead of clobbering the intact on-disk cold file with an empty body. <!--#c2b37d28d245bbd6|d7bf4c798f7e4d09-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a PAUSED feature FlowInstance populated with N completed IMPLEMENT steps each carrying distinct input/output bodies, with selected steps and current-step pointer initialized. <!--#bc516734977da4ea-->
- `_cold_step_path` (function) — Test helper that computes the on-disk path to a given step's cold-body JSON file (tianluo/state/steps/<flow_id>/<step_id>.json) under a pytest tmp_path root. <!--#4ddad8215de0530c-->
- `test_reexecuted_step_body_is_persisted_after_corrupt_cold_read` (function) — Verifies that a lazily-loaded step whose cold file is corrupt, once re-executed (cold_loaded flipped True with a fresh body), is not wiped by a later keyed access and is persisted/reloaded intact by save_flow. <!--#7c7919745bdc5398-->
- `test_pure_read_failure_does_not_clobber_lazy_cold_file` (function) — Verifies that a never-re-executed step whose cold read transiently failed keeps cold_loaded False and re-emits its cold_ref, so re-persisting does not overwrite the recovered intact cold file with an empty body. <!--#754cac471378f4c9-->
- `test_eager_load_failed_step_read_is_not_persisted_over_intact_file` (function) — Verifies the eager reconstruct path (load_flow / load_flow_tolerant) marks a failed-read step not-loaded and preserves its cold_ref—while a sibling successful read stays loaded—so a later save re-emits the reference instead of clobbering the intact on-disk cold file with {}. <!--#b1815ea43edf354c-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter31.py` (python) — Regression test suite locking in fix-iteration-31 self-check fixes: strict positive resolution (or typed raise, never silent worktree fallback) of the main checkout for worktree merge-side steps, mode-independent own-replay detection in the commit version-race guard, and symmetric clearing of the merge-lock waiting flag when a blocking acquire faults. <!--#2482ed8105dd2cb2|bb5a4c2f71f65998-->
- `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness` (class) — Test class verifying that probe_main_repo_root strictly distinguishes a genuine non-worktree (returns None) from actual git failures (git missing, non-zero exit, unparseable output, or underivable main worktree, all of which must raise MainRepoProbeError), while the lenient _resolve_main_repo_root wrapper still swallows failures to None. <!--#fc2274e015306e5b-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_non_worktree_returns_none` (method) — Asserts that when the probe succeeds and git-common-dir equals git-dir (a plain repo), it correctly reports None rather than a worktree main root. <!--#1135b33c1164ab27-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_git_missing_raises` (method) — Asserts that a FileNotFoundError from a missing git binary surfaces as MainRepoProbeError instead of being mistaken for a non-worktree. <!--#31bc709e6aacf775-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_nonzero_exit_raises` (method) — Asserts that a non-zero git exit (e.g. not a git repository) raises MainRepoProbeError. <!--#d39c7a1b6e967e5b-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_unparseable_output_raises` (method) — Asserts that git output with more than two lines (an embedded-newline path) is treated as an unparseable failure that raises rather than a non-worktree. <!--#b31f15d656b0b3ba-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_worktree_but_toplevel_fails_raises` (method) — Asserts that when a worktree is detected but deriving its main working tree fails, the probe raises rather than falling back to the worktree. <!--#6e276954010d6a79-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_resolve_wrapper_still_swallows_to_none` (method) — Asserts backward compatibility: the lenient _resolve_main_repo_root wrapper returns None on git failure so config-path lookup callers are unaffected. <!--#3ffb5818fdcd6869-->
- `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict` (class) — Test class asserting that StateMachine's worktree merge-side steps strictly resolve (or loudly raise) the main checkout root rather than silently falling back to the isolation worktree, and that such steps always acquire the merge lock regardless of a lost step.cwd override. <!--#1ae9c92fb2b9297b-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_probe_failure_raises_typed_error` (method) — Asserts a MainRepoProbeError from the probe is re-raised as a typed MergeCheckoutResolutionError from _resolve_main_checkout_root. <!--#4b5749bc4a4bad8e-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_non_worktree_resolves_to_project_root` (method) — Asserts a legitimate None probe result (project_root itself is the main checkout) resolves to the project root with no error. <!--#5202f7b292268cd7-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_worktree_resolves_to_main` (method) — Asserts that when the probe returns a main-repo path, resolution yields that main checkout. <!--#f871f93250751b0f-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_creation_tolerates_unresolvable_checkout_but_execution_is_strict` (method) — Asserts flow creation survives a transient probe fault without stashing the worktree, so a later merge step re-resolves strictly and raises while a non-merge step still gets no cwd override. <!--#d019758a2381efc4-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_stashed_checkout_used_verbatim_without_reprobe` (method) — Asserts that a positively-resolved and stashed merge_checkout_root is used verbatim by the merge step without re-probing. <!--#c48662e4a6d24b76-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_merge_step_without_cwd_still_acquires_lock` (method) — Verifies that a merge-side step whose persisted header lost its cwd override still rebinds project_root to the strictly-resolved main checkout and acquires (then releases) the merge lock, so a corrupted/reconstructed step cannot race a concurrent merge on master. <!--#d3ebc7e5f4fb982d-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_non_merge_step_without_cwd_takes_no_lock` (method) — Verifies that an ordinary non-merge step with no cwd yields through _step_cwd_override unchanged and never constructs a MergeLock, leaving the common path untouched by the merge-step lock rule. <!--#98edda92f50acf5e-->
- `TestScriptModeOwnReplayGuard` (class) — Test class asserting the commit version-race guard's durable flow_committed_version marker distinguishes a flow's own already-recorded version bump (own replay, returned verbatim) from genuine concurrent disk drift by another flow, even in script mode with no version file. <!--#ffa8104d453f4052-->
  - `TestScriptModeOwnReplayGuard._flow_with_analyze` (method) — Helper building a non-worktree FlowInstance with a completed VERSION_ANALYZE step carrying the given baseline and suggested versions. <!--#1523de14a5c51caf-->
