### `tests/test_server_authz_frontend.mjs` (text) — Node-assert test suite (Group G9) exercising the web console's DOM-free auth helpers exported from `src/tianluo/server/static/app.js` — the `nextAuthState` login state machine, `ownerLabel`, `isUnauthorizedStatus`, `canOwnerControlMachine`/`visibleMachinesForOwner` owner-narrowing, and `daemonKeyRowModel` — run browserless (bridged into pytest) to avoid the failing chromium e2e path. <!--#a3c2a5ab6760cf1b|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/test_server_authz_frontend.py` (python) — Pytest bridge for the web console's G9 auth/owner-narrowing frontend: it statically guards that app.js exports the pure helpers (nextAuthState, ownerLabel, isUnauthorizedStatus, visibleMachinesForOwner, canOwnerControlMachine, daemonKeyRowModel) and that index.html wires in the login-gate and daemon-key markup, then runs the Node assertion suite (test_server_authz_frontend.mjs) as a subprocess to verify the login/owner-visibility/key logic passes. <!--#4410c20a79887f54|8917e03b76db2c36-->
- `test_authz_frontend_module_present` (function) — Asserts the G9 node-stub suite file exists and that app.js exports the tested pure helpers (nextAuthState, ownerLabel, isUnauthorizedStatus, visibleMachinesForOwner, canOwnerControlMachine, daemonKeyRowModel). <!--#cdf12830a800d6f3-->
- `test_login_and_keys_markup_present` (function) — Asserts index.html wires in the login gate, top-bar owner/logout, and daemon-key panel markup by checking for their element ids. <!--#11948906df2d3d09-->
- `test_authz_frontend_node_suite_passes` (function) — Runs the Node assertion suite as a subprocess (skipping if node is absent) and verifies it exits cleanly with the expected G9 check messages present in its output. <!--#ef07192f9965eee0-->

### `tests/test_server_config.py` (python) — Unit tests for tianluo.config server/auth configuration parsing and validation, covering ServerConfig/AuthConfig defaults, provider list parsing, session cookie security, local-auth lockout/rate-limit rules, OIDC/proxy-header seams, db_path resolution, and load_server_config precedence between tianluo.yaml and tianluo.local.yaml. <!--#c588b81c3ddbaa32|78bbd8a3f9bb348f-->
- `_write_yaml` (function) — Test helper that serializes a dict to a YAML file at the given path. <!--#9513281fbf5817c0-->
- `TestServerConfigDefaults` (class) — Tests that ServerConfig.from_dict yields safe defaults (db_path, auth sub-configs, failsafe session/local settings, disabled OIDC/proxy) when given empty or non-mapping input. <!--#ba0e55c66ac1717b-->
  - `TestServerConfigDefaults.test_empty_dict_defaults` (method) — Asserts an empty dict produces the default db_path and local-only providers. <!--#e96f289b6f6071b4-->
  - `TestServerConfigDefaults.test_non_mapping_defaults` (method) — Asserts a non-mapping (list) input falls back to default db_path and providers. <!--#f0d7fbafcadc5fdf-->
  - `TestServerConfigDefaults.test_auth_subconfigs_are_defaults` (method) — Asserts the auth config and its session/local/oidc/proxy_header sub-configs are instantiated as their default types. <!--#c2615fd66f43f691-->
  - `TestServerConfigDefaults.test_session_security_defaults_are_failsafe` (method) — Asserts session cookie defaults are security-failsafe (secure, httponly, lax samesite, default name and max age). <!--#2d2a6f45c48a91b3-->
  - `TestServerConfigDefaults.test_local_defaults` (method) — Asserts default local-auth lockout and rate-limit thresholds. <!--#eded478472998ad1-->
  - `TestServerConfigDefaults.test_oidc_and_proxy_disabled_by_default` (method) — Asserts OIDC and proxy-header auth are disabled by default with their default scopes/header. <!--#3fc4d06dc487d053-->
  - `TestServerConfigDefaults.test_resolved_db_path_expands_user` (method) — Asserts resolved_db_path returns a Path with the ~ home expanded. <!--#45966338e87ebcb9-->
- `TestAuthProvidersParsing` (class) — Tests auth.providers parsing: explicit lists, filtering unknowns, fallback to local, non-list handling, case-insensitive dedup, and skipping blanks. <!--#f9618e9400cdf20c-->
  - `TestAuthProvidersParsing.test_explicit_providers` (method) — Asserts an explicit valid provider list is preserved in order. <!--#5cc74dcf40b56302-->
  - `TestAuthProvidersParsing.test_unknown_providers_filtered` (method) — Asserts unknown provider names are filtered out of the list. <!--#50e06ec0fe724184-->
  - `TestAuthProvidersParsing.test_all_unknown_falls_back_to_local` (method) — Asserts an all-unknown provider list falls back to local. <!--#8a96e962ace4450d-->
  - `TestAuthProvidersParsing.test_non_list_falls_back_to_local` (method) — Asserts a non-list providers value falls back to local. <!--#e7169f286fbbd06e-->
  - `TestAuthProvidersParsing.test_dedup_and_case_insensitive` (method) — Asserts providers are lowercased and de-duplicated while keeping first-seen order. <!--#4ee4b2f07f2fa3b3-->
  - `TestAuthProvidersParsing.test_blank_entries_skipped` (method) — Asserts empty/whitespace provider entries are skipped, keeping only valid ones. <!--#04d39547abdd5d6d-->
- `TestSessionValidation` (class) — Tests SessionConfig validation for samesite, cookie name, secure flag, and max-age fallbacks. <!--#5b45c385698a1565-->
  - `TestSessionValidation.test_invalid_samesite_falls_back` (method) — Asserts an invalid cookie_samesite falls back to 'lax'. <!--#64ccf147be6872ed-->
  - `TestSessionValidation.test_valid_samesite_strict` (method) — Asserts a valid samesite value is normalized to lowercase 'strict'. <!--#89a57dc7832afb42-->
  - `TestSessionValidation.test_blank_cookie_name_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a blank cookie_name falls back to the default name. <!--#5a54a5f0e84e97b4-->
  - `TestSessionValidation.test_secure_can_be_disabled` (method) — Asserts cookie_secure can be explicitly disabled. <!--#f7d186575a61fa8f-->
  - `TestSessionValidation.test_invalid_max_age_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a negative max_age_seconds falls back to the default. <!--#c047ef8ac52c7466-->
  - `TestSessionValidation.test_non_int_max_age_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a non-integer max_age_seconds falls back to the default. <!--#456ed402f67b92cc-->
- `TestLocalAuthValidation` (class) — Tests LocalAuthConfig parsing of custom thresholds, non-positive fallbacks, and rejection of bool-as-int. <!--#4d73e56a457ff1d0-->
  - `TestLocalAuthValidation.test_custom_values` (method) — Asserts custom lockout/rate-limit values are accepted as-is. <!--#3111827dd9c00f54-->
  - `TestLocalAuthValidation.test_non_positive_falls_back` (method) — Asserts non-positive local-auth values fall back to defaults. <!--#1325c7568be7b409-->
  - `TestLocalAuthValidation.test_bool_rejected` (method) — Asserts a boolean value is not coerced to an int and falls back to the default. <!--#ccaa9e9161bce987-->
- `TestOidcAndProxySeams` (class) — Tests OidcConfig and ProxyHeaderConfig parsing of enabled flags, fields, scopes, and blank/fallback handling. <!--#4a1285d6712f101b-->
  - `TestOidcAndProxySeams.test_oidc_enable_and_fields` (method) — Asserts OIDC fields (enabled, issuer, client_id, scopes) are parsed when fully specified. <!--#bcc347748fa6be70-->
  - `TestOidcAndProxySeams.test_oidc_invalid_scopes_fall_back` (method) — Asserts a non-list OIDC scopes value falls back to default scopes. <!--#578dd8ccecbde519-->
  - `TestOidcAndProxySeams.test_oidc_blank_fields_become_none` (method) — Asserts a blank OIDC field is normalized to None. <!--#a82a1033794a8ad5-->
  - `TestOidcAndProxySeams.test_proxy_header_custom` (method) — Asserts custom proxy-header settings (enabled, trust_proxy, header) are parsed. <!--#d69fd5e44b192e9b-->
  - `TestOidcAndProxySeams.test_proxy_header_trust_proxy_defaults_false` (method) — Asserts trust_proxy defaults to False when not specified. <!--#71d92fcc4bd0671b-->
  - `TestOidcAndProxySeams.test_proxy_header_blank_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a blank proxy header name falls back to the default with trust_proxy False. <!--#989aadc35e028b6e-->
- `TestDbPath` (class) — Test class verifying ServerConfig.db_path handling — that a custom db_path is preserved and resolved to a Path, and that a blank/whitespace value falls back to the default '~/.se3/server.db'. <!--#d726d7f06b1e4649-->
  - `TestDbPath.test_custom_db_path` (method) — Asserts that a custom db_path passed to ServerConfig.from_dict is stored verbatim and returned by resolved_db_path() as the corresponding Path. <!--#289788fff12b5ff4-->
  - `TestDbPath.test_blank_db_path_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a blank db_path falls back to the default. <!--#cc652a1bf1dff786-->
- `TestLoadServerConfig` (class) — Test class covering load_server_config: default fallback when YAML is missing or lacks a server section, parsing of a full server/auth section, tianluo.local.yaml shadowing tianluo.yaml, and coexistence with unrelated config sections. <!--#69a339714bed0b4d-->
  - `TestLoadServerConfig.test_missing_yaml_returns_defaults` (method) — Asserts loading from a directory with no YAML returns defaults. <!--#1d527808cb4fd2aa-->
  - `TestLoadServerConfig.test_yaml_without_server_section` (method) — Asserts that a tianluo.yaml lacking a server section still yields default auth providers (['local']) from load_server_config. <!--#c27f50c5ecd2cd27-->
  - `TestLoadServerConfig.test_yaml_with_server_section` (method) — Asserts that a full server section (db_path plus nested auth providers, session, and local settings) is parsed correctly into ServerConfig by load_server_config. <!--#1d5213ebc79f5f40-->
  - `TestLoadServerConfig.test_local_yaml_shadows_yaml` (method) — Asserts that tianluo.local.yaml overrides values from tianluo.yaml so the local file's db_path wins. <!--#4779fce482286ae8-->
  - `TestLoadServerConfig.test_existing_config_loading_not_broken` (method) — Asserts that a tianluo.yaml mixing a server section with an unrelated version section loads both load_server_config and load_version_config without breaking either. <!--#3b9e572697679e17-->

### `tests/test_server_crypto.py` (python) — Unit tests for tianluo.server.crypto verifying its security primitives: slow salted password hashing/verification, high-entropy token generation and hashing, constant-time comparison, and secret redaction/fingerprinting helpers. <!--#bcc7368702620eef|40059af7775ac059-->
- `test_hash_password_is_slow_salted_not_plaintext` (function) — Asserts hash_password never returns plaintext and always produces a recognized slow-hash format (argon2 or bcrypt). <!--#d3afd5778c29c5fc-->
- `test_hash_password_salted_unique_per_call` (function) — Asserts hashing the same password twice yields different hashes, proving per-call salting. <!--#73a16f573c53d386-->
- `test_verify_password_roundtrip` (function) — Checks verify_password returns True for the correct password and False for a wrong one against a generated hash. <!--#28670a6263b47894-->
- `test_verify_password_handles_long_and_unicode` (function) — Verifies password hashing/verification works correctly for long, multibyte unicode passwords exceeding 72 bytes. <!--#a137e3634ee844cf-->
- `test_verify_password_rejects_malformed_hash` (function) — Asserts verify_password safely returns False for empty, non-hash, and unknown-format hash strings. <!--#b1ae3910b192843b-->
- `test_generate_token_high_entropy_and_unique` (function) — Checks generate_token produces unique, high-entropy, prefixed plaintext tokens with distinct storage hashes. <!--#1ddc19e7a7976cc4-->
- `test_generate_token_no_prefix` (function) — Verifies generate_token without a prefix yields a non-empty plaintext (no leading underscore) whose hash matches token_hash. <!--#deaa040aa6bf41d4-->
- `test_token_hash_matches_and_verifies` (function) — Asserts token_hash is consistent and verify_token_hash accepts the correct plaintext while rejecting altered or empty input. <!--#ed04667e95071338-->
- `test_token_plaintext_not_derivable_from_hash` (function) — Confirms the stored token hash never contains the secret and is a 64-char sha256 hex digest. <!--#ee343b97c8b67187-->
- `test_const_eq_str_and_bytes` (function) — Tests const_eq for correct equality results across str/bytes mixes and length/content mismatches. <!--#4dc0d7f600d03df0-->
- `test_const_eq_bad_types_return_false` (function) — Asserts const_eq returns False for None and non-string/bytes types rather than raising. <!--#d951d353cc548368-->
- `test_redact_reveals_nothing` (function) — Verifies redact returns '<redacted>' hiding the secret and '<empty>' for empty or None input. <!--#ecd3a4a98a994dc1-->
- `test_token_fingerprint_is_short_and_non_reversible` (function) — Checks token_fingerprint yields a deterministic, non-reversible 12-char value, with '<empty>' for empty input. <!--#c66f84c97b785734-->

### `tests/test_server_g4_relay.py` (python) — Test suite for the G4 server relay covering ServerState history-index delta merge and differential broadcast, the history bundle content signature and not-modified snapshot logic, the full-pull throttle, keepalive liveness without re-broadcast, DetailRequestRegistry coalescing, on-demand issue/call detail REST endpoints, GZip/WS compression, and server wire-byte metrics — driving the daemon receive-loop dispatcher with a recording hub to assert broadcasts deterministically. <!--#c845186fd139d3f0|ff9838a7461b8524-->
- `test_merge_history_index_delta_upsert_add_remove` (function) — Verifies ServerState.merge_history_index_delta applies a delta by upserting changed flows, adding new ones, and removing listed flow_ids from the in-memory history index. <!--#bec26c1ccfe71a1a-->
- `test_merge_history_index_delta_ignores_rows_without_flow_id` (function) — Asserts that history-index delta rows lacking a flow_id are silently dropped while valid rows are still merged. <!--#7fa77088934117c9-->
- `test_merge_delta_matches_full_reindex` (function) — Confirms that applying a change as an incremental delta yields the same index set as re-pushing the full index. <!--#170efb516937bc72-->
- `test_snapshot_exposes_signature_and_changes_with_records` (function) — Checks that a history snapshot carries a non-empty signature string and that appending new records changes that signature. <!--#434ea6b7babdeb11-->
- `test_snapshot_not_modified_when_signature_matches_and_no_new_records` (function) — Verifies that echoing both the progress token and matching signature with no new records yields a 'not_modified' delivery with empty records. <!--#d1be82cbad00e736-->
- `test_snapshot_delta_when_new_records_even_with_signature` (function) — Ensures that when new records exist a snapshot returns a 'delta' with the tail records rather than 'not_modified', even if a signature is supplied. <!--#411dac7fe15ab98f-->
- `test_snapshot_legacy_client_without_signature_keeps_empty_delta` (function) — Confirms a client echoing only a token (no signature) still gets the old records-empty 'delta', keeping the not_modified fast path opt-in and backward compatible. <!--#157595ba561be479-->
- `test_snapshot_stale_signature_still_not_not_modified` (function) — Asserts a wrong/stale signature (with valid token at offset==total) falls back to an empty 'delta' instead of 'not_modified'. <!--#e662b7106fc9c9c9-->
- `test_bundle_signature_is_cheap_and_stable` (function) — Tests that bundle_signature is deterministic yet distinct across changes in record count, generation, and machine id. <!--#3ac4feb2ba6151c6-->
- `test_full_pull_throttle_window` (function) — Verifies ServerState's full-pull throttle marks a flow as recently pulled and respects the min_interval window (throttled unless the window is zero). <!--#9f1e684701fa3856-->
- `test_find_call_owner_scans_pending_calls` (function) — Checks that find_call_owner locates the owning (machine, project_root) of a pending call_id and returns None for unknown ids. <!--#fa8b3816110222d9-->
- `test_find_call_owner_disambiguates_by_project_root` (function) — Ensures find_call_owner pins a duplicated local call_id to the correct machine/project via project_root and returns None for an unmatched root. <!--#5016373fa37b19f0-->
- `RecordingHub` (class) — A minimal UiHub stand-in that records every scoped and owned broadcast so tests can assert on browser fan-out behavior. <!--#6661421851f19d63-->
  - `RecordingHub.__init__` (method) — Initializes the stub with a client count and empty lists capturing scoped and owned broadcasts. <!--#4026e1ba6580af2b-->
  - `RecordingHub.client_count` (method) — Property returning the configured number of connected UI clients. <!--#854f4922a8380908-->
  - `RecordingHub.distinct_owners` (method) — Returns the set of distinct owners, always {None} for this stub. <!--#b1dfd7732fb9e9b5-->
  - `RecordingHub.broadcast_scoped` (method) — Records an owner-scoped broadcast payload into the scoped list. <!--#24ae51509d068209-->
  - `RecordingHub.broadcast_owned` (method) — Records an owner-targeted broadcast payload and owner into the owned list. <!--#e03c98c48ffe7f09-->
- `test_keepalive_touches_liveness_without_broadcast` (function) — Verifies handling a keepalive frame refreshes a machine's last_seen liveness but triggers no browser fan-out. <!--#4b240bf11a8fd3f0-->
- `test_history_index_delta_merges_and_broadcasts_delta` (function) — Confirms an incoming history-index-delta frame is merged into the full index and relayed to /ws/ui as a machine-stamped delta frame rather than a full re-fan. <!--#3ed6ec0a298df223-->
- `test_detail_data_resolves_registry_waiter` (function) — Checks that a DETAIL_DATA message resolves the DetailRequestRegistry future so the awaiting caller receives the full detail body. <!--#88b8ff43d75d8e3a-->
- `test_detail_registry_followers_share_one_pull` (function) — Verifies that a second request for the same (kind,id,machine,root) target becomes a follower parked under the leader, so one reply wakes both waiters. <!--#50e9ac71125d28fd-->
- `test_detail_registry_scopes_coalescing_to_machine_and_root` (function) — Ensures detail-pull coalescing keys on the full (kind,id,machine,root) tuple so identical local ids on different machines/projects each lead their own pull, preventing cross-owner leaks. <!--#e1ecc99e8db73722-->
- `client_and_app` (function) — Pytest fixture that builds an authenticated FastAPI server app (via _authsrv.authed_app), shortens HISTORY_INDEX_REFRESH_TIMEOUT, and yields a logged-in TestClient plus the app for the G4 relay tests. <!--#f62ce9b7aa1529d8-->
- `_drain_index_requests` (function) — Test helper that reads daemon frames until one of the wanted type arrives, tolerating intervening MSG_HISTORY_INDEX_REQUEST frames. <!--#86d1090c4423bf37-->
- `test_gzip_middleware_registered` (function) — Asserts the built app has GZipMiddleware registered in its middleware stack. <!--#4be3ea510761a53f-->
- `test_run_enables_ws_per_message_deflate` (function) — Asserts that server app_mod.run() passes ws_per_message_deflate=True and ws_max_size=protocol.MAX_WS_MESSAGE_BYTES to uvicorn.run, pinning the WS-compression leg of the traffic-reduction work via a stubbed uvicorn. <!--#46ebbdd32622023f-->
- `test_run_falls_back_when_uvicorn_lacks_deflate_kwarg` (function) — Verifies that when uvicorn.run rejects the ws_per_message_deflate kwarg (older uvicorn), run() retries once without it instead of crashing, asserting exactly two calls with the kwarg dropped on the second. <!--#3cceceef547a818b-->
- `test_history_bundle_large_json_served_intact` (function) — Verifies that a large full history bundle survives the server's GZip middleware and is served intact over the REST endpoint with delivery=full and a signature. <!--#63668f0f2fa82b08-->
- `test_history_not_modified_via_rest` (function) — Verifies that re-requesting a cached history flow with matching after/sig params returns delivery=not_modified with no records. <!--#f8969817e21a59c5-->
- `test_issue_detail_endpoint_pulls_full_text` (function) — Verifies the /api/issues/{id}/detail endpoint routes a MSG_DETAIL_REQUEST to the owning daemon and returns the full untruncated issue body from the detail reply. <!--#0b6ccbe6c85243e8-->
- `test_call_detail_endpoint_resolves_owner_and_pulls` (function) — Verifies the /api/calls/{id}/detail endpoint resolves the owning machine, routes a MSG_DETAIL_REQUEST, and returns the full untruncated call prompt from the daemon. <!--#e40de1b8edee066a-->
- `test_call_detail_no_daemon_404` (function) — Asserts that requesting call detail for an unknown call id with no daemon returns HTTP 404. <!--#ef2aac4f77f337b6-->
- `test_wire_metrics_endpoint_counts_downlink` (function) — Verifies the /api/wire-metrics endpoint accounts a downlink HISTORY_INDEX_REQUEST, exposing a __total__ entry with nonzero bytes. <!--#f21a3679ce768a05-->
- `_drain_index_requests_soft` (function) — Best-effort test helper that reads at most one daemon frame, swallowing any exception if none is present. <!--#eefaeb0d537dddf8-->
- `_authed_hello_v2` (function) — Builds an authenticated HELLO advertising the pre-detail revision-2 protocol so tests can simulate a daemon that never learned DETAIL_REQUEST. <!--#4593412dcb53b89e-->
- `test_wire_metrics_records_welcome_and_ping` (function) — Verifies handshake WELCOME frames written directly to the daemon socket (bypassing ConnectionManager) are still counted in the per-type wire metrics. <!--#44eaee4c1ae120f1-->
- `test_issue_detail_pre_v3_daemon_serves_mirror` (function) — Verifies that for a pre-v3 daemon the issue-detail endpoint short-circuits to the server's mirror (no DETAIL_REQUEST, fast 200) instead of parking a doomed pull that would 504. <!--#8e203be47a7297e9-->
- `test_call_detail_pre_v3_daemon_serves_mirror` (function) — Verifies that for a pre-v3 daemon the call-detail endpoint returns the full mirror prompt with a fast 200 rather than routing a doomed DETAIL_REQUEST that would time out. <!--#ba62972f026fc000-->

### `tests/test_server_history.py` (python) — Tests for the server-side history relay, covering ServerState history-index aggregation and per-machine replacement, full/append bundle caching and merge semantics (including the requires-authoritative-full guard after a restart), WebSocket routing via HistoryRequestRegistry/request_history, and the /api/history REST endpoints' cache-hit, cache-miss on-demand pull, and pull-timeout paths. <!--#8c68f8228feea77d|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/test_server_history_authoritative_root.py` (python) — Pytest/async test module for the WebUI server's history layer, pinning three behaviours: `get_history_flow_project_root` resolves a flow's authoritative `project_root` from the history index (owner-scoped, index preferred over the live flow set, None when unknown), `ServerState.is_active_worktree_flow` classifies only running/paused `tianluo/worktrees/` flows as active reconcile candidates, and the #287 add-only history floor that refuses empty or shorter `full` frames (marking them `rejected_full`) for active worktree flows while still allowing growth, same-length replacement, cross-machine takeover, and non-worktree/completed shrinks. <!--#eb8e8088c5632e6d|7add1136e2576c1a-->
- `test_project_root_from_history_index_is_authoritative` (function) — Asserts that get_history_flow_project_root returns the flow's own authoritative project_root recorded in the history index, not a sibling flow's root. <!--#abbd8478f973bb48-->
- `test_project_root_not_first_match_but_authoritative_for_flow` (function) — Verifies that when multiple machines register different roots, resolving a flow returns the worktree root recorded for that specific flow rather than the first-enumerated root. <!--#5118f279103eb7ae-->
- `test_project_root_falls_back_to_live_flow_set` (function) — Checks that an active flow not yet in the history index still resolves its project_root via the live flow set from update_status. <!--#5306ad615d649f43-->
- `test_project_root_index_preferred_over_live_flow` (function) — Asserts the authoritative history index root takes precedence over a conflicting project_root reported by the live flow set. <!--#abc63e1596db0143-->
- `test_project_root_unknown_flow_returns_none` (function) — Asserts an unknown flow id resolves to None. <!--#9688762f6f4c7a4d-->
- `test_project_root_empty_when_not_recorded` (function) — Asserts a flow indexed without a project_root degrades to None (legacy empty behaviour). <!--#ffc525c9a24fc841-->
- `test_project_root_owner_scoped_out_returns_none` (function) — Verifies owner scoping so a flow on one owner's machine is invisible to another owner's lookup. <!--#20bb9c9f9cf5418b-->
- `client_and_app` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding an authenticated FastAPI TestClient and app with a shortened HISTORY_INDEX_REFRESH_TIMEOUT for the integration tests. <!--#1b8760119bd94b2b-->
- `_receive_until` (function) — Test helper that drains daemon WebSocket frames, ignoring interstitial MSG_HISTORY_INDEX_REQUEST frames, until a frame of the requested msg_type arrives and is returned. <!--#83126d5b34beeefb-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_true_for_running_worktree` (function) — Asserts is_active_worktree_flow returns True for a running flow rooted under tianluo/worktrees/. <!--#259f294634871c7e-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_true_for_paused_worktree` (function) — Asserts a paused worktree flow (blocked on a human reply) still counts as active so the self-heal reconcile gate fires during the pending-reply window. <!--#bf72fe72b05a5597-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_false_when_completed` (function) — Asserts a completed worktree flow is no longer active, so no reconcile pull is triggered. <!--#817071b19ea51f23-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_false_for_non_worktree` (function) — Verifies that a running flow rooted at an ordinary (non-worktree) path is not classified as a worktree flow. <!--#309f09885bcd658a-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_false_for_paused_non_worktree` (function) — Asserts that `ServerState.is_active_worktree_flow` returns False for a `paused` flow whose `project_root` is an ordinary repo path, pinning the gate to worktree-AND-(running|paused) so the reconcile path cannot open for every pending-reply flow in the fleet. <!--#4b20378b8951cb75-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_false_for_unknown_flow` (function) — Verifies that is_active_worktree_flow returns False for a flow id the server has never seen. <!--#e60043139d31df55-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_owner_scoped` (function) — Verifies is_active_worktree_flow is owner-scoped — one owner's active worktree flow is invisible when queried under a different owner. <!--#7eca16a7c2f18bc9-->
- `test_identical_full_repull_keeps_generation` (function) — Verifies that an identical full history re-pull keeps the bundle generation stable (so in-sync clients aren't forced to re-fetch) while a grown re-pull rolls a fresh generation. <!--#4331a2bd2b1b3d2e-->
- `_round` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal discovery history record dict for a given ordinal. <!--#c1080140cdba2448-->
- `_register_flow` (function) — Async test helper that pushes a STATUS_UPDATE registering one flow on machine `m1` with the given status and `project_root`, so the state layer can classify it as (non-)worktree/active. <!--#c28b5c262504e728-->
- `_paused_worktree_flow` (function) — Async test helper that registers a paused worktree-rooted flow via _register_flow. <!--#55f74610c976a3ac-->
- `test_empty_full_does_not_wipe_existing_bundle` (function) — Regression test for #287: an empty `full` frame from the same machine must leave an existing non-empty bundle and its generation untouched while still reporting as applied so pull waiters are released. <!--#4e26d7d164323ba2-->
- `test_empty_full_never_wipes_existing_bundle_whatever_the_flow` (function) — Parametrized test asserting the empty-`full` refusal is unconditional across flow registrations (including unregistered flows), and that the frame is marked `rejected_full` so the `/ws/ui` fan-out does not relay it. <!--#13c24b2f93482965-->
- `test_shorter_non_empty_full_does_not_shrink_existing_bundle` (function) — Asserts the add-only floor also blocks a non-empty but strictly shorter `full` frame for a paused worktree flow, preserving the later rounds and the generation. <!--#31e606229014de42-->
- `test_same_length_full_replace_is_applied` (function) — Asserts the floor is about record COUNT, not content — an equal-length `full` that rewrites records in place still replaces the bundle. <!--#76e0487b9fd97197-->
- `test_shrinking_full_still_replaces_bundle_for_a_non_worktree_flow` (function) — Asserts a shrinking `full` frame for an ordinary (non-worktree) flow still replaces the bundle, rolls the generation, and is not flagged `rejected_full`, preserving pre-#287 retry behaviour. <!--#d46ea965f4b68d5e-->
- `test_shrinking_full_still_replaces_bundle_for_a_completed_worktree_flow` (function) — Asserts that for a completed (terminal) worktree flow a shrinking non-empty FULL frame is accepted and replaces the cached bundle, since no reconcile shrink-floor applies to it. <!--#5e5bac2d2c4cac4b-->
- `test_non_empty_full_still_replaces_and_rolls_generation` (function) — Asserts the guard does not blunt a genuine self-heal reconcile — a `full` frame carrying MORE records replaces the bundle and rolls the generation so clients re-fetch. <!--#c93180308510a66a-->
- `test_cross_machine_full_still_establishes_new_bundle` (function) — Asserts the no-rollback guard is scoped to the same machine — a `full` frame from a different `machine_id` takes over the bundle wholesale even if shorter. <!--#ddbbba59d3c7c517-->
- `test_first_empty_full_still_creates_empty_bundle` (function) — Asserts an empty `full` frame with no cached bundle still writes through to create an authoritative empty bundle that later `append` frames can extend. <!--#bc2e7cc2d4508f34-->
- `_sync_live_flow` (function) — Test helper that polls the REST flow endpoint until a STATUS_UPDATE-reported flow becomes visible, failing if it never appears. <!--#340efbc6432c6d07-->
- `_report_running_flow` (function) — Test helper that sends a STATUS_UPDATE over the daemon websocket reporting a single running flow at the given project root. <!--#f144495ec85626c0-->
- `_first_full_pull` (function) — Test helper that issues the cache-miss history GET in a background thread, answers the daemon's HISTORY_REQUEST with the given records, and returns the response JSON. <!--#863884d15d001709-->
- `test_running_worktree_selfheal_reconciles_missing_round` (function) — End-to-end test that a running worktree flow stuck at round 1 self-heals on a not_modified poll by re-pulling the daemon, landing the missing round 2 with per-file identity preserved. <!--#5ae48ab9e2beb3c4-->
- `test_running_worktree_selfheal_respects_throttle` (function) — Verifies the self-heal reconcile honors the full-pull throttle window, answering not_modified from cache without emitting a redundant daemon history request. <!--#7aab78435a7edeb8-->
- `test_non_worktree_flow_never_reconciles` (function) — Asserts an ordinary non-worktree running flow is served straight from cache and never triggers the worktree-only self-heal reconcile, even with the throttle disabled. <!--#e042e18db0ea7146-->
- `test_cache_miss_pull_sends_authoritative_project_root` (function) — Asserts a cache-miss GET /api/history/{flow_id} sends the daemon the flow's authoritative worktree project_root so it merges the correct history dirs instead of first-match guessing. <!--#d838ebb401441144-->
- `test_cache_miss_pull_empty_root_when_unrecorded` (function) — Verifies that when a flow has no recorded root the cache-miss pull degrades to an empty project_root, preserving legacy behaviour for non-worktree flows. <!--#7dd2be7d6be00dd7-->

### `tests/test_server_history_live_append_broadcast.py` (python) — Regression test suite for the MSG_HISTORY_DATA broadcast-suppression rule (#193), driving the real UiHub/HistoryRequestRegistry and DaemonHistoryReader to assert that live `mode: append` increments always reach subscribed UI sockets while only waiter-resolving `mode: full` cache-miss replies are suppressed, and covering owner scoping, transition/retry no-loss/no-dup fidelity against golden fixtures, and the recovery-pull dedup/TTL/re-arm markers. <!--#0ad33f3f10ab0839|6fd7a421e9f9aab4-->
- `_UiWS` (class) — Minimal UI WebSocket stand-in that captures decoded frames sent to it and can filter them by history type and flow id. <!--#7ad41ce10c30c033-->
  - `_UiWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the stand-in's `sent` list that accumulates received frames. <!--#d14bbb740fc91394-->
  - `_UiWS.send_text` (method) — Decodes the JSON frame it is sent and appends it to the captured `sent` list. <!--#015e8192c9e42ee8-->
  - `_UiWS.history_frames` (method) — Returns the captured `history_data` frames, optionally filtered to a given flow id. <!--#bf1df282dc320385-->
- `_setup` (function) — Async fixture helper building a `ServerState` with one registered machine plus a `UiHub`, subscribed UI client, and `HistoryRequestRegistry`. <!--#6882b69cc105b9ba-->
- `_history_msg` (function) — Builds a `make_history_data` protocol message for the given flow, mode, records, and optional cursor. <!--#b3cef8632536f01e-->
- `test_full_pull_reply_resolving_waiter_is_not_broadcast` (function) — Asserts a `mode: full` frame that resolves a parked pull waiter resolves the future but is not re-broadcast to the UI socket. <!--#6cc7bb0aac263919-->
- `test_unsolicited_full_without_waiter_is_broadcast` (function) — Asserts a live `mode: full` replacement that resolves no waiter is still streamed to the UI client. <!--#54244e9ae4a93f12-->
- `test_append_resolving_waiter_is_still_broadcast` (function) — Core regression test that a `mode: append` racing a REST pull both resolves the waiter and is broadcast to the live view. <!--#29206f5e73a92ff0-->
- `test_live_append_without_waiter_is_broadcast` (function) — Asserts an ordinary active-flow append with no pull waiter streams unchanged to the UI. <!--#3f8e5618de5329a0-->
- `test_consecutive_appends_after_respond_keep_broadcasting` (function) — Asserts three successive post-respond appends (one resolving a stray waiter) all reach the live view in order. <!--#e54ef12d305b0c8e-->
- `test_append_broadcast_is_owner_scoped` (function) — Asserts a broadcast append reaches only the owning UI client and not a different owner's subscriber. <!--#54ae99d16f1a98e8-->
- `test_appends_after_bundle_keep_applied_and_stable_generation` (function) — Asserts successive appends on an existing bundle apply, keep the generation stable, and that the full REST snapshot contains every appended record. <!--#de9309fa27a97daa-->
- `_write_jsonl` (function) — Test helper that writes a list of records as JSON lines to a file, creating parent dirs. <!--#382769e0f0931aaa-->
- `_append_jsonl` (function) — Test helper that appends a list of records as JSON lines to an existing file. <!--#3e163ee803b3f93e-->
- `_write_engine` (function) — Test helper that writes a minimal `tianluo/state/engine.json` under the given root recording a flow's `flow_id` and `status`. <!--#1d4f2ea6d3f9b0fd-->
- `_hist` (function) — Test helper returning the `tianluo/history/<flow_id>` directory path for a given root and flow id. <!--#601cb88cd9e45820-->
- `_chat` (function) — Test helper building a chat record dict with role, content, and timestamp. <!--#653f232ec7903ab1-->
- `_started` (function) — Test helper building a `step_started` event record dict. <!--#3d42e46002c7b57f-->
- `_status` (function) — Test helper building a `step_status` event record dict with a given status. <!--#920eaa840d4289bb-->
- `_completed` (function) — Test helper building a `step_completed` event record dict with nested step data. <!--#7f324cfde56a8bb3-->
- `_failed` (function) — Test helper building a `step_failed` event record dict carrying an error message. <!--#ee10107398495af0-->
- `_transition_mutations` (function) — Returns an ordered list of filesystem mutation callbacks scripting a discovery flow that runs confirm rounds, completes, and transitions into analyze. <!--#55bf5514dc8de44b-->
- `_retry_mutations` (function) — Returns an ordered list of mutation callbacks scripting an update_spec step that fails, is retried, and re-runs to success. <!--#5fff23fdcc62de77-->
- `_drive_scenario` (function) — Drives the real `DaemonHistoryReader` through a mutation script into the real server broadcast, returning the UI frames and authoritative snapshot records. <!--#0c357244a78339e9-->
- `_generate_all` (function) — Runs both the transition and retry scenarios under a temp path and returns their combined frame/snapshot results. <!--#111188bdb850f608-->
- `_flat_records` (function) — Flattens a list of frames into a single concatenated list of their records. <!--#3e590f849a35ae9e-->
- `test_transition_broadcast_equals_full_snapshot_no_loss_no_dup` (function) — Asserts the concatenated transition broadcast (initial full then appends) exactly equals the authoritative snapshot with no lost or duplicated records. <!--#84b2c402e8d835e0-->
- `test_transition_analyze_arrives_as_live_delta_not_swallowed` (function) — Asserts the post-transition analyze records arrive in live append frames with the correct step_type, proving the transition batch is not swallowed. <!--#6e02fde2a1a538dc-->
- `test_retry_broadcast_equals_full_snapshot_no_loss_no_dup` (function) — Asserts the retry scenario's broadcast equals the full snapshot and that the success turn and similar-looking retry draft both stream as live deltas. <!--#829eec0b4656e356-->
- `test_e2e_frames_match_committed_golden_fixture` (function) — Asserts the generated daemon→server e2e frames match the committed golden fixture, regenerating it when `SE3_REGEN_GOLDEN` is set. <!--#c4428a64183fd608-->
- `test_take_recovery_pull_fires_once_per_stuck_flow` (function) — Asserts that a first-sighting discarded append arms exactly one recovery pull per stuck flow, dedupes a second consult while in flight, and never arms a pull for a healthy flow. <!--#e2fd46ad87964b15-->
- `test_recovery_full_head_clears_requires_full_but_keeps_marker_in_flight` (function) — An asyncio test asserting that when a recovery pull's full HEAD re-appends history via HISTORY_MODE_FULL, ServerState clears the flow's requires_full flag but keeps its in-flight recovery marker armed for the whole drain, preventing the mid-drain livelock where releasing the marker on the head would reopen the dedup window and arm a rival pull. <!--#bb6c4d70321b672b-->
- `test_clear_recovery_pull_re_arms_after_failed_send` (function) — Checks that explicitly clearing the recovery marker after a failed send releases it so a later append can re-arm a fresh recovery instead of wedging. <!--#ca9d0dbf117bd73c-->
- `test_recovery_marker_expires_when_reply_never_arrives` (function) — Confirms the timestamped recovery marker, once aged past its TTL on the monotonic clock, is treated as lost so a later discarded append re-arms a fresh pull. <!--#3c8889fbec2dea79-->
- `test_plan_recovery_pull_dedup_and_ttl_rearm_parity` (function) — Verifies that ServerState.plan_recovery_pull returns a cursorless ("full", None) plan on first consult, dedups a fresh follow-up call to None within the recovery TTL, and re-arms once the in-flight marker is backdated past _HISTORY_RECOVERY_TTL on the monotonic clock. <!--#7233658830ba0c2c-->
- `test_machine_change_releases_marker_so_new_machine_can_plan_full` (function) — Verifies that a history append from a different daemon (machine_id change) discards the stale bundle and unanchored delta, releases the in-flight recovery marker held by the superseded machine, and lets the new machine plan a fresh ("full", None) rebuild via plan_recovery_pull. <!--#b8e8677fa5d9d8f7-->
- `_RecordingDaemonWS` (class) — Fake daemon WebSocket that records each MSG_HISTORY_REQUEST recovery frame the server sends so tests can assert how many self-heal pulls fired. <!--#70ace732c5c37d47-->
  - `_RecordingDaemonWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake daemon socket with an empty list to accumulate captured request payloads. <!--#b21109e749814b4e-->
  - `_RecordingDaemonWS.send_text` (method) — Decodes an outgoing frame and records its payload only when it is a MSG_HISTORY_REQUEST. <!--#8ad3458d71f88f9a-->
- `test_first_sighting_append_dispatches_one_recovery_pull_then_heals` (function) — End-to-end test that a first-sighting append dispatches exactly one recovery pull, dedupes a second, and after the daemon's full reply heals the bundle so a later append applies and broadcasts to the live view without a re-enter. <!--#b789423bae269be1-->
- `test_recovery_pull_skipped_when_no_daemon_connection` (function) — Ensures that without a connection manager the handler degrades gracefully—flagging the flow requires_full without crashing or consuming the marker, so a later manager-backed retry can still heal it. <!--#934c08df37a56d57-->
- `_drive_server_restart_midflow` (function) — Helper that drives the real DaemonHistoryReader through a server-restart-mid-flow scenario (server-down phase advancing the cursor, then a restart with empty cache), answering each self-heal pull with the authoritative full snapshot, and returns the collected UI frames, snapshot, and recovery-pull count. <!--#9f4cf64dbd162caa-->
- `test_restart_at_discovery_analyze_boundary_self_heals_no_reenter` (function) — Integration test that a server restart across the discovery→analyze boundary self-heals with exactly one recovery pull, the full frame reaching the live view and subsequent appends converging on the authoritative snapshot with no loss, dup, or re-enter. <!--#17ded3a06a8ec941-->
- `test_healthy_boundary_never_triggers_recovery_pull` (function) — Regression test that a healthy boundary with no restart establishes the bundle from a full frame first, dispatches zero recovery pulls, and streams appends that equal the authoritative snapshot. <!--#8366b69d2df4bfa5-->

### `tests/test_server_interjection.py` (python) — Test module covering the FastAPI mid-flow interjection/respond endpoints (dispatch, 404 unknown flow, 422 empty text, 503 offline machine, resolving non-call pending calls) and `luo run`'s TTY-vs-non-TTY failure handler that externalises retry_decision call files. <!--#5595b8a5744b9ff8|92f4585162ccb414-->
- `client_and_app` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding a logged-in FastAPI TestClient and its app for the interjection/respond endpoint tests. <!--#5647f483dd970838-->
- `_snapshot` (function) — Helper building a machine status-update snapshot dict with the given machine id and flow list. <!--#bb6cf1d39dab98d7-->
- `_register` (function) — Test helper that registers a daemon over a WebSocket by sending an authed HELLO plus STATUS_UPDATE snapshot, then polls the flows API until the given flows are visible on the server. <!--#1ac0efeca7017cbb-->
- `test_interject_endpoint_dispatches` (function) — Verifies that POSTing to /api/flows/{id}/interject returns a 'dispatched' response and pushes an INTERJECT_FLOW frame carrying the text to the connected daemon. <!--#050504ddaa8a3370-->
- `test_interject_unknown_flow_returns_404` (function) — Asserts interjecting into an unknown flow id yields HTTP 404. <!--#58386143eda4a8f4-->
- `test_interject_empty_text_returns_422` (function) — Asserts interjecting with blank/whitespace text yields HTTP 422. <!--#54a6d740fb965b9a-->
- `test_interject_offline_machine_returns_503` (function) — Asserts that interjecting into a still-visible flow whose machine has disconnected yields HTTP 503. <!--#f055d27f301656b4-->
- `test_respond_locates_non_call_kind_pending_call` (function) — Verifies that /api/flows/{id}/respond with no call_id defaults to the first pending call of any kind (e.g. a retry_decision) and dispatches a matching RESPOND_CALL frame to the daemon. <!--#169700bd29d9f46a-->
- `_stub_failed_step` (function) — Helper producing a SimpleNamespace stub of a failed step with id, type, and retry count. <!--#89f62f82c7da6bb8-->
- `test_failure_with_tty_races_and_writes_retry_decision_call` (function) — Asserts that on an interactive TTY, run._resolve_step_failure_action returns a "race" action yet still writes a retry_decision call file so a webui bystander sees the failure as a Retry/Skip/Abort chip. <!--#ee86f81f1d1d2151-->
- `test_failure_without_tty_writes_retry_decision_call` (function) — Asserts that with no terminal and no prior response, the failure handler returns "pause" and externalises the decision as a deterministically-named retry_decision call file carrying the flow context and error message. <!--#854b85c818a28893-->
- `test_failure_without_tty_applies_existing_response` (function) — Asserts that a non-interactive failure first pauses and writes a call file, then on a second pass reads an out-of-band "skip" response from that same file and resolves to a "decision" action. <!--#7148cfb887ef9870-->
- `test_stdin_is_interactive_reflects_isatty` (function) — Asserts that run._stdin_is_interactive mirrors sys.stdin.isatty() (True/False) and returns False when stdin is None, using a fake StringIO stdin via monkeypatch. <!--#30ffbbc60ff91016-->

### `tests/test_server_persistence.py` (python) — Test suite for the server's sqlite-backed Store and IdentityService, covering owner CRUD with last-admin guards (including break-glass exclusion and concurrent-delete races), provider-decoupled identity bindings, hashed password/daemon-key/break-glass token storage and revocation, machine binding, and DB durability properties (WAL mode, path creation, concurrent writes). <!--#ad665037f6cdb569|d503c35b24245d9d-->
- `store` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding a fresh Store backed by a temp-path sqlite file. <!--#aecd8298b6711b7d-->
- `test_owner_id_is_stable_internal_key` (function) — Verifies create_owner returns a stable internal owner_id string that round-trips through get_owner with its display_name and admin flag. <!--#dd8394298a98ab2b-->
- `test_get_unknown_owner_returns_none` (function) — Asserts get_owner returns None for an unknown owner_id. <!--#a6ea7144dbc09ba5-->
- `test_set_admin_flip_roundtrip` (function) — Checks set_admin toggles an owner's is_admin flag both directions and persists each change. <!--#f2ad3e65c09792bf-->
- `test_set_admin_unknown_owner_returns_false` (function) — Asserts set_admin on an unknown owner returns False and creates no spurious row. <!--#cde36a3b5b1062c6-->
- `test_delete_owner_guarded_unknown_returns_not_found` (function) — Asserts delete_owner_guarded returns 'not_found' for a nonexistent owner. <!--#6399eb3b8328843b-->
- `test_delete_owner_guarded_last_admin_refused` (function) — Verifies the guard refuses deleting the sole admin, returning 'last_admin' and leaving the owner intact. <!--#892f8314ac665780-->
- `test_delete_owner_guarded_non_admin_always_allowed` (function) — Verifies deleting a non-admin owner is always permitted regardless of admin count. <!--#e7e3120358b4d88b-->
- `test_delete_owner_guarded_second_admin_allowed` (function) — Confirms deleting one of two admins succeeds but deleting the remaining last admin is then refused. <!--#55e7134c79b6047c-->
- `test_delete_owner_guarded_breakglass_not_counted_as_headroom` (function) — Verifies a break-glass admin is excluded from the admin count so the sole real admin is still protected from deletion. <!--#77137f18680db18c-->
- `test_set_admin_guarded_unknown_returns_not_found` (function) — Asserts set_admin_guarded returns 'not_found' for an unknown owner. <!--#17d949acc87beb3c-->
- `test_set_admin_guarded_promote_is_unguarded` (function) — Verifies promoting a non-admin to admin via set_admin_guarded is unguarded and returns 'updated'. <!--#c3955e1bd3a7e88b-->
- `test_set_admin_guarded_demote_last_admin_refused` (function) — Verifies demoting the sole admin is refused with 'last_admin' and the flag stays True. <!--#ff9c45d7f82861b2-->
- `test_set_admin_guarded_demote_second_admin_allowed` (function) — Confirms demoting one of two admins succeeds but demoting the remaining last admin is then refused. <!--#f1fb5939ab2cba5c-->
- `test_set_admin_guarded_breakglass_not_counted_as_headroom` (function) — Verifies a break-glass admin is excluded from the count so the sole real admin cannot be demoted. <!--#41b69d2081d8c872-->
- `test_guarded_delete_concurrent_keeps_one_real_admin` (function) — Concurrency test that two threaded deletions of two distinct admins yield exactly one 'deleted' and one 'last_admin', proving the atomic guard prevents a last-admin race. <!--#00d96b0b487da663-->
- `test_owner_decoupled_from_provider_identity_with_many_bindings` (function) — Verifies one owner can hold multiple (provider, external_id) identity bindings that all resolve back to the same owner_id. <!--#e7225b747598713d-->
- `test_create_local_user_atomic_owner_binding_password` (function) — Verifies create_local_user atomically creates the owner, identity binding, and password hash in one transaction. <!--#1e8dbfd2e7fdd9eb-->
- `test_create_local_user_duplicate_raises_and_leaves_no_orphan` (function) — Verifies a duplicate create_local_user raises IdentityAlreadyBound and rolls back, leaving no orphan owner row. <!--#0713ca3c3b10bdfe-->
- `test_resolve_unknown_identity_returns_none` (function) — Asserts resolve_owner_by_identity returns None for an unknown provider/external_id. <!--#78477c357392e475-->
- `test_link_identity_idempotent_same_owner` (function) — Verifies re-linking the same identity to the same owner is idempotent with no duplicate or error. <!--#7982f70e4151137d-->
- `test_link_identity_conflict_different_owner_raises` (function) — Verifies linking an already-bound identity to a different owner raises IdentityAlreadyBound and keeps the original binding. <!--#73c66b49081a8230-->
- `test_password_hash_roundtrip_and_upsert` (function) — Verifies set_password/get_password_hash round-trip and that a second set_password upserts/replaces the stored hash. <!--#69eeae67d92ca564-->
- `test_password_stored_is_hash_not_plaintext` (function) — Asserts stored passwords are hashes (no plaintext) that still verify via crypto.verify_password. <!--#af0ddc464adee2c9-->
- `test_issue_and_resolve_daemon_key_hash_only` (function) — Verifies daemon keys are stored hash-only and resolve back to their owner by key hash. <!--#0d069f0452aaff5f-->
- `test_revoke_daemon_key_then_resolve_fails` (function) — Verifies a revoked daemon key no longer resolves and is listed only when including revoked keys. <!--#21416019f31dd685-->
- `test_revoke_unknown_daemon_key_returns_false` (function) — Asserts revoking an unknown daemon key returns False. <!--#d14cb25b4520bf7a-->
- `test_revoke_is_idempotent` (function) — Verifies revoking an already-revoked daemon key still returns True as a no-op. <!--#d157b9170d877191-->
- `test_breakglass_one_time_consume` (function) — Verifies a break-glass token can be consumed once, with the second consume returning False. <!--#9aa8926803fc9633-->
- `test_breakglass_unknown_token_fails` (function) — Asserts consuming an unknown break-glass token hash returns False. <!--#16c808ea73b94c95-->
- `test_breakglass_expiry` (function) — Verifies break-glass consumption respects expires_at, refusing expired tokens and accepting unexpired ones. <!--#7dfdf1b223dcd990-->
- `test_breakglass_reissue_after_purge` (function) — Verifies purge_breakglass invalidates the old token and a freshly issued token consumes successfully. <!--#6e28adf5b0068756-->
- `test_breakglass_only_hash_stored` (function) — Asserts break-glass tokens are stored hash-only, matchable only by recomputed hash of the presented plaintext. <!--#d932a5c1d2c6d62e-->
- `test_db_path_from_config_and_persists_across_instances` (function) — Verifies the Store auto-creates parent dirs as a single DB file and that a fresh Store on the same path sees durably persisted data. <!--#52082cda4d2d03f4-->
- `test_wal_mode_enabled` (function) — Asserts the sqlite connection uses WAL journal mode. <!--#a02147b3dbc1f846-->
- `test_concurrent_writes_are_safe` (function) — Concurrency test that four threads each creating 20 owners complete without errors and produce all 80 rows. <!--#7ad32fdf606d6931-->
- `test_identity_resolve_owner_for_key_delegates_to_store` (function) — Verifies IdentityService.resolve_owner_for_key resolves a plaintext daemon key to its owner and returns None for empty/None/unknown keys. <!--#db37f759fcc4ea77-->
- `test_identity_revoked_key_no_longer_resolves` (function) — Verifies IdentityService stops resolving a daemon key once it is revoked in the store. <!--#6e52ba3be7f3f1ca-->
- `test_identity_machine_binding` (function) — Verifies IdentityService machine binding: bind/unbind machines to owners and query owner_of_machine and machines_for_owner. <!--#597bf72068d796c0-->
- `test_identity_link_seam_refuses_unverified_blind_merge` (function) — Verifies link_identity_to_owner refuses an unverified cross-provider link (raising UntrustedIdentityLink) but allows it with admin_override or a verified_claim. <!--#91df7eb9865a1458-->
- `test_identity_link_idempotent_and_conflict` (function) — Verifies link_identity_to_owner is idempotent for re-links to the same owner (bypassing the gate) and raises IdentityAlreadyBound when linking to a different owner. <!--#f6055ee11634fc28-->
- `test_in_memory_store_survives_concurrent_reads` (function) — Regression test asserting that a shared in-memory `Store` serializes reads (`get_owner`, `resolve_owner_by_identity`, `list_owners`) under 8 concurrent threads without raising `sqlite3.InterfaceError`, guarding against the reentrancy bug that caused 500s and permanent 401s. <!--#8d7fca4bb0f0f0f9-->

### `tests/test_server_users.py` (python) — End-to-end FastAPI TestClient tests for the admin user-management REST surface (the four `/api/users` list/delete/password-reset/admin-toggle routes), asserting every security boundary: non-admin 403 / unauthenticated 401 rejection, list-view field whitelisting and break-glass filtering, and the self / last-real-admin / break-glass / local-only guards, plus a password-reset login round-trip. <!--#074c6fd8ede6e9a0|d7e1feb697fcbe2e-->
- `client_and_app` (function) — Pytest fixture that builds an authenticated app and yields a `(TestClient, app)` pair for tests. <!--#7c0dc10f1bb22800-->
- `_seed_local` (function) — Test helper that seeds a local user in the server store by creating an owner, linking a (local, username) identity, and storing a password hash, returning the owner id. <!--#2dcd06a0aa5235a4-->
- `_seed_oidc` (function) — Helper that seeds a non-local OIDC owner with an `oidc` identity binding and no local credential, returning its owner id. <!--#7e4d5b1aff828151-->
- `_seed_breakglass` (function) — Helper that directly creates the reserved break-glass admin owner in the store, returning its owner id. <!--#0e39491a0ebfc96d-->
- `_login_breakglass` (function) — Test helper that mints and consumes a break-glass token so the test client holds a break-glass admin session, used to act on another owner as a non-real admin and exercise the last-real-admin guards. <!--#62d9ab62077fbf2d-->
- `test_user_routes_reject_non_admin_403` (function) — Asserts all four user routes return 403 for an authenticated non-admin, with the admin check preceding existence so no owner-id information leaks. <!--#a08a3a0b305732fe-->
- `test_user_routes_require_authentication_401` (function) — Asserts all four user routes return 401 when called by an unauthenticated client. <!--#75e992687ad509bf-->
- `test_list_users_whitelists_fields_and_filters_breakglass` (function) — Verifies GET `/api/users` filters out the break-glass owner, returns exactly the whitelisted fields, reflects provider/can_reset_password flags, and leaks no password hashes. <!--#dc39f88cea97eb56-->
- `test_delete_self_is_forbidden_403` (function) — Asserts an admin cannot delete their own account (403) and that the account survives. <!--#3d30012f94892fe3-->
- `test_delete_unknown_owner_is_404` (function) — Asserts deleting a nonexistent owner returns 404. <!--#654e48ca58b31d98-->
- `test_delete_breakglass_owner_is_404` (function) — Asserts deleting the reserved break-glass owner returns 404 and leaves it intact. <!--#f7814d2d4938178d-->
- `test_delete_last_real_admin_is_409` (function) — Acting as break-glass, asserts deleting the only real admin is blocked with 409 by the last-real-admin guard. <!--#f2cbcedbc16667f9-->
- `test_delete_user_succeeds_and_drops_from_list` (function) — Happy-path delete: a created user is removed (200), cascades to its binding, and disappears from the list. <!--#cf6a03afc9f4362a-->
- `test_reset_password_non_local_owner_is_409` (function) — Asserts resetting the password of a non-local (OIDC) owner returns 409. <!--#d49b596c8ddf9579-->
- `test_reset_password_unknown_or_breakglass_owner_is_404` (function) — Asserts password reset returns 404 for both an unknown owner and the break-glass owner. <!--#8a78af99dca70682-->
- `test_reset_password_empty_is_422` (function) — Asserts an empty password in a reset request is rejected with 422 validation error. <!--#f9f0d3e63222eb16-->
- `test_reset_password_lets_user_login_with_new_password` (function) — End-to-end check that after a reset the user can log in with the new password and the old one is rejected (401). <!--#04efca73d7e0ac77-->
- `test_reset_password_plaintext_not_logged` (function) — Asserts the plaintext password is never emitted to logs during a reset, even at DEBUG level. <!--#96431bc5939f5c6d-->
- `test_demote_self_is_forbidden_403` (function) — Asserts an admin cannot demote themselves (403) and remains admin. <!--#6dbf96791eb80ef5-->
- `test_demote_last_real_admin_is_409` (function) — Acting as break-glass, asserts demoting the only real admin is blocked with 409. <!--#017004218db04221-->
- `test_toggle_admin_on_breakglass_owner_is_404` (function) — Asserts toggling the admin flag on the break-glass owner returns 404. <!--#6713d5708e9318d5-->
- `test_toggle_admin_unknown_owner_is_404` (function) — Asserts toggling the admin flag on an unknown owner returns 404. <!--#ec23ef0d948ee170-->
- `test_promote_then_demote_reflected_in_list` (function) — Verifies promoting then demoting a user succeeds, is reflected in GET results and the store, with demotion allowed once a second real admin exists. <!--#fb4e6944d94653ad-->

### `tests/test_spawn_failed.py` (python) — Tests for the SPAWN_FAILED daemon-to-server feedback channel (G3), covering the protocol message constructor/registration, the daemon client's three failure paths (spawn, ensure-init, and resume) that must report SPAWN_FAILED instead of failing silently, and the server routing an inbound SPAWN_FAILED only to the reporting owner's UI clients. <!--#08019991dbf386e3|2472fefe739cbb08-->
- `test_make_spawn_failed_payload_and_registration` (function) — Asserts make_spawn_failed builds the correct payload, registers the type as daemon-to-server and known, and round-trips through encode/decode. <!--#83a62a34132b5e25-->
- `test_make_spawn_failed_omits_empty_optionals` (function) — Asserts make_spawn_failed omits unset optional fields (task_description, from_issue_id, resume_flow_id) from the payload. <!--#6d23a9165f4ecc10-->
- `_FakeWS` (class) — Minimal async WebSocket stand-in that decodes and records frames the daemon client sends. <!--#4bcd88a41b8c0413-->
  - `_FakeWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake WebSocket's empty `sent` capture list. <!--#b8b92aad379d234c-->
  - `_FakeWS.send` (method) — Async send that decodes the wire data and appends the resulting message to `sent`. <!--#7d44362527b3e749-->
- `_make_client` (function) — Helper that constructs a DaemonClient with default identity/snapshot args plus per-test handler overrides. <!--#2166366244481ca6-->
- `_spawn_failed_frames` (function) — Helper that filters a fake WS's captured frames down to SPAWN_FAILED messages. <!--#d01cff50f6f9f0cc-->
- `test_fresh_spawn_failure_reports_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies a raising spawn_handler causes one SPAWN_FAILED frame carrying the project root, error text, and task description. <!--#b72184d0d1a3df3d-->
- `test_ensure_error_reports_spawn_failed_and_skips_spawn` (function) — Verifies an ensure_handler returning an error reports SPAWN_FAILED and never invokes the spawn handler. <!--#ce8addba54557ff6-->
- `test_ensure_exception_reports_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies an ensure_handler raising an exception is caught and reported as a SPAWN_FAILED frame. <!--#2c4853ad6b426f7d-->
- `test_resume_failure_reports_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies a raising resume_handler reports SPAWN_FAILED preserving the resume_flow_id and error text. <!--#167f684e5afa5862-->
- `test_successful_spawn_emits_no_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies a successful spawn emits no SPAWN_FAILED frame. <!--#7c4e8621afe61635-->
- `test_empty_task_does_not_report_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies that dropping an empty/whitespace task at input validation emits no SPAWN_FAILED frame since nothing was launched. <!--#33d2c675d30ffaa4-->
- `test_handle_message_routes_spawn_failed_to_owner_ui` (function) — Tests that server.ws._handle_message routes an inbound MSG_SPAWN_FAILED only to the UI WebSocket clients owned by the reporting machine's owner (owner-A) and never to a different owner (owner-B), asserting the delivered spawn_failed event carries the correct machine_id, project_root, error, and task_description. <!--#21db6147712df697-->

### `tests/test_spec_write_protection_retired.py` (python) — Regression suite asserting the retired spec-write-protection feature is fully gone — no guard section in any writable or read-only LLM prompt, no `spec_write_hook` module or `--plugin-dir`/`--settings` runner argv, no `_spec_diff_guard_enabled` snapshot/restore logic in `StateMachine`, and no `SpecWriteProtectionConfig` loader — while a legacy `spec_write_protection:` block in `tianluo.yaml` still loads harmlessly. <!--#1dcf1ed0d093d06a|dba12db296cbf941-->
- `TestNoSpecWriteProtectionInPrompt` (class) — Asserts that no step's final LLM prompt (writable or read-only) still carries the retired spec-write-protection section, and that `context_builder`/`LLMCaller` no longer expose any of its symbols. <!--#e026eee3a7c4a35c-->
  - `TestNoSpecWriteProtectionInPrompt._final_prompt` (method) — Helper that builds an `LLMCaller` for a given step type, calls it with `_call_with_retry` patched, and returns the prompt that would have been sent. <!--#60efe72609e5a217-->
  - `TestNoSpecWriteProtectionInPrompt.test_writable_llm_step_prompt_has_no_spec_write_protection` (method) — Parametrized over writable step types (implement/commit/confirm/charter_freshness/update_spec), asserts the prompt contains neither `SPEC FILE WRITE PROTECTION` nor `tianluo/specs`. <!--#d9998f4fb40cbfac-->
  - `TestNoSpecWriteProtectionInPrompt.test_read_only_step_prompt_has_no_spec_write_protection` (method) — Checks the `analyze` prompt dropped the spec-write-protection section while still keeping the untouched `READ-ONLY STEP CONSTRAINT` layer. <!--#6f829ef1826f3fad-->
  - `TestNoSpecWriteProtectionInPrompt.test_context_builder_exposes_no_spec_write_symbols` (method) — Asserts `tianluo.engine.context_builder` no longer defines the spec-write-protection injection function, step predicate, or step-set constants. <!--#e2b03636d5811f2b-->
  - `TestNoSpecWriteProtectionInPrompt.test_llm_caller_exposes_no_guard_resolver` (method) — Asserts `LLMCaller` no longer has the `_resolve_spec_guard_settings` method. <!--#94d4fc0ad66f57ec-->
- `TestNoGuardPlugin` (class) — Verifies no code path installs the spec-guard plugin any more — the hook module is gone, runner argv carries no `--plugin-dir`/`--settings`, all runners share one `build_call_args` signature, and `LLMCaller` passes no guard keyword. <!--#72a50a87fef2e2d9-->
  - `TestNoGuardPlugin.test_spec_write_hook_module_is_gone` (method) — Asserts importing `tianluo.engine.spec_write_hook` now raises `ImportError`. <!--#0cc84eb886b84ae7-->
  - `TestNoGuardPlugin.test_claude_runner_args_have_no_plugin_dir` (method) — Builds `ClaudeCodeRunner` call args in both read-only and writable modes and asserts no `--plugin-dir`/`--settings` while the `-p` prompt and context file remain intact. <!--#4797f4c0199b06e5-->
  - `TestNoGuardPlugin.test_runner_build_call_args_signatures_match` (method) — Interface-parity check that `AgentRunner`, `ClaudeCodeRunner`, `CodexRunner`, and `ClaudeInteractiveRunner` all declare the same `build_call_args` parameters. <!--#3f5845fe8a8ea635-->
  - `TestNoGuardPlugin.test_llm_caller_does_not_pass_spec_guard_plugin` (method) — Uses a stub runner to capture the kwargs `LLMCaller.call` hands to `build_call_args` and asserts they exclude `spec_guard_plugin` and stay within prompt/read_only/context_files. <!--#1cb4c7dc4f9c1f64-->
- `TestNoSpecDiffFallback` (class) — Verifies the state machine's spec-diff fallback guard is fully removed, both as an attribute and as any residual snapshot/restore markers in its source. <!--#3861bccdf1b7c16f-->
  - `TestNoSpecDiffFallback.test_state_machine_has_no_spec_diff_guard` (method) — Asserts `StateMachine` no longer exposes `_spec_diff_guard_enabled`. <!--#a66342a705f6ea05-->
  - `TestNoSpecDiffFallback.test_state_machine_source_never_snapshots_specs` (method) — Reads `state_machine.py` source and asserts it mentions none of the spec snapshot/restore markers such as `capture_spec_contents` or `restore_spec_files`. <!--#c88bdd7e21182c30-->
- `TestLegacyConfigBlockIgnored` (class) — Guards backward compatibility: a `tianluo.yaml` still containing a residual `spec_write_protection:` block loads cleanly and is silently ignored, and its config loader class/function are gone. <!--#1f3d8a526412eea4-->
  - `TestLegacyConfigBlockIgnored._write_config` (method) — Helper that writes a `tianluo.yaml` containing a legacy `spec_write_protection:` block alongside a normal `test:` section. <!--#eca06d0e046340ea-->
  - `TestLegacyConfigBlockIgnored.test_project_yaml_loads_with_legacy_block` (method) — Asserts `load_project_yaml` parses the legacy-bearing config and keeps the unknown section in the returned data. <!--#1b85fcbd067d6fc8-->
  - `TestLegacyConfigBlockIgnored.test_config_loaders_ignore_legacy_block` (method) — Runs every named-section config loader against the legacy-bearing config to confirm none raises on the unrecognized block. <!--#c05f4e622c849601-->
  - `TestLegacyConfigBlockIgnored.test_spec_write_protection_loader_is_gone` (method) — Asserts `tianluo.config` no longer defines `SpecWriteProtectionConfig` or `load_spec_write_protection_config`. <!--#5ac7a51c11cb4333-->

### `tests/test_stash_archive.py` (python) — Unit/integration test suite for the safe git-stash-pop recovery helpers (_resolve_stash_ref, archive_stash_payload, pop_stash_by_label, resolve_stashpop_safely, and the LLM-aware conflict resolver), verifying that labeled stashes are resolved and dropped precisely, that both tracked and untracked stashed content is archived verbatim before any drop, and that the helper never refuses valid pops nor drops a stash when recovery cannot be proven. <!--#67597f4a7f4d4f9e|fe1c669acd248278-->
- `_git_nocheck` (function) — Test helper that runs a git subcommand without `check=True`, used to capture the non-zero exit of a deliberately-failing `git stash pop` as the input under test. <!--#aa07c14b65b63815-->
- `_git` (function) — Test helper that runs a git subcommand in a given repo with `check=True`, capturing output and raising on failure. <!--#c5eee978784b0ec4-->
- `_init_repo` (function) — Test fixture that initializes a fresh git repo with a configured user and a committed `README.md` base file. <!--#eee1c54b05431432-->
- `_hash_object` (function) — Test helper that returns git's blob sha for a file via `git hash-object`, used to assert archived content integrity. <!--#6ef861a24e5b4d63-->
- `test_resolve_stash_ref_matches_label_not_position` (function) — Verifies `_resolve_stash_ref` resolves a stash by its message label rather than by the `stash@{0}` position, returning None for unknown labels. <!--#6cb6c917d9f5604f-->
- `test_archive_stash_payload_untracked_and_tracked` (function) — Verifies that archive_stash_payload persists both tracked working-tree changes (case 'a') and untracked concurrent artefacts (case 'b') under tianluo/worktrees/.archive/<ts>_<label>/, preserving original relative paths, verbatim content, and a matching blob sha. <!--#3195cbec3daf9e8c-->
- `test_archive_stash_payload_missing_label_raises` (function) — Verifies `archive_stash_payload` raises RuntimeError when no live stash matches the label, so the caller never drops without recovery proof. <!--#a94aafc4e05162af-->
- `test_archive_stash_payload_untracked_only` (function) — Verifies a stash containing only untracked files archives cleanly without treating the absent tracked diff as an error. <!--#9271e5c7bea64147-->
- `test_archive_stash_payload_skips_stash_deleted_path` (function) — Verifies a path the stash deleted (with no recoverable content) is skipped rather than raising, while still-present content is archived normally. <!--#916da6b8a6a4686a-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_drops_despite_stash_deleted_tracked_file` (function) — Regression test proving resolve_stashpop_safely handles a non-clean pop caused by an uncommitted tracked-file deletion plus an untracked .next_id collision by skipping the deletion, archiving the recoverable rest, and dropping the labeled stash without a false data-loss refusal. <!--#8ce9dc2d13b74d22-->
- `test_archive_stash_payload_same_second_does_not_overwrite` (function) — Verifies two recoveries of the same label within one second go into distinct run directories (a `-2` suffix) so neither clobbers the other's recorded bytes. <!--#46b4c868982a8ec5-->
- `test_pop_stash_by_label_pops_labeled_not_top` (function) — Verifies `pop_stash_by_label` resolves and pops the labeled stash even when an unrelated stash sits on top, leaving the unrelated one untouched. <!--#259455fd18ade4b4-->
- `test_pop_stash_by_label_missing_label_returns_nonzero` (function) — Verifies that an unresolvable label yields a synthetic non-zero result (escalation) rather than a bare pop that would consume an unrelated `stash@{0}`. <!--#aa712b7edd8006e2-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_clean_pop_is_noop` (function) — Verifies `resolve_stashpop_safely` does nothing (archives nothing, drops nothing, creates no archive sink) when given a clean pop result. <!--#b314f071ac0ebd19-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_case_b_untracked_collision` (function) — Checks that on a case-b untracked-file pop collision, resolve_stashpop_safely archives the stashed content, leaves the merged working-tree version untouched (no take-ours), classifies the paths as case_b_files, and drops the stash only after recovery is proven. <!--#605a990d6346cd92-->
- `_setup_case_a` (function) — Test fixture that constructs a real 3-way tracked conflict on `app.py` and returns the failed `git stash pop` result with the stash still live. <!--#a6ebfef5956dd4b0-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_case_a_default_fallback_take_ours` (function) — Verifies that for a case-a conflict with no resolver, the safe fallback keeps the merged (ours) version in the tree while both the stashed and head sides are archived for recovery. <!--#cd81aff799c10148-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_case_a_uses_injected_resolver` (function) — Verifies an injected conflict resolver decides the working-tree result while both original conflict sides remain recoverable from the archive manifest. <!--#75cb4b50484ad915-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_case_a_resolver_keeping_stashed_archives_head` (function) — Regression test that a resolver keeping the stashed side still leaves the discarded merged-HEAD content recoverable from the manifest. <!--#a794e3234b45cc43-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_case_a_unresolved_keeps_stash` (function) — High-severity regression ensuring that when a case-a conflict resolver stages no resolution, resolve_stashpop_safely keeps the live stash, flags archive_failed, surfaces the still-unmerged path in unresolved_files, yet still archives both sides so nothing is lost. <!--#0b86369a4bf2cb57-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_drops_only_labeled_stash` (function) — Critical regression test that when the labeled stash is not at `stash@{0}`, the helper drops exactly the labeled entry and never the unrelated top stash, which stays intact and recoverable. <!--#c3455aefdb12cd20-->
- `test_resolve_stashpop_refuses_drop_when_archive_unconfirmed` (function) — Verifies the helper refuses to drop (keeps the stash and flags failure) when archival cannot be proven because there is no live stash to read. <!--#993052f216e1e5de-->
- `test_llm_resolver_applies_llm_output_and_stages` (function) — Verifies that make_llm_stashpop_resolver feeds the conflict-markered buffer to a (stubbed) LLMCaller, writes back the reconciled output as a staged change with no conflict markers, archives both original sides, and drops the stash. <!--#3690777ba39a4aca-->
- `test_llm_resolver_falls_back_to_take_ours_on_llm_failure` (function) — Verifies that when the LLMCaller raises, make_llm_stashpop_resolver falls back to a deterministic take-ours (merged HEAD) so the tree is never left conflicted, while the discarded stashed side remains recoverable from the archive and the stash is dropped. <!--#3a5d601c77b0e391-->

### `tests/test_step_renderers.py` (python) — Unit test suite for the engine's per-step Rich renderers (`_render_analyze`, `_render_verify_spec`, `_render_update_spec`, `_render_commit`, `_render_self_check`, `_render_spec_gate`, ...), building synthetic `Step` objects via a `_make_step` helper and asserting each renderer's status text, field defaults, key aliases, section omission, and regression guards for markup and error-message display. <!--#95db946994a886f2|61402c970735d895-->
- `_make_step` (function) — Test helper that builds a Step of a given type with supplied outputs, error message, and status. <!--#90e3565a0a67def9-->
- `TestRenderAnalyze` (class) — Test class verifying the ANALYZE step renderer (_render_analyze) formats the status bar (task_type/complexity/scope), reasoning, and 'Relevant Spec Items' as spec:requirement_name while hiding internal payload fields. <!--#e5e86deca10c7e22-->
  - `TestRenderAnalyze.test_normal_output` (method) — Asserts a fully-populated ANALYZE step renders task_type/complexity/scope, reasoning, and spec:requirement_name items, but not internal spec_content/project_summary payloads. <!--#b4f0266c4e7309b8-->

  - `TestRenderAnalyze.test_selected_items_rendering` (method) — Verifies selected_items are rendered under a 'Relevant Spec Items' section as spec:requirement_name pairs. <!--#77ebe48a68345657-->
  - `TestRenderAnalyze.test_analyze_renderer_shows_spec_items` (method) — G4 regression guard ensuring the renderer shows 'Relevant Spec Items' as spec:requirement_name and never reverts to bare spec names. <!--#949d99aaab82fe90-->
  - `TestRenderAnalyze.test_no_selected_items_no_section` (method) — Confirms the 'Relevant Spec Items' section is omitted entirely when selected_items is empty. <!--#7e22d0aa9527bb02-->
- `TestRenderVerifySpec` (class) — Test class for the VERIFY_SPEC renderer (_render_verify_spec) covering PASSED/FAILED status, issue rendering, recommendations, nested verification_result fallbacks, and correct Rich close-tag formatting. <!--#eb1c9c02c6f9c9f4-->
  - `TestRenderVerifySpec.test_passed` (method) — Asserts a verified step shows 'PASSED' and its summary while hiding internal fields like fix_context/fix_iteration/verification_result. <!--#0b73b9da60aec884-->
  - `TestRenderVerifySpec.test_failed_with_issues` (method) — Asserts an unverified step shows 'FAILED' and renders each issue's message and suggestion across priorities/scopes. <!--#ab9267dbe9ef9dcc-->
  - `TestRenderVerifySpec.test_no_issues` (method) — Checks a verified step with no issues shows 'PASSED' and omits scope/priority group headers like 'In-scope'. <!--#252ab469f28848b1-->
  - `TestRenderVerifySpec.test_with_recommendations` (method) — Verifies top-level recommendations are rendered into the output. <!--#d8ad4a9f2939aff8-->

  - `TestRenderVerifySpec.test_summary_from_verification_result` (method) — Checks the summary falls back to the nested verification_result dict when no top-level summary exists. <!--#4e6f7b55a9f50029-->
  - `TestRenderVerifySpec.test_recommendations_from_verification_result` (method) — Checks recommendations fall back to the nested verification_result dict. <!--#f6748c2e81a49236-->
  - `TestRenderVerifySpec.test_toplevel_summary_takes_precedence` (method) — Confirms a top-level summary is preferred over the nested verification_result summary. <!--#6addc7dd1e3b522b-->
  - `TestRenderVerifySpec.test_rich_close_tag_no_extra_bracket` (method) — Regression guard that issue-priority color close tags ([/red]/[/yellow]/[/dim]) render without a malformed extra ']' bracket. <!--#a808f098a092eef0-->
- `TestRenderUpdateSpec` (class) — Test class for the UPDATE_SPEC renderer (_render_update_spec) covering updated specs (dict and string forms), the 'no updates' message, the specs_updated key alias, and new_capabilities. <!--#b6dba809acfd5c06-->

- `TestRenderCommit` (class) — Test class for the COMMIT renderer (_render_commit) covering no-op vs committed states, commit hash/message, version bump display, missing-hash 'N/A', and error-message surfacing. <!--#b6cd386e03034ea8-->
