  - `TestRenderCommit.test_committed_true_no_version` (method) — Asserts a committed step renders the abbreviated commit hash and commit message without version info. <!--#cbf8acd01a2113f0-->
  - `TestRenderCommit.test_committed_true_with_version` (method) — Asserts a version-bumped commit renders the hash and the 'v1.3.0' version tag. <!--#cdf2bf28ab6444e0-->
  - `TestRenderCommit.test_missing_commit_hash` (method) — Checks a committed step lacking a commit_hash renders 'N/A'. <!--#0adf19f5da2053c7-->
  - `TestRenderCommit.test_empty_outputs_defaults_to_no_commit` (method) — Checks empty COMMIT outputs default to the 'No changes to commit' message. <!--#0973b996fb461eb9-->
  - `TestRenderCommit.test_error_message_is_never_hidden_by_the_no_op_shortcut` (method) — Regression guard that a failed commit's error_message (version tag failure) is shown instead of the 'No changes to commit' no-op shortcut. <!--#4c9f4f2442de40c8-->
- `TestRenderSelfCheck` (class) — Test class for the SELF_CHECK renderer (_render_self_check) verifying PASSED/FAILED is driven by step status (not just actionable_count) across failed and completed states. <!--#dad7fd6caaebf484-->
  - `TestRenderSelfCheck.test_failed_status_with_zero_actionable_shows_failed` (method) — Asserts a FAILED-status step with actionable_count=0 shows FAILED, not PASSED. <!--#b3895155b72f3fe4-->
  - `TestRenderSelfCheck.test_completed_status_with_zero_actionable_shows_passed` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED-status step with no issues shows PASSED. <!--#376eceeda12f6ed8-->
  - `TestRenderSelfCheck.test_failed_status_with_actionable_issues_shows_failed` (method) — Asserts a FAILED-status step with actionable issues shows FAILED. <!--#5d223f0a1d3810a1-->
  - `TestRenderSelfCheck.test_failed_status_no_outputs_shows_failed` (method) — Asserts a FAILED-status step with empty pre-failure outputs still shows FAILED. <!--#2eef8c4ecfc83e23-->
- `TestRenderSpecGate` (class) — Test class for the SPEC_GATE renderer (_render_spec_gate) covering registry registration, passed/skipped/failed states, gate routes, phase-summary rendering, and suppression of raw test output. <!--#d52c5b32f1901564-->
  - `TestRenderSpecGate.test_registered_in_registry` (method) — Asserts SPEC_GATE is present in both STEP_RENDERERS and STEP_TITLE_KEYS so it isn't default-rendered. <!--#0b3d26fffbd507c8-->
  - `TestRenderSpecGate.test_gate_passed_clean` (method) — Checks a passing gate shows PASSED with a test-command summary but never leaks the raw test output. <!--#646162746f5905d4-->
  - `TestRenderSpecGate.test_gate_skipped_noop` (method) — Checks a skipped gate shows PASSED and indicates 'skipped'/'no-op'. <!--#df8d1682fa591710-->
  - `TestRenderSpecGate.test_route_update_spec` (method) — Checks a failing gate routed to update_spec shows FAILED, the route, and fix_instructions, with no test output. <!--#5658c974d40822cb-->
  - `TestRenderSpecGate.test_route_implement_with_test_results` (method) — Checks a failing gate routed to implement renders FAILED, the route, a phase summary ('1 passed, 1 failed', pytest command), while suppressing raw stdout/stderr/traceback. <!--#6685399def9f0002-->
  - `TestRenderSpecGate.test_no_test_results_renders_conclusion_only` (method) — Checks a passing gate with no test_results renders only the PASSED conclusion. <!--#ad1110f5d3b4d9bb-->
- `TestStepUsageBlock` (class) — Test class verifying that `render_step_output`/`render_step_usage` in `tianluo.engine.step_renderers` emit a token-usage block exactly when `outputs.token_usage` is present and non-empty (including for default-rendered and non-terminal REVISION_NEEDED steps), prefer `usage_summary` over the legacy projection, and never read the engine-internal `carried_token_usage`. <!--#f644909d3cf76faa-->
  - `TestStepUsageBlock.test_usage_block_rendered_when_present` (method) — Asserts render_usage_block is called once with the outputs.token_usage payload when it is present. <!--#fe078dba81001c8d-->
  - `TestStepUsageBlock.test_no_usage_block_when_absent` (method) — Asserts no usage block is rendered when token_usage is absent from outputs. <!--#05933af80e51b558-->
  - `TestStepUsageBlock.test_no_usage_block_when_empty` (method) — Asserts no usage block is rendered when token_usage is an empty dict. <!--#509f25bc0325dd0b-->
  - `TestStepUsageBlock.test_usage_block_for_default_rendered_step` (method) — Checks a step type with no custom renderer (PROJECT_SUMMARY) still emits its usage block. <!--#0dc96b49e663c5e2-->
  - `TestStepUsageBlock.test_usage_block_rendered_for_non_terminal_step` (method) — Checks a REVISION_NEEDED self-check step with token_usage in outputs still renders the usage block. <!--#d6911057ef9524f1-->
  - `TestStepUsageBlock.test_usage_summary_wins_over_the_legacy_projection` (method) — Asserts that when a step carries both `usage_summary` and legacy `token_usage`, `render_step_usage` calls `render_usage_summary_block` with the summary and skips `render_usage_block`, so a missing provider cost is not displayed as a fabricated $0. <!--#1410b25f95807e84-->
  - `TestStepUsageBlock.test_usage_block_not_read_from_carried_token_usage` (method) — Asserts render_step_usage reads only outputs.token_usage and never the engine-internal carried_token_usage. <!--#f43618178701d58b-->
- `TestRenderImplement` (class) — Regression suite for the IMPLEMENT report card renderer, asserting via `_render_implement`/`render_step_output` that the summary, files/tests sections, per-group labelling and the trailing token-usage block all render without the translator-shadowing or positional-numbering bugs. <!--#4f38a909e6003dcc-->
  - `TestRenderImplement.test_renders_full_report_card` (method) — Asserts the IMPLEMENT renderer shows summary, files_changed, and tests_added entries with no unresolved raw i18n keys leaking. <!--#cbe50c3370936724-->
  - `TestRenderImplement.test_tests_added_loop_does_not_shadow_translator` (method) — Pins the exact shadowing-bug site: a non-empty tests_added list must not break later t() calls, so post-loop sections (incomplete_tasks) still render. <!--#1da2265250e9670f-->
  - `TestRenderImplement.test_usage_block_follows_report` (method) — Asserts render_step_output reaches the token-usage block after the IMPLEMENT report, which a raising renderer would have dropped. <!--#04f8182435a1e3a7-->
  - `TestRenderImplement.test_group_summaries_are_labelled_by_real_group_id` (method) — Asserts each entry of `group_summaries` is labelled with its own `group_id` (e.g. G2, G5) rather than numbered by position from splitting the aggregate `summary` on ";". <!--#61087f512871c5fd-->
  - `TestRenderImplement.test_single_group_summary_renders_unlabelled` (method) — Checks that a lone group summary is rendered as plain text with no `[dim]G1.[/dim]` label prefix. <!--#61d09ce28c305bd5-->
  - `TestRenderImplement.test_legacy_summary_only_flow_renders_whole_string` (method) — Checks that legacy flows lacking `group_summaries` render the aggregate `summary` string intact, with no splitting or group/positional numbering. <!--#e8c87f6f70f85558-->
- `TestRenderImplementLeftoverNotes` (class) — Test class asserting that `_render_implement` downgrades leftover `incomplete_tasks` to a neutral, localised "Notes / Unverified Items" block when `completion_status` is `complete`, while keeping the red "Incomplete Tasks" block for every other status. <!--#cf4214c098f7a92c-->
  - `TestRenderImplementLeftoverNotes._content` (method) — Static helper that pulls the rendered content string out of the patched `render_full` mock's first call argument. <!--#ef9349c9b69f60e7-->
  - `TestRenderImplementLeftoverNotes.test_complete_renders_neutral_notes` (method) — Verifies a `complete` step with string `incomplete_tasks` renders the neutral notes heading with dim bullets, no red ✗ markers, and no unresolved `cli.steprender.` i18n keys. <!--#429bd290fe4c0ee2-->
  - `TestRenderImplementLeftoverNotes.test_complete_neutral_branch_expands_dict_entries` (method) — Checks the neutral branch formats dict-shaped entries by `task_id`/`id` plus `reason`/`error`, tolerating entries with no detail and still emitting no red markers. <!--#a9ccdf0a9d8f49cf-->
  - `TestRenderImplementLeftoverNotes.test_non_complete_keeps_red_incomplete_block` (method) — Parametrised over `partial`/`failed`/`unknown`/missing status to confirm non-complete steps keep the red "Incomplete Tasks" block for both dict and plain-string entries. <!--#dfca9b8a4abd0254-->
  - `TestRenderImplementLeftoverNotes.test_complete_neutral_title_localises_to_zh_cn` (method) — Sets `SE3_LANG=zh-CN` (resetting i18n state before and after) to assert the neutral title renders as 备注 / 未验证项 rather than falling back to the en-US string. <!--#ee35bc4d87fd6772-->
  - `TestRenderImplementLeftoverNotes.test_neutral_key_present_in_both_locales` (method) — Reads the `en-US.json` and `zh-CN.json` locale files directly to assert `cli.steprender.implement.notes` exists in both and carries a `{count}` placeholder. <!--#55f8a1a1cadc881a-->
- `TestUsageMetadataExcludedFromGenericDump` (class) — Test class asserting that the three usage-accounting output keys (`token_usage`, `usage_records`, `usage_summary`) are excluded from the generic CLI step dumps (`_default_render` / `_render_remaining`), which render nothing at all when only those keys remain. <!--#d92f6f0a3af2a0e3-->
  - `TestUsageMetadataExcludedFromGenericDump.test_key_set_is_exactly_the_three_usage_keys` (method) — Asserts `USAGE_META_KEYS` contains exactly `token_usage`, `usage_records`, and `usage_summary`. <!--#8c45c8d21b747bd5-->
  - `TestUsageMetadataExcludedFromGenericDump.test_default_render_skips_usage_keys_but_keeps_real_fields` (method) — Checks `_default_render` drops the usage-metadata keys from its rendered content while still printing genuine output fields. <!--#d355e80436a7213f-->
  - `TestUsageMetadataExcludedFromGenericDump.test_default_render_renders_nothing_when_only_usage_keys_remain` (method) — Checks `_default_render` skips `render_full` entirely when outputs hold nothing but usage metadata, avoiding an empty accounting panel. <!--#93435030e5035176-->
  - `TestUsageMetadataExcludedFromGenericDump.test_render_remaining_skips_usage_keys_on_top_of_its_own_skip_set` (method) — Checks `_render_remaining` excludes the usage keys in addition to its caller-supplied already-rendered skip set, while keeping leftover fields. <!--#380769334c15e0ae-->
  - `TestUsageMetadataExcludedFromGenericDump.test_render_remaining_renders_nothing_when_only_usage_keys_remain` (method) — Checks `_render_remaining` skips `render_full` when the only unrendered outputs are usage metadata. <!--#3f1a679f0df87678-->
- `TestRenderInvariantCheck` (class) — Test class covering the CLI `_render_invariant_check` report card — registration, localized title, PASSED/FAILED derivation, severity-grouped issue rendering, and suppression of diagnostic payloads. <!--#a1a664f8c1488592-->
  - `TestRenderInvariantCheck._content` (method) — Helper returning the rendered content string passed to the patched `render_full`. <!--#a87135669e9c00a2-->
  - `TestRenderInvariantCheck.test_renderer_is_registered` (method) — Asserts `StepType.INVARIANT_CHECK` has an entry in the `STEP_RENDERERS` registry. <!--#0b85a05c9a4d2dbd-->
  - `TestRenderInvariantCheck.test_step_has_a_localized_title_instead_of_the_raw_key` (method) — Asserts `step_display_title` returns human titles ("Invariant Check", "Adjudication") rather than raw step-type keys. <!--#5a4b9d7255178d10-->
  - `TestRenderInvariantCheck.test_zero_actionable_shows_passed_with_summary` (method) — Checks a zero-actionable result renders PASSED plus the result summary and no FAILED marker. <!--#d80c61b3fb2aaf02-->
  - `TestRenderInvariantCheck.test_issues_render_grouped_by_severity_with_the_anchored_schema` (method) — Checks issues render with the actionable count, severity grouping, the `actual_behavior — divergence` line, evidence lines, and legacy `description`-only rows. <!--#ef3c51130636d939-->
  - `TestRenderInvariantCheck.test_missing_actionable_count_falls_back_to_issue_count` (method) — Checks a record lacking `actionable_count` falls back to the issue-list length so it never reads PASSED above listed issues. <!--#60d55bf82237f106-->
  - `TestRenderInvariantCheck.test_failed_status_wins_over_the_outputs_derived_branch` (method) — Checks a `StepStatus.FAILED` step renders FAILED with its error message, overriding the outputs-derived PASSED verdict. <!--#4b70f38d054a8a09-->
  - `TestRenderInvariantCheck.test_diagnostic_payloads_stay_out_of_the_card` (method) — Checks internal diagnostic outputs (`raw_issues`, `validation_stats`, why-comment violations/losses, `skipped_reason`) never leak into the rendered report card. <!--#3d8f2e420cece1ac-->
- `TestRenderConfirm` (class) — Test class covering the CLI `_render_confirm` card — registration, approved/rejected verdict wording, reviewer and reviewed-step resolution, revision-feedback deduplication, usage-metadata exclusion, and i18n key presence. <!--#fe0124902e85ad79-->
  - `TestRenderConfirm._content` (method) — Helper returning the rendered content string passed to the patched `render_full`. <!--#a87135669e9c00a2-->

  - `TestRenderConfirm.test_approved_verdict_renders_reviewer_and_reviewed_step` (method) — Checks an approved review renders "Approved" along with the reviewer, the reviewed step type and id, and the feedback text. <!--#46d40eb76adf921b-->
  - `TestRenderConfirm.test_rejected_verdict_reads_as_revision_requested` (method) — Checks a non-approved review renders as "Revision requested" with its feedback. <!--#6009ff0e50b36371-->

  - `TestRenderConfirm.test_identical_revision_feedback_is_not_printed_twice` (method) — Checks `revision_feedback` identical to the review feedback is printed once, with no separate Revision Feedback section. <!--#2bce20738f0580f6-->
  - `TestRenderConfirm.test_diverging_revision_feedback_gets_its_own_section` (method) — Checks `revision_feedback` differing from the review feedback gets its own labelled section. <!--#9f9508ad9ec81abc-->
  - `TestRenderConfirm.test_usage_metadata_never_reaches_the_confirm_card` (method) — Checks `token_usage` fields such as `total_cost_usd` never appear in the confirm card. <!--#c913863ee67b8f77-->
  - `TestRenderConfirm.test_new_i18n_keys_present_in_both_locales` (method) — Asserts the new `cli.steprender.*` title and confirm keys exist in both `en-US.json` and `zh-CN.json` locale files. <!--#043591566161fef7-->

### `tests/test_strategy_usage_compatibility.py` (python) — Backward-compatibility unit tests for the engine-independent control-plane projections — `plan_mode_view` (persisted plan-mode context, legacy `effective_implementation_strategy` records, step-based inference, and the not-applicable gate for plan-less task types), `scope_view`, `build_usage_payload` (per-call/step/summary shape, flow-record authority, legacy flagging, dedup), and the daemon's hot/cold `engine.json` projections. <!--#29b47a34830c246c|009b89b0ae08bd27-->
- `_record` (function) — Test helper that builds a `UsageRecord` with sensible defaults (tokens, cache splits, cost, model, status) so individual tests only override the fields they care about. <!--#97d600d8d87617f4-->
- `TestPlanModeView` (class) — Unit tests for the stdlib-only `plan_mode_view` projection, covering persisted plan-mode context, group-count resolution, `auto` defaults, legacy `effective_implementation_strategy` records, step-based inference for pre-plan-mode flows, the not-applicable gate for plan-less task types, and the rule that `strategy_view` never imports the engine package. <!--#1bd48d718d22a675-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_persisted_context_wins` (method) — Asserts the full projected dict when the context carries explicit `plan_decomposition` / `plan_granularity` / `plan_mode_reason`, including an empty `reason_key` and `inferred: False`. <!--#11842ea85f08eecb-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_group_count_falls_back_to_the_context_key` (method) — Checks that `plan_group_count` stored in the context supplies the group count when the PLAN body has been externalized to cold storage. <!--#a54bcd26e797d79b-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_group_count_is_none_before_plan_runs` (method) — Verifies the group count stays `None` for a flow whose PLAN step has not produced groups yet. <!--#57aea40512b37768-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_missing_granularity_defaults_to_auto` (method) — Verifies that a context with a decomposition but no granularity projects `granularity == "auto"`. <!--#59e51842f096da38-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_persisted_legacy_strategy_is_projected_as_legacy` (method) — Verifies a flow recorded under the retired `effective_implementation_strategy` axis projects as `legacy_strategy` with null plan-mode fields, `inferred: True`, and `reason_key == "legacy_strategy"`. <!--#e884a2bfb0ae0bc1-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_invalid_persisted_values_fall_back_to_inference` (method) — Verifies a corrupt `plan_decomposition` value does not crash the projection and falls back to inference from `selected_steps`. <!--#362a8cb06852da97-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_legacy_planned_inferred_from_steps` (method) — Checks that an empty context whose steps include PLAN infers `legacy_strategy == "planned"`. <!--#e7408b6a827957f7-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_legacy_direct_inferred_from_steps` (method) — Checks that a choice-surface flow with IMPLEMENT but no PLAN infers `legacy_strategy == "direct"`. <!--#7ef5c93ed5a6efde-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_no_surface_task_types_are_not_applicable` (method) — Verifies the `small` / `review` / `survey` task types always project `legacy_strategy == "not_applicable"`. <!--#9b80fe92124d8cb1-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_no_surface_type_ignores_an_initialized_context` (method) — Verifies plan-less task types suppress the plan-mode context that `create_flow` initializes for every flow, reporting the distinct `no_plan_surface` reason instead of a retired-model record. <!--#d0774968fad5afe6-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_no_surface_gate_does_not_touch_a_planning_type` (method) — Confirms the not-applicable gate leaves a planning task type's persisted decomposition intact. <!--#35c54a39010fcfe2-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_empty_state_is_unknown` (method) — Verifies an empty context with no task type and no steps projects everything as unknown rather than fabricating a path. <!--#f14486f5113661dc-->
  - `TestPlanModeView.test_module_never_imports_the_engine` (method) — Scans `tianluo/strategy_view.py` source to assert it never imports `tianluo.engine`, keeping the flow package out of the control plane. <!--#e8e110b08c2cf480-->
- `test_retired_task_type_infers_direct_on_the_control_plane` (function) — Checks that a retired task type persisted in an old flow, with no PLAN in its steps, still infers the `direct` legacy path via the feature-sequence fallback. <!--#e5ee51583d9fc628-->
- `test_empty_selected_steps_is_unknown_on_the_control_plane` (function) — Parametrized check that planning task types with an empty step list project as unknown rather than inventing a strategy. <!--#fc34ae98956ea385-->
- `test_empty_selected_steps_planless_type_reads_not_applicable` (function) — Parametrized check that plan-less task types with an empty step list still read `not_applicable`. <!--#3becfe2dec148d98-->
- `TestScopeView` (class) — Unit tests for the shared `scope_view` projection of self-check review scope, covering absent/malformed context, active-round projection, and counts-only input. <!--#dacd71e5c19d77a7-->
  - `TestScopeView.test_absent_context_returns_none` (method) — Asserts `scope_view` returns `None` for an empty context or a non-dict `self_check_review` value. <!--#6ff460b70deb9b96-->
  - `TestScopeView.test_active_round_projected` (method) — Asserts an active review round's scope mode and completed-full-round count are projected onto the view. <!--#1889e0147eeeb4b1-->
  - `TestScopeView.test_only_counts_returns_none` (method) — Asserts that review state with counters but no round that ever ran projects to `None`. <!--#b6ec9de6d3eb10f4-->
- `TestUsagePayload` (class) — Unit tests for `build_usage_payload`, covering call/step/summary shape, flow-record authority over the step union, no-usage vs zero, legacy flagging, and cross-step deduplication. <!--#d5d14b27dd81d84c-->
  - `TestUsagePayload.test_calls_steps_and_summary_shape` (method) — Asserts the payload exposes per-call entries, step keys, and a summary carrying totals, actual cost, and `complete` completeness. <!--#1508d0e57d735ce3-->
  - `TestUsagePayload.test_flow_records_override_step_union` (method) — Asserts that a session-level `flow_records` accumulator is authoritative and replaces (not adds to) the per-step record union. <!--#a2605fcfd6878d17-->
  - `TestUsagePayload.test_no_usage_is_none_not_zero` (method) — Asserts an empty input yields `completeness == "none"` with a `None` summary rather than fabricated zero totals. <!--#ddd3bc916ca5221b-->
  - `TestUsagePayload.test_legacy_record_flags_payload` (method) — Asserts adapted legacy tallies mark the payload `legacy` with a diagnostic, while an all-zero legacy tally becomes `LEGACY_AMBIGUOUS` instead of fake zeros. <!--#ad8ba94a6e2984aa-->
  - `TestUsagePayload.test_deduplication_across_steps` (method) — Asserts the same call/attempt record appearing under two steps is counted only once. <!--#18c5d8d480435f7e-->
- `_engine_state` (function) — Test helper that assembles a minimal engine `state` dict with optional context, serialized usage records, legacy token totals, and selected steps. <!--#40a36e6e56c6dbd5-->
- `TestDaemonProjections` (class) — Tests the daemon's `_projection_fields` / `_state_projections` plan-mode, scope and usage projections against hot/cold engine.json shapes — externalized `context_ref`, hash-memoized cold group counts, legacy token tallies, degraded headers, and snapshot/session-meta serialization. <!--#3be8824c6d685e8e-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_aggregator_projection_fields_match_shared_views` (method) — Asserts `DaemonAggregator._projection_fields` returns exactly the shared `plan_mode_view` result plus a usage summary in the common `UsageSummary` wire shape. <!--#4af32d038a2e848b-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_externalized_context_ref_is_resolved_not_legacy_inferred` (method) — Verifies both the aggregator and history reader follow a `context_ref` into the cold `_context.json` instead of falling back to legacy inference for a current-format flow. <!--#9050eaa325c34cb1-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_group_count_follows_the_externalized_plan_body` (method) — Verifies the group count is read from the cold PLAN body via its `cold_ref` and memoized on the content hash, so repeat polls skip the read but a plan revision invalidates the cached count. <!--#91fcf6646c25448b-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_unreadable_cold_plan_body_is_unknown_not_memoized` (method) — Verifies a failed cold-body read yields `None` without caching, so a later successful read still reports the real group count. <!--#88c695b768de4e87-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_aggregator_projection_legacy_inference` (method) — Checks the aggregator infers `planned` for a legacy flow and omits the usage summary entirely when there are no records. <!--#2e8da7c36b0af650-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_aggregator_legacy_totals_adapt` (method) — Verifies the retired five-field `session_token_usage` tally is adapted into usable totals rather than surfacing misleading zeros. <!--#bccbac2dd6688823-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_degraded_header_read_yields_none` (method) — Checks that a header-only engine dict with no `state` yields `None` for all three projections. <!--#776f46fe6b5f7dc1-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_flow_snapshot_to_dict_omits_absent_projections` (method) — Verifies daemon `FlowSnapshot.to_dict` omits `plan_mode` / `review_scope` / `usage_summary` when unset and emits them once assigned. <!--#3dc4739fea0ed4a4-->
  - `TestDaemonProjections.test_session_meta_carries_projections_when_recoverable` (method) — Verifies `_meta_from_engine` attaches plan-mode and usage projections while `_meta_from_history` never guesses them for history-only flows. <!--#bc4496628221c58f-->
- `_write_jsonl` (function) — Test helper that writes a list of dicts as a JSONL step-history file, creating parent directories as needed. <!--#f321072562a278a4-->
- `TestDaemonReadFlowUsage` (class) — Tests that `DaemonHistoryReader.read_flow` recovers usage from JSONL history on full reads, omits it on append windows, and flags adapted legacy `token_usage`. <!--#48533ffa05bf3e6a-->
  - `TestDaemonReadFlowUsage.test_full_read_recovers_usage` (method) — Asserts a full read reconstructs the complete usage payload, including per-call model, from `usage_records` in the JSONL history. <!--#fb27ccd8953f473d-->
  - `TestDaemonReadFlowUsage.test_append_read_omits_usage` (method) — Asserts history with no assistant usage yields no usage, and that append-mode reads never summarize usage from their window alone. <!--#7230656f1714cd13-->
  - `TestDaemonReadFlowUsage.test_legacy_token_usage_adapts_with_flag` (method) — Asserts a legacy `token_usage` block in history is adapted into an available call while the payload is marked `legacy` with a diagnostic. <!--#9c90971c6a17d8ab-->
- `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage` (class) — Tests the daemon wire protocol's plan-mode spawn fields — default omission, value validation, supported-value sets, the protocol-version gate, the still-speakable retired `implementation_strategy` field and its translation map, resume behaviour, and the optional `usage` field on history data. <!--#295f41c8cfd59936-->
  - `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage.test_spawn_omits_plan_mode_by_default` (method) — Asserts `make_spawn_flow` emits only the base payload keys when no plan-mode arguments are given. <!--#45e29215dc5ada52-->
  - `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage.test_spawn_carries_valid_plan_mode` (method) — Checks every valid decomposition and granularity value round-trips into the spawn payload. <!--#62b7e9520f5a9e47-->
  - `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage.test_spawn_rejects_invalid_plan_mode` (method) — Checks that out-of-vocabulary plan-mode values raise `ProtocolError` at message construction. <!--#c538dccb59c6f08e-->
  - `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage.test_spawn_plan_mode_supported_values_sets` (method) — Pins the exact `SPAWN_PLAN_DECOMPOSITION_VALUES` and `SPAWN_PLAN_GRANULARITY_VALUES` frozensets. <!--#3d8a4cfddda484fd-->
  - `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage.test_supports_spawn_plan_mode_gate` (method) — Pins `supports_spawn_plan_mode` behaviour across new, old, missing and malformed protocol versions against the minimum version 8. <!--#cbf95a5769eca481-->
  - `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage.test_retired_strategy_field_still_speakable_for_one_version` (method) — Verifies the retired `implementation_strategy` field is still accepted on the wire and pins its `SPAWN_STRATEGY_PLAN_MODE_MAP` translation into plan-mode pairs. <!--#8675a7ec6cc2f752-->
  - `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage.test_resume_spawn_never_carries_plan_mode` (method) — Checks a resume-by-flow-id spawn message never puts plan-mode fields on the wire. <!--#945fa03be4e2b1df-->
  - `TestProtocolPlanModeAndUsage.test_history_data_usage_field` (method) — Checks `make_history_data` omits the `usage` key unless a usage payload is supplied. <!--#33b5507bec4f6ea7-->
- `TestServerBundleUsage` (class) — Tests the WebUI server's `ServerState._bundle_usage` — preferring a stored payload, rebuilding from raw records through the shared `build_usage_payload` backend, pricing with the built-in catalog when none is stored, honouring a bundle's `usage_catalog` overrides, refreshing on appends — plus the server `FlowSnapshot`'s relay/omission of projection fields. <!--#a379cce7ac9411e1-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_bundle_usage_prefers_stored_payload` (method) — Asserts `ServerState._bundle_usage` returns the daemon-computed payload as-is when the bundle already carries one. <!--#50f2503afeaec43d-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_bundle_usage_rebuilds_from_records` (method) — Asserts a records-only bundle is rebuilt into the same shape and summary that `build_usage_payload` with the built-in catalog produces. <!--#d2c7ed4fc963d3e2-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_bundle_usage_rebuild_without_catalog_prices_with_builtin` (method) — Asserts a catalog-less bundle still prices with the built-in table, keeping estimates present and completeness `complete` instead of degrading to unknown-price. <!--#eee661b98e656c94-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_bundle_usage_rebuild_respects_stored_catalog` (method) — Asserts a bundle carrying the daemon's `usage_catalog` prices with those project overrides, producing an estimate distinct from the built-in one. <!--#2ea18c9591832549-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_refresh_bundle_usage_prices_with_stored_catalog` (method) — Asserts `_refresh_bundle_usage` re-prices the whole ledger with the stored override catalog on a usage-bearing append, so estimates stay consistent between frames. <!--#097ea9277cb2ade2-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_apply_history_frame_append_stores_catalog_and_refreshes` (method) — End-to-end async test that a full frame followed by an append frame, both carrying the project catalog, leaves the stored usage priced with that catalog. <!--#89b8123e9d0b03ab-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_bundle_usage_legacy_records_flagged` (method) — Asserts a bundle whose records only carry legacy `token_usage` rebuilds into an available call flagged `legacy` with a diagnostic. <!--#0ef76e94fcf07f53-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_bundle_usage_none_for_empty_bundle` (method) — Asserts an empty or record-less bundle yields `None` usage rather than an empty summary. <!--#0d30df313cae98b0-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_server_flow_snapshot_relays_projections` (method) — Verifies the server-side `FlowSnapshot` round-trips `plan_mode`, `review_scope` and `usage_summary` from payload to dict unchanged. <!--#8b5ec04b64a189e0-->
  - `TestServerBundleUsage.test_server_flow_snapshot_omits_absent_projections` (method) — Verifies the server-side `FlowSnapshot` omits the three projection keys entirely when the payload carries none. <!--#23be36674f7f126a-->
- `TestLegacyTaskGroupsDaemonCompat` (class) — Tests that old flows carrying legacy `task_groups` / `adjudicated_plan` step outputs still index and snapshot correctly — the projections count the groups without crashing or leaking the legacy scheduling data — and that a degraded legacy header survives indexing with null projections. <!--#94bf82043cd13bcd-->
  - `TestLegacyTaskGroupsDaemonCompat._legacy_engine` (method) — Test helper that writes an `engine.json` for a completed legacy flow whose plan and self_check steps carry `task_groups` and `adjudicated_plan` outputs. <!--#86cc38d437c76e93-->
  - `TestLegacyTaskGroupsDaemonCompat.test_index_and_snapshot_tolerate_legacy_outputs` (method) — Verifies a legacy `task_groups` flow appears in both the history index and the aggregator snapshot with an inferred `planned` strategy, a group count of 1, and no `task_groups` leaking into the emitted dicts. <!--#b175713b92595191-->
  - `TestLegacyTaskGroupsDaemonCompat.test_degraded_legacy_header_does_not_crash` (method) — Verifies a header-only legacy engine.json still indexes, with `plan_mode` and `usage_summary` left as `None`. <!--#90a08e72c7a12e3c-->
- `TestMixedLegacyModernUsage` (class) — Tests ledgers mixing modern `UsageRecord`s with adapted legacy tallies — correct one-time summation, retained legacy provenance, and the resulting partial completeness. <!--#434aa754a27b0386-->
  - `TestMixedLegacyModernUsage.test_mixed_records_sum_once_and_flag_legacy` (method) — Asserts modern and legacy calls sum into correct token/cost totals while missing legacy model/provider provenance degrades completeness to `partial`. <!--#2b647f89e0975b79-->
  - `TestMixedLegacyModernUsage.test_legacy_ambiguous_marks_payload_partial` (method) — Asserts an all-zero legacy tally beside a modern record is counted as an unknown call and marks the payload `partial`, never folded into a fake-zero `complete` summary. <!--#176720e7b310bea1-->
  - `TestMixedLegacyModernUsage.test_flow_records_authoritative_over_mixed_step_union` (method) — Asserts the session accumulator wins over a mixed step union so a record repeated across steps is not double-counted. <!--#9708b41333dafb66-->
- `TestSameEngineCrossSurfaceConsistency` (class) — Cross-surface tests pinning that the CLI (via `PersistenceManager` + `history_cmd`) and the daemon (via raw-dict parsing) derive identical plan-mode, scope and usage projections from one engine.json, across modern, legacy and pre-ledger flows. <!--#b02bae0cb40dfb2d-->
  - `TestSameEngineCrossSurfaceConsistency._write_engine` (method) — Helper that writes a synthetic engine.json under `tianluo/state/` with optional plan-mode context and self-check review scope, and returns the engine dict. <!--#337e58fa323b11e2-->
  - `TestSameEngineCrossSurfaceConsistency.test_daemon_and_cli_projections_match` (method) — Asserts the daemon's raw-dict projections equal the CLI's loader-based `plan_mode_view` / `scope_view` / usage payload for a modern flow with plan mode, incremental review scope and usage records. <!--#d1096d7b1d705aa2-->
  - `TestSameEngineCrossSurfaceConsistency.test_legacy_engine_projection_consistent_without_usage` (method) — Asserts both surfaces infer the same `planned` legacy path, no scope, and a `partial` (legacy-ambiguous) usage completeness for a record-less legacy flow. <!--#9326b5e78c1404f4-->
  - `TestSameEngineCrossSurfaceConsistency.test_modern_flow_before_first_call_reports_no_usage_on_both_surfaces` (method) — Verifies a modern flow with an empty usage ledger reports no usage on both surfaces instead of adapting the all-zero legacy tally into a phantom unknown call. <!--#c04639cb149dba79-->
  - `TestSameEngineCrossSurfaceConsistency.test_pre_ledger_tally_survives_a_modern_re_save` (method) — Verifies a pre-ledger flow's non-zero five-field tally still projects identically after the modern serializer writes an empty `session_usage_records` beside it, so resuming a pre-12.x flow does not erase its accumulated usage. <!--#516ecc42b3426646-->

### `tests/test_stream_progress_agent_model.py` (python) — Unit tests verifying agent/model attribution on the stream_progress channel: that record_stream_progress writes optional agent_name/model_name keys only when present (byte-identical to legacy schema otherwise), that the model-name extraction helpers parse init/system metadata and tolerate garbage, and that StreamJSONTracker labels every progress record with its agent from the first fragment, upgrades records to carry the real model once an init line streams, and gives each attempt its own agent across rotation. <!--#cb6aac5725358398|d312d4909f6252cf-->
- `test_extract_model_from_obj_top_level` (function) — Asserts extract_model_name_from_obj reads the model from a top-level 'model' key on an init metadata object. <!--#c8160b5f152a2f13-->
- `test_extract_model_from_obj_system_and_nested_session` (function) — Asserts extract_model_name_from_obj handles 'system' type and a model nested under a 'session' object. <!--#3ec7a5b377f420c7-->
- `test_extract_model_from_obj_non_metadata_returns_none` (function) — Asserts extract_model_name_from_obj returns None for non-metadata types, missing model, non-dict, and None inputs without raising. <!--#fa1343937690de71-->
- `test_extract_model_from_ndjson_multiline_and_single_line` (function) — Asserts extract_model_name_from_ndjson finds the model across multiline NDJSON, single-line, and already-parsed list inputs. <!--#0199e1f68ddfb12e-->
- `test_extract_model_from_ndjson_tolerates_garbage` (function) — Asserts extract_model_name_from_ndjson returns None for empty, non-JSON, and command-banner garbage input. <!--#9df662986cf96d10-->
- `_read_record` (function) — Test helper that reads and JSON-parses the single stream-progress record written to a given flow/step's `.jsonl` file under `tianluo/history`. <!--#43bf983b68545f11-->
- `test_record_stream_progress_omits_agent_model_when_none` (function) — Asserts record_stream_progress writes a byte-identical legacy schema (no extra keys) when agent/model are both None. <!--#039edbbc7aef219c-->
- `test_record_stream_progress_writes_agent_only` (function) — Asserts record_stream_progress adds agent_name but omits model_name when only the agent is provided. <!--#0174860483ea9b37-->
- `test_record_stream_progress_writes_agent_and_model` (function) — Asserts record_stream_progress writes both agent_name and model_name when both are provided. <!--#b05d5b7372a9d7d2-->
- `_make_capturing_tracker` (function) — Test helper that monkeypatches record_stream_progress to capture calls and builds a StreamJSONTracker with flow context for assertions. <!--#25c4a2cf5f508df2-->
- `test_tracker_stores_agent_name` (function) — Asserts a freshly constructed StreamJSONTracker stores the agent name and leaves model name unset. <!--#69ed932b8cf1368b-->
- `test_emit_agent_identity_seeds_agent_before_any_output` (function) — Asserts emit_agent_identity writes exactly one empty-content record carrying the agent (but no model) before any stream output. <!--#ac7a1cc506d455a9-->
- `test_emit_agent_identity_includes_model_when_known` (function) — Asserts emit_agent_identity includes the model in its seed record when the model is already known. <!--#ee974fa0e9a98575-->
- `test_emit_agent_identity_noop_without_agent` (function) — Asserts emit_agent_identity writes nothing when no agent name is set. <!--#7e626ea4cf9f4e1f-->
- `test_emit_agent_identity_noop_without_flow_context` (function) — Asserts emit_agent_identity is a safe no-op when no flow/step context (progress) is configured. <!--#57ee69439677da3d-->
- `test_call_emits_identity_seed_before_result` (function) — Verifies that LLMCaller.call() writes an identity-seed stream-progress record (empty content tagged with the active agent name) at attempt start, even when the runner streams no intermediate fragments and only returns a final result line. <!--#b7b5d9fc8057411a-->
- `test_tracker_progress_carries_agent_before_model` (function) — Asserts a tool_use fragment streamed before any init line produces a progress record with agent_name but no model_name yet. <!--#396d98e72fb8b4f8-->
- `test_tracker_upgrades_to_model_after_init_line` (function) — Asserts that after an init line streams, subsequent progress records gain the parsed model_name while earlier ones lack it. <!--#f4cbdb183008a25e-->
- `test_tracker_init_line_first_all_records_carry_model` (function) — Asserts that when the init line streams first, every subsequent progress record carries both agent and model. <!--#29d42b4b61d8c43c-->
- `test_init_line_emits_model_upgrade_without_further_fragments` (function) — Asserts the tracker emits an immediate empty-content agent·model upgrade record the moment an init line reveals the model, without waiting for more fragments. <!--#98d9d2dfaf89c4ed-->
- `_FakeResult` (class) — Test double mimicking an agent runner result object with success/output/returncode and related attributes. <!--#92f47d3c98413a64-->
  - `_FakeResult.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake result with success, output, returncode, and cmd_used, defaulting interrupted and stderr_tail. <!--#44ddd6d191c352dd-->
- `_RotationRunner` (class) — Test double agent runner that streams a fixed init line plus one tool_use fragment and then returns a caller-configured success or failure, so each attempt produces exactly one progress record for agent-rotation assertions. <!--#9cc581e26f827f76-->
  - `_RotationRunner.__init__` (method) — Stores whether this runner instance should report success. <!--#3f755d5b9d489032-->
  - `_RotationRunner.build_call_args` (method) — Returns a minimal `["-p", prompt]` argument list, standing in for real CLI argument construction. <!--#7f6ced27ed062dca-->
  - `_RotationRunner.detect_infra_error` (method) — Stub method on `_RotationRunner` that always reports `InfraErrorType.NONE`, signaling no infrastructure error. <!--#ef6e030cdd122d10-->
  - `_RotationRunner.run_with_monitor` (method) — Streams an init line and a tool_use via on_output, then returns the preset success/failure result. <!--#b8d4dcc2d83eef65-->
- `test_rotation_progress_records_carry_per_attempt_agent` (function) — Asserts that after agent A fails and rotation falls to B, each attempt's progress records carry its own agent name (A then B), with no stale carryover. <!--#c1a2cf8fd0b0a341-->

### `tests/test_test_parallel_switch.py` (python) — Unit tests for the `test.parallel` switch: config loading and validation of the `parallel` key (serial default, `auto`, positive ints, warn-and-default on invalid values), the `_apply_parallel` command rewriter that appends `-n <workers> --dist loadgroup` to pytest commands without duplicating user flags or mutating input, the `_pytest_module_launcher` interpreter-prefix extractor, and the `_is_missing_xdist_result` heuristic that tells a missing-pytest-xdist abort apart from ordinary test failures. <!--#a3c4cb7ea682fff6|71e11ea62db64ca3-->
- `TestParallelConfigLoading` (class) — Tests that `TestConfig.load` parses the `test.parallel` key correctly — defaulting to serial when absent, accepting `auto` (case/space-insensitive) and positive ints (quoted or not), and warning-and-defaulting on invalid values while preserving the rest of the `test:` block. <!--#0c89d015e30cb297-->
  - `TestParallelConfigLoading.test_default_is_serial` (method) — Asserts that a project with no config file loads with `parallel is None` (serial). <!--#bf0e9ad2fda03348-->
  - `TestParallelConfigLoading.test_absent_key_is_serial` (method) — Asserts that a `test:` block without a `parallel` key still yields `parallel is None`. <!--#cfcc3aa8a6062076-->
  - `TestParallelConfigLoading.test_auto_accepted_case_and_space_insensitive` (method) — Asserts that `auto`, `AUTO`, and `" auto "` all normalise to the string `"auto"`. <!--#4b37a773e2456b85-->
  - `TestParallelConfigLoading.test_positive_int_accepted` (method) — Asserts that an integer worker count such as `4` is loaded as the int `4`. <!--#3c938ee7ba4ea175-->
  - `TestParallelConfigLoading.test_quoted_positive_int_accepted` (method) — Asserts that a quoted numeric string `"4"` is coerced to the int `4`. <!--#fd46b7e4bbe858ee-->
  - `TestParallelConfigLoading.test_invalid_values_warn_and_stay_serial` (method) — Asserts that zero, negatives, floats, booleans, arbitrary strings, and collections fall back to serial and emit a warning naming `test.parallel`. <!--#05f72616aa18d159-->
  - `TestParallelConfigLoading.test_invalid_value_keeps_the_rest_of_the_block` (method) — Asserts that an invalid `parallel` value does not discard sibling keys — `command` and `timeout` survive the warn-and-default. <!--#386cf3161da811c9-->
  - `TestParallelConfigLoading.test_warning_names_the_config_source` (method) — Asserts the validation warning mentions the offending config file (`tianluo.yaml`) so the user can find it. <!--#e314fd883823d5aa-->
- `TestApplyParallel` (class) — Tests `_apply_parallel`, the pure command-rewriter that appends `-n <workers> --dist loadgroup` to pytest commands — covering off/non-pytest no-ops, non-duplication of user-supplied worker/dist flags, and non-mutation of the input list. <!--#1d484c2c6d28a145-->
  - `TestApplyParallel.test_auto_appends_workers_and_loadgroup` (method) — Asserts `auto` appends `-n auto --dist loadgroup` to a `python -m pytest` command. <!--#c70d38d8ddbc4f44-->
  - `TestApplyParallel.test_worker_count_appended` (method) — Asserts an explicit worker count is appended as `-n 4 --dist loadgroup`. <!--#489e00cc3ee20bea-->
  - `TestApplyParallel.test_off_leaves_command_untouched` (method) — Asserts that `None` (switch off) returns the command unchanged. <!--#ccd4f36d44581b8c-->
  - `TestApplyParallel.test_non_pytest_command_untouched` (method) — Asserts a non-pytest command like `npm test` is left alone and a "not pytest" debug message is logged. <!--#f00b635ccd995233-->
  - `TestApplyParallel.test_existing_worker_flag_is_not_duplicated` (method) — Asserts that any existing worker flag spelling (`-n 2`, `-n2`, `-nauto`, `--numprocesses ...`) suppresses adding another one. <!--#206c07e24efbc33a-->
  - `TestApplyParallel.test_existing_dist_flag_is_not_duplicated` (method) — Asserts that a user-supplied `--dist` (spaced or `=`-joined) suppresses adding `--dist loadgroup`. <!--#ee2c81344cd7f175-->
  - `TestApplyParallel.test_both_flags_present_is_a_noop` (method) — Asserts that a command already carrying both `-n` and `--dist` is returned unchanged. <!--#7c23676abbe07bea-->
  - `TestApplyParallel.test_does_not_mutate_the_input_command` (method) — Asserts `_apply_parallel` returns a new list rather than mutating the caller's command. <!--#918bf424dc4c6fdd-->
- `TestPytestModuleLauncher` (class) — Tests `_pytest_module_launcher`, which extracts the launcher prefix that would run `-m pytest` (bare interpreter or whole wrapper such as `uv run python`) and returns `None` when no interpreter is knowable. <!--#3e8bb07e43b3c612-->
  - `TestPytestModuleLauncher.test_module_form_yields_interpreter` (method) — Asserts a plain `<python> -m pytest` command yields just that interpreter path. <!--#1d06fa33535654a9-->
  - `TestPytestModuleLauncher.test_wrapper_form_yields_the_whole_prefix` (method) — Asserts wrapper launchers (`uv run python`, `poetry run python`, `pixi run python`, `env <python>`) yield the entire prefix, since the wrapper owns the environment being probed. <!--#925abd265bd53e70-->
  - `TestPytestModuleLauncher.test_bare_pytest_has_no_knowable_interpreter` (method) — Asserts a bare `pytest` command returns `None` — there is no interpreter to probe. <!--#f862815195e220e9-->
  - `TestPytestModuleLauncher.test_leading_dash_m_has_no_launcher` (method) — Asserts a command starting with `-m pytest` (no launcher token) returns `None`. <!--#d1669abec48b8b0f-->
  - `TestPytestModuleLauncher.test_non_pytest_module_is_not_matched` (method) — Asserts `-m unittest` is not mistaken for a pytest launcher. <!--#24b7c483876d2d6d-->
- `TestIsMissingXdistResult` (class) — Tests `_is_missing_xdist_result`, the heuristic that distinguishes a genuine "pytest-xdist not installed" abort (usage exit code 4, no collected results) from ordinary failures whose output merely quotes the `unrecognized arguments` signature. <!--#c2ec74eab0acacdc-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_recognises_unrecognized_arguments` (method) — Asserts the xdist-flag `unrecognized arguments` signature on stderr is detected as missing xdist. <!--#af25c8ead504dbd8-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_recognises_it_on_stdout_too` (method) — Asserts the same signature is detected when pytest prints it to stdout. <!--#255649e8c3649655-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_passing_run_is_never_missing_xdist` (method) — Asserts a passing run is never classified as missing xdist, whatever its output contains. <!--#0b87c93c204f70eb-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_ordinary_failure_is_not_missing_xdist` (method) — Asserts a normal assertion failure is not classified as missing xdist. <!--#69612ba378b79a87-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_unrelated_unrecognized_argument_is_not_missing_xdist` (method) — Asserts an `unrecognized arguments` error about some other flag is not attributed to xdist. <!--#98465a9494c4ad0b-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_a_run_that_produced_per_test_results_is_not_missing_xdist` (method) — Asserts that output containing per-test `[gw*]` results proves the suite ran, so a quoted signature stays a real failure bound for the fix loop. <!--#e519868482689b88-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_a_run_with_only_an_aggregate_summary_is_not_missing_xdist` (method) — Asserts that a quiet run's `N failed, M passed` summary also proves the suite ran and rules out missing xdist. <!--#f3b41b28c5238be4-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_non_usage_error_exit_code_is_not_missing_xdist` (method) — Asserts that any exit code other than pytest's usage-error 4 rules out the missing-plugin diagnosis. <!--#6783b6cf63648ee1-->
  - `TestIsMissingXdistResult.test_usage_error_exit_code_with_no_results_is_missing_xdist` (method) — Asserts the positive case: exit code 4, no results, and the xdist signature is classified as missing xdist. <!--#888a8cfffaeea7ba-->
- `_make_flow_and_step` (function) — Test helper building a minimal `FlowInstance` plus a `StepType.TEST` `Step` rooted at a temp path. <!--#a9c90b12e9cf3e24-->
- `_mock_process` (function) — Test helper returning a `MagicMock` process with the given return code and `communicate()` output. <!--#5653e84933f924f1-->
- `_commands_run` (function) — Test helper extracting the argv list of every command passed to a mocked `Popen`. <!--#19266877cd2e29bf-->
- `TestHandlerParallelCommand` (class) — End-to-end tests that `run_test_step` applies the parallel flags to the primary test command only — leaving user-defined phase commands and non-pytest commands verbatim, and staying serial by default. <!--#46ba06c84c58fc2a-->
  - `TestHandlerParallelCommand.test_primary_command_carries_parallel_flags` (method) — Asserts the step's first spawned command carries `-n auto --dist loadgroup` and the step completes. <!--#8959295471a0708a-->
  - `TestHandlerParallelCommand.test_phases_run_verbatim` (method) — Asserts the primary command is rewritten with the worker flags while a configured phase command runs exactly as written. <!--#7e70033b5c840582-->
  - `TestHandlerParallelCommand.test_serial_by_default` (method) — Asserts that with no `parallel` configured the command is spawned unmodified. <!--#51e6b24d334f42d9-->
  - `TestHandlerParallelCommand.test_non_pytest_command_is_not_rewritten` (method) — Asserts `npm test` is spawned unchanged even with the parallel switch on. <!--#f64e3367a57b5f93-->
- `TestHandlerXdistMissing` (class) — End-to-end tests of the missing-xdist handling in `run_test_step`: the pre-flight `import xdist` probe (which launcher, which cwd, when it runs), failing FAILED-with-install-hint rather than triggering the fix loop, and never mistaking a real test failure for a missing plugin. <!--#7cec9f558dff9e9b-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_preflight_path_fails_with_install_hint` (method) — Asserts that when the probe of the test command's own interpreter reports no xdist, the suite never runs and the step ends FAILED with an install hint naming that interpreter and no `fix_needed`. <!--#55b89b64c0bf5a4a-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_bare_pytest_path_fails_with_install_hint` (method) — Asserts that for a bare `pytest` command (nothing to probe) the missing plugin is diagnosed from the run output and yields the same FAILED-with-hint outcome. <!--#c4da42e4a18ae13d-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_preflight_covers_a_user_written_worker_flag` (method) — Asserts the pre-flight probe still runs when the user's command already pins `-n`/`--dist`, since it remains xdist-dependent. <!--#d652c19d0b1ec16a-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_wrapper_command_probes_the_wrapped_environment` (method) — Asserts a wrapper command probes through the whole prefix (`uv run python -c "import xdist"`) rather than invoking `uv` alone. <!--#acf49a298f92d36b-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_probe_runs_in_the_same_directory_as_the_test_command` (method) — Asserts the probe uses the same `cwd` as the test command, because wrapper launchers resolve their environment from the working directory. <!--#a83d70fde66223a4-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_probe_failing_for_an_unrelated_reason_is_inconclusive` (method) — Asserts that a probe failing for a non-xdist reason is treated as inconclusive and the suite still runs in parallel instead of aborting the step. <!--#7f7671ffd54b87f7-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_ordinary_failure_still_enters_the_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts a normal test failure under the parallel switch returns `REVISION_NEEDED` with `fix_needed` set. <!--#d3a1667193894e7e-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_suite_that_quotes_the_signature_still_enters_the_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts a real regression whose output quotes the `unrecognized arguments` wording (as this repo's own tests do) reaches the fix loop rather than being misdiagnosed as a missing plugin. <!--#de928a8bbc69a0ad-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_no_preflight_when_switch_is_off` (method) — Asserts no `import xdist` probe is issued when the parallel switch is off. <!--#04184231b63a08aa-->
  - `TestHandlerXdistMissing.test_unrecognized_arguments_without_the_switch_is_a_plain_failure` (method) — Asserts the signature is only read as missing xdist for commands the step itself rewrote — otherwise it is an ordinary failure needing revision. <!--#a911cb02f32ef86f-->
- `TestGeneratedCommandUnderRealXdist` (class) — Integration test that runs the generated command against a real pytest + xdist subprocess to prove `--dist loadgroup` actually keeps an `xdist_group` on a single worker (skipped when xdist is absent). <!--#dff58cb3470326d8-->
  - `TestGeneratedCommandUnderRealXdist.grouped_project` (method) — Fixture writing a throwaway project of two test files sharing one `xdist_group`, each test recording its `PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER` by touching a marker file. <!--#b61ec473fd1f8f6f-->
  - `TestGeneratedCommandUnderRealXdist.test_loadgroup_keeps_a_group_on_one_worker` (method) — Runs the `_apply_parallel`-generated command over the fixture project with two workers and asserts the run really parallelised yet all eight grouped tests landed on exactly one worker. <!--#f7bea4912aa36a80-->
- `TestXdistUnavailableError` (class) — Tests that `XdistUnavailableError` renders as its message plus, when present, a newline-joined remediation line. <!--#aaa1a538e04320ee-->
  - `TestXdistUnavailableError.test_str_joins_message_and_remediation` (method) — Asserts `str()` joins message and remediation with a newline. <!--#02bbf12d4e76077b-->
  - `TestXdistUnavailableError.test_str_without_remediation` (method) — Asserts `str()` is just the message when no remediation is given. <!--#4fd42961d9ed028d-->

### `tests/test_token_usage.py` (python) — Unit-test module for `tianluo.engine.token_usage`, covering the `UsageTotals` value object (defaults, field-wise `add` merging, fault-tolerant `to_dict`/`from_dict` round-tripping, and projection to/from authoritative `UsageRecord` cost semantics), the `format_cost`/`format_usage_line` display helpers with their None/bad-input safety, and the contextvars-based step-scoped accumulator (`accumulate_step_usage`/`add_call_usage`/`current_step_usage`, plus `use_step_usage` re-binding a parent accumulator across thread boundaries). <!--#7981cbf3ff576ba6|f039b751c782c905-->
- `TestUsageTotals` (class) — Unit tests for the legacy five-field `UsageTotals` value object — defaults, `add` merging, `total_tokens`/`is_empty` semantics, `to_dict`/`from_dict` coercion and round-tripping, and projection to/from authoritative `UsageRecord` objects. <!--#e4592a80a17fc4e0-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_defaults_are_zero_and_empty` (method) — Verifies a freshly constructed UsageTotals has all-zero fields, zero total_tokens, and reports is_empty(). <!--#8a806c0feaa0da35-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_add_merges_field_by_field` (method) — Verifies add() merges another UsageTotals field-by-field in place, returns self, and leaves the operand unchanged. <!--#1cc849570b3058e8-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_add_none_is_noop` (method) — Verifies add(None) leaves the receiver's fields unchanged. <!--#5ab6aec1420b3502-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_total_tokens_does_not_double_count_input_cache_subsets` (method) — Asserts `total_tokens` counts only input plus output, treating the cache-creation/cache-read fields as subsets of input rather than adding them again. <!--#7de1468221e1d587-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_is_empty_false_when_only_cost` (method) — Verifies a nonzero cost alone makes is_empty() return False. <!--#5d019dd1d46a2c9b-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_is_empty_false_when_only_tokens` (method) — Verifies a nonzero token count alone makes is_empty() return False. <!--#94808f679d609a72-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_to_dict_is_json_primitive` (method) — Verifies to_dict() emits the expected key/value map with only JSON-primitive numeric values. <!--#18933039f07692f6-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_round_trip` (method) — Verifies from_dict(to_dict(u)) reconstructs an equal UsageTotals. <!--#d86fde01ec57b51d-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_none` (method) — Verifies from_dict(None) yields a default (empty) UsageTotals. <!--#1ca398c14d2240b8-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_empty` (method) — Verifies from_dict({}) yields a default (empty) UsageTotals. <!--#d25f321f967c2339-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_missing_fields_default_zero` (method) — Verifies from_dict fills absent fields with zero while keeping provided ones. <!--#4cf3a7a77c656d5f-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_none_values_coerce_to_zero` (method) — Verifies from_dict coerces explicit None field values to zero. <!--#618b6bfce55b5d69-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_bad_values_coerce_to_zero` (method) — Verifies from_dict coerces non-numeric (unparseable) field values to zero. <!--#17dd3ef86ec0b72e-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_numeric_strings` (method) — Verifies from_dict parses numeric-string field values into their numeric types. <!--#e856df73945b94b9-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_usage_record_projection_round_trips_authority` (method) — Checks that `UsageTotals.from_usage_record` projects a `UsageRecord`'s logical/cache/output token fields correctly and that serialising and reloading via `to_dict`/`from_dict` preserves the original record. <!--#0cf0c2cf453caa3f-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_unavailable_record_survives_zero_projection` (method) — Verifies an `UNAVAILABLE` record projects to empty five-field totals yet is still carried through `usage_records` across a dict round trip, so "no usage" is not lost as "zero usage". <!--#73152a0fb9ddc873-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_cumulative_session_cost_uses_latest_record` (method) — Ensures that when merging records with `PROVIDER_SESSION_CUMULATIVE` cost semantics from one provider session, tokens sum but cost takes the latest cumulative value instead of being added. <!--#87defa15677c304a-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_old_zero_tally_projects_as_legacy_ambiguous` (method) — Asserts an all-zero legacy tally converts to a record marked `LEGACY_AMBIGUOUS` with unknown (`None`) cost, rather than claiming a measured zero. <!--#d4c2445d5651bf34-->
- `TestFormatting` (class) — Tests for the format_cost and format_usage_line display helpers, including their None/bad-input safety. <!--#c34831a354285e26-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_cost` (method) — Verifies format_cost renders a USD amount to four decimal places with a dollar sign. <!--#e2cdb4551149c66b-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_cost_none_safe` (method) — Verifies format_cost(None) returns the zero-cost string. <!--#2f49f442d343bf75-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_cost_bad_value_safe` (method) — Verifies format_cost on an unparseable value returns the zero-cost string. <!--#a0d166a2bb470167-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_usage_line_labels_and_units` (method) — Verifies format_usage_line includes in/out labels, thousands separators, cache read/write counts, and cost. <!--#6e83cf86ebbaf72b-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_usage_line_none_safe` (method) — Verifies format_usage_line(None) renders a zeroed line without error. <!--#4a3236797cfad026-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_usage_line_empty_safe` (method) — Verifies format_usage_line on an empty UsageTotals renders the zero-cost line. <!--#d83460b5e44a1638-->
- `TestStepScopedAccumulator` (class) — Tests for the contextvars-based step usage scope (accumulate_step_usage / add_call_usage / current_step_usage), covering accumulation, nesting, isolation, and restoration. <!--#173ae0abb738c5e9-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_no_scope_current_is_none` (method) — Verifies current_step_usage() is None when no scope is active. <!--#8b770ffd65d213b4-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_add_call_usage_outside_scope_is_noop` (method) — Verifies add_call_usage is a safe no-op when called with no active scope. <!--#cf6e53dc79d69217-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_scope_accumulates_multiple_calls` (method) — Verifies an active scope sums multiple add_call_usage contributions into its accumulator. <!--#ae2a81908169b5bf-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_scope_accepts_dict_usage` (method) — Verifies add_call_usage accepts plain dict/mapping usage payloads within a scope. <!--#99d3b5b792aa2bbf-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_add_call_usage_ignores_none_and_garbage` (method) — Verifies add_call_usage silently ignores None and non-usage values while still folding valid ones. <!--#84ba9869d9645313-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_scope_restored_after_exit` (method) — Verifies the active scope is cleared back to None after the context manager exits. <!--#59fa3846028df6bb-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_nested_scopes_isolated` (method) — Verifies nested scopes are isolated so inner usage does not leak into the outer accumulator. <!--#b664adca4fba95a8-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_scope_restored_on_exception` (method) — Verifies the scope is restored to None even when the body raises an exception. <!--#1fa78021c116e851-->
- `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread` (class) — Tests for use_step_usage re-binding a parent accumulator across thread boundaries, the fix for DAG-parallel workers dropping usage in fresh contextvars contexts. <!--#ac6aae1c28ce9619-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_use_step_usage_none_is_noop` (method) — Verifies use_step_usage(None) binds no scope and leaves add_call_usage a no-op. <!--#c6d75453b36fd5ed-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_use_step_usage_binds_existing_accumulator` (method) — Verifies use_step_usage binds a given accumulator so contributions fold into it, then unbinds on exit. <!--#e0cabeb598eff632-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_worker_thread_without_rebind_does_not_see_scope` (method) — Reproduces the bug where a bare worker thread sees no scope and its usage is discarded. <!--#9c8450d64dfa4818-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_worker_thread_with_rebind_folds_into_parent` (method) — Verifies the fix where workers re-bind the captured accumulator via use_step_usage so their usage folds into the parent. <!--#aa468b0a544eab98-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_concurrent_folds_are_not_lost` (method) — Verifies many threads concurrently folding into one shared accumulator lose no updates due to serialized read-modify-write. <!--#3f756857e7e807ad-->
- `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency` (class) — Tests that the legacy `UsageTotals` projection stays consistent with the authoritative `UsageSummary` computed from the same records, covering token/cost agreement, unknown-versus-zero cost distinctions, and unique call ids so legacy folds are not collapsed by dedup. <!--#e2d32ee9bbd395f3-->
  - `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency._records` (method) — Helper returning a fixed pair of AVAILABLE anthropic `UsageRecord` objects plus the builtin `PricingCatalog`, shared as the fixture for the consistency tests. <!--#9b98b6bd82a0ae33-->
  - `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency.test_token_totals_agree_between_projection_and_summary` (method) — Checks the projected input/output/cache-read/total token counts equal the corresponding `UsageSummary.totals` fields for the same records. <!--#460d652b74066c55-->
  - `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency.test_projection_cost_matches_deduplicated_actual` (method) — Checks the projection's `total_cost_usd` matches the summary's deduplicated `actual_cost_usd`. <!--#0e184d6f18d5644f-->
  - `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency.test_projection_zero_cost_when_actual_unknown` (method) — Documents that the legacy projection flattens unknown cost to `0.0` while `UsageSummary` preserves it as `None` with an `unknown_price_count`. <!--#b5caf67bd4dad368-->
  - `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency.test_no_usage_and_explicit_zero_reach_different_displays` (method) — Verifies a missing-usage record summarises as unknown cost with an unknown-call count, whereas an explicit `0.0` cost summarises as a real zero. <!--#f4fff93c2901d4b1-->
  - `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency.test_distinct_legacy_tallies_are_not_collapsed_by_dedup` (method) — Regression test that two legacy step tallies folded into one flow get distinct call ids, so identity-based dedup no longer silently drops one measurement from the summed totals. <!--#5c03ced728685da6-->
  - `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency.test_record_less_legacy_folds_get_unique_call_ids` (method) — Asserts that adding record-less legacy tallies into separate record-bearing accumulators generates globally unique synthetic call ids. <!--#2076286dd925e0db-->
  - `TestProjectionSummaryConsistency.test_accumulated_usage_projects_from_the_same_records` (method) — Checks that incrementally adding per-record projections yields the same token totals and actual cost as summarising all records at once. <!--#e98201bba0f40d3b-->

### `tests/test_transitive_reduction.py` (python) — Unit test suite for the transitive_reduce algorithm (from tianluo.engine.transitive_reduction), covering edge cases, non-reducible graphs (chains, diamonds, independent groups), removal of redundant transitive edges, input immutability, and preservation of extra fields and group ordering. <!--#7000401fd61a54dd|869eab9a07c73c40-->

- `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange` (class) — Test class verifying graphs with no redundant edges (linear chains, diamonds, independent groups) are returned unchanged. <!--#d779151c586f3030-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange.test_linear_chain_minimal` (method) — Asserts a minimal A→B→C chain with no redundant edges is unchanged. <!--#1bb1243b56655b1f-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange.test_diamond_not_reducible` (method) — Asserts a diamond's two independent edges into D are both essential and not reduced. <!--#b9399ca447fc1374-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange.test_two_independent_groups` (method) — Asserts two unconnected groups each retain empty dependencies. <!--#d21a215a0b5e578e-->

- `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant` (class) — Test class verifying redundant transitive edges are removed across chains, complex DAGs, and multi-root structures. <!--#b78a583848180213-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant.test_linear_chain_with_shortcut` (method) — Asserts a direct A→C edge is dropped when C is already reachable via A→B→C. <!--#ec21bdf86bf1c2d6-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant.test_longer_chain_with_skip` (method) — Asserts redundant A and B edges into D collapse to just C in a four-node chain. <!--#3e5bccb3bbb3fb56-->

  - `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant.test_multiple_roots_with_redundancy` (method) — Asserts redundant root edges (R1, R2) into C are removed, leaving only A and B. <!--#d018e44a6c07a5f0-->
- `TestTransitiveReduceImmutability` (class) — Test class verifying transitive_reduce does not mutate its input and returns fresh objects. <!--#42856ab8b4a25552-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceImmutability.test_does_not_mutate_input` (method) — Asserts the input groups list is unchanged after reduction by comparing against a deep copy. <!--#f24a0f4ca27664b4-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceImmutability.test_returned_list_is_new_object` (method) — Asserts the returned list and its group dicts are new objects, not the inputs. <!--#c3748e7d3153390d-->
- `TestTransitiveReducePreservesFields` (class) — Test class verifying extra group fields and input ordering survive reduction. <!--#aea212cd65523f99-->
  - `TestTransitiveReducePreservesFields.test_extra_keys_preserved` (method) — Asserts non-dependency keys like name and tasks are preserved in the reduced output. <!--#31208ba89d2f1b42-->

### `tests/test_why_comment_guard.py` (python) — Test module for invariant_check's why-comment deletion guard, verifying both the hard channel (deleted/rewritten WHY:/INVARIANT:-marked comments synthesize an anchored violation routing to REVISION_NEEDED, with same-file rewrite/net-count exemptions) and the advisory channel (plain-comment losses go through swallow-on-failure LLM triage into outputs only), plus the no-baseline skip and charter/prompt documentation of the marker and amendment-exemption conventions. <!--#433fbcd1b4007e23|d684febda683edbb-->
- `_clear_recursion_guard` (function) — Fixture helper that unsets SE3_TEST_RUNNING so se3's recursion-guarded command paths aren't short-circuited while this module's tests drive them. <!--#e95495568df3726b-->
- `_git` (function) — Small helper that runs a git subcommand in a given working directory, checking for success and capturing output. <!--#eae0deaeea597400-->
- `_init_repo_with` (function) — Helper that initializes a git repo containing one committed file and returns the baseline commit SHA for diffing against. <!--#6a08cc198849c1cd-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Helper that builds a minimal INIT-status FlowInstance with a change_path for exercising the invariant-check handler. <!--#ffc7ea4176dbfbe2-->
- `_make_step` (function) — Helper that constructs an INVARIANT_CHECK Step wrapping the given inputs dict. <!--#3e4d116d5efe7203-->
- `_install_fake_caller` (function) — Helper that monkeypatches invariant_check.LLMCaller with a scripted fake returning queued responses and recording prompts/call-count. <!--#48f66cdee783b441-->
- `test_helper_reports_deleted_comment` (function) — Asserts _deleted_comments_by_file reports a marked comment that was removed from the working tree relative to baseline. <!--#30876d34f61dd665-->
- `test_helper_reports_rewritten_comment` (function) — Asserts a rewritten marked comment is reported as deleted because its old body no longer appears. <!--#1be207f4f8b628f2-->
- `test_helper_skips_new_file` (function) — Asserts a file that never existed at baseline lost no comments and is silently skipped by the helper. <!--#d7d578da94cd20fd-->
- `test_helper_no_baseline_returns_empty` (function) — Asserts _deleted_comments_by_file returns an empty result when no baseline commit is provided. <!--#72a57724e493dd96-->
- `test_helper_deleted_file_loses_all_comments` (function) — Asserts a file deleted outright is reported as losing every marked comment it carried at baseline. <!--#4f51b9f30611a013-->
- `test_helper_unchanged_comment_not_reported` (function) — Asserts a marked comment that survives verbatim (only surrounding code changed) is not reported as deleted. <!--#3588ef3a41013f25-->
- `test_marked_comment_deletion_triggers_revision` (function) — End-to-end test that deleting a marked WHY comment yields REVISION_NEEDED with a synthesized hard violation anchored on the deleted body and restore/redeclare fix guidance. <!--#7ed6b3a02561dc2e-->
- `test_restored_marked_comment_passes` (function) — Asserts the handler completes cleanly when the marked comment is retained and only the annotated code changed. <!--#8db67bb19d01ff11-->
- `test_rewritten_marked_comment_with_updated_rationale_passes` (function) — Asserts rewriting a marked comment into a new marked comment (declared update) does not block the flow. <!--#7a10b3e6c9bf698d-->
- `test_rewritten_marked_comment_with_wholly_new_rationale_passes` (function) — Regression asserting a marked-comment rewrite with almost no word overlap over the same code slot is still recognized as a re-declaration and passes. <!--#345c2de7f0a00de6-->
- `test_same_file_marked_addition_covers_deletion_one_to_one` (function) — Asserts a same-file marked addition exempts a marked deletion one-to-one (net-count rule), leaving the marked-comment count intact and not blocking. <!--#b2cf421f9f57faca-->
- `test_sibling_marked_comment_in_same_slot_does_not_swallow_deletion` (function) — Regression asserting a verbatim-surviving sibling marked comment does not exempt a genuinely-deleted sibling in the same slot, which still triggers REVISION_NEEDED. <!--#79152e89fe8e251a-->
- `test_both_siblings_rewritten_in_same_slot_are_exempt` (function) — Asserts that when both protected comments over the same code are genuinely rewritten, each old body is exempted by its own replacement. <!--#ba8bdea59ab66bf5-->
- `test_partial_rewrite_in_shared_slot_guards_all_dropped` (function) — Asserts one-to-one pairing exempts only the most-similar deletion when two are dropped but a single new marked comment is added, guarding the unpaired loss. <!--#d44c3dc1aa15a838-->
- `test_rewritten_marked_exemptions_pairs_rewrite_in_place` (function) — Asserts _rewritten_marked_exemptions pairs a deleted marked comment with a new marked comment in the same file, ignoring plain unmarked comments. <!--#ee60f386b03d354e-->
- `test_rewrite_of_comment_and_its_code_together_is_exempt` (function) — Finding-1 regression asserting a marked comment rewritten together with its annotated code is still exempted by same-file pairing. <!--#eb8bd79f70ff479f-->
- `test_eof_marked_comment_rewrite_is_exempt` (function) — Finding-2 regression asserting an end-of-file marked comment with no following code can still be re-declared and exempted. <!--#7e47d2e547e8f30a-->
- `test_cross_file_marked_move_is_not_exempt` (function) — Asserts the same-file-only rule: a marked comment deleted from one file and reappearing in another leaves an unpaired deletion that triggers REVISION_NEEDED. <!--#4667262492202ad6-->
- `test_duplicate_marked_comment_one_rewritten_guards_the_other` (function) — Occurrence-accounting regression asserting two identical dropped marked comments with only one re-declaration exempt exactly one occurrence and guard the other. <!--#355e26734956b956-->
- `test_plain_comment_deletion_is_advisory_only` (function) — Asserts deleting a plain (unmarked) comment routes through an advisory LLM triage recorded in outputs but never becomes a hard violation or fix loop. <!--#7e29f0b4b90596f2-->
- `test_advisory_llm_failure_degrades_silently` (function) — Asserts a crashing advisory re-judge is swallowed and does not disturb the main audit's COMPLETED verdict. <!--#0169d45a8356467e-->
- `test_no_baseline_guard_silently_skips` (function) — Asserts that with no baseline commit the guard cannot diff and silently skips without calling the LLM or blocking. <!--#5b171e62e15a9b86-->
- `test_prompt_carries_amendment_exemption` (function) — Test asserting that invariant_check.INVARIANT_CHECK_PROMPT contains the constitutional-amendment exemption text, references tianluo/charter.md, and scopes the exemption strictly to task-directed clauses. <!--#3da703ca9d309756-->
- `test_charter_declares_marker_prefix_convention` (function) — Test that resolves the charter via runtime_dir() (to tolerate legacy se3/ layout) and verifies charter.md declares the WHY:/INVARIANT: marker convention and references invariant_check. <!--#21cd568f75dd87be-->

### `tests/test_wire_metrics.py` (python) — Unit tests for the daemon's shared WireMetrics accountant, covering per-message-type byte/frame accumulation with a synthetic '__total__' roll-up, defensive snapshot copies, coercion of bad byte sizes to zero, counter reset, thread-safe concurrent recording, and an AST-based guard enforcing core/server import isolation. <!--#860cab6680f9b2e7|cbd6cf441e18950d-->
- `test_record_and_snapshot_accumulate_by_type` (function) — Verifies that WireMetrics.record accumulates bytes and frame counts per message type and that snapshot() exposes a synthetic '__total__' roll-up across all types. <!--#1595c2a1752f867e-->
- `test_snapshot_is_a_copy` (function) — Asserts that snapshot() returns a defensive copy so mutating the returned dict cannot corrupt the accountant's internal state. <!--#5c9d95df602bea98-->
- `test_bad_nbytes_coerced_to_zero` (function) — Checks that invalid byte sizes (negative, None, non-int) are coerced to 0 bytes while still counting the frame. <!--#c5d1609fcb5cf103-->
- `test_reset_clears_counters` (function) — Confirms that reset() clears all per-type counters, leaving only a zeroed '__total__' entry in the snapshot. <!--#741a4bbff2c5173a-->
- `test_concurrent_record_is_thread_safe` (function) — Stress-tests concurrent record() calls from 8 threads to ensure the counters are thread-safe with no lost updates. <!--#cfa97846235431af-->
- `test_no_server_import` (function) — A pytest that AST-parses the source of tianluo.daemon.wire_metrics and asserts none of its imports start with tianluo.server, enforcing isolation of the metrics module from the server package. <!--#ea371cf143933b42-->

### `tests/test_worktree.py` (python) — Test suite for the git worktree helper module, covering get_current_branch (custom, empty-repo, and detached-HEAD cases), create_worktree path/registration behaviour, attachment seeding into forked worktrees via seed_uploads (hard-link sharing with copy fallback, legacy se3/uploads layout, non-clobbering, flat-directory scope, and never failing the fork), and removal paths including remove_worktree and force_cleanup_worktree against locked worktrees and stale metadata. <!--#3ced070ab61433ac|d82bb8e3edc1aa32-->

- `TestCreateWorktree` (class) — Test class verifying create_worktree makes a worktree directory, places it at the expected tianluo/worktrees/wt-<timestamp> path, and registers it with git. <!--#203d5f75f70a2691-->
  - `TestCreateWorktree.test_creates_worktree_directory` (method) — Asserts create_worktree produces an existing directory containing the repo's files. <!--#a68b71794077ad0e-->
  - `TestCreateWorktree.test_worktree_at_expected_path` (method) — Asserts create_worktree returns the path tmp_path/tianluo/worktrees/wt-test derived from the branch's timestamp. <!--#cf24bcfa81af97d2-->
