  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_a_baseline_outside_the_directory_is_refused` (method) — Parametrized check that absolute, `..`-relative, and Windows drive-relative baseline names are refused so reads/writes stay inside the baselines directory. <!--#12ff600fb59da1b0-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_identical_images_pass` (method) — Asserts identical screenshot and baseline pass at tier 2 with a zero difference ratio. <!--#e931d943eebefeda-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_difference_ratio_is_reported` (method) — Asserts a one-pixel difference fails with exact differing/total counts, the ratio, a percentage in the actual, and attached evidence. <!--#da40c1eda0bfda10-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_threshold_admits_a_small_difference` (method) — Asserts a `threshold` above the observed difference ratio lets the assertion pass. <!--#68a01758ea8c4b37-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_geometry_change_is_called_out` (method) — Asserts differing image dimensions fail with `size_mismatch` and both geometries reported. <!--#e643920f71592592-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_missing_baseline_fails_and_explains_how_to_make_one` (method) — Asserts a missing baseline fails with a `--write-baselines` hint and does not silently create the file. <!--#44bb32a442ef62a3-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_write_missing_baselines_captures_but_does_not_pass` (method) — Asserts `write_missing_baselines` writes the baseline but still fails the assertion, since an unreviewed rendering must not become the reference. <!--#4b3e2539f9f0cb15-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_an_earlier_screenshot_action_is_reused` (method) — Asserts a named screenshot captured by an earlier action is reused instead of taking a fresh snapshot. <!--#0f279ec4264d9ce3-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_browser_written_shot_is_copied_out_not_recaptured` (method) — Asserts a Playwright-written screenshot inside the container is copied out by path rather than re-captured. <!--#6b9fa28be77576fe-->
  - `TestScreenshotDiff.test_baseline_without_a_name_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts a screenshot_diff with no `baseline` name raises E2EConfigError. <!--#3e2e42c0c9aa0b2f-->
- `TestPillowIsolation` (class) — Test class guarding that Pillow stays an optional lazy dependency — no top-level PIL import, an actionable install message when it is absent, and per-channel accuracy in compare_images. <!--#95ab976fb8017f55-->
  - `TestPillowIsolation.test_module_has_no_top_level_pil_reference` (method) — Scans the assertions module source to ensure PIL is never imported at module top level. <!--#1546d06be5ac5f13-->
  - `TestPillowIsolation.test_missing_pillow_raises_with_the_install_command` (method) — Blocks PIL imports via a meta_path finder and asserts screenshot_diff raises E2EDependencyMissingError naming Pillow and the `pip install 'tianluo[e2e]'` command. <!--#ae3ff1257fddfbed-->
  - `TestPillowIsolation.test_compare_images_counts_single_channel_drift` (method) — Asserts compare_images detects a one-channel colour shift rather than rounding it away via luminance conversion. <!--#71de3f58ebcf02fc-->
- `FakeCaller` (class) — Test double for the LLM caller that records every call's kwargs and returns a canned answer or raises a canned error. <!--#1f9d68eaee62b064-->
  - `FakeCaller.__init__` (method) — Stores the canned answer or error and initialises the call log. <!--#092b5762f76898a2-->
  - `FakeCaller.call` (method) — Records the call kwargs, then raises the canned error or returns the canned answer. <!--#027b22b3490aa26d-->
- `TestSemanticVisual` (class) — Test class covering tier-3 visual_semantic assertions: the `semantic_visual` opt-in gate, that lower tiers never consult the LLM, verdict/evidence handling and parsing, caller failures, the mandatory question, prompt contents, and the scenario deadline clamp on a hanging or exhausted call. <!--#fa19819d49f4f247-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual._ctx` (method) — Helper building a FakeBackend with screenshot bytes plus a context whose `llm_factory` returns the supplied fake caller. <!--#25a44e593bca626c-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_undeclared_tier_three_is_refused` (method) — Asserts a visual_semantic assertion without the `semantic_visual` opt-in raises E2EConfigError and never consults the LLM. <!--#d804cf862bae1bcb-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_tier_one_assertions_never_reach_the_llm` (method) — Asserts evaluating tier-1 exit_code and dom assertions makes no LLM calls at all. <!--#167db2db0a5c3ac2-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_pass_with_evidence` (method) — Asserts a `pass` verdict with evidence passes at tier 3, carries the evidence through, and attaches the captured artifact as the LLM context file. <!--#c92aaf5b06844ad0-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_verdict_without_evidence_fails` (method) — Asserts a `pass` verdict with blank evidence fails when `require_evidence` is set, with 'evidence' in the message. <!--#f9500b62af960d71-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_negative_verdict_fails` (method) — Asserts a `fail` verdict fails the assertion while still retaining the model's evidence. <!--#3adde0d496ef6deb-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_raw_json_text_is_parsed` (method) — Asserts a raw JSON string answer from the caller is parsed into verdict and evidence. <!--#1b38d76ed166bb84-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_llm_failure_fails_the_assertion` (method) — Asserts an exception from the LLM caller fails the assertion with a 'no usable answer' message instead of propagating. <!--#b74e04d5a0a83444-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_unparseable_answer_fails` (method) — Asserts free-form prose that is not a parseable verdict fails the assertion. <!--#1c3bb000287e5965-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_question_is_mandatory` (method) — Asserts a visual_semantic assertion with no `question` raises E2EConfigError. <!--#27d20a9d33214129-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_a_hanging_llm_is_abandoned_at_the_scenario_budget` (method) — Asserts a blocking LLM call is abandoned at the scenario deadline — the assertion fails quickly with `timed_out` in details rather than holding the step open. <!--#a6c9e47238b9115d-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_an_exhausted_budget_never_reaches_the_llm` (method) — Asserts an already-expired deadline fails the assertion without making any LLM call. <!--#163a883bdb7f0569-->
  - `TestSemanticVisual.test_prompt_demands_reviewable_evidence` (method) — Asserts the generated prompt embeds the user's question, demands a mandatory evidence field, and requests the verdict/evidence keys. <!--#acc338546ee7db09-->
- `TestDispatch` (class) — Test class covering the assertion dispatch layer: unknown kinds raising E2EConfigError, `tier_of` mapping each kind to its tier, and the human-readable `describe()` failure line. <!--#f66b1f3ee0c2ad1b-->
  - `TestDispatch.test_unknown_kind_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts an unrecognised assertion kind raises E2EConfigError naming the offending kind. <!--#9f9df5f227d9711e-->
  - `TestDispatch.test_tier_of` (method) — Parametrized check that `tier_of` classifies each assertion kind into tier 1, 2, or 3. <!--#43cb3db060c11b04-->

### `tests/e2e/test_backend.py` (python) — Unit tests for the E2E isolation-backend contract module, asserting `IsolationBackend` stays an abstract five-verb interface with no extra public methods, that its data contracts (`ServiceSpec`, `EnvironmentSpec`, `EnvironmentHandle`, `ExecResult`, `BindMount`, `ReadinessProbe`) have the expected defaults, lookup, immutability and derived behaviour, and that `backend.py` depends on stdlib only. <!--#fab98ecf2ddfe652|db01960527c47f87-->
- `TestIsolationBackendInterface` (class) — Tests that the `IsolationBackend` ABC stays a narrow five-verb contract — abstract, no extra public methods, and only fully implemented subclasses can be instantiated and driven. <!--#64acb43b4f1a8d33-->
  - `TestIsolationBackendInterface.test_cannot_be_instantiated` (method) — Asserts instantiating the abstract `IsolationBackend` directly raises `TypeError`. <!--#5a841070fe491c17-->
  - `TestIsolationBackendInterface.test_exposes_exactly_the_five_narrow_verbs` (method) — Asserts `IsolationBackend.__abstractmethods__` matches exactly the expected set of five verbs. <!--#9eec476bf6255af2-->
  - `TestIsolationBackendInterface.test_declares_no_extra_public_methods` (method) — Uses `inspect.getmembers` to assert the interface declares no public methods beyond the five expected verbs. <!--#df9175baeae19574-->
  - `TestIsolationBackendInterface.test_a_partial_implementation_is_still_abstract` (method) — Asserts a subclass implementing only `create` remains abstract and raises `TypeError` on instantiation. <!--#b1c5379c534be50e-->
  - `TestIsolationBackendInterface.test_a_complete_implementation_instantiates` (method) — Defines a `Fake` backend implementing all five verbs and checks it instantiates and behaves through a create/start/exec round trip. <!--#0b7eaa3252291ab1-->
- `TestDataContracts` (class) — Tests the backend data contracts (`ServiceSpec`, `EnvironmentSpec`, `EnvironmentHandle`, `ExecResult`, `BindMount`, `ReadinessProbe`) for defaults, lookup, immutability, and derived properties. <!--#771a9927ef0c4e39-->
  - `TestDataContracts.test_service_spec_defaults_describe_a_pull_only_service` (method) — Asserts a bare `ServiceSpec` defaults to no template, build steps, readiness, or environment — i.e. a pull-only external dependency service. <!--#ff15f8472e0fd5c7-->
  - `TestDataContracts.test_environment_spec_looks_services_up_by_name` (method) — Asserts `EnvironmentSpec.service()` returns the matching `ServiceSpec` by name and `None` for unknown names. <!--#1baa661ee1fb9c44-->
  - `TestDataContracts.test_specs_are_immutable` (method) — Asserts mutating a frozen `ServiceSpec` field raises `dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError`. <!--#7e2319be592bab07-->
  - `TestDataContracts.test_handle_is_mutable_so_partial_creation_is_still_destroyable` (method) — Asserts `EnvironmentHandle` is mutable (network id, containers, `started`) so partially created environments can still be torn down. <!--#f169d939f8084df0-->
  - `TestDataContracts.test_exec_result_ok_requires_zero_exit_and_no_timeout` (method) — Asserts `ExecResult.ok` is true only for exit code 0 without a timeout. <!--#5222292628c8d114-->
  - `TestDataContracts.test_bind_mount_is_read_write_by_default` (method) — Asserts `BindMount.read_only` defaults to `False`. <!--#edcaaa6cc2e7a9c7-->
  - `TestDataContracts.test_readiness_probe_carries_a_budget` (method) — Asserts a `ReadinessProbe` comes with positive default `timeout` and `interval` budgets. <!--#ab099873074951e3-->
- `test_module_imports_only_stdlib` (function) — Scans `backend.py` source line by line to assert the backend contract module imports only stdlib modules, with no third-party dependency creeping in. <!--#806c376f3dfa03ae-->

### `tests/e2e/test_bootstrap.py` (python) — Tests for `bootstrap.ensure_content`: using a scripted FakeCaller, fixtures, and file snapshots, it covers generation happy paths, unusable on-disk content failing fast, validate-then-write retry bounds, path-traversal containment, and the invariant that `tianluo.yaml` is never modified. <!--#8e8fa84e544c6cf9|b0e343f3ca9bb35e-->
- `FakeCaller` (class) — Scripted stand-in for the engine's `LLMCaller` that records prompts and returns queued answers in order (repeating the last), raising them if they are exceptions and JSON-encoding non-string values. <!--#98a53d515bc17a7e-->
  - `FakeCaller.__init__` (method) — Stores the scripted response queue and initialises the list that records every prompt the code under test sends. <!--#17052ff7c6f9855d-->
  - `FakeCaller.call` (method) — Records the prompt and returns the next scripted answer — raising it if it is an exception, passing strings through, and JSON-dumping anything else. <!--#2cbd8853a1816d35-->
- `env_doc` (function) — Builds a minimal valid e2e environment document (one `app` service with build and readiness) with optional key overrides. <!--#c3000cd8b366d9da-->
- `scenario_doc` (function) — Builds a minimal valid scenario document (an `exec` action plus an `exit_code` assertion) with optional name and key overrides. <!--#3b0f9a0797a3cca9-->
- `generation` (function) — Assembles the `{environment, scenarios}` payload a model is expected to return from a generation call, defaulting to the sample environment and one `cli-smoke.yaml` scenario. <!--#b84672eb6b513b0d-->
- `project` (function) — Fixture creating a temporary project root with a `pyproject.toml` so the context collector recognises it as a real project. <!--#be89cb3d675dfc9b-->
- `write_content` (function) — Writes a valid `tianluo/e2e` content directory (environment plus scenario files) directly to disk, bypassing the model. <!--#db37de135716f50c-->
- `snapshot` (function) — Captures every file under a root as a relative-path-to-bytes mapping, so tests can assert that nothing was written or changed. <!--#dc06d5628460db3a-->
- `TestEnsureContent` (class) — Covers `bootstrap.ensure_content` happy paths: generating both documents when nothing exists, producing loader-accepted content, seeding `baselines/`, and leaving existing (or half-existing) content untouched. <!--#49a39e418d36d681-->
  - `TestEnsureContent.test_generates_both_documents_when_nothing_exists` (method) — Asserts a fresh project gets both the environment and the scenario written, with `created` true and the expected relative paths reported. <!--#d27d55fe90f9b690-->
  - `TestEnsureContent.test_generated_content_is_loadable` (method) — Asserts that content produced by generation is subsequently accepted by `load_content_config`, yielding the expected service and scenario names. <!--#f8271622b24e89b3-->
  - `TestEnsureContent.test_baselines_directory_is_seeded` (method) — Asserts generation creates the `baselines/.gitkeep` placeholder so the baseline directory exists from the start. <!--#b5c895bbb4bf23a1-->
  - `TestEnsureContent.test_existing_content_is_left_alone_without_calling_the_model` (method) — Asserts that a fully bootstrapped project is a no-op: nothing written, no prompt sent, and the file snapshot unchanged. <!--#bce1d720f9028150-->
  - `TestEnsureContent.test_existing_environment_is_used_and_not_rewritten` (method) — Asserts a directory with only an environment gets just the missing scenario generated, the environment stays byte-identical, and its topology is fed into the prompt. <!--#6728c911ac9e5e04-->
- `TestUnusableContentOnDisk` (class) — Asserts that empty or unparsable on-disk content is treated as an error rather than an absence — failing before any model call and never rewriting the file. <!--#50c06db631c14ad8-->
  - `TestUnusableContentOnDisk.test_an_unusable_environment_fails_before_any_model_call` (method) — Parametrised over empty, comment-only, and malformed environment YAML, asserting `E2EConfigError` is raised with no prompt sent and no file touched. <!--#b9332f8f01277d9a-->
  - `TestUnusableContentOnDisk.test_an_unusable_scenario_file_fails_before_any_model_call` (method) — Asserts an empty scenario file raises `E2EConfigError` naming that file, before any model call. <!--#a25a115b57cee070-->
- `TestGenerationIsValidatedBeforeWriting` (class) — Covers the validate-then-write contract for generation: retry with validator complaints, accept declared tier-2 scenarios, and write nothing on persistent invalidity, unparsable answers, caller errors, or exhausted attempts. <!--#805b00fa23060a49-->
  - `TestGenerationIsValidatedBeforeWriting.test_a_ladder_violation_is_retried_with_the_validator_complaints` (method) — Asserts an assertion-ladder violation triggers a second call whose prompt carries the validator complaint (`visual_regression`), and that the retry succeeds. <!--#742194fa130edd9b-->
  - `TestGenerationIsValidatedBeforeWriting.test_a_declared_tier2_scenario_is_accepted_before_its_baseline_exists` (method) — Asserts a scenario declaring `visual_regression: true` is accepted on the first attempt even though its baseline image does not yet exist. <!--#de22a6757c1f50f5-->
  - `TestGenerationIsValidatedBeforeWriting.test_a_persistently_invalid_proposal_writes_nothing` (method) — Asserts a proposal that stays invalid across retries raises `E2EConfigError` and leaves the project byte-identical, including no environment file. <!--#bbbb4e3819965394-->
  - `TestGenerationIsValidatedBeforeWriting.test_attempts_are_bounded` (method) — Asserts retries stop at `bootstrap.MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS` prompts before failing. <!--#89615cad0c16a7fb-->
  - `TestGenerationIsValidatedBeforeWriting.test_an_unparsable_answer_writes_nothing` (method) — Asserts a non-JSON model reply raises `E2EConfigError` and leaves the project unchanged. <!--#6fb8ab3f22487c67-->
  - `TestGenerationIsValidatedBeforeWriting.test_a_caller_failure_writes_nothing` (method) — Asserts an exception from the LLM caller surfaces as `E2EConfigError` with nothing written to disk. <!--#af051962907d2355-->
- `TestWriteContainment` (class) — Asserts that model-supplied file names cannot escape the content directory, both end-to-end and through the `_resolve_target` guard directly. <!--#7b05a60e89b66fc6-->
  - `TestWriteContainment.test_a_traversing_file_name_is_dropped` (method) — Asserts a `../../evil.yaml` scenario name fails generation and creates no file inside or above the project root. <!--#45bba64781dd5526-->
  - `TestWriteContainment.test_the_containment_guard_refuses_an_escaping_path` (method) — Asserts `bootstrap._resolve_target` itself rejects a traversing path, exercising the last line of defence directly. <!--#f88402b130be8bde-->
- `TestNeverWritesProjectConfig` (class) — Asserts the module's central invariant — neither generation nor evolution ever modifies `tianluo.yaml`, verified behaviourally and by inspecting the module source for write targets. <!--#6ca1dd6f6797060e-->
  - `TestNeverWritesProjectConfig.test_generation_leaves_tianluo_yaml_byte_identical` (method) — Asserts `ensure_content` leaves an existing `tianluo.yaml` byte-for-byte unchanged. <!--#b8ea273e7f5d88d8-->
  - `TestNeverWritesProjectConfig.test_evolution_leaves_tianluo_yaml_byte_identical` (method) — Asserts `evolve_content` leaves an existing `tianluo.yaml` byte-for-byte unchanged while applying a scenario addition. <!--#68fac01f8909ce03-->
  - `TestNeverWritesProjectConfig.test_no_write_path_targets_the_project_config` (method) — Scans the bootstrap module source to assert no `write_text`/`open(` line names `tianluo.yaml`, so the only mentions are prose. <!--#1f25e37223aff764-->
- `TestEvolveContent` (class) — Covers `bootstrap.evolve_content`: surgical `append`/`set` updates that preserve hand-written content, adding files, refusing overwrite and deletion, idempotent re-application, incremental environment growth, and error handling for corrupt content or bad proposals. <!--#9e280dd497f6aadf-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_appending_an_assertion_preserves_everything_else` (method) — Asserts an `append` of one assertion keeps description, tags, timeout, actions, and the original assertion intact. <!--#0b3c312eb1509244-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_set_replaces_only_the_named_keys` (method) — Asserts a `set` operation changes only the named key (`timeout`) and leaves driver and assertions untouched. <!--#b910ca1dfdcb1636-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_adding_a_new_scenario_file` (method) — Asserts an `add` operation writes the new scenario file and that both scenarios then load from the content config. <!--#8002bab510b97f5e-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_add_over_an_existing_file_is_refused` (method) — Asserts an `add` targeting an existing file is skipped rather than applied, leaving the file byte-identical. <!--#a25c002937ab4d31-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_no_operation_can_delete_a_scenario` (method) — Asserts a `delete` operation is ignored and the scenario file survives. <!--#48fc5e120fa984e3-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_repeating_the_same_append_changes_nothing` (method) — Asserts idempotence — re-applying the same append writes nothing, reports `evolved` false, and does not duplicate the assertion. <!--#87a8dd176d566e8f-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_evolving_an_unbootstrapped_project_generates_instead` (method) — Asserts evolving a project with no content falls through to generation, reporting `created` and writing the environment. <!--#d0a91bf7cd2bdf1f-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_a_corrupted_scenario_file_is_reported_not_silently_completed` (method) — Asserts a valid environment paired with an unparsable scenario raises `E2EConfigError` instead of being treated as nothing-to-evolve, with no prompt sent and no file changed. <!--#24a9ce86f14a6550-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_an_invalid_proposal_degrades_instead_of_breaking_the_run` (method) — Asserts an invalid evolution proposal is discarded into `result.errors` — nothing written, existing content preserved — rather than raising. <!--#36ef68f4ed7be312-->
  - `TestEvolveContent.test_the_environment_can_gain_a_service_incrementally` (method) — Asserts an environment `append` adds a new service while the original service keeps its build steps. <!--#1788e1d6709c50cb-->
- `TestSuggestEnable` (class) — Covers `bootstrap.suggest_enable`: it emits an `e2e.enabled` hint for a fitting project, writes nothing at all, and stays silent when e2e is enabled, content exists, or the project has no recognisable shape. <!--#8d5b364b14b5da8c-->
  - `TestSuggestEnable.test_suggests_for_a_project_that_looks_like_a_fit` (method) — Asserts a recognisable project yields a non-empty message mentioning `e2e.enabled`. <!--#5b455ce2a5281e22-->
  - `TestSuggestEnable.test_writes_nothing_at_all` (method) — Asserts the suggestion is purely advisory — the file snapshot is unchanged and no `tianluo.yaml` is created. <!--#65c2310fc02ecc69-->
  - `TestSuggestEnable.test_silent_when_e2e_is_already_enabled` (method) — Asserts no suggestion is produced when `tianluo.yaml` already sets `e2e.enabled: true`. <!--#5645232177008d09-->
  - `TestSuggestEnable.test_silent_when_content_already_exists` (method) — Asserts no suggestion is produced when the e2e content directory is already present. <!--#11c642ac38abee1c-->
  - `TestSuggestEnable.test_silent_for_a_project_with_no_recognisable_shape` (method) — Asserts an empty directory yields no suggestion. <!--#837d97229fa7f827-->
- `TestShippedExamples` (class) — Asserts the packaged `environment.example.yaml` and `scenario.example.yaml` assets are readable, pass `validate_content`, and demonstrate all three base kinds. <!--#786fca1713bac539-->
  - `TestShippedExamples.test_both_example_documents_ship_with_the_package` (method) — Asserts `bootstrap._read_asset` returns non-empty text for both shipped example documents. <!--#457f7f96f6bc5b01-->
  - `TestShippedExamples.test_the_examples_satisfy_the_schema` (method) — Asserts the shipped examples validate cleanly, so the reference sample never teaches a shape the validator would reject. <!--#62ae6d40eeb47307-->
  - `TestShippedExamples.test_the_example_scenario_illustrates_the_three_base_kinds` (method) — Asserts the example environment text mentions `base`, `playwright`, and `gui-xvfb`. <!--#8448e4b2592ff1ce-->
- `TestDependencyIsolation` (class) — Asserts the bootstrap module keeps its LLM-stack imports off the core import path. <!--#3a8b60f3d4f42bc2-->
  - `TestDependencyIsolation.test_the_llm_caller_import_lives_inside_a_function` (method) — Scans the module source to assert every `LLMCaller`/`parse_json_response` import line is indented, i.e. function-scoped rather than module-scope. <!--#9df8e7ad69c11beb-->

### `tests/e2e/test_cli_e2e_cmd.py` (python) — Test suite for the `luo e2e` command group, pinning its exit codes (0/1/3/4), its pass-through of flags and probe results to `session.run_e2e`/`runtime_probe`/`bootstrap`, and its runtime-free wiring — without touching docker, podman, or an LLM. <!--#eafa0beeeda5901a|4906979729906565-->
- `output_of` (function) — Test helper that concatenates a Click result's stdout and stderr into one string so assertions can match output regardless of which stream it went to. <!--#96b5ddf6134cbe2b-->
- `project` (function) — Pytest fixture building a temporary project with `e2e.enabled` in `tianluo.yaml` plus a valid `tianluo/e2e/` content directory (one service, one `cli-smoke` scenario). <!--#d1deef85112f2bf8-->
- `usable_runtime` (function) — Pytest fixture that monkeypatches `preflight` to report a healthy docker runtime so CLI tests never touch a real container engine. <!--#b31c7f46ca939140-->
- `passing_verdict` (function) — Helper constructing an all-passing `E2EVerdict` for the given scenario names, with a matching summary block. <!--#20f32db20a289a77-->
- `failing_verdict` (function) — Helper constructing a failing `E2EVerdict` for `cli-smoke`, including fix instructions and a failed-scenario summary. <!--#6593b2a0e166b85d-->
- `_add_visual_scenario` (function) — Helper that writes a tier-2 `screenshot_diff` scenario whose baseline image has never been captured, for exercising the `--write-baselines` path. <!--#22c2473f808773d4-->
- `stub_run` (function) — Helper that replaces `session.run_e2e` with a recorder returning (or raising) the supplied verdict, so tests can inspect exactly what arguments the CLI passed. <!--#e3e38ab41bfbc631-->
- `TestRun` (class) — Test class covering `luo e2e run`: exit codes for pass/scenario-failure/environment/config outcomes, localized output, absolute project root, and the pass-through of `--scenario`, `--keep`, `--write-baselines`, and the probe result. <!--#abc71c9f7eaab635-->
  - `TestRun.test_all_passing_exits_zero` (method) — Asserts an all-passing verdict makes `run` exit `EXIT_OK` and print the all-passed message. <!--#94d64843a482b66d-->
  - `TestRun.test_a_failed_scenario_exits_one` (method) — Asserts a failing verdict makes `run` exit `EXIT_SCENARIO_FAILED` and name the failed scenario. <!--#2be51fd32044753e-->
  - `TestRun.test_the_failed_scenario_line_is_localized` (method) — Asserts the per-scenario console line goes through `t()` rather than the hardcoded English `summary_line()`, so zh-CN output contains no `[PASS]`/`[FAIL]` markers. <!--#d58d079ee6263154-->
  - `TestRun.test_a_relative_project_root_reaches_the_session_absolute` (method) — Asserts `-p .` is resolved to an absolute path before reaching the session, since relative paths are invalid as container bind-mount hosts. <!--#a55c9224dc7c0353-->
  - `TestRun.test_a_preflight_failure_exits_with_the_environment_code` (method) — Asserts an `E2EEnvironmentError` from preflight exits `EXIT_ENVIRONMENT` (distinct from the scenario-failure code) and prints the remediation. <!--#c1fdc90bda8853d9-->
  - `TestRun.test_an_environment_verdict_also_exits_with_the_environment_code` (method) — Asserts a verdict carrying `environment_error` also exits `EXIT_ENVIRONMENT` and prints its remediation, not just a raised exception. <!--#041c50c1f57814d6-->
  - `TestRun.test_missing_content_exits_with_the_config_code` (method) — Asserts a project with no `tianluo/e2e/` content exits `EXIT_CONFIG` and points the user at `luo e2e bootstrap`. <!--#e3e19c08666925e9-->
  - `TestRun.test_inadmissible_content_exits_with_the_config_code` (method) — Asserts a tier-2 scenario missing its `visual_regression` opt-in is rejected at load time with `EXIT_CONFIG`. <!--#1a9b575317b47bfe-->
  - `TestRun.test_scenario_selection_reaches_the_session` (method) — Asserts repeated `--scenario` flags arrive at `run_e2e` as the expected name list. <!--#cab8997794d0dedc-->
  - `TestRun.test_keep_and_write_baselines_reach_the_session` (method) — Asserts `--keep` and `--write-baselines` reach the session as `keep_environment=True` and `write_missing_baselines=True`. <!--#8a592544372e2742-->
  - `TestRun.test_write_baselines_gets_past_a_not_yet_captured_baseline` (method) — Asserts `--write-baselines` relaxes load-time validation so a scenario with an absent baseline image still loads and runs. <!--#ea50765f4f460f76-->
  - `TestRun.test_without_the_flag_a_missing_baseline_is_a_configuration_error` (method) — Asserts that without `--write-baselines` an uncaptured baseline is an `EXIT_CONFIG` error naming the missing image. <!--#d5959bdac8e97e0d-->
  - `TestRun.test_a_kept_environment_prints_the_cleanup_commands` (method) — Asserts verdict notices (e.g. the manual `docker rm`/`network rm` cleanup commands) are printed to the console, since `luo` installs no logging handler. <!--#bb83f61c4addffa7-->
  - `TestRun.test_without_keep_the_configured_value_still_decides` (method) — Asserts omitting `--keep` passes `keep_environment=None` so the configured value still applies rather than being forced off. <!--#34ae71f05a7e07c0-->
  - `TestRun.test_the_probe_result_is_handed_on_rather_than_probed_twice` (method) — Asserts the CLI forwards its preflight `RuntimeProbeResult` to the session instead of making it probe the runtime again. <!--#61ef5d962cf1dd4d-->
  - `TestRun.test_a_disabled_project_is_told_so_but_still_runs` (method) — Asserts that with `e2e.enabled: false` the command still runs and exits `EXIT_OK`, only noting the setting, because manual invocation is itself the intent. <!--#35171f9f8a25b039-->
- `TestList` (class) — Test class covering `luo e2e list`: it prints declared services and scenarios, requires no container runtime, and exits `EXIT_CONFIG` when content is missing. <!--#7efee35c37b92e83-->
  - `TestList.test_lists_services_and_scenarios` (method) — Asserts `list` prints the service name, its image, and the scenario name. <!--#f3b39e8b9687dd87-->
  - `TestList.test_needs_no_container_runtime` (method) — Asserts `list` never calls `preflight` or `probe_one`, so it works on hosts that cannot run containers. <!--#f2d1024045141641-->
  - `TestList.test_missing_content_exits_with_the_config_code` (method) — Asserts `list` on a project without e2e content exits `EXIT_CONFIG`. <!--#be05acdb2f786790-->
- `stub_probe` (function) — Helper that replaces `probe_one` with a fake answering from a runtime-name → usable map while recording the probe order. <!--#29647c9a2e380829-->
- `TestDoctor` (class) — Test class covering `luo e2e doctor`: reporting the usable runtime, printing repair routes and exiting `EXIT_ENVIRONMENT` when none work, probing every candidate under auto but only the configured one when explicit, and creating no files. <!--#1e9837768967000c-->
  - `TestDoctor.test_reports_the_usable_runtime_and_exits_zero` (method) — Asserts `doctor` names the working runtime and exits `EXIT_OK` when docker is usable. <!--#545615727c1860ea-->
  - `TestDoctor.test_prints_the_three_repair_routes_and_exits_non_zero` (method) — Asserts that with no usable runtime `doctor` exits `EXIT_ENVIRONMENT` and prints the docker-group, podman, and rootless repair routes. <!--#7cf9c2800ba42fe9-->
  - `TestDoctor.test_auto_reports_every_candidate` (method) — Asserts auto-detection probes both `docker` and `podman` rather than stopping at the first success, so the diagnostic stays complete. <!--#a17685e99e730da6-->
  - `TestDoctor.test_an_explicit_runtime_is_probed_alone` (method) — Asserts a configured `runtime: podman` is probed alone with no silent fallback to docker, exiting `EXIT_ENVIRONMENT` when it fails. <!--#7ecf0a98326f91f1-->
  - `TestDoctor.test_creates_nothing` (method) — Asserts `doctor` is purely diagnostic by comparing the project's file tree before and after the run. <!--#7dbcee57c7bd3f62-->
- `TestBootstrap` (class) — Test class covering `luo e2e bootstrap`: reporting generated files, the already-present no-op, routing `--hint` to incremental evolution, `EXIT_CONFIG` on generation failure, and treating a discarded evolution as a report rather than an error. <!--#2a5f69e76677fddb-->
  - `TestBootstrap.test_reports_what_it_generated` (method) — Asserts `bootstrap` exits `EXIT_OK` and prints the paths `ensure_content` reports as written. <!--#8d15c0460e425607-->
  - `TestBootstrap.test_says_so_when_there_was_nothing_to_do` (method) — Asserts an empty `BootstrapResult` yields `EXIT_OK` with an "already present" message. <!--#cdc2458de7da79f0-->
  - `TestBootstrap.test_hints_route_to_incremental_evolution` (method) — Asserts `--hint` takes the `evolve_content` path (never `ensure_content`) and forwards the hint text verbatim. <!--#2615280da831cad3-->
  - `TestBootstrap.test_a_generation_failure_exits_with_the_config_code` (method) — Asserts an `E2EConfigError` from `ensure_content` exits `EXIT_CONFIG` with the error message shown. <!--#d4c40936b4f81b06-->
  - `TestBootstrap.test_a_discarded_evolution_is_reported_but_not_an_error` (method) — Asserts a rejected evolution suggestion is printed but still exits `EXIT_OK`, since the suite on disk remains valid. <!--#b925731c4f0c400b-->
- `TestWiring` (class) — Test class checking structural wiring of the e2e command group: all four subcommands registered, reachable from the root CLI, no module-level e2e imports, and distinct exit codes avoiding Click's 2. <!--#6ceae99cb5aeec86-->
  - `TestWiring.test_every_subcommand_is_registered_and_documented` (method) — Asserts `--help` lists `run`, `list`, `doctor`, and `bootstrap`. <!--#d73d3bec16f7c30e-->
  - `TestWiring.test_the_group_is_reachable_from_the_root_cli` (method) — Asserts `luo e2e --help` works through the root `cli.app`, confirming the group is mounted. <!--#9ca75ae6f1196a55-->
  - `TestWiring.test_the_module_defers_every_e2e_import` (method) — Asserts `e2e_cmd.py` has no module-level `..e2e` imports, keeping the optional extra off the core CLI import path. <!--#fbdfd2277483d9fc-->
  - `TestWiring.test_the_exit_codes_stay_distinct` (method) — Asserts the four exit-code constants are mutually distinct and none is 2, which Click reserves for usage errors. <!--#bf90916eba911271-->

### `tests/e2e/test_config_schema.py` (python) — Test suite for the e2e content config schema validators, using small document-builder helpers to pin happy-path acceptance of all documented base kinds, readiness kinds, tier-1 assertions, and programmatic actions, plus `validate_environment` rejection rules (document shape, service naming/uniqueness, image, build steps, readiness companion fields and budgets, env map, network name) and the host-reachability rule that `http`/`tcp` probes must target a published host port while in-container `command` probes are unconstrained. <!--#9e8733779f835c07|751927b1770644d6-->
- `environment` (function) — Test helper building a minimal valid two-service (app/db) environment document, with overrides merged in. <!--#e6df7decd392a6e6-->
- `scenario` (function) — Test helper building a minimal valid tier-1 scenario document, with overrides merged in. <!--#eb94031c9557936d-->
- `bundle` (function) — Test helper assembling an environment plus scenario map into the whole-bundle shape `validate_content` expects. <!--#7491ccbb5f176b1e-->
- `located` (function) — Test helper filtering a validation error list down to those anchored at exactly one source file and document path. <!--#d76e0aebd228c391-->
- `TestValidContent` (class) — Happy-path suite asserting that minimal bundles and every documented base kind, readiness kind, tier-1 assertion, and programmatic action validate without errors. <!--#d929854e1e761982-->
  - `TestValidContent.test_minimal_bundle_has_no_errors` (method) — Asserts the minimal two-service bundle validates clean. <!--#5ae24f96a844dba2-->
  - `TestValidContent.test_single_service_topology_is_valid` (method) — Asserts a one-service topology with no ports or readiness is a valid bundle. <!--#b6a548db07583477-->
  - `TestValidContent.test_every_base_kind_is_accepted` (method) — Parametrized check that each declared `BASE_KINDS` value validates and service names are returned. <!--#ba8d0338a61516f4-->
  - `TestValidContent.test_every_readiness_kind_is_accepted` (method) — Parametrized check that command/http/tcp/log readiness probes each validate. <!--#b2c25ea9caa3fc7d-->
  - `TestValidContent.test_every_tier1_assertion_is_accepted_without_declaration` (method) — Parametrized check that every tier-1 assertion kind validates with no opt-in flag. <!--#08c5e5a5ec1ebcc8-->
  - `TestValidContent.test_every_programmatic_action_is_accepted` (method) — Parametrized check that every programmatic action kind (exec/http/browser/wait/screenshot) validates. <!--#24958c16bab9a95a-->
- `TestEnvironmentRules` (class) — Suite covering `validate_environment` rejection rules — document shape, service names/uniqueness, image, base kind, build steps, readiness fields, env map, and network name. <!--#69627e1c88c7ae9d-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_non_mapping_document` (method) — Asserts a non-mapping environment document is reported at `<root>` and yields no service names. <!--#3f61f43935fab55b-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_services_missing` (method) — Asserts a missing `services` key is reported. <!--#1b90681519ec9729-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_services_not_a_list` (method) — Asserts `services` given as a mapping is reported. <!--#f3aeee5379f3e109-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_services_empty` (method) — Asserts an empty `services` list is reported. <!--#c32d0ad6f43d7e02-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_service_entry_not_a_mapping` (method) — Asserts a non-mapping service entry is reported at its index. <!--#2698b82ccd7990c3-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_service_name_missing` (method) — Asserts a service without a `name` is reported at `services[0].name`. <!--#71abeb1b60ff09e5-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_service_name_must_be_a_dns_label` (method) — Parametrized check that non-DNS-label service names are rejected and excluded from the returned names. <!--#579a973a08382bb2-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_service_names_must_be_unique` (method) — Asserts a duplicate service name is reported at the second occurrence while the first is still returned. <!--#7696291346c52400-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_image_required` (method) — Asserts a service without an `image` is reported. <!--#c957de4f15831c4c-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_unknown_base_kind` (method) — Asserts an unrecognised `base_kind` is reported. <!--#23d05ffbe236cf09-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_build_steps_must_be_a_list` (method) — Asserts a string `build` value is reported. <!--#b39539f3176b2c52-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_build_step_must_be_a_string` (method) — Asserts a non-string build step is reported at its item index. <!--#381f077fda220387-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_unknown_readiness_kind` (method) — Asserts an unrecognised readiness `kind` is reported. <!--#58c98053b4870da9-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_readiness_requires_its_companion_field` (method) — Parametrized check that each readiness kind reports its missing companion field (command/url/port/pattern). <!--#21290eee52f96722-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_readiness_budgets_must_be_positive` (method) — Asserts a zero `timeout` or `interval` on a readiness probe is reported. <!--#e5f19159ba84c520-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_environment_map_must_be_a_mapping` (method) — Asserts a list-valued service `environment` is reported. <!--#b317b5e4168442a1-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_network_name_must_be_a_dns_label` (method) — Asserts a non-DNS-label `network` name is reported. <!--#5d684de257ba840a-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_valid_network_name_accepted` (method) — Asserts a well-formed `network` name validates clean. <!--#2196cef9ccd971b3-->
  - `TestEnvironmentRules.test_readiness_kinds_are_exactly_the_documented_four` (method) — Pins `READINESS_KINDS` to exactly command/http/tcp/log. <!--#0ec57071d51eeb1c-->
- `TestReadinessReachability` (class) — Suite pinning the rule that host-dialled `http`/`tcp` probes must name a published host port, while in-container `command` probes and external hosts are unconstrained. <!--#d961a7472d3ceabf-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.probe_errors` (method) — Helper validating an environment with a substituted readiness probe (and optional ports) and returning only the errors anchored at that probe. <!--#671abc33fadf168e-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_http_probe_naming_an_in_network_service_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts an http probe using an in-network service hostname is rejected as undialable from the host. <!--#4967dac514826804-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_http_probe_on_an_unpublished_loopback_port_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a loopback http probe on the container-side port rather than the published host port is rejected. <!--#ce5db6a124971802-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_http_probe_on_the_published_host_port_is_accepted` (method) — Asserts a loopback http probe on the actually published host port validates. <!--#52c667679a102c28-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_a_service_publishing_nothing_cannot_carry_an_http_probe` (method) — Asserts a loopback http probe on a service that publishes no ports is rejected. <!--#184ddb8bca36fb3e-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_command_probes_are_unconstrained_because_they_run_inside` (method) — Asserts `command` probes escape the reachability rule because they execute inside the container. <!--#8e8ba19978aad181-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_tcp_probe_defaults_to_loopback_and_needs_the_port_published` (method) — Asserts a tcp probe is rejected on the container-side port and accepted on the published host port. <!--#495446fff4d306e1-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_an_ephemeral_host_port_mapping_is_not_second_guessed` (method) — Asserts a bare `-p 8000`-style ephemeral mapping suppresses the reachability check since the host port is unknowable. <!--#bc3d14a84fef1c4a-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_an_external_host_is_left_alone` (method) — Asserts a probe against a non-loopback external host is not subject to the published-port rule. <!--#fa4717ff8b82d44a-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_expected_http_status_is_accepted` (method) — Asserts an explicit expected `status` (e.g. 401) on an http probe validates. <!--#287e19d0384bdf1c-->
  - `TestReadinessReachability.test_a_nonsensical_expected_status_is_rejected` (method) — Parametrized check that out-of-range, string, or boolean expected statuses are reported at `readiness.status`. <!--#9c472ad418302aa7-->
- `TestReadinessFieldTypes` (class) — Suite asserting readiness field *values* (not just presence) are type-checked, so `ServiceDecl.to_spec` coercion never surfaces a bare ValueError instead of a located config error. <!--#306653db241125a3-->
  - `TestReadinessFieldTypes.field_errors` (method) — Helper validating an environment with a substituted probe and returning errors whose location prefix-matches a given field path. <!--#1010f57da1d71ea6-->
  - `TestReadinessFieldTypes.test_a_non_port_tcp_port_is_rejected` (method) — Parametrized check that non-integer, out-of-range, boolean, or float tcp ports are reported. <!--#fed55a9829b185ef-->
  - `TestReadinessFieldTypes.test_a_malformed_command_is_rejected` (method) — Parametrized check that non-list, empty, or non-string-item readiness commands are reported. <!--#9d6a42b5f7276f79-->
  - `TestReadinessFieldTypes.test_a_well_formed_command_still_validates` (method) — Asserts a well-formed argv readiness command produces no errors. <!--#bbe5ea5ae1da94d3-->
  - `TestReadinessFieldTypes.test_a_non_string_url_is_rejected` (method) — Parametrized check that non-string readiness URLs are reported. <!--#b8d31bd4ef850a3a-->
  - `TestReadinessFieldTypes.test_a_non_finite_readiness_budget_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts inf/NaN `timeout` or `interval` budgets are reported rather than producing an unreachable deadline. <!--#61f23fd623048162-->
  - `TestReadinessFieldTypes.test_a_non_finite_scenario_timeout_never_reaches_the_loader` (method) — End-to-end check that a NaN scenario timeout raises `E2EConfigError` from `load_content_config`, not a ValueError. <!--#5695a1552049ce62-->
  - `TestReadinessFieldTypes.test_a_malformed_probe_never_reaches_the_conversion_layer` (method) — End-to-end check that a non-numeric tcp port raises `E2EConfigError` from the loader rather than a ValueError out of `int()`. <!--#84d196e3cf317720-->
- `TestScenarioRules` (class) — Suite covering `validate_scenario` rules — required name/driver, driver-must-exist cross-check, timeout, action/assertion kinds and fields, `fail_fast` typing, playwright capability gating, and browser-action ordering. <!--#8e5496abdc1bedcf-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.validate` (method) — Helper calling `validate_scenario` with the suite's default service names and environment source. <!--#616f00bd8fc08daf-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_name_required` (method) — Asserts a scenario missing `name` is reported. <!--#fb477f7a33192388-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_driver_required` (method) — Asserts a scenario missing `driver` is reported. <!--#3a3f36d6eac98ad2-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_driver_must_name_a_declared_service` (method) — Asserts an unknown driver is reported with both the offending name and the environment source in the message. <!--#83a40d090c24d8fe-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_driver_accepted_when_declared` (method) — Asserts a driver naming a declared service validates clean. <!--#96fbec7b315cda11-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_timeout_must_be_positive` (method) — Asserts a zero scenario timeout is reported. <!--#48a31cfaa46d87b1-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_positive_timeout_accepted` (method) — Asserts a positive scenario timeout validates clean. <!--#5719b04af5d371e7-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_non_finite_timeout_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts inf/-inf/NaN timeouts are reported, since they survive a bare `<= 0` test and later crash the conversion layer. <!--#1b9bc5ece795e381-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_assertions_required` (method) — Asserts a scenario missing `assertions` is reported. <!--#a36addaebae788cb-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_empty_assertions_rejected` (method) — Asserts an empty `assertions` list is reported. <!--#8ecbbddf83d08eb9-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_unknown_assertion_kind` (method) — Asserts an unrecognised assertion kind is reported. <!--#1b775d04d10ef6c4-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_unknown_action_kind` (method) — Asserts an unrecognised action kind is reported. <!--#058152b392be1940-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_action_missing_required_field` (method) — Asserts an `exec` action without `command` is reported at that field. <!--#f5f9c9e42461caa5-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_action_needing_one_of_several_fields` (method) — Asserts an action satisfying none of its alternative required fields is reported at the action itself. <!--#a657de1ea0d4852b-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_assertion_missing_required_field` (method) — Asserts a `dom` assertion without `selector` is reported at that field. <!--#b171df1462259e79-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_assertion_needing_one_of_several_fields` (method) — Asserts an assertion satisfying none of its alternative required fields is reported at the assertion itself. <!--#a47ee8e3db6c45f1-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_a_non_boolean_fail_fast_is_rejected` (method) — Parametrized check that a non-boolean `fail_fast` is reported rather than silently dropped by the identity-based parse layer. <!--#37bd1b814ab94be6-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_a_boolean_fail_fast_is_accepted` (method) — Asserts a genuine boolean `fail_fast` validates clean. <!--#6aac32edcef28d49-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_a_dom_assertion_needs_a_playwright_driver` (method) — Asserts a `dom` assertion on a non-playwright driver is caught statically, before any image build. <!--#841aefb384472c30-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_a_browser_action_needs_a_playwright_driver` (method) — Asserts a `browser` action on a non-playwright driver is reported at the action. <!--#1417c64b4d07fd4c-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_a_playwright_driver_may_drive_the_browser` (method) — Asserts browser actions and dom assertions validate when the driver is a playwright service. <!--#c815776779fb9560-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_capability_is_not_checked_without_the_base_kind_map` (method) — Asserts the playwright capability check is skipped when the caller supplies no `service_kinds` map. <!--#b534301c26a5e7fd-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_a_bundle_rejects_a_dom_assertion_on_a_base_driver` (method) — Asserts the whole-bundle entry point joins the two documents and rejects a dom assertion on a base driver. <!--#e9e493d6110e5103-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_a_bundle_accepts_a_dom_assertion_on_a_playwright_driver` (method) — Asserts a bundle declaring a playwright service and driving it with a dom assertion validates clean. <!--#35158f6076df88e7-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_a_non_browser_action_after_a_browser_one_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a non-browser action declared after a browser one is reported, since browser ops are batched last and the declared order cannot hold. <!--#d931ac3d31158cbe-->
  - `TestScenarioRules.test_non_browser_actions_declared_first_are_fine` (method) — Asserts non-browser actions preceding browser ones validate clean. <!--#d9e3b62ea9e60266-->
- `TestAssertionLadder` (class) — INVARIANT suite pinning the assertion-tier ladder: tier 2/3 must be explicitly declared with boolean flags, must not be escalated where a lower tier would do, and flags must not appear on deterministic assertions. <!--#cf41927b08066adc-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.validate` (method) — Helper validating a single-assertion scenario against a one-service environment. <!--#12b66478e390616f-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_screenshot_diff_without_visual_regression_flag_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a tier-2 `screenshot_diff` without `visual_regression: true` produces exactly one located error. <!--#afaaf6087f475480-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_screenshot_diff_with_declaration_is_accepted` (method) — Asserts a `screenshot_diff` with its tier-2 declaration validates clean. <!--#be06dbe9b2319450-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_screenshot_diff_requires_a_baseline` (method) — Asserts a declared `screenshot_diff` without a `baseline` is reported. <!--#49fb0ac886db2c3c-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_screenshot_diff_threshold_must_be_a_unit_fraction` (method) — Asserts an out-of-unit-range `threshold` is reported. <!--#ebc96b6d17ea1399-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_screenshot_diff_may_scope_to_a_selector` (method) — Asserts scoping a diff to a selector stays valid tier 2. <!--#9c73f78458682784-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_llm_vision_without_semantic_visual_flag_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a tier-3 `visual_semantic` assertion without `semantic_visual: true` produces exactly one error. <!--#f15582bd63a30db6-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_llm_vision_without_evidence_requirement_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a `visual_semantic` assertion without `require_evidence: true` produces exactly one error. <!--#f204a5003018f606-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_fully_declared_llm_vision_is_accepted` (method) — Asserts a `visual_semantic` assertion with both tier-3 declarations validates clean. <!--#49907f80a084bf55-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_llm_vision_with_a_selector_is_rejected_as_a_needless_escalation` (method) — Asserts a fully declared `visual_semantic` assertion carrying a selector is rejected, since a tier-1 DOM assertion would answer it. <!--#d149fd83feb235e5-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_screenshot_diff_with_a_text_expectation_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a `screenshot_diff` carrying a text expectation is rejected as a needless escalation over a text assertion. <!--#cc1231f92d53f6e8-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_tier_flag_on_a_deterministic_assertion_is_rejected` (method) — Parametrized check that a tier-2/3 flag placed on a deterministic tier-1 assertion is reported. <!--#a9e58c1a35f848c5-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_a_non_boolean_tier_flag_never_unlocks_a_tier` (method) — Asserts a truthy-but-non-boolean tier flag (e.g. `"false"`) never counts as a declared escalation. <!--#ad405d431f038679-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_a_non_boolean_evidence_flag_does_not_satisfy_the_evidence_rule` (method) — Asserts a non-boolean `require_evidence` is reported both as a type error and as an unmet tier-3 requirement. <!--#2b910c818b71bdf5-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_a_non_string_baseline_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a non-string `baseline` is reported, so the baseline-existence rule cannot be bypassed by a non-str value. <!--#077dc43d39e5bb59-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_an_empty_baseline_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a whitespace-only `baseline` is reported. <!--#74ed1488a8fe1180-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_semantic_flag_on_a_tier2_assertion_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a tier-3 `semantic_visual` flag on a tier-2 `screenshot_diff` is reported. <!--#ba1a450efc956fa3-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_coordinate_click_without_visual_driving_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a `visual_click` action without a `visual_driving` declaration produces exactly one located error. <!--#fd939635eaff3597-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_coordinate_click_with_visual_driving_declared_is_accepted` (method) — Asserts a `visual_click` action validates once `visual_driving` is declared on the scenario. <!--#b324ace6eb2691ae-->
  - `TestAssertionLadder.test_coordinate_click_with_a_selector_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a declared `visual_click` carrying a selector is rejected, since the selector proves a lower tier would do. <!--#46f1101a5648dc4d-->
- `TestBaselinesAndBundle` (class) — Suite covering opt-in baseline-file checks (containment, existence, first-capture relaxation) and whole-bundle behaviour (duplicate names, shape errors, one-pass reporting, no cascading, dependency purity). <!--#845a519dcb4a21c8-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_baseline_check_is_skipped_without_a_directory` (method) — Pins the purity guarantee that validation performs no filesystem IO unless a `baselines_dir` is supplied. <!--#ccb1e2cd2ddcaf9c-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_a_baseline_outside_the_directory_is_rejected` (method) — Parametrized containment check rejecting absolute, traversal, and Windows drive/root-anchored baseline names that would escape the baselines directory. <!--#212cc9065e31c41d-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_a_baseline_in_a_subdirectory_is_still_allowed` (method) — Asserts a baseline nested inside the baselines directory is accepted. <!--#14ae6539125be75e-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_missing_baseline_file_is_reported` (method) — Asserts an absent baseline file is reported with its name in the message. <!--#a67161a85a6fabf6-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_first_capture_admits_a_baseline_that_is_not_there_yet` (method) — Asserts `require_existing_baselines=False` lets the first-capture path past the existence check. <!--#98f5f8c67b928859-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_first_capture_does_not_relax_the_ladder` (method) — Asserts the first-capture escape hatch still enforces the tier-declaration rules. <!--#c75c17a16b9ace6e-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_present_baseline_file_passes` (method) — Asserts an existing baseline file validates clean. <!--#597305558edc9088-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_duplicate_scenario_names_across_files_are_reported` (method) — Asserts two scenario files sharing a name are reported at the second file's `name`. <!--#dadc5877ab0fa2fd-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_bundle_must_be_a_mapping` (method) — Asserts a non-mapping bundle produces errors. <!--#f602609e7121b6f3-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_scenarios_must_be_a_mapping` (method) — Asserts a list-valued `scenarios` entry is reported. <!--#db37d6af134262ec-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_every_problem_is_reported_in_one_pass` (method) — Asserts validation accumulates rather than short-circuits, reporting all four seeded problems across both documents in a single pass. <!--#0429d8afa3318e6c-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_driver_check_does_not_cascade_when_no_service_resolved` (method) — Asserts a wholly invalid environment reports itself without emitting one "unknown driver" error per scenario. <!--#1d612605832bccad-->
  - `TestBaselinesAndBundle.test_no_third_party_validation_dependency` (method) — AST-inspects `config_schema` to pin its imports to the stdlib plus `tianluo`, forbidding a third-party validation library. <!--#df2a8430362a4b8b-->
- `write_content` (function) — Test helper materializing a `tianluo/e2e/` directory on disk with environment, scenario, and baseline files. <!--#e4afe30e1627faa4-->
- `TestContentLoader` (class) — Suite covering `read_raw_content`/`load_content_config` — absent-directory sentinel, half-present vs corrupted content, YAML location, parsing into declarations, and the legacy `se3/` layout. <!--#8b4bd8b6ad30b6de-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_absent_directory_is_a_sentinel_not_an_error` (method) — Asserts a project with no e2e directory yields `None` rather than an error. <!--#f7d60a96d6e8c238-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_empty_directory_is_also_the_sentinel` (method) — Asserts an empty e2e directory also loads as `None`. <!--#49b969cc0bc4d13b-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_scenarios_without_environment_is_an_error` (method) — Asserts scenarios present without an environment file raise `E2EConfigError` naming the missing file. <!--#5189b5ba1e85b572-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_environment_without_scenarios_is_an_error` (method) — Asserts an environment present without scenarios raises `E2EConfigError`. <!--#3379fdff1144b855-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_only_the_half_present_shapes_are_marked_incomplete` (method) — Asserts only half-present directories raise `E2EContentIncompleteError` (bootstrap-completable), while corrupted content raises a plain `E2EConfigError`. <!--#ea20617abcc45deb-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_malformed_yaml_is_located` (method) — Asserts a YAML parse failure raises `E2EConfigError` naming the offending file. <!--#0c2b65c90ecc7ca3-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_valid_directory_parses_into_declarations` (method) — Asserts a valid directory loads into service and scenario declarations with their fields intact. <!--#daeeab916d98ca35-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_a_fractional_timeout_survives_parsing` (method) — Asserts a sub-second declared timeout rounds up to 1 rather than truncating to 0 and silently inheriting the 300s default. <!--#b5fb5747efbd1d50-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_declaration_flags_are_parsed_as_the_schema_validates_them` (method) — Asserts `_build_scenario` reads tier flags by boolean identity, so a `"false"` string parses to `False`. <!--#c689de56d6887606-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_readiness_status_reaches_the_probe` (method) — Asserts a declared expected `status` survives conversion into the readiness probe spec. <!--#dd86d8dba6dcf746-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_scenario_name_defaults_to_the_filename` (method) — Asserts a scenario without an explicit name takes its filename stem. <!--#e119330c229bc681-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_invalid_content_raises_with_every_problem_listed` (method) — Asserts the loader's error message names every offending file, not just the first. <!--#9db215aa07c78f1d-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_baseline_existence_is_enforced_by_the_loader` (method) — Asserts the loader enforces baseline existence, that `require_baselines=False` is the first-capture escape hatch, and that adding the file makes it load. <!--#1ce7b4300155a45a-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_legacy_se3_layout_is_honoured` (method) — Asserts a legacy `se3/e2e/` checkout still loads, with `content.root` pointing at it. <!--#de9a4a0c3258bb12-->
  - `TestContentLoader.test_content_dir_is_not_hardcoded` (method) — Source-inspects `content_config` to assert paths route through `runtime_dir` rather than a hardcoded `tianluo/` prefix. <!--#0c66ddb4f59b946f-->
- `TestConversionToBackendSpecs` (class) — Suite covering `to_environment_spec` — template/build/mount selection per service, readiness command shelling, network override and defaulting, and GUI template selection. <!--#b8672d465256ca4b-->
  - `TestConversionToBackendSpecs.test_environment_spec_round_trip` (method) — Asserts a loaded environment converts to a backend spec with the right template, build steps, mounts, workdir, and readiness per service. <!--#2391b2978ea19b07-->
  - `TestConversionToBackendSpecs.test_a_string_readiness_command_is_wrapped_in_a_shell` (method) — Asserts a shell-string readiness command is converted to `("sh", "-lc", ...)` so `backend.exec` can run it as argv. <!--#c31ac51ce79443b8-->
  - `TestConversionToBackendSpecs.test_a_list_readiness_command_is_left_as_argv` (method) — Asserts a declared argv readiness command is passed through without gaining a shell wrapper. <!--#053145ae92c3be42-->
  - `TestConversionToBackendSpecs.test_network_override` (method) — Asserts an explicit `network=` argument overrides the spec's network. <!--#58f110a9e034784e-->
  - `TestConversionToBackendSpecs.test_declared_network_is_used_by_default` (method) — Asserts the environment's declared network is used when no override is given. <!--#5a989bf2d37db5bd-->
  - `TestConversionToBackendSpecs.test_gui_service_selects_its_template` (method) — Asserts a `gui-xvfb` base kind selects the matching image template. <!--#580372780c63b54a-->

### `tests/e2e/test_container_backend.py` (python) — Runtime-free tests for ContainerBackend that inject a FakeRunner and assert the argv each verb (create/start/exec) assembles, covering docker-vs-podman differences, mounts/SELinux labels, name-conflict recovery, and error mapping to E2EEnvironmentError/E2EConfigError. <!--#0abbc35f950be7d1|711a7d58e8783497-->
- `make_backend` (function) — Test helper that builds a ContainerBackend over a probed runtime (docker/podman) with a FakeRunner, returning the backend and runner pair. <!--#91d1f724f35b88f0-->
- `_app_runs` (function) — Test helper counting how many recorded `run` invocations targeted the app service's container name, used to assert retry behaviour. <!--#90070cc1abc0d2ca-->
- `started_handle` (function) — Test helper that creates an environment from a sample spec, clears recorded calls, starts it, and returns the handle. <!--#f4fde25cb1b3bd07-->
- `TestCreate` (class) — Tests for ContainerBackend.create: network creation/reuse, image build vs pull, throwaway build context, and failure paths that must raise E2EEnvironmentError while leaving a recoverable handle. <!--#de7dd9e2f134541b-->
  - `TestCreate.test_creates_the_shared_network_first` (method) — Asserts the very first runtime call is `network create` for the spec's network name. <!--#9ccb5ce447ab6ff9-->
  - `TestCreate.test_builds_services_with_a_template_and_pulls_the_rest` (method) — Asserts templated services are built to a `tianluo-e2e/...` tag while external images are pulled as published, both recorded in handle.images. <!--#ecb55edcdf4be887-->
  - `TestCreate.test_build_context_is_a_throwaway_dir_not_the_project_root` (method) — Asserts the build context is a temporary directory rather than the project source tree. <!--#0386054416c5914f-->
  - `TestCreate.test_existing_network_is_reused_rather_than_recreated` (method) — Asserts an "already exists" network-create failure is treated as reuse and still yields the network id. <!--#c85951163aa826a2-->
  - `TestCreate.test_network_failure_is_an_environment_error_with_remediation` (method) — Asserts a genuine network-create failure raises E2EEnvironmentError carrying the stderr text and a remediation hint. <!--#f1bd79b6059e37b6-->
  - `TestCreate.test_build_failure_names_the_service` (method) — Asserts a failed image build raises an error that names the offending service. <!--#62fa41603d4cad75-->
  - `TestCreate.test_a_failed_build_leaves_the_created_network_recoverable` (method) — Asserts the partially-filled handle stays reachable via backend.last_handle after a build failure so the already-created network can still be torn down. <!--#0b5ae61ca4368999-->
  - `TestCreate.test_pull_failure_is_tolerated_when_the_image_is_already_local` (method) — Asserts a pull failure is ignored when `image inspect` shows the image is present locally. <!--#0e09a58993541532-->
  - `TestCreate.test_pull_failure_without_a_local_image_raises` (method) — Asserts a pull failure with no local image raises E2EEnvironmentError. <!--#8df3265c4d1219f4-->
- `TestStart` (class) — Tests for ContainerBackend.start: run argv composition (network/alias/env/ports/workdir/mounts), SELinux label selection, docker-vs-podman differences, name-conflict recovery, and start failure handling. <!--#5492a5a7300e0bf2-->
  - `TestStart.test_run_argv_wires_the_service_onto_the_shared_network` (method) — Asserts the run argv attaches the container to the shared network with a service-name alias/hostname and the deterministic container name. <!--#550203bb745b8776-->
  - `TestStart.test_run_argv_carries_env_ports_workdir_and_image` (method) — Asserts environment variables, port mapping, working directory, and the resolved image tag all appear in the run argv. <!--#f07cb239b3d7aed3-->
  - `TestStart.test_source_is_bind_mounted_never_copied` (method) — Asserts the project source reaches the container via a bind mount and is never COPYed into the built image. <!--#cee8549d593994e2-->
  - `TestStart.test_selinux_label_is_applied_by_default_and_can_be_turned_off` (method) — Asserts mounts get an SELinux label suffix by default and none when selinux_label=False. <!--#efbdaeb8cbfbeee1-->
  - `TestStart.test_a_source_mounted_into_two_services_gets_the_shared_label` (method) — Asserts a source bind-mounted into two services uses the shared `:z` label so the second container cannot revoke the first's access. <!--#6f9e4083fb62485f-->
  - `TestStart.test_a_source_mounted_into_one_service_keeps_the_private_label` (method) — Asserts a source mounted into only one service keeps the private `:Z` label. <!--#8e5625f7d1d670ed-->
  - `TestStart.test_read_only_mount_renders_ro` (method) — Asserts format_mount renders a read-only bind mount with the `:ro,Z` suffix. <!--#bbbea92fac698489-->
  - `TestStart.test_podman_maps_the_host_uid_and_docker_does_not` (method) — Asserts `--userns=keep-id` is added for podman only. <!--#59d3a4cd839bc94f-->
  - `TestStart.test_a_podman_probe_invokes_the_podman_binary_for_every_verb` (method) — Asserts every runtime call (run/exec/rm) shells out to the probed `podman` binary rather than a hard-coded `docker`. <!--#967bb8e3da7ed157-->
  - `TestStart.test_the_only_run_argv_difference_between_runtimes_is_uid_mapping` (method) — Asserts docker and podman run argv are identical apart from the binary name and the rootless UID-mapping flag. <!--#ebf3df8de6dae020-->
  - `TestStart.test_oci_runtime_is_passed_through_only_when_configured` (method) — Asserts `--runtime` is emitted only when an oci_runtime is configured. <!--#2dc9f43112a249ba-->
  - `TestStart.test_container_ids_are_recorded_and_the_handle_is_marked_started` (method) — Asserts the container id from `run` stdout is recorded on the handle and the handle is flagged started. <!--#f9ba8577d2b87142-->
  - `TestStart.test_run_failure_is_an_environment_error` (method) — Asserts a failing `run` raises E2EEnvironmentError naming the service. <!--#b489e479db1f0453-->
  - `TestStart.test_a_leftover_container_under_our_own_name_is_replaced` (method) — Asserts a docker name-conflict triggers a forced removal and a single retry that succeeds, so kept environments don't wedge the fix loop. <!--#2204e35d957022e4-->
  - `TestStart.test_podman_name_conflict_wording_is_recognised_too` (method) — Asserts podman's differently-worded name-conflict message is also recognised and retried. <!--#c6b0766b665c3702-->
  - `TestStart.test_a_port_conflict_is_not_mistaken_for_a_name_conflict` (method) — Asserts a host port-allocation failure raises immediately without removing the container or retrying. <!--#37c8303489500e7a-->
  - `TestStart.test_a_persistent_name_conflict_still_reports_the_service` (method) — Asserts that when removal also fails the retry stops after one attempt and the error still names the service. <!--#9575bc76d311cfe6-->
  - `TestStart.test_buildkit_is_requested_for_docker_but_not_podman` (method) — Asserts DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 is set in the build environment for docker and absent for podman. <!--#23a3d1e6b0848ba6-->
- `TestExec` (class) — Tests for ContainerBackend.exec: argv targeting, env forwarding, config/environment error cases, timeout reporting, and missing-binary handling. <!--#bff1757adf533b29-->
  - `TestExec.test_exec_targets_the_service_container` (method) — Asserts exec builds `<runtime> exec` argv with the working directory and command, returning a successful result. <!--#508af0acedd57397-->
  - `TestExec.test_exec_forwards_environment` (method) — Asserts environment entries passed to exec appear in the exec argv. <!--#0cab5bc28c30a358-->
  - `TestExec.test_exec_on_an_undeclared_service_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts exec against a service not in the spec raises E2EConfigError. <!--#1817489d0154325c-->
  - `TestExec.test_exec_before_start_is_an_environment_error` (method) — Asserts exec on a created-but-unstarted environment raises E2EEnvironmentError. <!--#240a680d40d3916c-->
  - `TestExec.test_timeout_is_reported_not_raised` (method) — Asserts a subprocess timeout is surfaced as a result with timed_out set rather than propagating an exception. <!--#6e2d1a7b8d6b76de-->
  - `TestExec.test_a_vanished_binary_becomes_an_environment_error` (method) — Asserts a FileNotFoundError from the runtime binary becomes an E2EEnvironmentError with remediation. <!--#63941ba64be32c0f-->
- `TestSnapshot` (class) — Tests for ContainerBackend.snapshot across file/screenshot/log kinds, including destination handling, temp-file hygiene, and error classification. <!--#28731c724a7a1263-->
  - `TestSnapshot.test_file_snapshot_copies_out_of_the_container` (method) — Asserts a file snapshot issues `cp` from the container path to the destination and returns a file-kind snapshot. <!--#98283020cf38243e-->
  - `TestSnapshot.test_screenshot_captures_with_scrot_then_copies` (method) — Asserts a screenshot snapshot runs `scrot -o` inside the container then copies the image out. <!--#45a3d1a83182cb3a-->
  - `TestSnapshot.test_screenshot_failure_is_an_environment_error` (method) — Asserts a failing in-container screenshot capture raises E2EEnvironmentError. <!--#c8ca9d1314c96b13-->
  - `TestSnapshot.test_log_snapshot_exposes_the_text_in_metadata` (method) — Asserts a log snapshot puts the container logs in metadata['text'] and writes them to the given destination. <!--#f5732f54523b2a59-->
  - `TestSnapshot.test_log_snapshot_without_a_destination_writes_no_host_file` (method) — Asserts a destination-less log snapshot returns text in metadata with no path and leaves no temp file, so readiness polling doesn't leak files. <!--#c541e6905db80dc6-->

- `TestDestroy` (class) — Tests for ContainerBackend.destroy: full container/network teardown, idempotency, name-based removal of unrecorded containers, half-created handles, and non-fatal removal failures. <!--#1dece1fe2d8a0d73-->

  - `TestDestroy.test_removes_by_deterministic_name_when_the_run_never_recorded_one` (method) — Asserts teardown falls back to deterministic container names so containers created by a failed/interrupted start are still removed. <!--#c384fbd4c9d9f73c-->

  - `TestDestroy.test_unexpected_removal_failure_is_logged_not_raised` (method) — Asserts an unexpected removal failure is logged as a warning instead of raising, so teardown never masks the real failure. <!--#bd0b265ba477946d-->
- `TestJsonParsing` (class) — Tests for ContainerBackend.parse_json and inspect: tolerant parsing of empty/malformed/line-delimited runtime output and the portable go-template inspect form. <!--#cde8e85abf4ff4de-->

  - `TestJsonParsing.test_malformed_output_parses_to_none` (method) — Asserts malformed JSON parses to None rather than raising. <!--#1dfbbd8a2cda3b86-->

  - `TestJsonParsing.test_inspect_uses_the_portable_go_template_form` (method) — Asserts inspect passes the `{{json .}}` go-template so output is portable across runtimes. <!--#e1c847e6d6028b8a-->
  - `TestJsonParsing.test_inspect_of_a_missing_object_returns_none` (method) — Asserts inspecting a nonexistent object returns None instead of raising. <!--#3d10cbef5e46caa1-->
- `TestNaming` (class) — Tests for the container_name and image_tag helpers: network namespacing, sanitisation, and tags keyed to the build recipe rather than the flow. <!--#d0d88f309fafa83c-->

- `test_no_direct_subprocess_run_call_outside_the_injection_point` (function) — Source-level guard asserting container_backend.py calls subprocess.run only at the injected `runner` default, so every runtime invocation stays interceptable. <!--#ea4476d1e28f1983-->

### `tests/e2e/test_core_import_isolation.py` (python) — Test module that verifies importing tianluo's core (CLI, engine, `tianluo.e2e` package) never eagerly loads the optional e2e extra (e.g. Pillow) and that core imports and `--help` still work when the extra is made unimportable via a subprocess-safe `_ExtraBlocker` meta-path hook. <!--#50d0acffd9309629|f23a35458440b5bd-->
- `_subprocess_env` (function) — Builds an environment for subprocess runs with the repo's src directory prepended to PYTHONPATH so the worktree code is importable. <!--#239b143ce4a730af-->
- `_run_python` (function) — Executes a Python code snippet in a fresh subprocess via `sys.executable -c`, capturing output with the src-prefixed environment. <!--#d4c54da2d630bd16-->
- `test_core_imports_do_not_pull_in_the_e2e_extra` (function) — Asserts that importing the CLI, engine steps, and `tianluo.e2e` in a subprocess never loads Pillow or other e2e-extra top-level modules into `sys.modules`. <!--#43f065ff128caaa9-->
- `test_e2e_package_import_pulls_in_no_submodule` (function) — Asserts that `import tianluo.e2e` stays a bare package declaration by verifying no `tianluo.e2e.*` submodules get eagerly imported. <!--#e25a755ef4e38421-->
- `test_core_modules_import_with_the_extra_blocked` (function) — Asserts the CLI and engine modules still import cleanly when the e2e extra (Pillow) is made unimportable via a blocking meta-path hook. <!--#15e312b931596278-->
- `test_cli_help_works_with_the_extra_blocked` (function) — Asserts the full Typer command tree builds and `--help` exits 0 even when the e2e extra is blocked from import. <!--#be8caa340530e0ef-->
- `_ExtraBlocker` (class) — A meta-path import hook that raises ModuleNotFoundError for blocked top-level module names, simulating a missing e2e extra. <!--#1719efcad3100286-->
  - `_ExtraBlocker.__init__` (method) — Stores the blocked module names as a set. <!--#fed87dbdbcfe9383-->
  - `_ExtraBlocker.find_spec` (method) — Raises ModuleNotFoundError when the requested module's top-level package is blocked, otherwise defers to other finders. <!--#9f65fd7f0a9e3e6c-->
- `_block_imports` (function) — Context manager that installs an `_ExtraBlocker` at the front of `sys.meta_path` and removes it on exit. <!--#d7f3c6f4e990922c-->
- `test_blocking_hook_is_fully_restored` (function) — Asserts the blocking hook intercepts imports while active and is fully removed from `sys.meta_path` afterward so it cannot poison later tests. <!--#b1273d7358bbdd40-->

### `tests/e2e/test_e2e_config.py` (python) — Unit tests for `E2EConfig.load`, covering default fallbacks for missing/malformed `e2e` blocks, boolean coercion with warnings, `runtime`/`oci_runtime` parsing, timeout clamping, scenario list selection, `keep_environment`, and full-block integration. <!--#a3ca4623dc978e3f|1da89d3331ce9715-->

  - `TestDefaults.test_empty_block` (method) — Verifies an empty `e2e` block leaves e2e disabled. <!--#6e88e09cc4bb96e5-->
  - `TestDefaults.test_null_block` (method) — Verifies a null `e2e` block leaves e2e disabled. <!--#3c46f5dc5f914e99-->
  - `TestDefaults.test_non_mapping_block_falls_back` (method) — Verifies a non-mapping (list) `e2e` block falls back to disabled defaults. <!--#9f459f34b559a474-->
  - `TestDefaults.test_defaults_are_not_shared_between_instances` (method) — Verifies the mutable `scenarios` default is not shared between separately loaded `E2EConfig` instances. <!--#124a3c016714f171-->
- `TestEnabled` (class) — Tests boolean coercion of `enabled` and `keep_environment`, including warnings when unrecognized values fall back to off. <!--#7bdf2272c255c2a7-->
  - `TestEnabled.test_truthy_forms` (method) — Verifies truthy forms (`True`, `"true"`, `"yes"`, `"on"`, `1`) enable e2e. <!--#837e07b14fb98008-->
  - `TestEnabled.test_falsy_and_unparseable_forms_stay_off` (method) — Verifies falsy or unparseable values keep e2e disabled. <!--#926989e4f42613c7-->

  - `TestEnabled.test_an_unrecognized_keep_environment_warns_too` (method) — Verifies an unrecognized `keep_environment` value warns (naming `e2e.keep_environment`) and falls back to `False`. <!--#1decfc371acea6e9-->
- `TestRuntimeSelection` (class) — Tests `runtime` parsing: valid choices pass through, case/whitespace is normalized, and invalid values fall back to `auto` (with a warning for bad strings). <!--#bf0a0ff594501440-->
  - `TestRuntimeSelection.test_valid_values_pass_through` (method) — Verifies every value in `E2E_RUNTIME_CHOICES` is accepted verbatim. <!--#466c451cd24dfcf2-->
  - `TestRuntimeSelection.test_case_and_whitespace_normalized` (method) — Verifies `runtime` is lowercased and stripped (e.g. `" Podman "` → `"podman"`). <!--#5c9badc197b531bc-->
  - `TestRuntimeSelection.test_invalid_string_warns_and_falls_back_to_auto` (method) — Verifies an unknown runtime string warns (naming `e2e.runtime`) and falls back to `auto`. <!--#a9654dd2509f7fe6-->
  - `TestRuntimeSelection.test_non_string_falls_back_without_raising` (method) — Verifies a non-string `runtime` value falls back to `auto` without raising. <!--#24bc884f5e220a98-->

- `TestTimeouts` (class) — Tests timeout and `estimated_e2e_duration` parsing: valid values pass through, non-positive/malformed/bool/non-finite values clamp to defaults or `None`. <!--#b070ca580fc919f5-->

- `TestKeepEnvironment` (class) — Tests the `keep_environment` flag: off by default, enabled by a truthy value. <!--#d2ec806fe3de3f21-->
