### `tests/e2e/test_errors.py` (python) — Tests for the E2E error hierarchy, verifying every error class derives from E2EError, E2EEnvironmentError renders an optional remediation hint, E2EDependencyMissingError carries an actionable 'tianluo[e2e]' install hint and routes as an environment error, and E2EScenarioFailure routes to the fix loop while carrying scenario name and structured results. <!--#acde283ed8e523cc|31a1ca1b8e84e250-->
- `test_every_error_shares_the_common_base` (function) — Parametrized test asserting every E2E error class instance is an instance of the common base E2EError. <!--#0187713d7807060f-->
- `TestEnvironmentError` (class) — Test class verifying E2EEnvironmentError's optional remediation hint defaults to empty and is appended to the rendered message when provided. <!--#6c126d9f2dd6c477-->
  - `TestEnvironmentError.test_remediation_defaults_to_empty_and_is_exposed` (method) — Verifies remediation defaults to "" and str(exc) is just the base message. <!--#2aa028ed86ed246c-->
  - `TestEnvironmentError.test_remediation_is_appended_to_the_rendered_message` (method) — Verifies a provided remediation is stored on the exception and included alongside the base message in str(exc). <!--#6e923c622c10b613-->
- `TestDependencyMissingError` (class) — Test class verifying E2EDependencyMissingError renders an actionable install hint (E2E_EXTRA / "pip install 'tianluo[e2e]'"), includes feature context when given, routes as an environment error, and matches the E2E_EXTRA constant. <!--#8ceab09b1a9c7249-->
  - `TestDependencyMissingError.test_message_carries_the_actionable_install_command` (method) — Verifies the error message contains the install command hint and the dependency name, and that exc.dependency is stored. <!--#d77197b1fc4a374a-->
  - `TestDependencyMissingError.test_feature_context_is_included_when_given` (method) — Verifies an optional feature description appears in the message together with the install hint. <!--#3e3f9e76c688b1a0-->
  - `TestDependencyMissingError.test_routes_like_an_environment_error` (method) — Verifies a missing-dependency error is an E2EEnvironmentError (host problem) but not an E2EScenarioFailure, so handlers route it away from the fix loop. <!--#5e469628da789c13-->
  - `TestDependencyMissingError.test_extra_name_constant_matches_the_hint` (method) — Verifies E2E_EXTRA equals "tianluo[e2e]" and appears in the error's rendered message. <!--#ea0b8ed07a054c36-->
- `TestScenarioFailure` (class) — Test class verifying E2EScenarioFailure is not an environment error (so it routes to the fix loop) and carries scenario name plus structured results defaulting to an empty list. <!--#9449767f2e4523ef-->
  - `TestScenarioFailure.test_is_not_an_environment_error` (method) — Verifies a scenario failure is not an E2EEnvironmentError, keeping the environment-vs-defect routing split intact. <!--#1f157c386653d670-->
  - `TestScenarioFailure.test_carries_structured_results_for_fix_context` (method) — Verifies scenario and results attributes are stored for fix-loop context while str(exc) remains the plain message. <!--#b187971d21447bd1-->
  - `TestScenarioFailure.test_results_default_to_an_empty_list` (method) — Verifies the results attribute defaults to an empty list when not provided. <!--#f49dafda253c3b2b-->

### `tests/e2e/test_executor.py` (python) — Tests for the e2e Executor covering driver-service resolution and validation, exec/wait/screenshot/visual-click action semantics (including timeout coercion, error location, and failure-vs-note behaviour), browser-scenario batching of playwright ops and dom queries, and assertion collection semantics (collect-all vs fail_fast). <!--#e36a03f8f001b8c6|9a82d9670480e2ff-->
