  - `TestBrowserScenarios.test_failed_browser_op_is_surfaced_on_the_result` (method) — Verifies a failed browser op fails the scenario with its error surfaced in action_failures. <!--#52574f1f01b218f6-->
  - `TestBrowserScenarios.test_a_failed_browser_op_condemns_even_a_green_assertion_set` (method) — Verifies a failed browser op fails the scenario even when all assertions pass, since the behaviour under test was never exercised. <!--#26f8ec610805594b-->
  - `TestBrowserScenarios.test_a_non_browser_action_after_a_browser_one_is_refused` (method) — Verifies a scenario declaring a non-browser action after browser actions is rejected because batching would reorder execution. <!--#d5d4b30a242b8957-->
- `TestAssertionCollection` (class) — Tests for assertion evaluation semantics: collect-all vs fail-fast, empty-assertion failure, result shape, and run order. <!--#971bc061d7b9db33-->
  - `TestAssertionCollection.test_every_assertion_is_evaluated_by_default` (method) — Verifies all assertions are evaluated by default so one run exposes the whole failure surface. <!--#82bb1b8918496853-->
  - `TestAssertionCollection.test_fail_fast_stops_after_the_first_failure` (method) — Verifies fail_fast stops after the first failing assertion and records a fail-fast evidence note. <!--#b3770ce62d0bb3fe-->
  - `TestAssertionCollection.test_scenario_with_no_passing_assertion_is_not_green` (method) — Verifies a scenario with no assertions does not pass. <!--#5f79c37fa97846d9-->
  - `TestAssertionCollection.test_result_carries_every_field` (method) — Verifies ScenarioResult exposes every field (name, driver, source, duration, assertions, artifacts, evidence) and serialises via to_dict and summary_line. <!--#9471ebdb1d878551-->
  - `TestAssertionCollection.test_run_scenarios_preserves_declaration_order` (method) — Verifies run_scenarios returns results in scenario declaration order. <!--#8d0f6e21be1d3dae-->
- `TestTimeBudget` (class) — Tests for scenario time-budget enforcement: timeout-as-result, per-scenario overrides, per-call clamping, and skipped assertions. <!--#36f10911b2d560ad-->
  - `TestTimeBudget.test_scenario_timeout_produces_a_result_not_an_exception` (method) — Verifies an exhausted scenario budget yields a timed-out failing result and stops launching further actions. <!--#c2f4f81df36b17c1-->
  - `TestTimeBudget.test_scenario_timeout_overrides_the_config_default` (method) — Verifies a scenario-level timeout overrides the config default budget. <!--#05d56de00685b0f9-->
  - `TestTimeBudget.test_per_call_timeout_is_clamped_to_the_remaining_budget` (method) — Verifies an action's per-call timeout is clamped to the remaining scenario budget. <!--#c7a6660b1d2abd8a-->
  - `TestTimeBudget.test_assertions_are_skipped_once_the_budget_is_gone` (method) — Verifies no assertions are evaluated once the scenario budget is exhausted. <!--#7dc27decd0ba187c-->

### `tests/e2e/test_readiness.py` (python) — Test suite for readiness.wait_ready covering all four probe kinds (command/http/tcp/log), no-probe fast path, timeout diagnostics and budget clamping, transient-error tolerance, and config/unknown-kind validation, using a fake backend and FakeClock. <!--#2369c6afcbdc609b|b52fbfa0606d9252-->
- `make_handle` (function) — Helper that builds an EnvironmentHandle for a fake runtime from the sample environment spec. <!--#81997a40508376b0-->
- `wait` (function) — Helper that calls readiness.wait_ready with a FakeClock-driven clock and sleeper for a given backend, handle, service, and probe. <!--#82fbb48ef685c8d3-->
- `TestNoProbe` (class) — Tests that a service with no readiness probe is treated as ready immediately. <!--#7bf1cb11f74c7eca-->
  - `TestNoProbe.test_a_service_without_a_probe_is_ready_immediately` (method) — Asserts wait_ready returns True without touching the backend when the probe is None. <!--#25db3003306cdab4-->
- `TestCommandProbe` (class) — Tests command-kind readiness probes: retrying until exit code 0, exec targeting the named service, and config errors for a missing command. <!--#94245a3165a34008-->
  - `TestCommandProbe.test_passes_once_the_command_exits_zero` (method) — Verifies the probe retries failing exec calls and passes once the command exits zero after three attempts. <!--#12351a3600d6d942-->
  - `TestCommandProbe.test_runs_the_command_in_the_named_service` (method) — Verifies the probe command is executed against the named service with the given argv. <!--#0d247fdd4b7660e0-->
  - `TestCommandProbe.test_a_command_probe_without_a_command_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts a command probe lacking a command raises E2EConfigError. <!--#65c176e31d13e8dd-->
- `TestHttpProbe` (class) — Tests http-kind readiness probes: 2xx success, retrying through errors, declared-status matching (including 3xx via a no-redirect opener), and config errors for a missing URL. <!--#e31181983bafecc1-->
  - `TestHttpProbe.test_passes_on_a_2xx_answer` (method) — Asserts an HTTP probe passes when the URL answers with a 200 status. <!--#763edf33cbc58158-->
  - `TestHttpProbe.test_retries_until_the_server_answers` (method) — Asserts the probe retries through connection errors until the server answers successfully. <!--#89fc1035c63e5454-->
  - `TestHttpProbe.test_a_404_does_not_count_as_ready` (method) — Asserts persistent 404 answers are never treated as ready and the wait eventually raises E2EEnvironmentError. <!--#8c7232160d383881-->
  - `TestHttpProbe.test_a_declared_status_is_what_counts_as_ready` (method) — Asserts an explicitly declared status (e.g. 401 from an auth-guarded endpoint) counts as ready. <!--#eca03fb47b5b76f9-->
  - `TestHttpProbe.test_a_declared_3xx_is_observed_instead_of_followed` (method) — Asserts a declared 3xx status is observable by using a no-redirect opener instead of following the redirect to its terminal status. <!--#3652c304c7e52b40-->
  - `TestHttpProbe.test_a_non_redirect_probe_keeps_the_default_opener` (method) — Asserts non-3xx probes never build a private opener and keep the default urlopen behaviour. <!--#cd308b18fc8d5db2-->
  - `TestHttpProbe.test_a_declared_status_also_excludes_other_answers` (method) — Asserts that when a status is declared, other HTTP answers do not count as ready. <!--#c06b5123b7d89dbf-->
  - `TestHttpProbe.test_an_http_probe_without_a_url_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts an http probe lacking a URL raises E2EConfigError. <!--#ad702b4dfa3802ed-->
- `TestTcpProbe` (class) — Tests tcp-kind readiness probes: port-accept success, retrying refused connections, host resolution from URL or localhost default, and config errors for a missing port. <!--#17ea4b2dfab8ec10-->
  - `TestTcpProbe.test_passes_when_the_port_accepts` (method) — Asserts a TCP probe passes when the port accepts a connection. <!--#4f3048c273ff24e4-->
  - `TestTcpProbe.test_retries_a_refused_connection` (method) — Asserts the probe retries a refused connection until the port accepts. <!--#9fe6bd1ae88a74f3-->
  - `TestTcpProbe.test_dials_the_host_named_in_the_url_when_given` (method) — Asserts the probe dials the host parsed from the probe URL when one is given. <!--#e72eab07bc1a56b2-->
  - `TestTcpProbe.test_defaults_to_the_published_port_on_localhost` (method) — Asserts the probe defaults to dialling the published port on 127.0.0.1 when no URL host is given. <!--#be7ec4989e8f3168-->
  - `TestTcpProbe.test_a_tcp_probe_without_a_port_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts a tcp probe lacking a port raises E2EConfigError. <!--#ca4e688592490a64-->
- `TestLogProbe` (class) — Tests log-kind readiness probes: regex matching against service logs fetched via the backend snapshot verb, and config errors for missing or invalid patterns. <!--#6ff842b98504ac9a-->
  - `TestLogProbe.test_passes_when_the_pattern_appears` (method) — Asserts a log probe passes once the configured regex appears in the service log. <!--#2f3af0c83b8ff0d6-->
  - `TestLogProbe.test_reads_the_log_through_the_backend_snapshot_verb` (method) — Asserts log probes read logs through the backend's snapshot call with the 'log' kind. <!--#e5421b24c39c8f4f-->
  - `TestLogProbe.test_an_invalid_pattern_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts an un-compilable regex pattern raises E2EConfigError. <!--#cbf2aa9f33769e0c-->
  - `TestLogProbe.test_a_log_probe_without_a_pattern_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts a log probe lacking a pattern raises E2EConfigError. <!--#9c301711b9a067ae-->
- `TestTimeout` (class) — Tests wait_ready timeout behaviour: diagnostic-rich E2EEnvironmentError reporting, minimum attempt guarantees, sleep clamping to the remaining budget, and tolerance of transient probe mechanism errors. <!--#62438e9f9eb020f8-->
  - `TestTimeout.test_timeout_reports_service_kind_and_log_tail` (method) — Asserts a timeout raises E2EEnvironmentError naming the service and probe kind, embedding the log tail, and carrying remediation guidance. <!--#ab2945bf7d6b00dd-->
  - `TestTimeout.test_timeout_without_any_log_still_reports` (method) — Asserts a timeout still raises E2EEnvironmentError even when no log output is available. <!--#295a3012a595c343-->
  - `TestTimeout.test_at_least_one_attempt_happens_even_with_a_zero_budget` (method) — Asserts the probe runs at least once before timing out even with a zero-second timeout budget. <!--#01fc26fda167aa4b-->
  - `TestTimeout.test_the_sleep_never_outlasts_the_remaining_budget` (method) — Asserts the interval sleep is clamped so a long interval never stretches the wait past its timeout budget. <!--#e8d560436bd817a8-->
  - `TestTimeout.test_a_short_interval_is_still_slept_in_full` (method) — Asserts the sleep clamp only shortens the final sleep, leaving in-budget interval sleeps intact. <!--#e56a43c82d674ee4-->
  - `TestTimeout.test_probe_mechanism_errors_do_not_abort_the_wait` (method) — Asserts transient exceptions from the probe mechanism (e.g. exec not yet accepted) are retried rather than aborting the wait. <!--#7e4e45b1ddd303fd-->
- `TestUnknownKind` (class) — Tests probe-kind validation: unknown kinds raise config errors and the documented kind set is exactly command/http/tcp/log. <!--#a502f3fec0413372-->
  - `TestUnknownKind.test_unknown_kind_is_a_config_error_not_a_silent_pass` (method) — Asserts a typo'd probe kind raises E2EConfigError naming the kind instead of silently passing as ready. <!--#a2ff0c490534f829-->
  - `TestUnknownKind.test_all_four_documented_kinds_are_accepted` (method) — Asserts readiness.PROBE_KINDS contains exactly the four documented kinds: command, http, tcp, log. <!--#10f690a6e50917bb-->
- `TestLogTail` (class) — Tests readiness.read_log_tail: returning trailing lines, destination-less snapshot polling, text/metadata and file fallbacks, and graceful handling of snapshot failures. <!--#11b9f9270d938437-->
  - `TestLogTail.test_returns_the_last_lines` (method) — Asserts read_log_tail returns exactly the requested number of trailing log lines. <!--#96ca9bd70668dd81-->
  - `TestLogTail.test_no_destination_is_requested_so_polling_leaves_no_host_files` (method) — Asserts log-tail polling requests no destination file so repeated polls leave no files on the host. <!--#5ce96a32c0868dd0-->
  - `TestLogTail.test_a_snapshot_without_a_path_still_yields_its_text` (method) — Asserts a destination-less snapshot whose text arrives in metadata still yields that text. <!--#1e206ddb9e2166c6-->
  - `TestLogTail.test_a_backend_that_cannot_snapshot_yields_no_diagnostic` (method) — Asserts a backend whose snapshot call fails yields an empty diagnostic string instead of raising. <!--#9f51acef234fbd92-->
  - `TestLogTail.test_falls_back_to_the_snapshot_file_when_metadata_is_empty` (method) — Asserts read_log_tail falls back to reading the snapshot's file path when no metadata text is present. <!--#dcb42c3a4d4e3572-->
- `_fake_urlopen` (function) — Factory for a urllib urlopen stub that replays a queue of status codes or exceptions. <!--#0b8700a24702587a-->
- `_fake_connect` (function) — Factory for a socket.create_connection stub that records dialled addresses and replays accept/refuse outcomes. <!--#e794aa64e9bf4e74-->

### `tests/e2e/test_runtime_probe.py` (python) — Unit tests for the container-runtime probing logic (`probe_runtime`/`probe_one`), using a stubbed `subprocess.run` to verify auto-selection with docker-preferred fallback to podman, explicit-runtime selection without fallback, preference normalization, failure classification with remediation, rootless detection, and the immutability of `RuntimeProbeResult`. <!--#98dbc7211030ccb3|45ea6b8de66a8d0c-->
- `ok` (function) — Test helper that builds a successful ``CompletedProcess`` (returncode 0) with the given stdout for stubbing ``subprocess.run``. <!--#1ef330582e33be13-->
- `fail` (function) — Test helper that builds a failed ``CompletedProcess`` with the given stderr and exit code (default 1) for stubbing ``subprocess.run``. <!--#bdcf55d80018bc27-->
- `StubRunner` (class) — Stand-in for ``subprocess.run`` that records invocations and returns per-binary canned ``CompletedProcess`` outcomes or raises canned exceptions, treating unmapped binaries as not installed (``FileNotFoundError``). <!--#1e77e026a4cb01eb-->
  - `StubRunner.__init__` (method) — Initializes the stub with the binary-to-outcome mapping and an empty call log. <!--#cb22658748408e9f-->
  - `StubRunner.__call__` (method) — Records the argv, then returns the mapped outcome, raises a mapped exception, or raises ``FileNotFoundError`` for unmapped binaries. <!--#37283b97972d61a3-->
  - `StubRunner.binaries` (method) — Property returning the ordered list of binary names the probe actually invoked. <!--#4b4771e00fe79bfb-->
- `TestAutoSelection` (class) — Tests for ``probe_runtime`` auto mode: docker preferred, fallback to podman on denial/absence/timeout, and a remediation-rich ``E2EEnvironmentError`` naming each failure when no runtime is usable. <!--#94cb9f81d52716f8-->
  - `TestAutoSelection.test_prefers_docker_when_both_are_usable` (method) — Verifies auto mode picks docker when both runtimes work and never probes podman after docker succeeds. <!--#85ccb01196105045-->
  - `TestAutoSelection.test_falls_back_to_podman_when_docker_is_installed_but_denied` (method) — Verifies a permission-denied docker counts as absent, falling back to a rootless podman after probing both. <!--#0b1575df74c7256d-->
  - `TestAutoSelection.test_falls_back_to_podman_when_docker_is_not_installed` (method) — Verifies auto mode falls back to podman when docker is not installed, probing docker first. <!--#f168e55888b1fc8e-->
  - `TestAutoSelection.test_falls_back_when_docker_info_times_out` (method) — Verifies a ``docker info`` timeout triggers fallback to podman. <!--#53189dfe07fe1b2c-->
  - `TestAutoSelection.test_raises_with_all_three_repair_paths_when_none_available` (method) — Verifies that with no usable runtime the raised ``E2EEnvironmentError`` mentions both binaries, all three repair paths (docker group, install podman, rootless), and carries remediation. <!--#bab383523055ec0d-->
  - `TestAutoSelection.test_none_available_message_names_each_failed_candidate` (method) — Verifies the no-runtime error message includes each candidate's specific failure detail. <!--#30b83f4e2ec5a049-->
- `TestExplicitSelectionNeverFallsBack` (class) — Tests that an explicitly requested runtime is probed alone and its failure raises without ever falling back to the other runtime. <!--#c03a4460b881b190-->
  - `TestExplicitSelectionNeverFallsBack.test_explicit_docker_unavailable_does_not_try_podman` (method) — Verifies explicit docker selection probes only docker and raises even when podman is usable. <!--#e9a209662dff5ec8-->
  - `TestExplicitSelectionNeverFallsBack.test_explicit_podman_unavailable_does_not_try_docker` (method) — Verifies explicit podman selection probes only podman and raises even when docker is usable. <!--#69430b291f7c7ba2-->
  - `TestExplicitSelectionNeverFallsBack.test_explicit_failure_carries_remediation_and_the_no_fallback_reason` (method) — Verifies an explicit-runtime failure error carries the failure detail, a no-fallback explanation, and remediation. <!--#77c14a0629cd2a5a-->
  - `TestExplicitSelectionNeverFallsBack.test_explicit_podman_selected_when_usable` (method) — Verifies explicit podman selection returns podman and probes only podman even when docker also works. <!--#234da02f6922fb28-->
- `TestPreferenceNormalization` (class) — Tests that runtime preference values are normalized — blank/cased/whitespace values mean auto, explicit names tolerate case and whitespace, and unknown values raise ``E2EConfigError`` without probing. <!--#7be1cf1be1e806e2-->
  - `TestPreferenceNormalization.test_blank_and_cased_values_mean_auto` (method) — Verifies None, empty, blank, and variously-cased 'auto' preferences all select the auto path (docker). <!--#0a8f2a091df7faeb-->
  - `TestPreferenceNormalization.test_case_and_whitespace_tolerated_for_explicit_runtime` (method) — Verifies a padded, upper-cased explicit runtime name (' PODMAN ') still selects podman. <!--#7b32f09ffaf4f142-->
  - `TestPreferenceNormalization.test_unknown_value_is_a_config_error_not_an_environment_error` (method) — Verifies unrecognized preference values raise ``E2EConfigError`` referencing ``e2e.runtime`` without any probing. <!--#3d3f85feb7ecffa9-->
- `TestProbeOne` (class) — Tests for ``probe_one``: the exact ``info --format {{json .}}`` command, never-raise failure reporting with distinct error keys, rootless detection, and tolerance of unparsable output. <!--#5684a77c6a729942-->
  - `TestProbeOne.test_builds_a_json_formatted_info_command` (method) — Verifies the probe invokes ``<binary> info --format {{json .}}``. <!--#bdcaeabe5e9f29de-->
  - `TestProbeOne.test_never_raises_for_an_unusable_runtime` (method) — Verifies a missing binary yields a falsy, not-ok result with error_key ``e2e.probe.not_installed`` and remediation instead of raising. <!--#2d2fb585f1bf94c2-->
  - `TestProbeOne.test_reports_exit_code_and_stderr_detail` (method) — Verifies a nonzero-exit failure result includes the exit code and stderr detail in its error text. <!--#f4a06d5a012ef500-->
  - `TestProbeOne.test_timeout_is_reported_as_its_own_failure_kind` (method) — Verifies a timeout produces a failure result with error_key ``e2e.probe.timeout``. <!--#6c53e847b56b158a-->
  - `TestProbeOne.test_launch_failure_is_distinguished_from_a_nonzero_exit` (method) — Verifies an ``OSError`` at launch produces error_key ``e2e.probe.launch_failed`` with the OS error detail. <!--#fd7878540e239c68-->
  - `TestProbeOne.test_rootless_detection` (method) — Parametrized test verifying the rootless flag is derived correctly from docker/podman info output for rootful and rootless variants. <!--#92d3ad79d36f643c-->
  - `TestProbeOne.test_unparsable_info_output_still_counts_as_usable` (method) — Verifies that a zero exit code with non-JSON output still counts as usable, defaulting rootless to False. <!--#a65c05ec992b4dd3-->
- `TestResultObject` (class) — Tests for the ``RuntimeProbeResult`` value object: frozen immutability and a binary attribute matching the selected runtime. <!--#277a682795bd4099-->
  - `TestResultObject.test_result_is_immutable_so_a_session_can_pin_it` (method) — Verifies the probe result is a frozen dataclass, raising ``FrozenInstanceError`` on attribute assignment. <!--#008cc908549f76c0-->
  - `TestResultObject.test_binary_matches_the_selected_runtime` (method) — Verifies the result is a ``RuntimeProbeResult`` whose ``binary`` equals the selected runtime name. <!--#042fe1e9393e7bd9-->
- `TestPreflight` (class) — Tests for the ``preflight`` entry point: it delegates to the same probe path as ``probe_runtime``, accepts a bare string/None/partial config, defaults to auto, and raises ``E2EEnvironmentError`` with remediation on failure. <!--#1869dc59832b4241-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_shares_the_probe_path_with_probe_runtime` (method) — Verifies ``preflight`` with a config object produces the identical result and probe calls as calling ``probe_runtime`` directly. <!--#45328f28e4791c43-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_accepts_a_bare_preference_string` (method) — Verifies ``preflight`` accepts a bare runtime preference string in place of a config object. <!--#77d6e9e37f174040-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_no_config_means_auto` (method) — Verifies ``preflight(None)`` behaves as auto mode, probing docker then podman. <!--#834d27ffed853cab-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_config_without_runtime_attribute_means_auto` (method) — Verifies a config lacking a ``runtime`` attribute defaults to auto selection. <!--#46b57e3ecdc0594e-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_failure_is_an_environment_error_so_it_skips_the_fix_loop` (method) — Verifies preflight failure raises ``E2EEnvironmentError`` (with remediation) so callers skip the fix loop. <!--#ca8e551d5bc98f5c-->
- `test_probe_module_never_escalates_privileges` (function) — Source-scanning guard test asserting the runtime_probe module never invokes ``sudo`` or ``pkexec``, keeping tianluo unprivileged end to end. <!--#f1c60ef36363bef1-->

### `tests/e2e/test_session.py` (python) — Tests the e2e run session orchestration — runtime preflight short-circuiting and probe forwarding, scenario selection semantics (config vs explicit precedence, critical-scenario guarantees, unknown/empty selections, network-name isolation), and environment lifecycle (create/start/destroy ordering, teardown on failure, `keep_environment` behaviour) — using stub runners, scenario factories, and a RecordingFactory backend spy. <!--#acd4fb8f5aab7c82|ce359a67bb6e27b2-->
- `working_runner` (function) — Subprocess-runner stub that simulates a successful `docker info` so runtime preflight passes. <!--#766ef78fb9708885-->
- `broken_runner` (function) — Subprocess-runner stub that fails every runtime probe, simulating a host with no usable container runtime. <!--#92baeb26c6412693-->
- `passing_scenario` (function) — Factory for a scenario whose single `file_exists` assertion on /workspace will pass against the fake backend. <!--#f3575a4bfeb2626a-->
- `failing_scenario` (function) — Factory for a scenario whose `file_exists` assertion on /nope will fail. <!--#8796285319dddcd9-->
- `enabled_config` (function) — Factory returning an `E2EConfig` with `enabled=True` plus caller overrides. <!--#a95628a10eb1e03e-->
- `RecordingFactory` (class) — Backend-factory spy that records each invocation (probe and kwargs) while returning a fixed FakeBackend. <!--#38e0e7059cb8c4f8-->
  - `RecordingFactory.__init__` (method) — Stores the FakeBackend to return and initialises the call log. <!--#b10c787c7cd5b71f-->
  - `RecordingFactory.__call__` (method) — Records the probe and kwargs it was called with, then returns the stored backend. <!--#0ec9099343408ee9-->
- `TestPreflight` (class) — Tests that container-runtime preflight short-circuits before any environment is built, skips the fix loop, reports remediation, forwards probe results to the factory, and is bypassed by an injected backend. <!--#f331c58852b60b18-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_failure_short_circuits_before_anything_is_created` (method) — Asserts a failed runtime probe yields an environment error with remediation and no backend/network/container is ever created. <!--#e82fdc41ca775de6-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_environment_failure_never_enters_the_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts an environment failure produces no fix payload (`should_fix` False, empty instructions/context, `as_failure()` None). <!--#05216b9a0c87f4ea-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_remediation_mentions_how_to_get_a_runtime` (method) — Asserts the remediation text points the user at installing docker or podman. <!--#878a1a41bdd97da1-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_probe_result_reaches_the_backend_factory` (method) — Asserts the successful probe result and config kwargs (`oci_runtime`, `build_timeout`) are passed through to the backend factory. <!--#d95de03151fbaf77-->
  - `TestPreflight.test_injected_backend_skips_probing_entirely` (method) — Asserts that passing a backend directly means no subprocess probing runs at all. <!--#a8fdc21a55118944-->
- `TestConfigurationAndSelection` (class) — Tests scenario selection semantics: config vs explicit argument precedence, unknown/critical scenario validation, critical-scenario guarantees, empty runs, and network-name isolation. <!--#58a47e7251d91ffa-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_absent_content_directory_is_reported_with_its_path` (method) — Asserts a missing e2e content directory raises `E2EConfigError` naming the path before any backend creation. <!--#0851b20d33d9a610-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_content_is_loaded_from_disk_when_not_injected` (method) — Asserts content is loaded from the on-disk `tianluo/e2e/` tree when not injected, and the run passes. <!--#bdfe8093644d9f14-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_configured_selection_limits_the_run` (method) — Asserts a `scenarios` list in config narrows the run to only the named scenario. <!--#4bcb1ba1ec8eea46-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_explicit_argument_overrides_the_configured_selection` (method) — Asserts an explicit `scenarios` argument takes precedence over the configured selection. <!--#eda72b0bf36f8432-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_unknown_selected_scenario_is_an_error_not_an_empty_run` (method) — Asserts selecting an undeclared scenario raises a config error naming both the typo and the available scenarios, before anything is built. <!--#610143c99bbfc94c-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_unknown_configured_scenario_is_also_refused` (method) — Asserts an unknown scenario named in config also raises `E2EConfigError`. <!--#aae65c8657e00454-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_a_critical_scenario_runs_even_when_the_selection_excludes_it` (method) — Asserts a critical scenario is force-included and run even when the selection would exclude it. <!--#4164071b5645c1f2-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_a_critical_scenario_is_added_to_an_explicit_scenario_argument_too` (method) — Asserts critical scenarios are also appended to an explicit `scenarios` argument. <!--#fcc6fcdb989e051d-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_a_selected_critical_scenario_is_not_run_twice` (method) — Asserts a scenario that is both selected and critical runs exactly once. <!--#f9e211171e544ffb-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_a_failing_critical_scenario_fails_the_run` (method) — Asserts a failing critical scenario fails the whole run and routes to the fix loop. <!--#5cc84f240a8bdadd-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_an_undeclared_critical_scenario_is_a_configuration_error` (method) — Asserts a critical scenario that doesn't exist is a config error raised before any environment is built. <!--#39381afa71d9fc16-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_an_unverified_critical_scenario_cannot_pass` (method) — Asserts a critical scenario with no recorded result makes the verdict fail with a `critical_scenario_not_verified` fix issue. <!--#2facbdeb582ee167-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_nothing_selected_builds_no_environment` (method) — Asserts an empty scenario selection passes trivially with total 0 and no environment created. <!--#84015e16f0e4b988-->
  - `TestConfigurationAndSelection.test_network_suffix_isolates_concurrent_runs` (method) — Asserts a `network_suffix` produces a sanitised, lowercased, unique `tianluo-e2e-*` network name for concurrent-run isolation. <!--#5de9660432c34572-->
- `TestLifecycle` (class) — Tests environment lifecycle: create/start/destroy ordering, teardown on failure paths, `keep_environment` behaviour and notices, readiness awaiting, and error classification. <!--#75469ae1f1975e64-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_happy_path_creates_starts_and_destroys` (method) — Asserts a passing run creates, starts, and destroys exactly one environment. <!--#8945f9849a2a3e24-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_destroy_still_runs_when_a_scenario_explodes` (method) — Asserts teardown still happens even when a scenario raises an unexpected exception. <!--#b1671fa65f2ff6bc-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_keep_environment_skips_teardown` (method) — Asserts `keep_environment=True` skips teardown and surfaces a WARNING-level cleanup notice both via logging and as structured verdict data. <!--#c7c7e5c43c4662fa-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_a_torn_down_environment_produces_no_cleanup_notice` (method) — Asserts a normally torn-down run carries no notices and no `kept_environment` summary entry. <!--#7b4ba08193f60729-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_keep_environment_argument_overrides_the_config` (method) — Asserts an explicit `keep_environment=False` argument overrides the config and teardown runs. <!--#1612e676c0d28823-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_readiness_is_awaited_for_every_declared_probe` (method) — Asserts declared readiness probes (e.g. `pg_isready`) are actually executed before scenarios run. <!--#bec774f66b5303ba-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_readiness_timeout_is_an_environment_error` (method) — Asserts a readiness timeout becomes a non-fixable environment error with teardown still performed. <!--#d352116b19982294-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_start_failure_is_an_environment_error_with_remediation` (method) — Asserts a backend start failure surfaces its message and remediation as an environment error, with teardown still run. <!--#316873e72f103f52-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_a_partially_created_environment_is_still_torn_down` (method) — Asserts a `create` failure mid-way (after the network exists) still triggers teardown via the published handle. <!--#53f78abe41d6c989-->
  - `TestLifecycle.test_nothing_is_torn_down_when_create_was_never_reached` (method) — Asserts that when preflight fails before create, no handle exists and destroy is never called. <!--#7e2a69de2c8cee4b-->
- `TestVerdict` (class) — Tests the E2EVerdict shape: fix-loop routing, fix instructions/context content (logs, action traces, structured issues), summary structure and timing, and the exception/`as_failure` form. <!--#cb3a33eed55ad130-->
  - `TestVerdict._failing_verdict` (method) — Helper that runs a failing scenario against a FakeBackend with failing execs and a log tail, returning backend and verdict. <!--#1a3bcab2c7046b3e-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_scenario_failure_routes_to_the_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts a scenario (non-environment) failure sets `should_fix` with no environment error. <!--#9bc346301e807324-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_fix_instructions_quote_expected_and_actual` (method) — Asserts fix instructions name the scenario and quote expected and actual values. <!--#77d53b0723bab104-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_fix_instructions_include_the_container_log_tail` (method) — Asserts the container log tail is captured (while the container still exists) and embedded in fix instructions. <!--#08d48429c4c94d03-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_the_log_tail_covers_every_service_not_only_the_driver` (method) — Asserts log tails are captured from every service, not just the driver, so server-side tracebacks reach the fix loop. <!--#fad1dc938e9d6e81-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_action_trace_reaches_the_fix_instructions` (method) — Asserts the failed action's command and exit code appear in fix instructions so the root cause is visible. <!--#765665ed298047eb-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_an_action_failure_becomes_its_own_fix_issue` (method) — Asserts a failed action with no adjudicating assertion still produces an `action`-kind fix issue. <!--#c978f7b5b3f42610-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_fix_context_is_structured` (method) — Asserts `fix_context` carries the reason, failed scenario list, and structured issues with kind/tier/expected/actual. <!--#a639ee16a11f2088-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_summary_is_the_structured_step_output` (method) — Asserts the verdict summary reports totals, per-scenario pass/fail lists, runtime, and per-scenario entries. <!--#774095d25082f4a7-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_summary_times_the_environment_apart_from_the_scenarios` (method) — Asserts the summary times environment setup separately from scenario execution using the injected clock. <!--#d1e4c0a8f8ccdbc4-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_as_failure_exposes_the_exception_form` (method) — Asserts `as_failure()` returns an `E2EScenarioFailure` naming the scenario and carrying the results. <!--#2b84ebe8d2d1ebd1-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_passing_verdict_carries_no_fix_payload` (method) — Asserts a passing verdict has empty fix instructions/context and no failed scenarios. <!--#9c5131944e8ff0ec-->
  - `TestVerdict.test_verdict_mirrors_the_test_verdict_field_names` (method) — Asserts `E2EVerdict` shares the fix-related field vocabulary with `TestVerdict` and documents the mapping in its docstring. <!--#7b9d1f449d0125a8-->
- `_write_content` (function) — Helper writing a minimal valid on-disk `tianluo/e2e/` tree (environment.yaml plus a cli-smoke scenario). <!--#5190cdfb46a0f1a3-->
- `_write_visual_content` (function) — Helper writing content whose only scenario uses a tier-2 `screenshot_diff` assertion with no baseline image yet. <!--#9d1d3ad98c661af1-->
- `TestOnDiskContent` (class) — Tests loading real YAML content from disk: end-to-end runs, invalid-content errors, strict missing-baseline behaviour, baseline capture, and project config loading. <!--#8fe8314d3dabd4e5-->
  - `TestOnDiskContent.test_yaml_scenario_runs_end_to_end_against_the_fake_backend` (method) — Asserts a YAML-defined scenario loads from disk and runs to a pass against the FakeBackend. <!--#d0236c83b2fa8570-->
  - `TestOnDiskContent.test_invalid_yaml_content_propagates_as_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts invalid YAML content (tier-2 assertion without opt-in) surfaces as `E2EConfigError` before any environment is created. <!--#fe65dcc98d9853f2-->
  - `TestOnDiskContent.test_an_absent_baseline_aborts_the_load_by_default` (method) — Asserts a missing screenshot baseline aborts loading by default with an error pointing at `--write-baselines`. <!--#9d2d0ad6d9d6c612-->
  - `TestOnDiskContent.test_write_missing_baselines_reaches_the_assertion_layer` (method) — Asserts `write_missing_baselines=True` lets the first capture reach the assertion layer, writing the baseline file while deliberately not passing. <!--#9759e83378e93d14-->
  - `TestOnDiskContent.test_config_is_loaded_from_the_project_when_not_passed` (method) — Asserts the E2E config is loaded from the project's `tianluo.yaml` when not passed explicitly. <!--#c10d9b3d3e0846dd-->

### `tests/e2e/test_templates.py` (python) — Tests the e2e Dockerfile template system: the kind registry (base/playwright/gui-xvfb), per-template rendering invariants (base image, workdir, no-COPY bind-mount, pinned playwright image, headless GUI stack, opt-in VNC), and build-step expansion/rendering semantics including render_for_service field mapping. <!--#07c99c82291efab9|7ec961a92fbf506a-->
- `render` (function) — Local helper that renders a Dockerfile template of the given kind via templates.render_dockerfile with a keyword context dict. <!--#4d55b7368b8533d2-->
- `TestKinds` (class) — Tests that the template registry advertises exactly the base/playwright/gui-xvfb kinds, rejects unknown kinds as config errors, and that every advertised kind actually renders. <!--#f7f043ef4ba1fb33-->
  - `TestKinds.test_the_three_service_shapes_are_available` (method) — Asserts available_kinds() returns exactly the set {base, playwright, gui-xvfb}. <!--#de2275b3634dcc0c-->
  - `TestKinds.test_unknown_kind_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts rendering an unknown kind ("kubernetes") raises E2EConfigError mentioning the kind name. <!--#be5ba7c0376c4f87-->
  - `TestKinds.test_every_advertised_kind_actually_renders` (method) — Asserts every advertised kind renders to a Dockerfile starting with the "# syntax=" directive when given a base_image. <!--#21e4c1c045cdbc5d-->
- `TestBaseTemplate` (class) — Tests the base Dockerfile template: base image selection, workdir defaulting/overriding, the no-COPY bind-mount invariant, and missing-base_image config errors. <!--#1edbe1caa6907afd-->
  - `TestBaseTemplate.test_uses_the_configured_base_image` (method) — Asserts the rendered base template's FROM line uses the configured base_image. <!--#aaf1570fee019926-->
  - `TestBaseTemplate.test_defaults_the_workdir` (method) — Asserts the base template defaults WORKDIR to /workspace. <!--#945025ae78ff73b0-->
  - `TestBaseTemplate.test_honours_an_explicit_workdir` (method) — Asserts an explicit workdir context value overrides the default WORKDIR. <!--#e501d50187714aef-->
  - `TestBaseTemplate.test_never_copies_the_project_source_in` (method) — Asserts the rendered base template contains no COPY or ADD instructions, since the source is bind-mounted for fix-loop image reuse. <!--#fcc45718ece7f691-->
  - `TestBaseTemplate.test_a_missing_base_image_is_a_config_error` (method) — Asserts rendering the base template without base_image raises E2EConfigError naming the missing field. <!--#991cb0c036f6a4a0-->
- `TestPlaywrightTemplate` (class) — Tests the playwright Dockerfile template: pinned official default image, the font-rendering INVARIANT note for visual baselines, and explicit base image override. <!--#7ab929c8352ccc35-->
  - `TestPlaywrightTemplate.test_defaults_to_a_pinned_official_image` (method) — Asserts the playwright template defaults FROM to a pinned (non-latest) mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image so visual baselines stay stable. <!--#8bfdac10a95f59bc-->
  - `TestPlaywrightTemplate.test_records_why_baselines_must_come_from_this_image` (method) — Asserts the rendered playwright template documents the font-rendering INVARIANT that makes tier-2 screenshot diffs meaningful. <!--#7504fbba26b1e605-->
  - `TestPlaywrightTemplate.test_accepts_an_explicit_base_image` (method) — Asserts an explicit base_image context value is honoured in the playwright template's FROM line. <!--#4f73fd0373cb5326-->
- `TestGuiTemplate` (class) — Tests the gui-xvfb Dockerfile template: headless GUI stack packages, virtual display env, configurable display/screen, opt-in VNC debug stack, and single-FROM self-containment. <!--#941554d0b803847d-->
  - `TestGuiTemplate.test_installs_the_headless_gui_stack` (method) — Parametrized test asserting the gui-xvfb template installs xvfb, openbox, scrot, and xdotool. <!--#833555836e6f5558-->
  - `TestGuiTemplate.test_exposes_the_virtual_display` (method) — Asserts the gui-xvfb template sets ENV DISPLAY=:99 and launches Xvfb. <!--#7de8b80268ba9b76-->
  - `TestGuiTemplate.test_display_and_screen_are_configurable` (method) — Asserts display and screen context values override the default DISPLAY and screen geometry in the gui-xvfb template. <!--#6b019c33881a016c-->
  - `TestGuiTemplate.test_the_vnc_debug_stack_is_off_by_default` (method) — Asserts the gui-xvfb template omits x11vnc and port 5900 unless debug tools are requested. <!--#6d111e188fe2f3a2-->
  - `TestGuiTemplate.test_the_vnc_debug_stack_can_be_requested` (method) — Asserts debug_tools=True adds x11vnc/noVNC and exposes ports 5900 and 6080 in the gui-xvfb template. <!--#07db7f121cf2001c-->
  - `TestGuiTemplate.test_the_recipe_is_self_contained` (method) — Asserts the gui-xvfb template has exactly one FROM line on the caller's base image, building on nobody else's image. <!--#36c07a231490249c-->
- `TestBuildSteps` (class) — Tests build-step expansion and rendering: ordering, RUN-layer conversion, verbatim Dockerfile instructions, block scalars, continuations, blanks, bare strings, and render_for_service field mapping. <!--#e561cc8ea23e1f60-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_steps_keep_their_declared_order` (method) — Asserts build steps appear as RUN layers in the rendered Dockerfile in their declared order. <!--#78dd0b58fd1b2844-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_a_plain_step_becomes_a_run_layer` (method) — Asserts a plain command string step is expanded into a RUN instruction. <!--#f8b1208411852fba-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_a_dockerfile_instruction_is_emitted_verbatim` (method) — Asserts steps that already start with a Dockerfile instruction (ENV, USER) are emitted verbatim while plain commands get RUN-prefixed. <!--#1929fd6e5ccd1278-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_blank_steps_are_dropped` (method) — Asserts empty or whitespace-only build steps are dropped from expansion. <!--#a42c9f1af832212d-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_a_block_scalar_step_becomes_one_layer_per_line` (method) — Asserts a multi-line (YAML block scalar) step expands to one RUN layer per line, fixing the bare-instruction docker build failure. <!--#e6c7e7184af70c02-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_a_backslash_continuation_stays_one_instruction` (method) — Asserts a step written with a backslash line-continuation is kept as a single RUN instruction. <!--#c10506cc5b24dc27-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_instruction_and_comment_lines_inside_a_block_are_respected` (method) — Asserts comment and Dockerfile-instruction lines inside a multi-line block pass through verbatim while plain lines get RUN-prefixed. <!--#7941055e52adfe6f-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_every_rendered_line_is_a_valid_dockerfile_instruction` (method) — Property test asserting every rendered Dockerfile line (skipping blanks, comments, and continuations) starts with a valid Dockerfile instruction. <!--#8663f63b0f9500e8-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_no_steps_renders_nothing` (method) — Asserts expand_build_steps returns an empty string for None or an empty list. <!--#062769ded3182887-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_a_bare_string_is_one_step_not_one_layer_per_character` (method) — Asserts a bare string build_steps value is treated as one step rather than iterated per character into one-letter RUN layers. <!--#9975b0d320475b5a-->
  - `TestBuildSteps.test_render_for_service_maps_service_fields` (method) — Asserts render_for_service maps service fields (image, workdir, build_steps) into the corresponding FROM, WORKDIR, and RUN lines. <!--#ee848265d00c1a78-->
- `TestPackaging` (class) — Test class asserting that the e2e Dockerfile templates ship and load as proper package data — resolvable via `importlib.resources` for every kind in `available_kinds()`, with no third-party template engine (jinja2/mako) imported and no `__file__`-based path joining. <!--#280fc1dd3619f213-->
  - `TestPackaging.test_templates_are_locatable_as_package_data` (method) — Asserts every advertised kind's .Dockerfile.tmpl resolves as a file under tianluo.e2e/templates via importlib.resources, so installed wheels ship the templates. <!--#00028d593bc0ffdf-->
  - `TestPackaging.test_no_third_party_template_engine_is_imported` (method) — Asserts importing tianluo.e2e.templates pulls in neither jinja2 nor mako. <!--#7fa2c4d0af745210-->
  - `TestPackaging.test_loader_reads_through_the_import_system_only` (method) — Reads the `templates` module's own source to assert it loads resources only through `importlib.resources`/`pkgutil.get_data` and never references `__file__` outside explanatory prose, so zip-imported installs still resolve templates. <!--#069c3aa68a60235d-->

## `tests/engine/` — The unit/regression test package for SE3's flow engine, covering the StateMachine's step sequencing and routing (confirm/revision loops, adjudication, partial and spec-change reflows, baseline-failure handling), the step handlers and their sub-packages (formatters, steps), the fix/investigation loops and baseline capture-and-memory subsystem, LLM caller behaviour (agents, rotation errors, step overrides, retry context and continuation), prompt composition and residue/retirement guards, merge/conflict resolution and worktree GC, review scope and self-check, plus chat history, display/i18n rendering and docs/knowledge-asset updates. <!--#120e93e08a28b571|7a0645e5e134fe32-->

### `tests/engine/__init__.py` (python) — Package initializer marking the tests/engine directory as the Python test package for engine-related tests. <!--#33fbe48a88ada88d|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/engine/test_analyze_merge.py` (python) — Regression tests for the analyze-merge refactor, verifying that ANALYZE now carries the merged `project_summary`/`relevant_specs`/`root_cause_clear` outputs through `StateMachine._build_step_inputs` and `STEP_POOL`, that the retired `PROJECT_SUMMARY` step remains deprecated-but-working via a stub handler while `READ_SPEC` is gone from `StepType`, and that each task type's default step sequence matches the expected post-refactor order. <!--#28780a03694460b0|5323fe3368485c96-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Helper that constructs a running FlowInstance with default test ids for use across the merge tests. <!--#58ee353a1e28cb80-->
- `_add_completed_step` (function) — Helper that appends a COMPLETED step of a given type and outputs to a flow's state and returns it. <!--#5458df88dacfff7e-->
- `TestBuildStepInputsAnalyzeMapping` (class) — Tests that `StateMachine._build_step_inputs` forwards a completed ANALYZE step's merged outputs (`project_summary`, `task_type`, `scope`) into downstream steps such as PLAN. <!--#48439eda4820c535-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsAnalyzeMapping.sm` (method) — Fixture providing a StateMachine bound to the temp directory. <!--#6df4537a65345870-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsAnalyzeMapping.flow_with_analyze` (method) — Fixture building a flow whose completed ANALYZE step carries the full merged output set (`task_type`, `scope`, `root_cause_clear`, `project_summary`, `relevant_specs`, `spec_content`). <!--#4a1b5c8657e931e4-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsAnalyzeMapping.test_analyze_forwards_project_summary` (method) — Asserts project_summary from the ANALYZE step is forwarded into PLAN step inputs. <!--#9a3cc2f5396eb68b-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsAnalyzeMapping.test_analyze_forwards_task_type_and_scope` (method) — Asserts original ANALYZE outputs (task_type, scope) are still forwarded to PLAN inputs. <!--#191827367a8522b7-->
- `TestBuildStepInputsDeprecatedBackwardCompat` (class) — Tests backward compatibility for old flows, verifying the deprecated PROJECT_SUMMARY step still forwards project_summary while the removed READ_SPEC StepType is no longer parseable. <!--#6e100c3f7f1083a1-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsDeprecatedBackwardCompat.sm` (method) — Fixture providing a StateMachine bound to the temp directory. <!--#6df4537a65345870-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsDeprecatedBackwardCompat.test_old_project_summary_step_still_forwards` (method) — Asserts a legacy flow with a PROJECT_SUMMARY step still forwards its project_summary into PLAN inputs. <!--#1f9705fa50691f56-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsDeprecatedBackwardCompat.test_old_read_spec_step_type_no_longer_parseable` (method) — Asserts that constructing StepType('read_spec') raises ValueError since READ_SPEC was removed from the enum. <!--#f3fe62332f9ed641-->
- `TestStepSequenceNoProjectSummaryOrReadSpec` (class) — Sweeps `get_default_step_sequence` across all task types to assert PROJECT_SUMMARY is gone and pins the exact expected sequences for feature, review, small, survey, and discovery. <!--#539bc6f3d503069b-->
  - `TestStepSequenceNoProjectSummaryOrReadSpec.test_no_project_summary_in_sequence` (method) — Parametrized test asserting no task-type sequence contains PROJECT_SUMMARY. <!--#e2e529e31d989bf2-->
  - `TestStepSequenceNoProjectSummaryOrReadSpec.test_feature_sequence_starts_analyze_then_plan` (method) — Asserts the feature sequence begins with ANALYZE then PLAN. <!--#1e64a5cc0fbaa069-->
  - `TestStepSequenceNoProjectSummaryOrReadSpec.test_review_sequence_analyze_then_invariant_check` (method) — Asserts the review sequence is ANALYZE, INVARIANT_CHECK, SUMMARIZE after the charter refactor retired VERIFY_SPEC. <!--#95c9f463b7c4083f-->
  - `TestStepSequenceNoProjectSummaryOrReadSpec.test_small_sequence` (method) — Asserts the small sequence matches the expected steps including the new non-blocking CHARTER_FRESHNESS before VERSION_ANALYZE. <!--#63d5526840817295-->
  - `TestStepSequenceNoProjectSummaryOrReadSpec.test_survey_sequence` (method) — Asserts the survey task type is a pure investigation flow — ANALYZE → INVESTIGATE → SUMMARIZE with no SELF_CHECK. <!--#5cdab120ff235dbe-->
  - `TestStepSequenceNoProjectSummaryOrReadSpec.test_discovery_sequence_starts_with_discovery_then_analyze` (method) — Asserts the discovery sequence begins with DISCOVERY, ANALYZE, then PLAN. <!--#63d2146b2ff1b9e4-->
- `TestStepPoolUpdates` (class) — Test class asserting that STEP_POOL reflects the analyze-merge refactor — ANALYZE gains `project_summary`, `relevant_specs`, and `root_cause_clear` outputs while dropping `spec_content`, `PROJECT_SUMMARY` is flagged deprecated yet still read-only, and `read_spec` is gone from the `StepType` enum. <!--#baa49ce378db6ba3-->
  - `TestStepPoolUpdates.test_analyze_outputs_include_new_fields` (method) — Asserts the ANALYZE step's declared outputs now include the merged-in `project_summary` and `relevant_specs` fields. <!--#9e3ba4b4bf985f25-->
  - `TestStepPoolUpdates.test_analyze_outputs_drop_retired_spec_content` (method) — Asserts the retired `spec_content` output channel is no longer declared among the ANALYZE step's outputs. <!--#b808218df354f76c-->
  - `TestStepPoolUpdates.test_analyze_outputs_include_original_fields` (method) — Asserts ANALYZE's STEP_POOL outputs still include the original task_type and scope fields. <!--#0302de3ebd19f632-->
  - `TestStepPoolUpdates.test_analyze_outputs_declare_root_cause_clear` (method) — Asserts ANALYZE declares the `root_cause_clear` output that gates the conditional INVESTIGATE step. <!--#508b65693388d73d-->
  - `TestStepPoolUpdates.test_project_summary_marked_deprecated` (method) — Asserts PROJECT_SUMMARY's STEP_POOL entry is flagged deprecated in both its flag and description. <!--#9a86da873466eb5f-->
  - `TestStepPoolUpdates.test_project_summary_still_has_read_only` (method) — Asserts the deprecated PROJECT_SUMMARY step retains read_only=True for backward compatibility. <!--#7322b19ea1fa2798-->
  - `TestStepPoolUpdates.test_read_spec_step_type_removed` (method) — Asserts StepType('read_spec') raises ValueError, confirming READ_SPEC was removed from the enum. <!--#d52cc05074768f0c-->
- `TestStubHandlers` (class) — Tests that the deprecated project_summary_stub_handler is registered in STEP_HANDLERS and correctly delegates to the underlying project_summary_handler. <!--#fb2b9aac8d625568-->
  - `TestStubHandlers.test_step_handlers_uses_project_summary_stub` (method) — Asserts STEP_HANDLERS maps PROJECT_SUMMARY to project_summary_stub_handler. <!--#0e42afec96ee1e5c-->
  - `TestStubHandlers.test_project_summary_stub_forwards` (method) — Asserts project_summary_stub_handler delegates to project_summary_handler and returns its status. <!--#3adec8036aca7620-->

### `tests/engine/test_baseline_fix_loop.py` (python) — Unit tests for the fix loop's "mechanism B" that bounded-loops inherited/baseline test failures, driving the real test_handler with mocked _run_command to verify budget-gated looping, fix reason/instruction generation, and cross-flow given-up recording across enabled, disabled, exhausted, already-given-up, and mixed introduced+baseline scenarios. <!--#32be8920229cc48b|eb48e3bcadffb717-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a `FlowInstance` with a `tmp_path`-based `change_path` and an optional pre-seeded `baseline_fix_attempts` count in its state context. <!--#e034458e28c0e35d-->
- `_make_step` (function) — Helper that constructs a TEST Step pre-populated with tests_added, is_fix_iteration, and baseline_failures inputs. <!--#6d826d71807904bb-->
- `_primary_result` (function) — Helper that returns a fake _run_command result dict for a pytest invocation with the given stdout and pass/fail state. <!--#6184a48e6168a4c1-->
- `_run` (function) — Test helper that invokes the real `test_handler` while patching out `_run_command`, history/reporting side effects, and `TestConfig`/`WorkflowConfig` so the test command's stdout and the `baseline_fix_max_attempts` budget can be controlled. <!--#8805a82144ddaf1d-->
- `TestBaselineLoopsWithinBudget` (class) — Test class asserting that, while the retry budget is not yet exhausted, a pure baseline (pre-existing) test failure yields REVISION_NEEDED with `fix_context["reason"] == "baseline_failure"`, emits the baseline fix-instructions section, and is not yet recorded as given-up. <!--#b37bf15e52752ad0-->
  - `TestBaselineLoopsWithinBudget.test_pure_baseline_loops_with_reason_baseline_failure` (method) — Asserts a pure baseline failure within budget yields REVISION_NEEDED with blocking results and a 'baseline_failure' fix reason targeting that id. <!--#cbf561ae8c0a4a07-->
  - `TestBaselineLoopsWithinBudget.test_baseline_fix_instructions_section_present` (method) — Verifies the generated `fix_instructions` contain the "BASELINE (PRE-EXISTING) TEST FAILURES" section listing the failing baseline id, plus the equal-priority / PARALLEL / charter / INVARIANT: / MUST NOT wording. <!--#812bcdb8596ca029-->
  - `TestBaselineLoopsWithinBudget.test_given_up_recorded_only_on_exhaustion_not_while_looping` (method) — Asserts that while still within budget no baseline id is yet recorded in the persistent given-up store. <!--#d059337ea6cd12e2-->
- `TestBaselineBudgetDisabled` (class) — Test group covering budget=0, where baseline failures are surfaced but never looped or recorded as given-up. <!--#d02507f78e408e63-->
  - `TestBaselineBudgetDisabled.test_disabled_budget_surfaces_without_loop` (method) — Asserts a disabled (0) budget completes without blocking, without a fix loop, and without recording any given-up id. <!--#d8d9824461255022-->
- `TestBaselineBudgetExhausted` (class) — Test group covering exhausted budgets, where baseline failures are recorded as given-up yet still surfaced. <!--#236f3bded59f172b-->
  - `TestBaselineBudgetExhausted.test_exhausted_records_given_up_and_surfaces` (method) — Asserts that hitting the attempt cap completes non-blocking and persists the baseline id as given-up with reason 'exhausted'. <!--#dc64b10e3da34dfb-->
  - `TestBaselineBudgetExhausted.test_exhausted_inherited_still_surfaced` (method) — Asserts that even when exhausted the inherited failure is still reported in the step outputs. <!--#72e3d83aa8b72422-->
- `TestGivenUpSkipped` (class) — Test group verifying that ids already in the cross-flow given-up store are excluded from the active baseline and not looped. <!--#8e701a73dc37d458-->
  - `TestGivenUpSkipped.test_given_up_id_not_looped` (method) — Asserts a pre-recorded given-up id leaves active_baseline empty and non-blocking while still surfacing it as inherited. <!--#ae899665d23c08e1-->
- `TestMixedIntroducedAndBaseline` (class) — Test group covering runs mixing introduced and baseline failures, checking reason selection and baseline-section inclusion. <!--#76dbe576b61fa498-->
  - `TestMixedIntroducedAndBaseline.test_mixed_uses_introduced_reason_but_targets_baseline` (method) — Asserts a mixed failure uses the 'test_failure' reason yet still annotates targeted baseline ids and prepends the baseline section. <!--#901815a17c23dcd6-->
  - `TestMixedIntroducedAndBaseline.test_only_introduced_has_no_baseline_section` (method) — Asserts an introduced-only failure uses 'test_failure' with no baseline_failures_targeted key and no baseline section in instructions. <!--#6b547b62a98770d3-->

### `tests/engine/test_baseline_fix_memory.py` (python) — Unit tests for engine/baseline_fix_memory.py verifying that load_given_up tolerates missing/corrupt/schema-mismatched/non-mapping stores by returning an empty set, that record_given_up performs atomic writes and correctly accumulates attempts, preserves reasons, isolates entries, and clamps negatives, and that the store enforces an LRU bound at MAX_ENTRIES that keeps the most-recently-touched ids. <!--#8c9f654a6125f015|9d56640a2bdb373d-->
- `TestLoadGivenUp` (class) — Test class verifying load_given_up returns an empty set for missing, corrupt, schema-mismatched, or non-mapping store files, plus a basic write/read roundtrip. <!--#792ba7e132421709-->
  - `TestLoadGivenUp.test_missing_file_reads_empty` (method) — Asserts load_given_up returns an empty set when no store file exists. <!--#e63e4f0e11cd3648-->
  - `TestLoadGivenUp.test_roundtrip` (method) — Asserts ids recorded via record_given_up are read back by load_given_up. <!--#aec9a337fe48fd9b-->
  - `TestLoadGivenUp.test_corrupt_json_reads_empty` (method) — Asserts load_given_up returns an empty set when the store file contains invalid JSON. <!--#4c74462bb47565d1-->
  - `TestLoadGivenUp.test_schema_mismatch_reads_empty` (method) — Asserts load_given_up ignores a store with an unrecognized schema_version and returns an empty set. <!--#d2af19853dc6b275-->
  - `TestLoadGivenUp.test_non_mapping_reads_empty` (method) — Asserts load_given_up returns an empty set when the store's top-level JSON is not a mapping. <!--#0c0ab6bcf4510ac2-->
- `TestRecordGivenUp` (class) — Test class verifying record_given_up's atomic write, empty-id no-op, attempt accumulation, reason preservation, entry isolation, and negative-attempt clamping. <!--#d301c4f2b80464f6-->
  - `TestRecordGivenUp.test_atomic_write_leaves_no_tempfile` (method) — Asserts record_given_up leaves no temp file behind after its atomic write. <!--#d6ec216aa4b4aa88-->
  - `TestRecordGivenUp.test_empty_ids_is_noop` (method) — Asserts recording an empty id list writes no file and stores nothing. <!--#bf1c73ab868c704a-->
  - `TestRecordGivenUp.test_attempts_accumulate` (method) — Asserts repeated records sum attempt counts and the latest non-null reason wins. <!--#99b2a123cf4f4d63-->
  - `TestRecordGivenUp.test_reason_preserved_when_none_on_rerecord` (method) — Asserts a re-record with reason=None keeps the previously stored reason while still accumulating attempts. <!--#3d2cbc5840bff03e-->
  - `TestRecordGivenUp.test_other_entries_preserved` (method) — Asserts recording a new id does not drop previously recorded entries. <!--#abde7743737cca5f-->
  - `TestRecordGivenUp.test_negative_attempts_clamped_to_zero` (method) — Asserts a negative attempts value is clamped to zero when stored. <!--#b14f44f3650c518d-->
- `TestLruBound` (class) — Test class verifying the store enforces MAX_ENTRIES by evicting least-recently-touched ids, with re-records refreshing recency. <!--#d5ac364cfd31a01f-->
  - `TestLruBound.test_trims_oldest_beyond_cap` (method) — Asserts that exceeding MAX_ENTRIES evicts the oldest ids and keeps the most-recently-added ones. <!--#7f3d8f66cd8d90e6-->
  - `TestLruBound.test_rerecord_refreshes_recency` (method) — Asserts re-recording an existing id refreshes its recency so a later eviction removes a different, now-oldest id. <!--#7d1996effce747e5-->

### `tests/engine/test_baseline_module.py` (python) — Unit test suite for the baseline module, covering `compute_baseline_key` git-state fingerprinting, the bounded/atomic on-disk baseline cache with miss-on-corruption semantics, and `BaselineCapture`'s async launch/wait lifecycle including failure-ID parsing, `test.parallel` xdist command resolution, the `None` infra-failure sentinel, and timeout-kill behavior. <!--#e8b16b43e188c8f8|a1a16535a7375348-->
- `_git` (function) — Helper that runs a git subcommand in a given directory, raising on non-zero exit. <!--#4d03c5ca196c4c7c-->
- `git_repo` (function) — Pytest fixture providing a freshly initialized git repository with one committed file. <!--#3595cbba9e350caa-->
- `_py_print_command` (function) — Helper that builds a `python -c` command which prints a given body and exits zero. <!--#fdcbb03109808f97-->
- `TestComputeBaselineKey` (class) — Tests that compute_baseline_key is stable for an unchanged tree but changes on HEAD, tracked, or untracked content edits. <!--#3e2c1742c13ca0fd-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_stable_for_unchanged_tree` (method) — Asserts the baseline key is identical across calls on an unchanged tree and has the head:dirty form. <!--#35ff829c306de2bf-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_changes_on_head_change` (method) — Asserts the baseline key changes after a new commit moves HEAD. <!--#c338ec26a40a95af-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_changes_on_tracked_modification` (method) — Asserts the baseline key changes when a tracked file is modified without committing. <!--#60418cd7cfa2e500-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_changes_on_untracked_content` (method) — Asserts adding and then editing untracked file content each shift the baseline key. <!--#e546805d74335034-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_non_git_dir_does_not_raise` (method) — Asserts a non-git directory yields a string key prefixed with 'no-head:' rather than raising. <!--#49ba46bb2ad9da63-->
- `TestBaselineCache` (class) — Tests the on-disk baseline cache: round-trip, hit/miss semantics, corruption tolerance, bounding, and atomic writes. <!--#f26adb14f46c5b49-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_round_trip_hit` (method) — Asserts a saved failure set is read back identically for the same key. <!--#5997ca605e765382-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_empty_set_is_a_hit_not_a_miss` (method) — Asserts a cached empty set loads as an empty set (a hit), distinct from a None miss. <!--#0afae4918df906a4-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_missing_file_is_miss` (method) — Asserts loading from a nonexistent cache file returns None. <!--#35ac32b6958f0d56-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_unknown_key_is_miss` (method) — Asserts loading an unsaved key returns None even when other keys exist. <!--#9af4e2169e08410e-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_corrupt_json_is_miss` (method) — Asserts a cache file with invalid JSON is treated as a miss (returns None). <!--#9c39405c78fbf2f9-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_schema_mismatch_is_miss` (method) — Asserts a cache file with an unrecognized schema_version is treated as a miss. <!--#481b991450893f86-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_save_preserves_other_keys` (method) — Asserts saving one key does not overwrite previously saved keys. <!--#44354eeb93b3b5a5-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_cache_is_bounded` (method) — Asserts the cache evicts oldest entries once MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES is exceeded. <!--#ef7189669d7f2b95-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_atomic_write_leaves_no_tmp` (method) — Asserts the atomic save leaves no leftover temporary files behind. <!--#229289b723094e42-->
- `TestBaselineCapture` (class) — Tests BaselineCapture's launch/wait lifecycle, failure-ID parsing, recursion-guard env, idempotency, and the None infra-failure sentinel. <!--#0258b1770d194d78-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_parses_failed_ids` (method) — Asserts capture parses out the set of FAILED test IDs from subprocess output. <!--#c99d72414043f287-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_all_passed_returns_empty_set` (method) — Asserts an all-passing run resolves to an empty set rather than None. <!--#eaa31b2711465301-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_wait_blocks_until_ready` (method) — Asserts is_ready is False right after launch and wait() blocks until the slow run completes. <!--#8416f225cb9b92c0-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_infra_failure_returns_none_sentinel` (method) — Asserts a non-zero exit with no parseable per-test output resolves to the None sentinel. <!--#c3c02e5b0555b59b-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_launch_failure_returns_none_sentinel` (method) — Asserts a failure to launch the command is immediately ready and resolves to None. <!--#4b3a1f5099033cec-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_sets_recursion_guard_env` (method) — Asserts the child subprocess sees SE3_TEST_RUNNING=1 to guard against recursive test runs. <!--#a5d52ace5e789446-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_wait_is_idempotent` (method) — Asserts repeated wait() calls return the same resolved result. <!--#2e3d29481ca17e0f-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_wait_timeout_raises_then_resolves` (method) — Asserts wait() with a short timeout raises TimeoutExpired but remains resumable to completion. <!--#2def5cf22cb7963b-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_resolve_command_defaults_to_pytest_verbose` (method) — Asserts the default resolved command runs pytest in verbose (-v) mode. <!--#59b8e7921a4687bb-->
- `TestResolveCommandParallel` (class) — Test class asserting that `BaselineCapture._resolve_command()` honours the same `test.parallel` setting as the test step — appending `-n <workers> --dist loadgroup` to pytest commands, leaving serial/non-pytest commands untouched, and degrading to the `None` sentinel when xdist is missing. <!--#16a592932baebcb8-->
  - `TestResolveCommandParallel._write_project` (method) — Helper that seeds a temporary project root with a minimal `pyproject.toml` and a `tianluo.yaml` containing the given `test:` block. <!--#724f518e9db9ff1f-->
  - `TestResolveCommandParallel.test_auto_appends_xdist_flags_to_detected_command` (method) — Asserts that with `parallel: auto` and no configured command, the auto-detected pytest command gains `-n auto`, `--dist loadgroup`, and `-v`. <!--#7b4b5a66ff853531-->
  - `TestResolveCommandParallel.test_integer_workers_appended_to_configured_command` (method) — Asserts that an integer `parallel: 3` appends `-n 3 --dist loadgroup` to an explicitly configured pytest command. <!--#5367534dac7bb322-->
  - `TestResolveCommandParallel.test_unset_parallel_stays_serial` (method) — Asserts that omitting `parallel` leaves the resolved command free of `-n` and `--dist`, keeping the baseline serial. <!--#311c865b2b89f2c7-->
  - `TestResolveCommandParallel.test_non_pytest_command_is_untouched` (method) — Asserts that a non-pytest command such as `npm test` is returned verbatim even when `parallel: auto` is set. <!--#05f593559b4485bd-->
  - `TestResolveCommandParallel.test_missing_xdist_degrades_to_none_sentinel` (method) — Asserts that a `_resolve_command()` failure (missing pytest-xdist) does not crash the capture — `wait()` yields `None` while `is_ready()` stays `True`. <!--#d14cc54d55dab5e5-->
  - `TestResolveCommandParallel.test_usage_error_output_resolves_to_none_sentinel` (method) — Asserts that a real pytest argparse usage error (unrecognized `-n`/`--dist`) produces no parseable per-test lines, so `wait()` returns the `None` sentinel. <!--#c971f6b000f5ff26-->
- `TestBaselineTimeoutKill` (class) — Tests BaselineCapture.wait_or_kill/kill behavior: timeout-kills the subprocess, returns None, sets timed_out, and is idempotent. <!--#370ef7ae91c50b96-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_wait_or_kill_returns_none_and_kills_on_timeout` (method) — Asserts wait_or_kill on timeout returns None, sets timed_out, and actually terminates the subprocess. <!--#bbb42dda51601768-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_wait_or_kill_resolves_normally_within_bound` (method) — Asserts wait_or_kill returns the parsed failures and leaves timed_out False when the run finishes in time. <!--#f056cbb5fdf103b4-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_wait_or_kill_none_timeout_is_unbounded` (method) — Asserts wait_or_kill with timeout=None waits indefinitely and resolves normally. <!--#ec11ed9b2827e801-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_kill_is_idempotent` (method) — Asserts calling kill twice does not raise and keeps the resolved None sentinel. <!--#3d175b8284bef17f-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_kill_before_resolution_yields_none_sentinel` (method) — Asserts killing before resolution makes a subsequent wait_or_kill return None. <!--#b8103279018cca75-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_wait_or_kill_after_done_returns_cached` (method) — Asserts a bounded wait_or_kill after the run already resolved returns the cached result. <!--#677079820c630792-->
- `TestResolveBaselineTimeout` (class) — Test class verifying test_baseline.resolve_baseline_timeout() correctly derives the baseline test timeout from a project's tianluo.yaml (falling back to defaults when absent). <!--#d5c48c12f174c81b-->
  - `TestResolveBaselineTimeout.test_defaults_when_not_a_project` (method) — Asserts that resolve_baseline_timeout() returns the default 1800.0 when tmp_path has no tianluo.yaml (not a project). <!--#3b4b09223b3fe756-->
  - `TestResolveBaselineTimeout.test_reads_configured_timeout` (method) — Asserts that resolve_baseline_timeout() returns 600.0 when tianluo.yaml configures test.timeout to 600. <!--#4b701d2cdfae434d-->

### `tests/engine/test_bugfix_conditional_investigate.py` (python) — Test suite verifying the conditional INVESTIGATE round for bugfix flows — that an unclear root-cause verdict from `analyze_handler` inserts INVESTIGATE just before PLAN (for LLM-classified, explicitly-typed, and discovery-entry bugfixes) while clear root causes, non-bugfix types, PLAN-less sequences, and worktree merge/CONFIRM ordering stay untouched, plus assertions on `ANALYZE_PROMPT` wording that keep the judgement genuinely asked and decoupled from classification. <!--#8ced4670406ad9f7|5c710df1d2631e47-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal RUNNING `FlowInstance` with a given `task_type`, optional worktree mode, and `project_root` seeded into its state context. <!--#8c9892cc7c23f5fc-->
- `_run_analyze` (function) — Test helper that drives the real `analyze_handler` with a stubbed `LLMCaller`, parsed result, and patched context-builder injections, returning the resulting flow and step for a chosen explicit type, LLM-classified type, and `root_cause_clear` verdict. <!--#a6a60c840041590e-->
- `project_root` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding an empty temporary directory so no repo `tianluo.yaml` influences the step-sequence rebuild. <!--#c749c7c9debbcadc-->
- `TestAutoClassifiedBugfix` (class) — Tests that an LLM-classified bugfix inserts INVESTIGATE before PLAN when the root cause is unclear and leaves the baseline sequence untouched when it is clear. <!--#57f14d6b3e5567ce-->
  - `TestAutoClassifiedBugfix.test_unclear_root_cause_inserts_investigate_before_plan` (method) — Asserts an unclear root cause yields `root_cause_clear` False, the investigation-bearing sequence, and INVESTIGATE positioned ahead of PLAN. <!--#2a8f5af239c26d07-->
  - `TestAutoClassifiedBugfix.test_clear_root_cause_keeps_the_existing_sequence` (method) — Asserts a clear root cause leaves the sequence at the bugfix baseline with no INVESTIGATE step. <!--#8904490ef6380591-->
- `TestExplicitBugfixTypeStillJudged` (class) — Tests that a user-supplied `--type` overrides the LLM's classification but never its root-cause judgement, so hand-typed bugfixes still gain or skip the investigation round. <!--#88276e1c54d19c52-->
  - `TestExplicitBugfixTypeStillJudged.test_explicit_bugfix_with_unclear_root_cause_inserts_investigate` (method) — Asserts an explicit bugfix type over an LLM 'feature' classification keeps the unclear-root-cause judgement and inserts INVESTIGATE. <!--#0ce7838ee45882d4-->
  - `TestExplicitBugfixTypeStillJudged.test_explicit_bugfix_with_clear_root_cause_skips_investigate` (method) — Asserts an explicit bugfix type with a clear root cause keeps the plain bugfix baseline sequence. <!--#41e5c20b27a167ea-->
  - `TestExplicitBugfixTypeStillJudged.test_explicit_feature_type_suppresses_the_insertion` (method) — Asserts an explicit feature type wins over an LLM bugfix classification, so no INVESTIGATE step is added. <!--#d7214708e680a955-->
- `TestDiscoverEntryGetsInsertion` (class) — Tests that discovery-mode flows keep `task_type == 'discovery'` while the insertion decision keys off the LLM's real task type. <!--#1b16bbc999ee5ed2-->
  - `TestDiscoverEntryGetsInsertion.test_discovery_flow_with_bugfix_root_type_inserts_investigate` (method) — Asserts a discovery flow with an underlying bugfix keeps its DISCOVERY-led sequence while INVESTIGATE lands between ANALYZE and PLAN. <!--#aa76252aa4b12a50-->
  - `TestDiscoverEntryGetsInsertion.test_discovery_flow_with_clear_root_cause_is_untouched` (method) — Asserts a discovery flow with a clear root cause gains no INVESTIGATE step. <!--#369119d6ecb7ecd4-->
  - `TestDiscoverEntryGetsInsertion.test_discovery_flow_with_feature_root_type_is_untouched` (method) — Asserts a discovery flow whose real type is a feature gains no INVESTIGATE step even when the root cause is unclear. <!--#e1af8d4c92de2530-->
- `TestWorktreeRebuildOrdering` (class) — Test class asserting that inserting the conditional INVESTIGATE step into a worktree bugfix flow preserves the rest of the step ordering. <!--#ca2f8da4746034ea-->
  - `TestWorktreeRebuildOrdering.test_merge_tail_and_confirm_gate_survive_the_insertion` (method) — Runs analyze with an unclear root cause plus worktree and an opt-in plan confirmation gate, then asserts INVESTIGATE sits directly before PLAN, CONFIRM directly after PLAN, and MERGE_INTEGRATE/VERSION_RECONCILE still follow COMMIT. <!--#0cd8ee0a77637d2b-->
- `TestOtherTaskTypesUnaffected` (class) — Tests that non-bugfix task types (feature, small, review, survey) see no extra investigation round, comparing each against its own no-flag rebuild. <!--#bc48944b788664dd-->
  - `TestOtherTaskTypesUnaffected.test_needs_investigation_does_not_change_other_types` (method) — Parameterized check that passing `needs_investigation` to `_update_flow_steps` only alters sequences containing a PLAN, and then only by the single expected insertion. <!--#ca5a42f1a7605bfb-->
  - `TestOtherTaskTypesUnaffected.test_planless_sequences_take_no_insertion` (method) — Asserts PLAN-less sequences take no insertion and raise no error, with survey retaining exactly its own single INVESTIGATE. <!--#047eb9a514647ae1-->
  - `TestOtherTaskTypesUnaffected.test_non_bugfix_classification_never_investigates_for_the_root_cause` (method) — Asserts an unclear root-cause verdict on a non-bugfix classification never adds an INVESTIGATE round beyond survey's built-in one. <!--#0edae0902e832c1e-->
- `TestRootCauseJudgementPrompt` (class) — Tests the wording of `ANALYZE_PROMPT` so the root-cause judgement is genuinely asked for and decoupled from the model's own classification. <!--#93d06f81980980f8-->
  - `TestRootCauseJudgementPrompt.test_prompt_does_not_license_a_blanket_true_for_non_bugfix` (method) — Asserts `ANALYZE_PROMPT` contains no 'this field is irrelevant' escape hatch that would let the model rubber-stamp the judgement. <!--#ad6878c5eefc7b10-->
  - `TestRootCauseJudgementPrompt.test_prompt_decouples_the_judgement_from_the_classification` (method) — Asserts `ANALYZE_PROMPT` asks for the judgement independently of `task_type` and includes symptom vocabulary such as 'intermittent' and 'regression'. <!--#d8331662b33a7bc3-->

### `tests/engine/test_chat_history.py` (python) — Pytest suite for tianluo.engine.chat_history that verifies format_history_for_retry's continue-vs-retry modes and truncation rules, record_user_interjection's JSONL output and no-op behavior, and that interjections are shown but excluded from LLM retry context, using helper builders for chat messages and sessions. <!--#19883c27900b7955|d800b9196812e12d-->
- `_make_user_message` (function) — Helper that builds a user-role ChatMessage with the given content and attempt for use in tests. <!--#0789be187417b31b-->
- `_make_assistant_message` (function) — Helper that builds an assistant-role ChatMessage with optional raw_json for use in tests. <!--#a26120606e410c1f-->
- `_make_assistant_with_tool_calls` (function) — Helper that builds an assistant ChatMessage whose raw_json contains a tool_use call plus a long tool_result, simulating tool-call history. <!--#1b7eea4d4878b676-->
- `_make_session` (function) — Helper that wraps a list of messages into a ChatSession for the implement step. <!--#6e6a27ca09aeb484-->
- `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode` (class) — Test class verifying the `mode` parameter of `format_history_for_retry`, covering the default 'continue' vs 'retry' instruction wording, per-mode prompt/response truncation behavior, verbatim preservation of user prompts, and None returns for missing/empty history. <!--#56a2385f6f53009c-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_default_mode_is_continue` (method) — Asserts the default mode is 'continue', emitting the continue-from-where-stopped instruction. <!--#90208ccbb219cdf1-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_retry_mode_uses_restart_instruction` (method) — Asserts retry mode emits the try-again restart instruction and omits the continue wording. <!--#18c9039d0f3443c5-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_continue_mode_user_prompt_not_truncated` (method) — Asserts continue mode preserves a long user prompt verbatim without truncation. <!--#ea702d978ab5290e-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_retry_mode_user_prompt_not_truncated` (method) — Asserts retry mode preserves a long user prompt verbatim without truncation. <!--#4797e01033972d64-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_continue_mode_preserves_tool_call_responses` (method) — Asserts continue mode keeps tool-call content and results intact rather than truncating them. <!--#5eabb3548cd0b449-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_retry_mode_truncates_long_assistant_responses` (method) — Asserts retry mode applies head+tail truncation (head 500, tail 1500) to long assistant responses. <!--#3890950494841c58-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_no_history_returns_none` (method) — Asserts format_history_for_retry returns None when no session history exists. <!--#dd1e9b42d61fb15a-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_empty_messages_returns_none` (method) — Asserts format_history_for_retry returns None when the session has no messages. <!--#0882b40bd2343266-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_continue_mode_short_prompts_not_truncated` (method) — Asserts short prompts pass through untruncated in continue mode. <!--#d5fa191a858be6af-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_user_prompt_preserved_verbatim_regardless_of_size` (method) — Asserts the old 50K per-prompt cap is gone so even a 60K-char user prompt is preserved verbatim. <!--#a7b6069de9bed331-->

### `tests/engine/test_chat_history_fix_loop_split.py` (python) — Unit tests for chat_history's fix-loop timeline logic, verifying that split_implement_session_by_iterations partitions an implement ChatSession into virtual per-iteration sessions using test-session timestamps as fences and that interleave_sessions_for_display reorders a flow's sessions so each implement iteration appears chronologically between its test/self_check rounds, across edge cases like empty/single-round/unsorted/no-fence inputs. <!--#bb12abe15e49bc66|8eea953b60d7b2d7-->

- `test_interleave_single_round_preserves_unchanged_implement` (function) — Asserts that a single-round implement session is emitted unchanged (no -iter suffix) when interleaved. <!--#c822263521a5029d-->
