### `tests/engine/test_confirm_revision_and_meta.py` (python) — Regression test module for `StateMachine` confirm/revision handling and flow metadata, covering that a `REVISION_NEEDED` CONFIRM routes back to the reviewed step (no infinite loop) with a fresh `fix-` baseline, that already-confirmed detection reads the nested `review_result` so rejected confirms re-review the same step, that the review↔revise loop is bounded by the persisted `flow.state.review_iterations` cap, and that `_write_flow_meta`/`init_flow` create a `_meta.json` that is not overwritten on resume. <!--#97783b216a0e7513|daf717c236b6ee5b-->
- `TestBugB_ConfirmRevisionNoInfiniteLoop` (class) — Regression test class (with tmpdir-backed `PersistenceManager`/`StateMachine` fixtures) asserting that a CONFIRM step returning `REVISION_NEEDED` routes through `transition_to_next()` back to the reviewed step instead of looping forever on CONFIRM, and that revising IMPLEMENT records a fresh fix baseline. <!--#1387de13c86d8089-->
  - `TestBugB_ConfirmRevisionNoInfiniteLoop.setup_method` (method) — Creates a temp project root with a PersistenceManager and StateMachine before each test. <!--#70bd64e57dffc13b-->
  - `TestBugB_ConfirmRevisionNoInfiniteLoop.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temp directory after each test. <!--#c34398a3746e8dbf-->
  - `TestBugB_ConfirmRevisionNoInfiniteLoop.test_confirm_revision_needed_transitions_to_reviewed_step` (method) — Drives a flow with a CONFIRM handler that first rejects then approves, asserting the reviewed PLAN step re-runs and the flow doesn't fail from an infinite loop. <!--#2f05487ed05b9cd0-->
  - `TestBugB_ConfirmRevisionNoInfiniteLoop.test_revision_of_implement_captures_fresh_fix_baseline` (method) — Verifies that when a rejected CONFIRM sends IMPLEMENT back for revision, `transition_to_next()` returns the IMPLEMENT step with `revision_feedback` attached and stores a fresh `latest_fix_baseline` (id prefixed `fix-`) under `context["review_scope"]` so the next SELF_CHECK diffs against current state. <!--#cb52c983e80d8560-->
  - `TestBugB_ConfirmRevisionNoInfiniteLoop.test_confirm_revision_calls_transition_to_next` (method) — Calls transition_to_next directly on a REVISION_NEEDED confirm and asserts it returns the reviewed PLAN step reset to PENDING for revision. <!--#7cd72b8756552a50-->
- `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection` (class) — Test class verifying that already_confirmed detection in StateMachine._build_step_inputs reads from the nested review_result structure (approved + step_to_review_id) rather than top-level outputs, so rejected CONFIRMs re-review the same step and pending steps are still selected. <!--#644d760427f1dfab-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.setup_method` (method) — Creates a temp project root with a PersistenceManager and StateMachine before each test. <!--#70bd64e57dffc13b-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temp directory after each test. <!--#c34398a3746e8dbf-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.test_already_confirmed_detected_with_nested_review_result` (method) — Asserts a second CONFIRM reviews IMPLEMENT rather than the already-approved PLAN, given the prior confirm's nested review_result. <!--#8f68141922ae98aa-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.test_rejected_confirm_does_not_mark_step_confirmed` (method) — Regression test asserting that a CONFIRM with approved=False does not shield its reviewed plan step, so the next CONFIRM re-reviews plan-001 rather than sliding forward to an unconfigured later step and triggering the human fallback. <!--#71edfd4ba6ad38c6-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.test_not_yet_confirmed_step_is_found` (method) — Asserts that a step with no prior CONFIRM is selected for review by _build_step_inputs. <!--#16992e217f2b5b8b-->
- `TestBoundedCrossRevisionReview` (class) — Test class ensuring the LLM review↔revise loop is bounded by max_iterations across revisions via the persisted cross-revision counter flow.state.review_iterations, so it eventually auto-approves instead of looping forever. <!--#17a3381254d1143d-->
  - `TestBoundedCrossRevisionReview.setup_method` (method) — Per-test fixture that creates a temp project root with tianluo/state and tianluo/specs directories plus a PersistenceManager and StateMachine. <!--#3c35e19d2f0b9f58-->
  - `TestBoundedCrossRevisionReview.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temp directory after each test. <!--#c34398a3746e8dbf-->
  - `TestBoundedCrossRevisionReview._make_flow` (method) — Helper that builds a FlowInstance with a named change and change_path under the temp root. <!--#b40a448a98c713b4-->
  - `TestBoundedCrossRevisionReview.test_unit_auto_approve_when_persisted_count_at_cap` (method) — Unit test asserting that when flow.state.review_iterations reaches max_iterations, confirm_handler auto-approves (COMPLETED, approved=True, 'max review iterations' feedback) without ever constructing or calling LLMCaller. <!--#e2fcb1727d36179d-->
  - `TestBoundedCrossRevisionReview.test_integration_revision_loop_is_bounded` (method) — End-to-end test driving the full PLAN→CONFIRM→IMPLEMENT flow with an always-rejecting LLM, asserting the loop is bounded (LLM called exactly max_iters times, plan re-ran max_iters+1 times, IMPLEMENT ran once, flow COMPLETED). <!--#499b49b3126e2491-->
- `TestWriteFlowMeta` (class) — Test class for StateMachine._write_flow_meta, verifying it writes _meta.json with version/runtime fields, skips overwriting on resume, and is invoked by init_flow. <!--#937f54e9755c7e68-->
  - `TestWriteFlowMeta.setup_method` (method) — Creates a temp project root with a PersistenceManager and StateMachine before each test. <!--#70bd64e57dffc13b-->
  - `TestWriteFlowMeta.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temp directory after each test. <!--#c34398a3746e8dbf-->
  - `TestWriteFlowMeta.test_meta_json_created_with_correct_fields` (method) — Test asserting _write_flow_meta creates _meta.json containing se3_version, python_version, and created_at with correct types, a valid ISO created_at, and python_version matching sys.version. <!--#8a8c9933e24feac4-->
  - `TestWriteFlowMeta.test_meta_json_not_overwritten_on_resume` (method) — Test asserting a second _write_flow_meta call (resume scenario) leaves the existing _meta.json content unchanged. <!--#0e29bc5d416d37bb-->
  - `TestWriteFlowMeta.test_meta_json_written_by_init_flow` (method) — Test asserting init_flow() calls _write_flow_meta so that _meta.json exists in the flow's history directory. <!--#37c2a67a3e7fe029-->

### `tests/engine/test_docs_updater.py` (python) — Unit tests for the docs_updater's VERSIONS.md changelog handling, verifying that colliding version blocks are merged rather than swallowed, verbatim rewrites stay idempotent, and head-blank accumulation is drained to a single separator and kept stable across repeated inserts. <!--#ebfe3a06e10130c4|715abec5e013d908-->

  - `TestNoBlankAccumulation.test_existing_head_accumulation_is_drained` (method) — Asserts an existing ~89-blank-line head is collapsed to a single blank on the next insert while preserving prior entries and avoiding triple blanks. <!--#0b9a392b40511c02-->

### `tests/engine/test_implement_dispatch_edge_cases.py` (python) — Edge-case test suite for the IMPLEMENT step's parallel-dispatch decision, covering transitive_reduce exceptions, empty repos (has_commits=False), small-LOC merge, single-group and use_worktree=False short-circuits, capability-mode bypass of the legacy granular LOC gate in _should_use_dag, and the INFO log messages explaining why DAG parallel was skipped. <!--#f7ccff601afc4779|6f31f1afe82b932a-->
- `_make_step_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a paired IMPLEMENT `Step` and `FlowInstance` for the given task groups, pinned to `granular` decomposition so the legacy LOC gate is genuinely exercised. <!--#199a4abaa34cbb59-->
- `TestLinearChainDetectionExceptionPath` (class) — Test class asserting that when transitive_reduce raises, the linear-chain short-circuit is skipped and dispatch still falls through to DAG parallel. <!--#6ac06dd8fa799535-->
  - `TestLinearChainDetectionExceptionPath.test_linear_chain_detection_raises_falls_through_to_dag` (method) — Patches transitive_reduce to raise and verifies implement_handler swallows the exception, keeps want_dag True, and calls _run_dag_parallel exactly once for LINEAR_GROUPS. <!--#a4b1d1b61e03ad33-->
- `TestHasCommitsFalseFallsThroughToSequential` (class) — Test class verifying that an empty repo (has_commits=False) bypasses DAG parallel and runs the sequential group-by-group path even when DAG was selected. <!--#2b54d735fab56afa-->
  - `TestHasCommitsFalseFallsThroughToSequential.test_empty_repo_skips_dag_and_runs_sequential` (method) — With FORK_GROUPS, use_worktree=True, and has_commits=False, asserts _run_dag_parallel is not called and LLMCaller is invoked once per group in the sequential loop. <!--#e29a5f226b24358b-->
- `TestSmallLocPathIgnoresUseWorktree` (class) — Test class confirming the small-LOC single-call merge path precedes the dispatch decision, so use_worktree=False does not alter its behavior. <!--#a6e17869b2e24df2-->
  - `TestSmallLocPathIgnoresUseWorktree.test_small_loc_with_use_worktree_false_still_single_call` (method) — With SMALL_GROUPS and use_worktree=False, asserts the LOC-merge path wins so _run_single_llm_call runs once and _run_dag_parallel is never called. <!--#8d0ccc7045d791fb-->
- `TestSingleGroupNotEligibleForDag` (class) — Test class asserting single-group inputs bypass DAG parallel because _should_use_dag requires len(groups) >= 2, regardless of use_worktree. <!--#515c764bbfc2e34a-->
  - `TestSingleGroupNotEligibleForDag.test_single_group_with_use_worktree_true_never_uses_dag` (method) — With SINGLE_GROUP and use_worktree=True, asserts DAG is never considered so _run_dag_parallel is not called and _run_single_llm_call runs once. <!--#59e5d82b97432420-->
- `_make_capability_step_flow` (function) — Test helper that wraps `_make_step_flow` and overrides both step inputs and flow context to `capability` decomposition with `auto` granularity. <!--#404298501bb0bf35-->
- `TestCapabilityModeBypassesLocGate` (class) — Test class asserting that capability-mode scheduling ignores the LOC threshold and decides on group count plus dependency topology, while the granular LOC gate and the other sequential short-circuits keep their existing behaviour. <!--#c3252866fc7865a3-->
  - `TestCapabilityModeBypassesLocGate.test_two_independent_capability_groups_run_in_parallel` (method) — Asserts that two independent capability groups with zero total LOC still dispatch through `_run_dag_parallel` rather than collapsing into the single-LLM-call merge path. <!--#e1d3369faf6b087a-->
  - `TestCapabilityModeBypassesLocGate.test_linear_capability_chain_still_short_circuits_to_sequential` (method) — Asserts that a linear capability dependency chain bypasses the DAG and runs one `LLMCaller` invocation per group, proving the pre-existing short-circuits survive the LOC-gate bypass. <!--#c16df125b6bb2cb6-->
  - `TestCapabilityModeBypassesLocGate.test_use_worktree_false_still_forces_sequential` (method) — Asserts that `use_worktree=False` forces sequential per-group LLM calls even for otherwise DAG-eligible parallel capability groups. <!--#faec2dc7a7af27c2-->
  - `TestCapabilityModeBypassesLocGate.test_threshold_value_is_irrelevant_under_capability` (method) — Unit-tests `_should_use_dag` with `capability_mode=True` across every threshold/LOC combination, confirming it always returns True for multiple parallel groups and False for a single group. <!--#32c9975ef27f52cf-->
  - `TestCapabilityModeBypassesLocGate.test_granular_threshold_behaviour_is_unchanged` (method) — Unit-tests `_should_use_dag` in legacy granular mode, pinning that LOC above the threshold enables the DAG, below it vetoes, and zero LOC means "no estimate" rather than a veto. <!--#d51c2effab44ce7e-->
- `TestDispatchLogMessages` (class) — Test class verifying dispatch short-circuits emit INFO logs (captured via caplog) explaining why DAG parallel was skipped. <!--#bf51b3c65721ab00-->
  - `TestDispatchLogMessages.test_use_worktree_false_logs_skip_message` (method) — Asserts that with use_worktree=False an INFO log announcing the sequential short-circuit (mentioning 'use_worktree=False' and 'sequential') is emitted. <!--#c994f8caa3d6720d-->
  - `TestDispatchLogMessages.test_linear_chain_logs_fallback_message` (method) — Asserts that a linear-chain group graph emits an INFO log announcing the sequential short-circuit (mentioning 'linear chain' and 'sequential'). <!--#21a7082977d89464-->

### `tests/engine/test_implement_execution_strategy.py` (python) — Unit tests for the IMPLEMENT step's execution-strategy selection, covering dispatch between sequential, DAG-parallel, and LOC-merged single-call paths, the capability-mode group prompt variant, and _holistic_execution_mode's whole-task "single_group" collapse across doctrine, granularity, and legacy-flow cases. <!--#b5ad5ee304aa5ae5|41cc4cade8f182f8-->
- `_make_step_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a matched IMPLEMENT Step / FlowInstance pair with the given task_groups and an explicit plan_decomposition (defaulting to "granular") for the dispatch tests. <!--#fd354c6ac59fe67b-->
- `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch` (class) — Test class verifying implement_handler's four execution-strategy dispatch paths (forced-sequential, linear-chain fallback, fork-DAG parallel, and small-multi-group single-call) via mocked config, LLMCaller, and DAG/single-call helpers. <!--#d0bcd5c361feb96e-->
  - `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch.test_use_worktree_false_forces_sequential_even_on_dag_eligible_groups` (method) — Asserts that with use_worktree=False, a DAG-eligible fork of groups over the LOC threshold never calls _run_dag_parallel and instead runs one LLMCaller per group sequentially. <!--#06091fa5cb11005c-->
  - `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch.test_linear_chain_falls_back_to_sequential` (method) — Asserts that use_worktree=True with a linear (non-fork) group chain above the LOC threshold skips DAG parallelism and runs one LLMCaller per group sequentially. <!--#36979204f0204f99-->
  - `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch.test_fork_dag_uses_dag_parallel` (method) — Asserts that use_worktree=True with a fork-shaped DAG above the LOC threshold dispatches to _run_dag_parallel exactly once. <!--#100d93cfb798dd18-->
  - `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch.test_small_multi_group_collapses_to_single_call` (method) — Asserts that use_worktree=True with total LOC at or below the threshold takes the LOC-merge single-call path (_run_single_llm_call once), bypassing both DAG and per-group sequential loops. <!--#cc6ecfa3210bf2e1-->
- `TestCapabilityGroupPrompt` (class) — Tests that capability-mode IMPLEMENT uses the IMPLEMENT_CAPABILITY_GROUP_PROMPT variant — which tells the agent to decompose the group and own its tests instead of implementing an enumerated task list — and that both the sequential and DAG-parallel execution paths select it via capability_mode/_group_prompt_template while leaving the legacy granular template untouched. <!--#73c6106b430a28fa-->
  - `TestCapabilityGroupPrompt.test_capability_variant_replaces_the_enumeration_wording` (method) — Asserts the rendered capability prompt swaps the granular template's "implement the tasks listed" enumeration wording for decomposition/sub-agent/own-tests instructions while still inheriting the shared boilerplate sections (version-file ban, process cleanup, completion_status). <!--#1c1dd3e51257b102-->
  - `TestCapabilityGroupPrompt.test_sequential_capability_groups_get_the_capability_prompt` (method) — Runs `implement_handler` with heavily mocked LLM/config/git dependencies over sequential capability groups and asserts every prompt passed to `LLMCaller.call` carries the capability wording and none carries the granular enumeration line. <!--#00ad33fb674d4821-->
  - `TestCapabilityGroupPrompt.test_dag_path_forwards_the_doctrine_to_the_group_executor` (method) — Introspects _run_dag_parallel/_make_execute_fn signatures and _group_prompt_template to confirm the capability_mode flag is threaded through to template selection. <!--#577a1f36a44d8ae6-->
  - `TestCapabilityGroupPrompt.test_independent_capability_groups_run_dag_with_capability_mode` (method) — Asserts independent capability groups dispatch to _run_dag_parallel exactly once with capability_mode=True. <!--#3a0fe3ffadd0d3df-->
- `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy` (class) — Tests _holistic_execution_mode's decision to run one whole-task executor instead of per-group calls — returning "single_group" for zero or one capability group and for forced `single` granularity (read from step inputs or flow context), and None for multiple groups, conservative granularity, granular decomposition, or a flow that never ran PLAN. <!--#3ba23f03f710b66f-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy._flow_step` (method) — Static helper building a flow/step pair with configurable task_type, decomposition, granularity, and task_groups plus marker-laden analysis and root-cause context. <!--#518b194db848f945-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_single_capability_group_is_holistic` (method) — Asserts one capability group resolves to the "single_group" holistic mode. <!--#0ca79ef43059010c-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_two_capability_groups_are_not_holistic` (method) — Asserts two capability groups stay on the per-group path (mode is None). <!--#c6b5c4ecfe7a0973-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_forced_single_granularity_is_holistic_despite_many_groups` (method) — Asserts plan_granularity="single" collapses a multi-group capability plan into the holistic single_group shape. <!--#877a03510f44d6e4-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_forced_single_is_read_off_context_when_inputs_lack_it` (method) — Asserts the forced-single granularity is still honoured when read from persisted flow context rather than step inputs. <!--#d23d16a87c903df5-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_forced_single_does_not_reshape_the_granular_doctrine` (method) — Asserts granularity="single" has no effect under the granular doctrine, which keeps its grouped path. <!--#0d3ff95c46aa2f7d-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_conservative_granularity_still_follows_the_group_count` (method) — Asserts "conservative" granularity does not override the group count, so two groups remain non-holistic. <!--#2149e8966d917808-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_zero_capability_groups_reach_the_whole_task_shape` (method) — Asserts a legacy groupless capability plan falls into the single_group whole-task shape rather than the per-group contract. <!--#8727fe87c6e93c1b-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_a_flow_that_has_not_run_plan_is_not_holistic` (method) — Asserts a missing task_groups key reads as "unknown", not "one group", so the mode is None. <!--#0008f9bda3ed3d9d-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_single_granular_group_is_not_holistic` (method) — Asserts the legacy granular doctrine keeps its group path even with a single group. <!--#9b0a6f56fb7b5c71-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_a_doctrineless_flow_is_shaped_the_way_plan_planned_it` (method) — Asserts a doctrineless pre-upgrade flow projects to "capability" via PlanModeResolver.view so IMPLEMENT reaches the same whole-task shape PLAN produced. <!--#a1a1e692878a9b0a-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_a_legacy_planned_flow_still_keeps_its_group_path` (method) — Asserts the legacy effective_implementation_strategy="planned" marker projects to granular so LOC-driven grouped scheduling is preserved. <!--#fcfb2ac9c6e5ad97-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy._legacy_direct_flow_step` (method) — Helper building a flow/step pair from the retired "direct" strategy axis — no PLAN, hence no task_groups. <!--#b8f5a22d3ee647cd-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_legacy_direct_flow_is_holistic` (method) — Asserts a legacy direct flow resolves to the "legacy_direct" mode and that StateMachine._is_holistic_implement_step agrees. <!--#d9bb9469ff7e1180-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_legacy_direct_flow_runs_the_whole_task_prompt` (method) — Asserts the legacy-direct prompt carries the partial attempt and project context but no Task Groups section or sizing verdict, with DIRECT_IMPLEMENTATION intent and empty implemented_groups. <!--#c4b53e2e08b1507d-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_legacy_direct_flow_that_ran_plan_is_a_single_group` (method) — Asserts a legacy direct flow that later acquired task_groups is reclassified as single_group, consistently in the state machine. <!--#70f63935a26ef366-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_legacy_direct_flow_that_ran_plan_keeps_its_groups_in_the_prompt` (method) — Asserts such a flow's prompt drops the "retired direct" wording and instead renders its groups as an outline. <!--#3e26cdcfa22eeaa8-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_small_is_holistic_regardless_of_group_count` (method) — Asserts task_type="small" yields the "small" holistic mode no matter how many groups exist. <!--#e560bd4b5d45734a-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_handler_and_state_machine_agree_on_the_shape` (method) — Sweeps representative flow shapes to assert _holistic_execution_mode and StateMachine._is_holistic_implement_step never disagree. <!--#1924a2687e9da005-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_single_group_prompt_is_whole_requirement_and_has_full_context` (method) — Asserts the single-group prompt states the whole-requirement contract with charter/code-index/root-cause context, names PLAN's sizing verdict, and leaks no group enumeration. <!--#52055b66adef64e2-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_single_group_prompt_carries_the_group_scope_and_no_design` (method) — Asserts the single-group holistic prompt includes the group's description as scope but omits the group name, the per-group "Task Groups" enumeration, and any legacy design-document section. <!--#13b7088b275e949e-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_forced_single_collapse_renders_no_design` (method) — Asserts the forced-`single` multi-group collapse path likewise renders no design-document section in the prompt. <!--#00ae51938e530772-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_legacy_direct_prompt_renders_no_design_section` (method) — Asserts the planless legacy-direct prompt renders no design section even if a stray design_doc is present in inputs. <!--#91c3b0ef79f9b583-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_forced_single_collapses_groups_into_one_call_without_losing_them` (method) — Asserts forced-single runs exactly one agent call whose prompt names plan_granularity=single and both groups, without claiming PLAN sized the task as one group. <!--#89a77d3e6b44d336-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_nonempty_incomplete_tasks_override_complete_and_preserve_outputs` (method) — Verifies that on the holistic path a self-reported "complete" result carrying incomplete_tasks is downgraded to PARTIAL while prior files_changed/tests_added outputs are merged rather than replaced. <!--#28d6dd6acb4ae13a-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_small_shares_executor_but_not_direct_intent` (method) — Asserts "small" tasks reuse the whole-task executor but carry AgentInvocationIntent.DEFAULT rather than DIRECT_IMPLEMENTATION. <!--#21330405932377e6-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_junk_structured_result_is_partial_not_complete` (method) — Ensures a structured response lacking any implementation-summary keys is treated as PARTIAL with incomplete_tasks, so the holistic path stays recoverable instead of advancing on zero work. <!--#fdfde0ccd296e20e-->
  - `TestHolisticExecutionStrategy.test_grouped_complete_with_leftover_tasks_stays_complete` (method) — Asserts _run_single_llm_call on a grouped flow records "complete" with leftover incomplete_tasks, since partial coercion is a holistic-path-only rule. <!--#719e8df8fadcaf54-->
- `TestFlowTypeMatrix` (class) — End-to-end matrix over flow types checking how StateMachine builds IMPLEMENT inputs (task_groups, doctrine inheritance), which types gain an IMPLEMENT/PLAN segment, and how holistic partial continuations are bounded. <!--#54d81cc6b6e443c4-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix._flow_with_history` (method) — Helper constructing a StateMachine plus a flow positioned at IMPLEMENT with a given step history and plan doctrine. <!--#6856e40fa0b0400e-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_granular_task_groups_flow_into_implement_inputs` (method) — Asserts PLAN's task_groups, including per-task estimated_loc, are propagated into IMPLEMENT's inputs. <!--#628d6b585a006215-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_implement_inherits_the_doctrine_plan_recorded` (method) — Asserts the doctrine recorded in PLAN's outputs outranks an empty pre-upgrade flow context when building IMPLEMENT inputs. <!--#b777483e59acdec7-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_context_doctrine_is_used_when_plan_recorded_none` (method) — Asserts the flow context supplies the doctrine when a legacy PLAN step recorded none. <!--#0b2e9afcb0549f41-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_planless_inputs_never_carry_plan_task_groups` (method) — Asserts a flow whose history has no PLAN step produces IMPLEMENT inputs without a task_groups key. <!--#941969d5a5fdf548-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_review_and_survey_never_gain_implement` (method) — Asserts "review" and "survey" flows are created with neither IMPLEMENT nor PLAN in their selected steps. <!--#e44dfeb544264011-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_small_keeps_holistic_implement_without_a_plan` (method) — Asserts "small" flows keep IMPLEMENT but skip PLAN, while the plan mode is still recorded in context for uniformity. <!--#a4c8f86a122cb11b-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_holistic_partial_continuations_are_bounded` (method) — Asserts repeated partial holistic results auto-re-arm the same step up to _HOLISTIC_CONTINUATION_LIMIT and then fail it into the Retry/Skip/Abort decision path, including after a user retry. <!--#f02d24b4551ee263-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix._make_direct_flow_with_partial_implement` (method) — Helper building a StateMachine plus a single-capability-group flow whose IMPLEMENT step is recorded PARTIAL, for the skip/continuation tests. <!--#de71e5c9810ed87e-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_holistic_partial_skip_advances_past_exhausted_step` (method) — Verifies that after the continuation budget is exhausted, a user Skip (COMPLETED status plus the holistic_skip_forced flag) advances to the TEST step without re-capturing the partial record or incrementing continuations, and consumes the one-shot flag. <!--#1336c38297a77d3e-->
  - `TestFlowTypeMatrix.test_holistic_partial_skip_under_limit_does_not_rearm` (method) — Verifies that while still under the continuation limit a plain transition re-arms the step (crash-resume), but an explicit holistic_skip_forced Skip advances to TEST without re-invoking the implement agent. <!--#85f94f0c8802dd6c-->

### `tests/engine/test_implement_sequential_reason.py` (python) — Unit tests verifying implement_handler threads the correct sequential-fallback reason (use_worktree=False, linear chain, no commits) — or none for the single/dag_parallel paths — into _display_task_plan and onward to the TaskFormatter. <!--#b7b05d662b9b7cd3|9e871969c4eed64e-->
- `_make_step_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a matching IMPLEMENT `Step` (with the given `task_groups` and a `plan_decomposition` pinned to `granular`, since only that doctrine carries per-task `estimated_loc`) plus a `FlowInstance` rooted at `tmp_path`, for the sequential-execution-reason cases. <!--#11c5176c619252ad-->
- `_extract_sequential_reason` (function) — Test helper that scans a mocked _display_task_plan's recorded calls and returns the sequential_reason kwarg from the call whose strategy is 'sequential'. <!--#63c9ea9b1893f7f7-->
- `TestSequentialReasonPropagation` (class) — Test class verifying that implement_handler threads the correct sequential_reason (use_worktree=False, linear chain, no commits) to _display_task_plan, and emits no sequential display on the single-merge or fork-DAG paths. <!--#6c4ea1ea8a06251f-->
  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_use_worktree_false_reports_reason` (method) — Asserts that with use_worktree=False the handler skips the DAG path and reports sequential_reason 'use_worktree=False'. <!--#f7258bada2282534-->
  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_linear_chain_reports_reason` (method) — Asserts that a linear-chain group plan short-circuits to sequential with reason 'linear chain' rather than running the DAG. <!--#2291dbdb6cb66fdd-->
  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_has_commits_false_reports_reason` (method) — Asserts that when has_commits is False the handler falls back to sequential with reason 'no commits' and does not run the DAG. <!--#2a8c4543e2fdf15d-->
  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_small_loc_merge_no_sequential_reason` (method) — Asserts that small multi-group plans merge via the 'single' LLM-call path, displaying strategy 'single' and never 'sequential'. <!--#cc7db605efb2516a-->
  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_fork_dag_no_sequential_display` (method) — Asserts that a fork-shaped group DAG takes the DAG-parallel path (strategy 'dag_parallel') and never triggers the sequential display. <!--#52f6583c61f35acc-->
- `TestDisplayTaskPlanForwards` (class) — Test class verifying the _display_task_plan wrapper forwards the sequential_reason kwarg (and defaults it to None) into TaskFormatter.format_implement_plan. <!--#b33924575110d3d2-->
  - `TestDisplayTaskPlanForwards.test_forwards_sequential_reason_to_formatter` (method) — Asserts _display_task_plan passes an explicit sequential_reason and execution_strategy through to format_implement_plan via a fake formatter/console. <!--#034288301f5da6c7-->
  - `TestDisplayTaskPlanForwards.test_default_sequential_reason_is_none` (method) — Asserts that omitting sequential_reason causes _display_task_plan to forward None to format_implement_plan. <!--#ad83fabdf91d6ad7-->

### `tests/engine/test_investigate_baseline_serialization.py` (python) — Unit tests asserting that the baseline test capture is serialized correctly around INVESTIGATE steps — `_settle_baseline_before_investigation` awaits the in-flight capture when a later test step still needs the baseline, kills and discards it for survey flows, and never starts a synchronous suite when nothing is running, while `run_step` settles the capture before an INVESTIGATE handler yet leaves it overlapping for other step types. <!--#1ced1a9070bee69e|4325642898a56425-->
- `_make_state_machine` (function) — Test helper that constructs a StateMachine rooted at tmp_path with PersistenceManager patched out so no real persistence occurs. <!--#6938f22d4cd35ac1-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a RUNNING bugfix FlowInstance whose state carries the given selected_steps. <!--#4934298c8ef30c7c-->
- `TestSettleBaselineBeforeInvestigation` (class) — Test class covering _settle_baseline_before_investigation: await the in-flight baseline capture when a later test step needs it, discard it for survey flows, and never start a synchronous suite when no capture is running. <!--#db050c2d18599b14-->
  - `TestSettleBaselineBeforeInvestigation.test_awaits_capture_when_a_test_step_still_consumes_the_baseline` (method) — Asserts that for a BUGFIX_STEPS flow the settle call awaits the capture via _ensure_baseline_ready and does not kill it. <!--#99e7bce5fd8ab950-->
  - `TestSettleBaselineBeforeInvestigation.test_discards_capture_for_a_survey_flow_without_measuring` (method) — Asserts that for a SURVEY_STEPS flow the capture is killed and cleared without awaiting, leaving baseline_failures unset. <!--#6250598a20b1b250-->
  - `TestSettleBaselineBeforeInvestigation.test_no_capture_in_flight_never_triggers_a_synchronous_suite` (method) — Asserts that with no capture in flight (cache hit or resumed flow) the settle call never invokes _ensure_baseline_ready. <!--#b0a545c37fd94cc7-->
- `TestRunStepSerializesBeforeTheHandler` (class) — Test class verifying run_step settles the baseline capture before invoking an INVESTIGATE handler while leaving the capture running for other step types. <!--#d302478deeeaf0cb-->
  - `TestRunStepSerializesBeforeTheHandler.test_capture_is_settled_before_the_investigate_handler_runs` (method) — Asserts ordering by recording _baseline_capture inside a stub INVESTIGATE handler and requiring it to already be None with kill() called. <!--#7adee990cca86bd8-->
  - `TestRunStepSerializesBeforeTheHandler.test_non_investigate_steps_leave_the_capture_running` (method) — Asserts that running an ANALYZE step keeps the in-flight capture intact and never kills it, preserving the intended overlap. <!--#0e319d6975581e5c-->

### `tests/engine/test_investigation_loop.py` (python) — Test suite for the bugfix INVESTIGATE repeat loop in the state machine, covering how inconclusive root-cause reports schedule another round at the same step slot while conclusive ones advance to PLAN, the iteration cap (including the 0 = unlimited sentinel, `investigation_exhausted` fallout, invalid-config handling, and per-transition memoization), skipped-round and REVISION_NEEDED cases that must not loop, and injection of the latest root-cause report into downstream PLAN/IMPLEMENT step inputs and prompt context. <!--#cf35932ae833a5a2|e844a312329b935f-->
- `_report` (function) — Test helper that builds a canonical root-cause report dict (root_cause, evidence, files_involved, suggested_fix_direction, confidence, conclusive) with a `conclusive` toggle and arbitrary field overrides. <!--#e7ce1d0c08e04fa6-->
- `_section_is_framework_context` (function) — Test helper that decides whether a prompt template's `{root_cause_section}` slot sits in framework context by diffing empty-vs-filled renderings to recover the slot's offset and checking it falls outside the `## Task Description` block and any USER_CONTENT bubble. <!--#89b682e6fac76d60-->
- `_make_state_machine` (function) — Test helper that constructs a StateMachine with a patched PersistenceManager and stubbed workflow/investigation-cap config so tests need no yaml on disk. <!--#1fa179ee29a29775-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that creates a RUNNING bugfix FlowInstance with a default ANALYZE→INVESTIGATE→PLAN→IMPLEMENT→TEST→COMMIT step selection. <!--#affcbdd7859f3dbc-->
- `_add_step` (function) — Test helper that appends a Step of a given type/status with optional inputs and outputs to a flow's state. <!--#2b37d5b60259d594-->
- `_investigate_round` (function) — Test helper that appends one finished INVESTIGATE round carrying a (in)conclusive report and makes it the flow's current step. <!--#150643445997075b-->
- `_count_investigate_steps` (function) — Test helper that counts how many INVESTIGATE steps exist in a flow's step history. <!--#ff7e0b41fc516553-->
- `TestInvestigateRepeatLoop` (class) — Test class asserting that inconclusive INVESTIGATE rounds spawn repeat steps at the same slot index while conclusive ones advance to PLAN, and that repeat rounds carry iteration counters plus all prior reports. <!--#cc55192a1dc0f3ca-->
  - `TestInvestigateRepeatLoop.test_inconclusive_round_creates_repeat_without_advancing` (method) — Asserts an inconclusive round yields a new PENDING INVESTIGATE step as current without moving the step index. <!--#d9b5efebe09eefe9-->
  - `TestInvestigateRepeatLoop.test_rounds_accumulate_in_step_history` (method) — Asserts three inconclusive rounds accumulate three INVESTIGATE steps while the current step index stays at the INVESTIGATE slot. <!--#43b6275a1fd4bbfb-->
  - `TestInvestigateRepeatLoop.test_conclusive_round_advances_to_plan` (method) — Asserts a conclusive round transitions to PLAN without creating an extra INVESTIGATE step. <!--#2c9de512dc08a228-->
  - `TestInvestigateRepeatLoop.test_repeat_round_carries_iteration_metadata` (method) — Asserts a repeat round's inputs carry investigation_iteration, investigation_max_iterations, and the previous round's report. <!--#e6e6a4831dd07deb-->
  - `TestInvestigateRepeatLoop.test_third_round_sees_both_earlier_reports` (method) — Asserts the third round's inputs list both earlier reports in order with iteration 3. <!--#196bce50b33ed4a2-->
- `TestInvestigationBounds` (class) — Test class covering the investigation iteration cap: exhausted budgets advance to PLAN with an `investigation_exhausted` flag instead of failing, 0 means unlimited, invalid config fails fast at init but degrades to the default mid-flow, and the cap is read once per transition. <!--#9d52f513fc402c65-->
  - `TestInvestigationBounds.test_exhausted_budget_advances_to_plan_without_failing` (method) — Asserts that running out of rounds while inconclusive advances to PLAN, keeps the flow RUNNING, and sets `investigation_exhausted` in flow context. <!--#b84857dad12ad264-->
  - `TestInvestigationBounds.test_exhausted_flag_reaches_plan_inputs` (method) — Asserts the exhausted flag and the last report both land in the PLAN step's inputs. <!--#31161d746b9323f3-->
  - `TestInvestigationBounds.test_zero_is_the_unlimited_sentinel` (method) — Asserts max_iterations=0 loops indefinitely without marking exhaustion, and only a conclusive round exits to PLAN. <!--#baf8ed98e37cf3f4-->
  - `TestInvestigationBounds.test_invalid_cap_fails_fast_at_flow_init` (method) — Asserts a negative `investigation.max_iterations` in tianluo.yaml raises ConfigError at init_flow. <!--#f8d30cf80ccba01d-->
  - `TestInvestigationBounds.test_invalid_cap_mid_flow_degrades_instead_of_crashing` (method) — Asserts an invalid cap hot-edited mid-flow falls back to the default of 3 rather than aborting the transition. <!--#3491cdc68e33af27-->
  - `TestInvestigationBounds.test_config_read_once_per_transition` (method) — Asserts InvestigationConfig.load is called exactly once per transition (the cap is memoized). <!--#3e91c630edb8ebf4-->
- `TestRevisionNeededIsNotTheLoopMechanism` (class) — Test class pinning the failure mode that motivates repeat-steps: an INVESTIGATE step in REVISION_NEEDED silently falls through ordinary progression and never enters the fix loop, so nobody reimplements the loop that way. <!--#a269b4426c5fda78-->
  - `TestRevisionNeededIsNotTheLoopMechanism.test_revision_needed_produces_no_repeat_round` (method) — Asserts a REVISION_NEEDED INVESTIGATE step advances straight to PLAN with no repeat round. <!--#4e68a5303d154f35-->
  - `TestRevisionNeededIsNotTheLoopMechanism.test_revision_needed_does_not_route_into_the_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts a REVISION_NEEDED INVESTIGATE step neither routes back to IMPLEMENT nor increments the fix-iteration counter. <!--#9f10e72cb1b108c7-->
- `TestSkippedRoundDoesNotLoop` (class) — Test class ensuring a round the user skipped at the failure gate (FAILED forced to COMPLETED, no report) advances instead of scheduling another round, while an explicit `conclusive: False` still loops. <!--#d80ab191f165063d-->
  - `TestSkippedRoundDoesNotLoop._skipped_round` (method) — Class helper that simulates the Retry/Skip/Abort gate's "Skip step" choice: a FAILED INVESTIGATE round with no report force-set to COMPLETED. <!--#d04a20e6567d6a0c-->
  - `TestSkippedRoundDoesNotLoop.test_skipped_round_advances_instead_of_repeating` (method) — Asserts a skipped round with no report advances to PLAN rather than creating a second INVESTIGATE step. <!--#3b6dbee3707dd506-->
  - `TestSkippedRoundDoesNotLoop.test_skipped_round_after_a_real_one_still_advances` (method) — Asserts skipping the second round ends the loop and leaves round 1's report as the one PLAN plans against. <!--#3c334efc09ba6c85-->
  - `TestSkippedRoundDoesNotLoop.test_an_explicit_false_verdict_still_loops` (method) — Asserts the gate keys on presence of `conclusive`, not truthiness, so an explicit False verdict still schedules another round. <!--#67613cd5315449d2-->
- `TestRootCauseContextInjection` (class) — Test class verifying `_build_step_inputs` passes the latest root-cause report to PLAN/IMPLEMENT as a separate key while keeping it out of the task description and self-check source pool, and omits the key entirely when no investigation ran. <!--#f77d18003771ae46-->

  - `TestRootCauseContextInjection.test_report_never_enters_the_self_check_source_pool` (method) — Asserts the SELF_CHECK source pool retains the real task description but contains no report text and no `root_cause_report` key. <!--#f40bbc567d05bdbd-->

- `TestFixIterationKeepsRootCause` (class) — Test class asserting the TEST→IMPLEMENT fix transition copies an existing root-cause report onto the reused IMPLEMENT step without touching the task description, and adds nothing when no report exists. <!--#7fd9671a20a9f5cc-->
  - `TestFixIterationKeepsRootCause.test_fix_transition_copies_the_report_onto_implement` (method) — Asserts a fix iteration reuses the same IMPLEMENT step, carries the root-cause report in its inputs, and leaves the task description clean. <!--#851c90b2761e2a7f-->

- `TestRootCausePromptSections` (class) — Test class verifying that the root-cause investigation report is rendered correctly into the plan/implement/group/fix prompt templates — presence, ordering before the output schema, clean omission when absent, low-confidence marking on exhausted budget, and placement as framework context outside any user-content segment. <!--#a189a4f3ae66d0bf-->

  - `TestRootCausePromptSections.test_plan_prompt_unchanged_without_a_report` (method) — Asserts an empty `root_cause_section` yields a plan prompt byte-identical to the default one, with no lingering "Root-Cause" text. <!--#c67431c58ff449b4-->
  - `TestRootCausePromptSections.test_implement_prompts_render_the_section` (method) — Asserts `IMPLEMENT_PROMPT`, `IMPLEMENT_GROUP_PROMPT`, and `FIX_PROMPT` each render the root-cause section ahead of their JSON-summary instruction. <!--#61328d8ddd19db57-->
  - `TestRootCausePromptSections.test_empty_section_leaves_no_residue` (method) — Asserts an empty root-cause section leaves `IMPLEMENT_PROMPT` free of both the heading and any stray whitespace between the task-type and task-groups blocks. <!--#b1f3c7e7dffa3534-->
  - `TestRootCausePromptSections.test_exhausted_budget_marks_the_section_low_confidence` (method) — Asserts `exhausted=True` renders the section as a LOW-confidence best-current-hypothesis caveat. <!--#1c352ae7fe81a9a2-->
  - `TestRootCausePromptSections.test_section_stays_outside_the_user_content_segment` (method) — Asserts positionally that the `{root_cause_section}` slot lands outside the user-content segment in all three implement-family templates, using two synthetic counter-examples to prove the checker actually discriminates. <!--#310f2e294fe4480c-->
  - `TestRootCausePromptSections.test_missing_or_malformed_report_renders_nothing` (method) — Asserts `render_root_cause_section` returns an empty string for None, empty dict, a string, or a blank root_cause. <!--#51379661f4668b90-->
  - `TestRootCausePromptSections.test_plan_handler_wires_inputs_into_the_prompt` (method) — End-to-end test asserting `plan_handler` turns a step's `root_cause_report`/`investigation_exhausted` inputs into the rendered section inside the prompt sent to the LLM. <!--#f9caa03b4e7a53cf-->
