### `tests/engine/test_self_check_scope.py` (python) — Test suite for the SELF_CHECK review-scope machinery, covering how rounds are classified (initial_full, post_fix_incremental, full_closure) across multi-pass reviews, findings-driven FIX loops, baseline capture and diff reconstruction after commits, requirement-mutation invalidation, scope isolation from TEST/E2E inputs, and cross-process resume where corrupted or missing baselines must degrade safely to a full round. <!--#e2ea8a6eedf47418|851825f9d38db14e-->
- `_git` (function) — Test helper that runs a git subcommand in the given repo root with output suppressed and non-zero exit treated as an error. <!--#4bdbf4ef339f050b-->
- `_machine_and_flow` (function) — Fixture-style helper that builds a temp git project, a PersistenceManager-mocked StateMachine, and a RUNNING FlowInstance already past IMPLEMENT/TEST with an implementation review baseline captured and a pending edit to app.py, positioned at SELF_CHECK. <!--#ac13a83f0aa3005c-->
- `_add_current` (function) — Helper that appends a SELF_CHECK Step with the given inputs/status to the flow and marks it as the current step. <!--#049d93b9480fbe44-->
- `_complete_initial_full` (function) — Helper that builds and completes the initial full SELF_CHECK round and asserts the flow transitions on to INVARIANT_CHECK, returning that next step. <!--#acf01a0aea8e0916-->
- `test_initial_full_multi_pass_keeps_one_round_and_skips_closure` (function) — Asserts that a multi-pass initial full review keeps one round id/baseline across passes, increments only pass_index, and needs no extra full-closure round before INVARIANT_CHECK. <!--#2b00f7a7baea7be4-->
- `test_full_round_after_the_flow_commits_still_carries_the_diff` (function) — Asserts the first full round still reconstructs the real baseline-to-current diff and causal anchors even after the implementation was committed and HEAD advanced. <!--#d8ab23cbde39e779-->
- `test_post_fix_incremental_clean_inserts_full_closure` (function) — Asserts a clean post-FIX incremental round (scoped to the fix baseline) is followed by a newly-numbered full_closure round before the flow may advance to INVARIANT_CHECK. <!--#cc460a2f7ea3fc31-->
- `test_findings_from_initial_full_round_switch_post_fix_to_incremental` (function) — Asserts an initial full round that reports findings routes back to IMPLEMENT, persists a fix-1 baseline, and makes the next SELF_CHECK a post_fix_incremental round against that baseline. <!--#4f9fafade1a45763-->
- `test_untracked_runtime_dir_asset_is_reviewed_but_runtime_state_is_not` (function) — Asserts new whitelisted runtime-directory assets (tianluo/e2e/...) enter the full review scope while transient tianluo/state/ artifacts stay out of it. <!--#d8f849e66b737dbc-->
- `test_test_fix_before_any_full_round_still_uses_full` (function) — Asserts that a fix baseline created before any full round has run does not downgrade the review — the round is still initial_full against the implementation baseline. <!--#4a3ad5ef967820d9-->
- `test_requirement_mutation_discards_incremental_and_restarts_full` (function) — Asserts a user interjection during an incremental round causes _refresh_self_check_scope to discard it and start a fresh full round with reason effective_requirements_changed. <!--#2529783eb7816950-->
- `test_requirement_mutation_after_self_check_reflows_from_downstream_gate` (function) — Asserts that forcing a full round after SELF_CHECK already passed makes the downstream INVARIANT_CHECK gate reflow back into a fresh full SELF_CHECK. <!--#872b5306bcd26396-->
- `test_full_closure_finding_routes_to_fix_then_incremental_again` (function) — Asserts a finding raised by the full-closure round routes to IMPLEMENT, captures a fix-2 baseline, and yields another incremental round scoped to it. <!--#4794561474da15c3-->
- `test_test_and_e2e_inputs_never_consume_review_scope` (function) — Asserts review-scope keys (scope_mode, scope_changed_paths, baseline_id) never leak into TEST or E2E step inputs. <!--#3c76b623ed516a77-->
- `test_test_inputs_identical_across_scope_modes` (function) — Asserts TEST step inputs are byte-for-byte identical under incremental and full review scope, so changed-path lists can never narrow the executed test selection. <!--#31d410fbb0807b28-->
- `test_run_step_persists_implementation_baseline_before_handler_write` (function) — Asserts run_step captures and persists the implementation baseline before the IMPLEMENT handler writes anything, so the baseline can later reconstruct the handler's changes. <!--#0cca41bba5298dda-->
- `TestCrossProcessScopeResume` (class) — Test class that verifies self-check review-scope state (round id, incremental/full mode, baselines, diffs, fix iteration) is correctly rebuilt after a crash-and-resume by persisting a real engine.json plus blob store and constructing a brand-new StateMachine rather than mocking PersistenceManager. <!--#811ab70e9e133497-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume._real_machine` (method) — Helper that builds a temp git project and a real (unmocked) StateMachine with a configurable self_check_passes_required. <!--#686a712c0749041f-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume._patch_workflow_config` (method) — Helper that overrides a machine's _get_workflow_config to return a WorkflowConfig with the desired pass count. <!--#d941fc5d0e19cbea-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume._flow_to_incremental` (method) — Helper that drives a real flow through the initial full round into a persisted post-fix incremental round, returning the root, machine, flow, fix baseline, and incremental inputs. <!--#63123926f8a3ab7d-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume.test_incremental_round_state_survives_fresh_process` (method) — Asserts a brand-new StateMachine reloads the flow and rebuilds identical incremental round id, baseline, pass index, fingerprint and diff from the persisted blob store. <!--#02140d9b05f09797-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume.test_requirement_fingerprint_detects_mutation_after_restart` (method) — Asserts the persisted requirement fingerprint still detects a post-restart interjection, forcing a fresh full round instead of silently continuing incremental. <!--#52f36909b3cb69a9-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume.test_corrupted_baseline_descriptor_degrades_to_full` (method) — Asserts a corrupted baseline descriptor.json degrades the resumed round to a full fallback round with a diagnostic, never an empty diff posing as an incremental review. <!--#cfd77fd8af50fdac-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume.test_missing_baseline_blob_degrades_to_full` (method) — Asserts deleting the baseline blob store (needed to rebuild the diff for dirty files) degrades the resumed round to full with scope_fallback_from_incremental set. <!--#b57114a93445a6b6-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume.test_missing_fix_baseline_context_degrades_to_full` (method) — Asserts that context corruption dropping latest_fix_baseline degrades the resumed round to a full fallback with reason incremental_undecidable_full_fallback. <!--#c998a139c6a55659-->
  - `TestCrossProcessScopeResume.test_legacy_flow_without_scope_state_resumes_to_full` (method) — Asserts that a legacy flow persisted before diff scoping resumes with scope_mode == "full", keeps its original selected_steps and task_description, and never has the newer plan_decomposition / plan_granularity / self_check_review context keys injected into it. <!--#a2840f5746ffec69-->
- `test_resume_honors_persisted_pending_closure_marker` (function) — Asserts a flow interrupted with a persisted next_scope_mode marker but no active round recreates the full_closure round on transition and consumes the marker. <!--#ac9cca5e71a0a420-->
- `test_resume_without_pending_closure_advances_to_next_gate` (function) — Asserts that with neither an active round nor a closure marker the flow follows ordinary progression straight to INVARIANT_CHECK. <!--#03433344a2210222-->
- `test_interjection_after_step_build_refreshes_source_pool_inputs` (function) — Asserts a late interjection arriving after step build is re-derived into the verbatim-quote source pool and structured user_interjections by the pre-run refresh, and forces the round back to full. <!--#e08c600124f151f2-->
- `test_legacy_resume_of_pending_pass_keeps_its_persisted_pass_index` (function) — Asserts a resumed pre-upgrade multi-pass flow adopts its completed-pass tail exactly once, keeping the persisted pass index across repeated refreshes instead of restarting the whole N-pass chain. <!--#31ef8d2b30bb66a1-->
- `test_confirm_revision_of_self_check_reruns_full_scope` (function) — Asserts a CONFIRM-driven revision of a SELF_CHECK step re-runs at full scope with reason confirmation_revision rather than reusing the stale fix delta. <!--#785c09074ecef175-->
- `test_gitignored_file_written_by_the_flow_reaches_the_review_scope` (function) — Asserts a git-ignored file self-reported in files_changed still enters the review scope and diff, with no fabricated causal anchor since no baseline content exists. <!--#8bbead4e90403136-->
- `test_declared_paths_are_persisted_for_the_read_only_diff_command` (function) — Verifies that a step's self-reported git-ignored paths are persisted into the flow context so `luo review-scope diff` can rebuild the same round via `ReviewScopeManager.reconstruct(declared_paths=...)` without dropping them as out of scope. <!--#5a9765d6f5e8f3b5-->
- `test_incremental_round_inputs_carry_the_whole_task_evidence_domain` (function) — End-to-end check that an incremental SELF_CHECK round scopes its attention to the fix delta while still exposing whole-task `scope_task_*` inputs, so `_validate_and_filter_issues` keeps a finding whose evidence line sits in the original IMPLEMENT work. <!--#cd7c16eabb3b9815-->
- `test_incremental_round_inputs_name_binaries_that_carry_earlier_work` (function) — Checks that an anchor-less binary touched by both IMPLEMENT and the fix is marked in `scope_prior_work_paths` and rendered with the "this fix + earlier work in this task" domain, derived purely from comparing the two persisted baseline snapshots. <!--#cae57c2fb7b629d4-->
- `test_full_closure_round_inputs_carry_no_separate_task_domain` (function) — Asserts that the full closure round following an incremental one diffs from the implementation baseline directly, so it reports `scope_task_available` false and empty task-domain fields while covering all task paths. <!--#1b7d89be70c123d2-->
- `test_initial_full_round_has_no_fix_delta_annotation` (function) — Asserts the first full SELF_CHECK round carries no `scope_fix_delta_*` annotation, since labelling the original implement work as a fix would be false. <!--#4e3975ce0863986d-->
- `test_full_closure_round_marks_the_fix_changes_since_the_last_full_round` (function) — Verifies the full closure round reviews the whole task yet still annotates which paths the fix produced since the last full round, and that `_format_review_scope` expresses this as git facts without exposing iteration counters or round reasons. <!--#b1b19587744473d7-->
- `test_full_round_marker_advances_so_the_next_one_measures_from_it` (function) — Verifies `full_round_fix_head` advances to the fix baseline a closure round consumed, so a later closure round measures its fix delta from only the newer, not-yet-reviewed fix baseline. <!--#2a43074281e787d6-->
- `test_a_pass_one_full_fallback_also_advances_the_full_round_marker` (function) — Verifies that an incremental round degrading to a full one because its fix baseline blobs are unreadable still advances `full_round_fix_head`, so the next closure round annotates from the later healthy fix rather than re-selecting the corrupt baseline. <!--#8c8577aa411b5ba8-->
- `test_gitignored_path_is_listed_without_a_domain_mark` (function) — Verifies a git-ignored path that no baseline can compare is listed in the manifest by bare path only — no domain mark and no `+N -M` sizes — with an explicit note telling the checker to open the file since `luo review-scope diff` cannot render it. <!--#d324c22f42a88df4-->
- `test_declared_paths_accumulate_across_the_flow` (function) — Verifies declared paths accumulate across rounds rather than being replaced, so a later fix's narrower `files_changed` report does not erase the git-ignored file an earlier IMPLEMENT declared. <!--#6bccf8b4269abfc9-->
- `test_declared_path_keeps_the_spelling_the_step_reported` (function) — Verifies a declared path whose real name contains a leading/trailing space is preserved verbatim (and quoted via `quote_diff_path` in the rendered manifest), while whitespace slop around an existing tracked path resolves to the real file instead of being admitted as anchor-less. <!--#fbc6108e6b8fca33-->
- `test_path_ignored_after_capture_keeps_the_anchors_the_task_diff_holds` (function) — Verifies that a file untracked and ignored mid-flow — declared-only to the fix baseline but still anchored by the whole-task diff — is treated as anchor-bearing in the union domain, so its line citations survive `_validate_evidence` instead of being dropped as bad evidence. <!--#4484cba3eec36924-->

### `tests/engine/test_self_check_state_machine.py` (python) — Pytest suite covering the SELF_CHECK step's integration with StateMachine — its REVISION_NEEDED fix loop back to IMPLEMENT (shared fix-iteration counter, fix inputs, fix_history 'self_check' trigger and log source), its _build_step_inputs wiring (test_results, changes_made, fix_iteration, and downstream self_check_result/self_check_issues), which task types' default step sequences include or exclude SELF_CHECK, and registration of self_check_handler in STEP_HANDLERS. <!--#91a0bb840a02dccf|1d948e20b097c11c-->
- `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext` (class) — Test class verifying that StateMachine.transition_to_next handles a SELF_CHECK step returning REVISION_NEEDED by looping back to IMPLEMENT with fix inputs, respecting the shared max-fix-iteration counter, and otherwise proceeding to VERIFY_SPEC. <!--#9ae57775accc7385-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.state_machine` (method) — Pytest fixture that builds a StateMachine rooted at tmp_path with PersistenceManager patched out. <!--#bb325568033d5f9c-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext._make_flow_with_self_check` (method) — Helper that builds a FlowInstance with completed IMPLEMENT/TEST steps and a SELF_CHECK step of the given status, returning the flow plus its implement and self-check steps. <!--#b588e220690f4aad-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_revision_needed_triggers_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts a REVISION_NEEDED SELF_CHECK transitions back to the original IMPLEMENT step and increments the fix iteration to 1. <!--#3153c2dabe3f662b-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_revision_sets_implement_fix_inputs` (method) — Asserts the fix loop populates the implement step's inputs with the fix-iteration flag, iteration number, self-check fix instructions, and self_check fix-context reason. <!--#933299815a923e8d-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_respects_max_fix_iterations` (method) — Asserts that when max fix iterations are exhausted, a SELF_CHECK revision fails the flow and returns no next step. <!--#9dcbb1b14d1f5e30-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_completed_proceeds_to_verify_spec` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED SELF_CHECK with no fix needed proceeds to the VERIFY_SPEC step. <!--#442d0a1d6384c37c-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_shares_fix_iteration_with_test_and_verify` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK fix triggers increment the same global fix-iteration counter shared with TEST and VERIFY_SPEC across successive revisions. <!--#a36abf80a6bbfa30-->
- `TestTransitionToFixFromSelfCheck` (class) — Test class verifying that StateMachine._transition_to_fix records 'self_check' as the trigger/reason in fix_history and prints the 'Source: self_check (code review)' log when a SELF_CHECK step initiates the fix loop. <!--#2981dbccc1bf5b79-->
  - `TestTransitionToFixFromSelfCheck.state_machine` (method) — Pytest fixture that builds a StateMachine rooted at tmp_path with PersistenceManager patched out. <!--#bb325568033d5f9c-->
  - `TestTransitionToFixFromSelfCheck.test_fix_history_records_self_check_trigger` (method) — Asserts the fix-history entry records trigger_step_type and reason as 'self_check' after a SELF_CHECK-triggered fix transition. <!--#d8e423ef3c54077d-->
  - `TestTransitionToFixFromSelfCheck.test_fix_transition_prints_self_check_source` (method) — Asserts the fix-transition log output identifies the source as 'self_check (code review)' and notes code review found actionable issues. <!--#d39e77ed8163fa51-->
- `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck` (class) — Test class verifying StateMachine._build_step_inputs assembles the correct inputs for the SELF_CHECK step and exposes its outputs downstream. <!--#2fafd7e9c7788d5e-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.state_machine` (method) — Pytest fixture providing a plain StateMachine instance rooted at a temp path. <!--#a40360b4f3664c09-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_receives_test_results` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK inputs include the test_results carried from the completed TEST step. <!--#ad8504db832a896f-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_receives_changes_made` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK inputs include a changes_made bundle with files_changed and implemented_groups from the IMPLEMENT step. <!--#7b6e6b961488ef91-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_receives_fix_iteration_in_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK inputs include the current fix_iteration value when the flow is in a fix loop. <!--#4624881bf8a8bd9d-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_no_fix_iteration_when_zero` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK inputs omit the fix_iteration key when the flow is not in a fix loop. <!--#39978e5b64b2f505-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_outputs_accessible_to_downstream` (method) — Asserts a completed SELF_CHECK's result and issues are surfaced to downstream VERIFY_SPEC inputs as self_check_result and self_check_issues. <!--#9aff3b4474f7eb4e-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_receives_all_required_inputs` (method) — Integration test asserting SELF_CHECK inputs combine task_description, test_results, and changes_made drawn from ANALYZE/IMPLEMENT/TEST steps. <!--#882d0002829fb576-->
- `TestStepSequencesIncludeSelfCheck` (class) — Test class asserting which task types' default step sequences contain StepType.SELF_CHECK (feature, bugfix, discovery — positioned between TEST and INVARIANT_CHECK) versus which exclude it (small, review, survey), plus a guard that every task type in ALL_TASK_TYPES is classified. <!--#5ff8a6010fff3f81-->
  - `TestStepSequencesIncludeSelfCheck.test_feature_includes_self_check` (method) — Asserts the 'feature' step sequence includes SELF_CHECK ordered after TEST and before INVARIANT_CHECK. <!--#c85529d1c0876293-->
  - `TestStepSequencesIncludeSelfCheck.test_bugfix_includes_self_check` (method) — Asserts the 'bugfix' step sequence includes SELF_CHECK ordered after TEST and before INVARIANT_CHECK. <!--#41be39fa6585d926-->
  - `TestStepSequencesIncludeSelfCheck.test_discovery_includes_self_check` (method) — Asserts the 'discovery' step sequence includes SELF_CHECK ordered after TEST and before INVARIANT_CHECK. <!--#03ee668d9ba3b9b0-->
  - `TestStepSequencesIncludeSelfCheck.test_small_excludes_self_check` (method) — Asserts the 'small' step sequence does not include SELF_CHECK. <!--#0995e138b56ed15e-->
  - `TestStepSequencesIncludeSelfCheck.test_review_excludes_self_check` (method) — Asserts the "review" task type's default step sequence does not include StepType.SELF_CHECK. <!--#ed1968da0ad34fae-->
  - `TestStepSequencesIncludeSelfCheck.test_survey_excludes_self_check` (method) — Asserts the "survey" sequence is exactly [ANALYZE, INVESTIGATE, SUMMARIZE] and omits SELF_CHECK, since survey writes no code. <!--#5deea3757bc8a72d-->
  - `TestStepSequencesIncludeSelfCheck.test_every_task_type_is_classified` (method) — Completeness guard that the with/without SELF_CHECK task-type sets behave as expected and together cover all of ALL_TASK_TYPES, so a newly added task type cannot slip past this class untested. <!--#a653e8128fb88a45-->
- `TestSelfCheckHandlerRegistration` (class) — Test class verifying self_check_handler is registered in STEP_HANDLERS under StepType.SELF_CHECK, exported in the steps module's __all__, and callable. <!--#49a4bcfaa1f2e30e-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandlerRegistration.test_handler_in_step_handlers` (method) — Asserts StepType.SELF_CHECK is present as a key in the STEP_HANDLERS registry. <!--#b46cc37b2f78a26a-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandlerRegistration.test_handler_in_all` (method) — Asserts 'self_check_handler' is exported in the steps module's __all__. <!--#1b5be8a7c8479a1d-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandlerRegistration.test_handler_is_callable` (method) — Asserts the STEP_HANDLERS entry for StepType.SELF_CHECK is callable. <!--#818037e1e261dc8d-->

### `tests/engine/test_spec_dead_code_retired.py` (python) — Regression suite asserting the retired spec subsystem is fully gone — the `spec_validator`/`spec_governance`/`spec_format` modules, `tianluo.config` spec loaders, and spec-loading helpers in `context_builder`/`utils`/`ProjectContextCollector` — while leftover legacy YAML blocks still load inertly and the analyze step's project summary keeps building. <!--#b82965480b88de91|323563a7c0cb1a5c-->
- `TestRetiredModulesGone` (class) — Asserts the retired spec parse/validate/govern modules are neither importable nor present as files in the `tianluo.engine` package directory. <!--#bf8ff25739e6d490-->
  - `TestRetiredModulesGone.test_module_not_importable` (method) — Parametrized check that importing each name in `RETIRED_MODULES` raises `ModuleNotFoundError`. <!--#abb96b1084407488-->
  - `TestRetiredModulesGone.test_package_dir_has_no_spec_modules` (method) — Verifies `spec_validator.py`, `spec_governance.py`, and `spec_format.py` no longer exist on disk in the engine package directory. <!--#cdb3de5ebc87580c-->
- `TestRetiredConfigLoaders` (class) — Checks that the spec-era config loader symbols are gone while leftover legacy YAML blocks still load inertly without breaking live loaders. <!--#b97095e7b112f2bd-->
  - `TestRetiredConfigLoaders.test_loader_symbol_removed` (method) — Parametrized assertion that `tianluo.config` no longer exposes the spec loading/governance config classes and loader functions. <!--#54189413e81be095-->
  - `TestRetiredConfigLoaders.test_legacy_blocks_load_without_error` (method) — Writes a config containing retired blocks and confirms it parses silently while `load_workflow_config` still reads its live values correctly. <!--#1231cdcb64adf930-->
  - `TestRetiredConfigLoaders.test_legacy_blocks_do_not_break_merge_config` (method) — Confirms residual `merge.guardrail_repair` config is simply ignored and `load_merge_config` still succeeds. <!--#24b2a121a7802f9e-->
- `TestSpecLoadingSurfaceRemoved` (class) — Asserts no remaining module resolves a specs directory or reads spec files, covering `context_builder`, `utils`, and `ProjectContextCollector`. <!--#4455e83e9446ac23-->
  - `TestSpecLoadingSurfaceRemoved.test_context_builder_class_removed` (method) — Verifies `context_builder` no longer exposes `ContextBuilder` or `get_spec_names_injection`. <!--#71526cc2cdf66d0a-->
  - `TestSpecLoadingSurfaceRemoved.test_utils_spec_helpers_removed` (method) — Checks that the spec discovery/parsing helper functions have been removed from `tianluo.utils`. <!--#0b92450083ff9919-->
  - `TestSpecLoadingSurfaceRemoved.test_project_context_collects_no_specs` (method) — Confirms `ProjectContextCollector` dropped `_collect_specs` and now collects exactly the `git`, `flow_engine`, and `backlog` keys. <!--#5fe9b520bfafd0cb-->
- `TestAnalyzeProjectSummaryStillBuilds` (class) — Regression guard that the analyze step's project-context summary still builds after specs collection was removed. <!--#5dfd301a66c3ae89-->
  - `TestAnalyzeProjectSummaryStillBuilds.test_summary_reports_branch` (method) — Asserts `_collect_project_summary` returns a non-empty string that no longer mentions "Available specs". <!--#9cba977aa30c0fe0-->

### `tests/engine/test_spec_prompt_residue_retired.py` (python) — Regression test module asserting that all traces of the retired spec-document pipeline are gone from the engine — implement/self_check/version_analyze/discovery prompts carry no spec sections or helpers, STEP_POOL declares no spec_content/spec_changes/updated_specs ports, the merge conflict resolver takes no spec_content parameter, and legacy spec inputs from resumed flows can no longer leak into generated prompts. <!--#9d35c47ae219fdd6|79682d6a311109a6-->
- `_implement_templates` (function) — Test helper that returns every implement-step prompt template (single_call, holistic, grouped, capability_group, fix) paired with a dummy field set sufficient to render it end to end. <!--#70b4e9bcc9a82979-->
- `test_implement_prompt_paths_have_no_project_conventions` (function) — Asserts that each rendered implement prompt path contains no '## Project Conventions' section and no spec_summary placeholder. <!--#6d8fa824355a9275-->
- `test_implement_module_exposes_no_spec_brief_formatter` (function) — Asserts the implement step module no longer defines the retired _format_spec_brief spec-summary renderer. <!--#c0f85f241c59f776-->
- `test_implement_handler_ignores_a_legacy_spec_content_input` (function) — Asserts the implement module source never reads inputs.get("spec_content"), so a resumed legacy flow cannot re-inject spec text into the prompt. <!--#8a951a0e43424259-->
- `test_merge_conflict_resolver_takes_no_spec_context` (function) — Asserts resolve_merge_conflicts_with_context, _merge_leaf_branch and _attempt_merge_with_resolution no longer accept a spec_content parameter. <!--#585d779a61810666-->
- `test_version_analyze_prompt_has_no_spec_changes_section` (function) — Asserts VERSION_ANALYZE_PROMPT contains neither a '## Spec Changes' section nor a spec_changes placeholder. <!--#cedb76090727b25b-->
- `test_version_analyze_declares_no_updated_specs_input` (function) — Asserts the VERSION_ANALYZE entry in STEP_POOL no longer declares an updated_specs input. <!--#a6fe197696bdc493-->
- `test_version_analyze_ignores_legacy_updated_specs_input` (function) — Runs version_analyze_handler with a mocked caller on a step still carrying a legacy updated_specs input and asserts the marker spec text never reaches the generated prompt. <!--#2f81daef6f06a9b8-->
- `test_plan_declares_no_spec_changes_output` (function) — Asserts the PLAN entry in STEP_POOL no longer declares a spec_changes output. <!--#b8ee80d9c65f6113-->
- `test_analyze_declares_no_spec_content_output` (function) — Asserts the ANALYZE entry in STEP_POOL no longer declares a spec_content output. <!--#2903b4ecfe2b2784-->
- `test_self_check_prompt_does_not_defer_to_verify_spec` (function) — Asserts SELF_CHECK_PROMPT no longer mentions verify_spec or spec-compliance checking. <!--#42f1f0a8899f6916-->
- `test_self_check_module_exposes_no_spec_content_formatter` (function) — Asserts the self_check step module no longer defines the retired _format_spec_content helper. <!--#b27fd59139a47127-->
- `test_discovery_prompts_point_at_charter_not_specifications` (function) — Asserts both discovery prompts direct the agent at the code-index rather than 'available specifications'. <!--#b4fa13087cd58a8d-->
- `test_runtime_environment_no_longer_warns_about_luo_sync` (function) — Asserts the implement runtime-environment injection is non-empty and no longer names the retired `luo sync` spec-mirror command. <!--#3c8970050326112f-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_adjudicate.py` (python) — Unit tests for the state machine's adjudication-trigger routing, verifying that a SELF_CHECK REVISION_NEEDED diverts to a dynamically-inserted ADJUDICATE step on an oscillation hit or periodic backstop (while a miss stays on the IMPLEMENT fix loop), that only SELF_CHECK-sourced revisions can adjudicate, and that inserted ADJUDICATE steps survive persistence round-trips while the global max-fix-iterations bound still caps the flow. <!--#19184eb4d38ab742|096963a6f60a3880-->
- `_make_state_machine` (function) — Test helper that constructs a StateMachine rooted at tmp_path with PersistenceManager patched out and, when a cfg is given, pins _get_workflow_config to return it so tests don't depend on an on-disk tianluo.yaml. <!--#52d3d83709a5a387-->
- `_issue` (function) — Test factory that builds a canonical self-check issue dict (severity, expected/actual behavior, expectation source, evidence lines) with overridable expected/path/line/quote fields. <!--#662ca7d1aea26b11-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that constructs a running FlowInstance with completed IMPLEMENT and TEST steps plus a trigger step (SELF_CHECK or TEST) in REVISION_NEEDED carrying fix issues, positioned as the current step. <!--#3bf85c76ffb40e02-->
- `_seed_oscillation` (function) — Test helper that records a prior self-check round on the ledger so the current round appears as an expectation-flip oscillation against it. <!--#ebaa02ae19b3874d-->
- `TestTriggerRouting` (class) — Test class verifying how the state machine routes a REVISION_NEEDED trigger — oscillation and periodic-backstop signals route to ADJUDICATE while a clean/below-period miss routes into the normal fix loop. <!--#13dc7133ae10de55-->
  - `TestTriggerRouting.test_oscillation_hit_routes_to_adjudicate` (method) — Asserts that an oscillation on the ledger inserts and routes to an ADJUDICATE step just before SELF_CHECK without entering the fix loop or advancing the fix iteration. <!--#bb41277a9ab4368c-->
  - `TestTriggerRouting.test_miss_routes_to_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts that with no oscillation signal and the period disabled, the trigger routes back to IMPLEMENT (the fix loop) and increments the fix iteration. <!--#73401511f17e81db-->
  - `TestTriggerRouting.test_periodic_backstop_forces_adjudicate` (method) — Asserts that reaching the configured adjudicate_period forces an ADJUDICATE step even without a structural signal and resets the ledger's period baseline to the current iteration. <!--#ef02aa6bf7ef4c81-->
  - `TestTriggerRouting.test_below_period_no_backstop` (method) — Asserts that one iteration short of the adjudicate_period the backstop does not fire and routing stays in the IMPLEMENT fix loop. <!--#0da3364651edd48d-->
- `TestSourceGating` (class) — Test class verifying that only SELF_CHECK-sourced revisions can trigger adjudication. <!--#166ec82ad044fd83-->
  - `TestSourceGating.test_test_revision_never_adjudicates` (method) — Asserts that a TEST-sourced REVISION_NEEDED keeps fix routing (IMPLEMENT) even when the ledger holds an oscillation that would fire for SELF_CHECK. <!--#4b8ad6e35371e9b6-->
- `TestResumeAndBound` (class) — Test class verifying that an inserted ADJUDICATE step survives state serialization round-trips and that the global max-fix-iterations bound still halts a diseased flow. <!--#bafbb55058b88983-->
  - `TestResumeAndBound.test_adjudicate_survives_state_roundtrip` (method) — Asserts that after routing to ADJUDICATE, serializing and deserializing the state preserves the step in selected_steps, its current-step id, and its PENDING status. <!--#6fcfc2410e6e122f-->
  - `TestResumeAndBound.test_max_fix_iterations_still_caps` (method) — Asserts that at the max_fix_iterations bound the flow fails and halts (returns None, no ADJUDICATE inserted) even with an active oscillation on the ledger. <!--#70aee44b593baed9-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_adjudicate_reflow.py` (python) — Unit tests for the state machine's post-ADJUDICATE handling (group G6), covering both the reflow routing (benign no-op rulings passing through to IMPLEMENT vs. effective/fallback rulings reflowing to a fresh SELF_CHECK pass #1, with fix-iteration counting and stash reset) and the confirmation gate (when a CONFIRM step is inserted, skipped, approved, or rejected based on ruling type and reviewer config). <!--#a75b61145f4d35e1|e3201e089c060315-->
- `_make_state_machine` (function) — Test helper that builds a StateMachine with a patched PersistenceManager and a stubbed _get_workflow_config returning a WorkflowConfig (default: unbounded fix iterations, adjudicate_period=0) for use across the reflow/confirmation tests. <!--#664a1808c54a6ceb-->
- `_issue` (function) — Test helper that returns a canonical self-check issue dict (high-severity, task-description-sourced) for use as fixture data. <!--#90e9ca2a0f8e0ca4-->
- `_make_post_adjudicate_flow` (function) — Test helper that constructs a FlowInstance parked on a just-completed ADJUDICATE step (with IMPLEMENT/TEST/SELF_CHECK history) mirroring the state left by _transition_to_adjudicate, parameterized by the ruling's outputs. <!--#7e9e0fb960c78ce3-->
- `TestReflow` (class) — Test class covering the post-ADJUDICATE reflow router: benign no-op pass-through to IMPLEMENT (plus its defensive fallbacks) and landing rulings that reflow to a fresh SELF_CHECK at pass #1, resetting the deferred stash, counting a fix iteration, superseding fix_instructions, and enforcing max_fix_iterations. <!--#29eb52fc918b40d7-->
  - `TestReflow.test_benign_ruling_passes_through_to_implement` (method) — Asserts a no-op (review_divergence) ruling routes straight to IMPLEMENT with the triggering round's untouched fix_instructions — no supersede, no reflow, one fix increment — with only the ADJUDICATE-slot strip and benign rejected_positions landing surviving. <!--#dbd0aee69e54a39c-->
  - `TestReflow.test_noop_falls_back_to_reflow_when_trigger_id_absent` (method) — Asserts that when a no-op ruling's adjudication_trigger_step_id is missing, the router degrades to the standard reflow (fresh SELF_CHECK pass #1) without raising while still stripping the slot and landing ledger effects. <!--#6fec3f821363525e-->
  - `TestReflow.test_noop_falls_back_to_reflow_when_trigger_is_non_self_check` (method) — Asserts a no-op ruling whose trigger id resolves to a non-SELF_CHECK step (e.g. IMPLEMENT) also degrades to the standard SELF_CHECK reflow without raising. <!--#2bfb0cf845ceaf7b-->
  - `TestReflow.test_noop_falls_back_to_reflow_when_fix_transition_declines` (method) — Asserts that when _transition_to_fix returns None despite a resolvable trigger, the no-op router falls back to the standard reflow, exercising idempotent double-stripping of the ADJUDICATE slot to still yield a fresh SELF_CHECK. <!--#e76e97b940379283-->
  - `TestReflow.test_reflow_starts_at_pass_1_and_resets_stash` (method) — Asserts a landing ruling (plan override, auto-passed) reflows to SELF_CHECK at pass #1 and mechanically resets the cross-pass self_check_deferred_issues stash to empty in both context and step inputs. <!--#cd99c4d5898d469a-->
  - `TestReflow.test_reflow_counts_as_fix_iteration` (method) — Asserts a landing plan-override ruling's SELF_CHECK reflow increments the fix iteration counter (3→4) and threads fix_iteration=4 into the re-run step's inputs. <!--#4bf9f2eac4928124-->
  - `TestReflow.test_superseded_fix_instructions_never_reach_implement` (method) — Asserts a plan-only ruling reflows to SELF_CHECK without re-running IMPLEMENT on the superseded fix_instructions (IMPLEMENT stays COMPLETED with no fix_instructions), recording fix_instructions_superseded=True on the ruling for audit. <!--#372e7cb9a44c3a3d-->
  - `TestReflow.test_no_synthetic_description_changed_issue` (method) — Asserts the reflow does not fabricate a synthetic 'description changed' issue — the fresh SELF_CHECK carries empty outputs ({}) with no injected issues list, relying on the effective-text layer instead. <!--#0132a51a4429990b-->
  - `TestReflow.test_max_fix_iterations_caps_after_reflow` (method) — Asserts the reflow increment keeps max_fix_iterations enforceable: with the cap at 2, the re-run SELF_CHECK reaches the bound and a subsequent REVISION_NEEDED fails the flow (result None, FlowStatus.FAILED). <!--#47edac8697c6799c-->
- `TestConfirmationGate` (class) — Test class covering the adjudicate confirmation gate: description rewrites insert a CONFIRM (with the pre-ruling task as reviewer baseline) only when opted in, while plan-only rulings and unconfigured cases skip confirmation and reflow straight to SELF_CHECK. <!--#e5e141c130f95d9c-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_description_change_inserts_human_confirm` (method) — Asserts a description-rewrite ruling with a human reviewer config inserts a CONFIRM step (reviewer=human, targeting the adjudicate step) positioned between ADJUDICATE and SELF_CHECK, with no fix iteration counted until the gate clears. <!--#91439feaefe451f5-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_confirm_baseline_is_pre_ruling_task_not_the_rewrite` (method) — Asserts the inserted CONFIRM reviews the rewrite against the pre-ruling task_description (not the not-yet-approved proposed text), with the proposal itself reaching the reviewer only via the adjudicate step's outputs. <!--#32c91aa8a370f79a-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_description_change_auto_passes_when_unconfigured` (method) — Asserts adjudicate is opt-in: with no confirmation config, even a description rewrite auto-passes, reflowing straight to SELF_CHECK with no CONFIRM inserted. <!--#a77143b4f7e135bc-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_plan_only_no_config_skips_confirmation` (method) — Asserts a plan-only ruling with no confirmation config skips confirmation and reflows straight to SELF_CHECK with no CONFIRM step. <!--#c7a2faa7c330320f-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_plan_only_llm_reviewer_inserts_confirm` (method) — Asserts a plan-only ruling with an LLM reviewer config inserts a CONFIRM step whose reviewer is None (the default LLM chain). <!--#360c1becb6bc90c7-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_plan_only_human_reviewer_skips_confirmation` (method) — Asserts a plan-only ruling is never human-gated: even with reviewer=human configured, it reflows straight to SELF_CHECK with no CONFIRM, since human gating governs description rewrites only. <!--#8d3264d609dcaf10-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_confirm_approved_reflows_and_counts` (method) — Asserts an approved adjudicate-CONFIRM reflows to SELF_CHECK and counts the fix iteration exactly like a direct ruling. <!--#0d384cf8ca91dfcd-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_confirm_rejected_reruns_adjudicate_via_revision` (method) — Asserts a rejected CONFIRM re-runs the same ADJUDICATE step through the shared revision loop with feedback threaded in, reusing the review counter and consuming no fix iteration. <!--#09a06fc7774395ac-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_rejected_then_benign_reruling_removes_stale_confirm_slot` (method) — Asserts that when a rejected description-patch CONFIRM is followed by a benign re-ruling, the no-op pass-through removes both the orphaned CONFIRM and ADJUDICATE slots so the flow reaches IMPLEMENT and keeps running instead of pausing on a spurious TEST confirmation. <!--#e9e4f127a5e4cb86-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_baseline.py` (python) — Unit test suite pinning StateMachine's baseline-commit recording and its effective-task-description plumbing — VERSION_ANALYZE→COMMIT forwarding, IMPLEMENT session-commits forwarding, user-interjection appending, discovery-refined description composition, and fix-loop re-entry. <!--#9b3a1082b45b65a2|478163e9e0d6c151-->
- `TestBaselineCommitRecording` (class) — Test class verifying StateMachine records the git HEAD as the flow's baseline commit, without overwriting on resume and tolerating git failures. <!--#748a2e04a0a6e0a4-->
  - `TestBaselineCommitRecording.test_record_baseline_commit_sets_hash` (method) — Asserts _record_baseline_commit captures the trimmed `git rev-parse HEAD` output into flow.baseline_commit when unset. <!--#0c6294ea83f262c0-->
  - `TestBaselineCommitRecording.test_record_baseline_commit_does_not_overwrite` (method) — Asserts an already-set baseline_commit is left untouched and git is not invoked (resume scenario). <!--#7da0b309ef473426-->
  - `TestBaselineCommitRecording.test_record_baseline_commit_handles_git_failure` (method) — Asserts baseline_commit stays None when `git rev-parse` returns a nonzero exit code. <!--#e04e7945e27fc0dd-->
  - `TestBaselineCommitRecording.test_record_baseline_commit_handles_exception` (method) — Asserts baseline_commit stays None when the subprocess call raises (e.g. git not installed). <!--#22ade4445354264a-->
  - `TestBaselineCommitRecording.test_record_baseline_commit_persists_flow` (method) — Asserts the flow is persisted via persistence.save_flow after the baseline commit is recorded. <!--#ce02bd45c80c313c-->
  - `TestBaselineCommitRecording.test_init_flow_calls_record_baseline_commit` (method) — Asserts init_flow() invokes _record_baseline_commit during flow initialization. <!--#47668408b663f1b6-->
- `TestVersionAnalyzeForwarding` (class) — Test class verifying a completed VERSION_ANALYZE step's outputs are forwarded into the COMMIT step's built inputs. <!--#251e7b9229c7192f-->
  - `TestVersionAnalyzeForwarding.test_version_analyze_outputs_forwarded_to_commit` (method) — Asserts bump_type, reasoning, confidence, and suggested_version flow from VERSION_ANALYZE outputs into COMMIT inputs. <!--#6936a8f7773152cc-->
  - `TestVersionAnalyzeForwarding.test_version_analyze_not_forwarded_when_absent` (method) — Asserts VERSION_ANALYZE keys are absent from COMMIT inputs when no such step has run. <!--#66cb53c0e64f7198-->
  - `TestVersionAnalyzeForwarding.test_version_analyze_partial_outputs_forwarded` (method) — Asserts partial VERSION_ANALYZE outputs are forwarded with missing keys defaulting to None. <!--#bd51e8e0f284b380-->
- `TestImplementSessionCommitsForwarding` (class) — Test class verifying that the IMPLEMENT step's `pre_session_version` and `session_commits` outputs are forwarded into downstream step inputs (notably VERSION_ANALYZE) via `StateMachine._build_step_inputs`, including a backward-compat default when those outputs are absent. <!--#4da47c2262a7a4f4-->
  - `TestImplementSessionCommitsForwarding.test_session_commits_forwarded_to_version_analyze` (method) — Asserts that a completed IMPLEMENT step's `pre_session_version` and `session_commits` outputs appear verbatim in the VERSION_ANALYZE inputs built by `_build_step_inputs`. <!--#69fb71a8eba908fe-->
  - `TestImplementSessionCommitsForwarding.test_session_commits_default_empty_list_when_missing` (method) — Asserts an older IMPLEMENT step lacking these outputs yields pre_session_version=None and session_commits=[] rather than missing keys. <!--#77cc63e49dd8c75d-->
- `TestUserInterjectionsInTaskDescription` (class) — Test class pinning the integration where _build_step_inputs appends flow context user_interjections onto every step's effective task_description. <!--#f4dd610641721d04-->
  - `TestUserInterjectionsInTaskDescription.test_no_interjections_leaves_task_description_untouched` (method) — Asserts task_description is unchanged and carries no Additional Instructions section when no interjections exist. <!--#32fed1e9a8e76c2e-->
  - `TestUserInterjectionsInTaskDescription.test_interjections_appended_to_task_description` (method) — Asserts an interjection is appended under an Additional Instructions heading with its step-type/timestamp tag. <!--#f1a9e95d9ba1868b-->
  - `TestUserInterjectionsInTaskDescription.test_interjections_appended_after_refined_description_overwrite` (method) — Asserts interjections are appended onto the discovery-refined description (not the original), with original_task_description preserved. <!--#30a28716d1bfe2a4-->
  - `TestUserInterjectionsInTaskDescription.test_interjections_propagate_across_step_types` (method) — Asserts the same interjection list reaches the task_description of every step type (ANALYZE, PLAN, IMPLEMENT). <!--#8857826a672a65cd-->
- `TestComposeEffectiveTaskDescription` (class) — Test class for the `_compose_effective_task_description` helper, checking it consistently derives the effective task description from the raw input, discovery's `refined_description`, and appended user interjections. <!--#7073b5d81908497f-->
  - `TestComposeEffectiveTaskDescription.test_no_discovery_no_interjections_returns_canonical` (method) — Asserts the helper returns the raw `task_description` unchanged when there is no discovery refinement and no interjections. <!--#f550478bbdd09183-->
  - `TestComposeEffectiveTaskDescription.test_picks_up_refined_description_from_discovery` (method) — Asserts a completed DISCOVERY step's `refined_description` replaces the raw input as the composed description's prefix, dropping the original raw text. <!--#fc470ef0339729ec-->

- `TestFixLoopReentryUsesEffectiveTaskDescription` (class) — Regression test class ensuring _transition_to_fix re-enters IMPLEMENT with the effective (refined + interjected) task_description rather than the raw flow.task_description. <!--#b695887d82870d84-->
  - `TestFixLoopReentryUsesEffectiveTaskDescription._setup_flow_at_fix_loop_entry` (method) — Helper that builds a StateMachine and flow poised at fix-loop entry, with completed discovery/implement steps and a revision-needed self_check trigger. <!--#08ecaed7eaf68579-->
  - `TestFixLoopReentryUsesEffectiveTaskDescription.test_fix_loop_implement_sees_refined_description` (method) — Asserts the fix-loop implement step's task_description carries the discovery-refined text and not the raw user input. <!--#2514b5cdea3d2e4e-->
  - `TestFixLoopReentryUsesEffectiveTaskDescription.test_fix_loop_implement_sees_user_interjections` (method) — Asserts user_interjections appear in the fix-loop implement step's task_description. <!--#b74bf71673246901-->
  - `TestFixLoopReentryUsesEffectiveTaskDescription.test_fix_loop_with_no_discovery_uses_canonical_task` (method) — Asserts the canonical flow.task_description is used unchanged on fix re-entry when discovery never ran. <!--#4b8a57a9d13d6774-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_baseline_failures.py` (python) — Unit tests for the StateMachine's pre-implement test-baseline lifecycle (G3), covering _start_baseline_capture (cache hit/miss, resume, launch-failure safety), _ensure_baseline_ready (idempotency, background success, sync fallback, timeout/double-fail degradation to empty, and cache writeback), cleanup_baseline_capture (killing or safely skipping the capture handle), run_step wiring (ensure only on IMPLEMENT, idempotent fix-loop re-entry), and _build_step_inputs injecting a defensive copy of baseline_failures into TEST inputs. <!--#09aaab1c075f3441|84848daf1e31f612-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Helper that builds a fresh feature-type FlowInstance for use as a test fixture. <!--#32a40d3cc61515b7-->
- `_fake_capture` (function) — Helper that builds a MagicMock stand-in BaselineCapture whose bounded wait returns a given result and exposes a configurable timed_out flag. <!--#506ee1ac9f9a10d7-->
- `TestStartBaselineCapture` (class) — Test class covering StateMachine._start_baseline_capture, verifying cache-hit writes the baseline without launching a background capture, cache-miss launches one, an already-measured resume skips relaunch, and a launch failure never raises. <!--#85e887ad4a677ee7-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_cache_hit_skips_background_launch` (method) — Asserts that when a cached baseline key is found, the failures are written from cache and no BaselineCapture background process is launched. <!--#9daf2aa21dc2a6e4-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_cache_miss_launches_background_capture` (method) — Asserts that on a cache miss a background BaselineCapture is launched and stored while flow state stays un-measured (None) until _ensure_baseline_ready resolves it. <!--#6c02b6477d0bbd87-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_resume_with_existing_baseline_does_not_relaunch` (method) — Asserts that resuming a flow whose baseline_failures is already set skips key computation and BaselineCapture entirely. <!--#d710f1439078eef2-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_launch_failure_does_not_raise` (method) — Asserts that an exception raised while starting the baseline capture is swallowed, leaving baseline_failures unmeasured (None) rather than propagating. <!--#de9340b1ffc1380f-->
- `TestEnsureBaselineReady` (class) — Test class covering StateMachine._ensure_baseline_ready, verifying idempotency when measured, sorting of background results, synchronous fallback on a None sentinel or missing handle, empty-baseline last resort, timeout skipping the sync re-run, and cache write-back. <!--#7c30df3b3c8e2278-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_idempotent_when_already_measured` (method) — Asserts an already-measured baseline causes no wait and leaves the value unchanged. <!--#65f5014c4333e224-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_background_success_sets_sorted_baseline` (method) — Asserts a successful background capture yields a sorted baseline_failures list, calls save_cache once, and clears the capture handle for idempotent re-entry. <!--#9aee7a706c6b854e-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_background_none_triggers_sync_fallback` (method) — Asserts that a None background result triggers a synchronous BaselineCapture fallback that produces the authoritative baseline. <!--#2b6b44ad8407f953-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_no_handle_runs_sync_fallback` (method) — Asserts that when no background capture handle exists (e.g. earlier launch failure) a synchronous fallback capture is run to measure the baseline. <!--#82a2bc87622a93c3-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_both_paths_fail_uses_empty_baseline` (method) — Asserts that when both the background and synchronous captures fail, the baseline defaults to an empty list (never None) so introduced-failure detection still runs. <!--#18c5db3999cb1aac-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_background_timeout_skips_sync_and_uses_empty_baseline` (method) — Asserts that a background capture that returned None due to timeout (timed_out=True) is not re-run synchronously and falls straight to an empty baseline. <!--#191be212e3f94df3-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_resolved_baseline_written_to_cache` (method) — Asserts the resolved baseline is persisted via save_cache with the (project_root, key, failures_set) arguments. <!--#4fcb9d3726baae41-->
- `TestCleanupBaselineCapture` (class) — Test class covering StateMachine.cleanup_baseline_capture, verifying a still-running capture is killed and cleared, no-ops when there is no handle or it was already reaped, and that kill failures are swallowed. <!--#76892fc3ad783522-->
  - `TestCleanupBaselineCapture.test_kills_still_running_capture` (method) — Asserts an early-abort flow's still-held background capture is killed and its handle cleared. <!--#943438d7e34ea393-->
  - `TestCleanupBaselineCapture.test_noop_when_no_capture` (method) — Asserts cleanup is a safe no-op when no capture handle was ever stored. <!--#cd418d778273daab-->
  - `TestCleanupBaselineCapture.test_noop_after_ensure_already_reaped` (method) — Asserts cleanup is a no-op when _ensure_baseline_ready already consumed and cleared the capture handle before IMPLEMENT. <!--#7f886478c782a0ce-->
  - `TestCleanupBaselineCapture.test_kill_failure_is_swallowed` (method) — Asserts an exception raised by kill during cleanup is swallowed and the handle still cleared. <!--#ca8221e1b749360b-->
- `TestRunStepBaselineWiring` (class) — Test class verifying run_step wiring: an IMPLEMENT step triggers _ensure_baseline_ready, non-IMPLEMENT steps do not, and a fix-loop re-entry into implement does not re-measure the baseline. <!--#182591da0e132487-->
  - `TestRunStepBaselineWiring.test_implement_triggers_ensure_baseline` (method) — Asserts running an IMPLEMENT step calls _ensure_baseline_ready exactly once with the flow. <!--#b348a9d6aafcb599-->
  - `TestRunStepBaselineWiring.test_non_implement_step_does_not_ensure_baseline` (method) — Asserts running a non-IMPLEMENT (TEST) step does not invoke _ensure_baseline_ready. <!--#c4e68f70aca48858-->
  - `TestRunStepBaselineWiring.test_fix_loop_reentry_does_not_remeasure` (method) — Asserts that re-entering an IMPLEMENT step with an already-set baseline runs _ensure_baseline_ready but hits its guard, launching no new BaselineCapture and leaving the baseline unchanged. <!--#03d2554322a291fa-->
- `TestBuildStepInputsBaselineInjection` (class) — Test class verifying _build_step_inputs injects baseline_failures into TEST inputs (as [] when uncaptured) and passes a defensive copy. <!--#e4b19923113a629f-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsBaselineInjection.test_test_step_receives_baseline_failures` (method) — Asserts TEST step inputs carry the captured baseline_failures list. <!--#e5801e0cf3d5282d-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsBaselineInjection.test_uncaptured_baseline_injected_as_empty_list` (method) — Asserts an uncaptured (None) baseline is injected into TEST inputs as an empty list. <!--#c727c0e15c28d77a-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsBaselineInjection.test_injected_baseline_is_a_copy` (method) — Asserts the injected baseline list is a copy so mutating it does not corrupt flow state. <!--#3aa5fab33484a5d1-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_fix_loop.py` (python) — Pytest suite covering the StateMachine fix loop: State-level fix-iteration counting/history capping and serialization, `_transition_to_fix` routing a failed verify step back to the IMPLEMENT step with fix inputs and reset status, and `transition_to_next` exhaustion behavior across all TEST/SELF_CHECK/VERIFY_SPEC triggers — including finite `max_fix_iterations` caps that FAIL the flow and the `0` unlimited sentinel that bypasses exhaustion, verified both with mocks and end-to-end through real `WorkflowConfig.load` from tianluo.yaml. <!--#c57af77b43d59e8d|ea5e43e068b9403c-->
- `TestFixIterationTracking` (class) — Tests the State class's fix-iteration counter, history tracking with sliding-window cap, and serialization round-tripping. <!--#d02217aa5d1efca8-->
  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_increment_fix_iteration_initial` (method) — Verifies increment_fix_iteration starts the counter at 1 from an initial 0. <!--#4c2fb1bcb7f76ed3-->
  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_increment_fix_iteration_multiple` (method) — Verifies repeated increment_fix_iteration calls increment the counter monotonically. <!--#356bc7627ff31311-->
  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_increment_fix_iteration_tracks_history` (method) — Verifies each increment appends an entry (iteration + reason) to fix_history. <!--#40944e2a053e76c2-->
  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_fix_history_capped_at_max_entries` (method) — Verifies fix_history is capped to a recent-window of FIX_HISTORY_MAX_ENTRIES while the counter keeps growing. <!--#61effe85088e4f43-->
  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_fix_iteration_serialization` (method) — Verifies fix-iteration count and history serialize correctly via to_dict. <!--#4d3953bd9caa9354-->
  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_fix_iteration_deserialization` (method) — Verifies fix-iteration count and history deserialize correctly via State.from_dict. <!--#9432ab875a7f59a0-->
- `TestTransitionToFix` (class) — Tests the StateMachine._transition_to_fix method that routes a failed verify step back to the implement step. <!--#d6ff3f47d758c77f-->
  - `TestTransitionToFix.state_machine` (method) — Fixture creating a StateMachine rooted at the temp path. <!--#a5ef0625c538493b-->
  - `TestTransitionToFix.flow_with_implement` (method) — Fixture building a flow with implement/test/verify_spec steps where verify_spec is in REVISION_NEEDED. <!--#4fce6e6b249a7531-->
  - `TestTransitionToFix.test_transition_to_fix_finds_implement_step` (method) — Verifies _transition_to_fix locates and returns the prior implement step. <!--#36b0a3d545fe5748-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_partial.py` (python) — Test suite covering StateMachine handling of PARTIAL implement results — verifying that PARTIAL advances (or, for single-group/small holistic implementations, re-enters IMPLEMENT with resume context), that outputs and discovered_issues are forwarded downstream for PARTIAL/COMPLETED but not FAILED, and that partial flows finish as COMPLETED without retry loops. <!--#1588346932a338bb|d04dc1455844f1c1-->
- `state_machine` (function) — A pytest fixture that constructs a StateMachine rooted at a temporary path with PersistenceManager patched out and its persistence attribute replaced by a Mock (with a stubbed save_flow), yielding an isolated instance for tests. <!--#41ad2addbfda915b-->
- `_make_flow_with_implement` (function) — Test helper that constructs a FlowInstance with an IMPLEMENT step (at a given status/outputs) followed by COMMIT. <!--#a6172047e21f93b5-->
- `TestPartialTransition` (class) — Test class asserting transition_to_next() advances/completes/halts the flow correctly across PARTIAL, COMPLETED, and FAILED statuses. <!--#99d7d16d41039bfd-->
  - `TestPartialTransition.test_partial_transitions_to_next_step` (method) — Asserts a PARTIAL step transitions to the next (COMMIT) step in PENDING status, like COMPLETED. <!--#0ae38ee6fc792921-->
  - `TestPartialTransition.test_completed_still_transitions` (method) — Sanity check that a COMPLETED step still transitions to the next step. <!--#ab7cf28fda08770e-->
  - `TestPartialTransition.test_failed_does_not_transition` (method) — Asserts a FAILED step does not transition to a next step (returns None). <!--#726d39f87cb3b616-->
  - `TestPartialTransition.test_partial_does_not_trigger_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts a PARTIAL test step advances forward to COMMIT rather than looping back to IMPLEMENT for fixes. <!--#472c4e75ae180786-->
  - `TestPartialTransition.test_partial_completes_flow_when_last_step` (method) — Asserts a PARTIAL status on the final step completes the flow (FlowStatus.COMPLETED). <!--#c91c71495e9c6754-->
- `_mark_single_capability_group` (function) — Test helper that configures a flow onto the single-group capability path by setting `plan_decomposition="capability"`, `plan_granularity="auto"`, and a one-entry `task_groups` list on the implement step. <!--#75d8110b8b83ad34-->
- `TestHolisticPartialContinuation` (class) — Test class asserting that only single-group/small (holistic) implementations are forced to re-enter IMPLEMENT on partial or incomplete output, while a genuinely complete one advances to TEST. <!--#19bbbefc10cdbda1-->
  - `TestHolisticPartialContinuation.test_single_group_partial_reenters_same_implement` (method) — Verifies a PARTIAL single-group implement step is re-entered as the same PENDING step with `resumed`, `retry_count`, and `previous_output` carried in its inputs and the phase-1 cache cleared. <!--#747e2f173a4f5728-->
  - `TestHolisticPartialContinuation.test_complete_with_incomplete_tasks_still_reenters` (method) — Verifies a COMPLETED single-group implement step still re-enters itself as PENDING when its output reports leftover `incomplete_tasks`. <!--#7b7a13ba81d300a9-->
  - `TestHolisticPartialContinuation.test_single_group_complete_and_empty_advances_to_test` (method) — Verifies a COMPLETED single-group implement step with no `incomplete_tasks` advances the flow to the TEST step instead of repeating IMPLEMENT. <!--#a432d4e70f13188d-->
  - `TestHolisticPartialContinuation.test_small_partial_uses_the_same_continuation_rule` (method) — Verifies that a `small` task type triggers the same PARTIAL continuation rule as the direct strategy, re-entering IMPLEMENT as PENDING and clearing the phase1 cache. <!--#bc6fb6a1788db477-->
- `TestPartialRunLoop` (class) — Test class verifying the run loop processes a PARTIAL step exactly once with no retries. <!--#84621379326379cf-->
  - `TestPartialRunLoop.test_partial_does_not_retry` (method) — Asserts a handler returning PARTIAL is invoked only once and the flow completes without retrying. <!--#61151e8d04513314-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_self_check.py` (python) — Pytest suite covering StateMachine handling of the SELF_CHECK step — that a REVISION_NEEDED self-check re-triggers the IMPLEMENT fix loop with the right inputs and reset status, that `fix_iterations` is a single counter shared across TEST/SELF_CHECK/VERIFY_SPEC and is capped by `max_fix_iterations`, that `_build_step_inputs` assembles test results, changes made, task description and fix iteration for SELF_CHECK, and that `get_default_step_sequence` includes SELF_CHECK between TEST and INVARIANT_CHECK only for the feature/bugfix/discovery task types. <!--#33c2e25deed603a4|01e7decd52719f7e-->

- `_add_step` (function) — Helper that creates a Step of a given type/status with optional inputs/outputs and appends it to a flow's state. <!--#2b37d5b60259d594-->

  - `TestSelfCheckRevisionNeeded.test_increments_fix_iteration` (method) — Asserts the fix-iteration counter advances from 0 to 1 on a SELF_CHECK revision transition. <!--#dd74e8ae27dc1f99-->

  - `TestSelfCheckRevisionNeeded.test_resets_implement_to_pending` (method) — Asserts the IMPLEMENT step is reset to PENDING when the fix loop re-runs it. <!--#3c8e9f21ac9270a4-->

- `TestMaxFixIterationsForSelfCheck` (class) — Test class verifying that once max_fix_iterations is exhausted, a SELF_CHECK revision does not re-trigger the fix loop. <!--#dcd1549fce5e8477-->

  - `TestSpecChangesNotForwarded.test_legacy_plan_proposal_and_design_are_not_revived` (method) — Parametrized test asserting a persisted plan.proposal/plan.design never resurfaces as design_doc or proposal inputs for UPDATE_SPEC, IMPLEMENT, or COMMIT. <!--#b47e947ddba0d1e7-->
- `TestPlanForwardingUnaffected` (class) — Test class verifying that removing the spec_changes channel is a targeted change — PLAN's task_groups forwarding and legacy DESIGN/PROPOSE step outputs still flow to downstream steps. <!--#6c683a4265f204b2-->

- `TestAnalyzePersistsAnalyzedType` (class) — Tests that `analyze_handler` records the LLM's real `analyzed_type` in state and step outputs without overwriting the sequence-driving `task_type` (notably for `--discover` runs), and that a missing `root_cause_clear` defaults to False. <!--#f509907cf057346f-->

### `tests/engine/test_step_sequence.py` (python) — Unit tests for the default step sequences and step configuration, asserting SUMMARIZE terminates every task type's sequence exactly once, verifying the charter refactor's gate layout (retired spec steps absent, INVARIANT_CHECK after SELF_CHECK, CHARTER_FRESHNESS before VERSION_ANALYZE, survey/review/lightweight subsets), and covering `StepConfig.load` from `tianluo.yaml` plus `apply_step_config` append/dedup/invalid-name behaviour. <!--#6aae6bb17c1cdca7|305a502e57f7dd4a-->
- `TestSummarizeInDefaults` (class) — Test class asserting that SUMMARIZE appears exactly once and last in the default step sequence for every task type, immediately after COMMIT for commit-bearing flows, after INVARIANT_CHECK for review, after INVESTIGATE for survey, and that unknown task types fall back to the feature sequence. <!--#f7a033023a284c24-->

  - `TestSummarizeInDefaults.test_survey_summarize_follows_investigate` (method) — Asserts the survey default sequence is exactly ANALYZE → INVESTIGATE → SUMMARIZE with no COMMIT step, so SUMMARIZE directly closes the investigation flow. <!--#7a7c2105b651fe7e-->
  - `TestSummarizeInDefaults.test_unknown_task_type_falls_back_to_feature_with_summarize` (method) — Asserts an unknown task type falls back to the feature sequence ending in SUMMARIZE. <!--#4838c846530944c3-->
- `TestCharterStepsInDefaults` (class) — Test class verifying the charter refactor's step layout in default sequences: the retired VERIFY_SPEC/UPDATE_SPEC/SPEC_GATE steps are absent, INVARIANT_CHECK follows SELF_CHECK, CHARTER_FRESHNESS precedes VERSION_ANALYZE, and review/small/survey flows carry only their applicable subset of these gates. <!--#efcbb12e5ca8c100-->

  - `TestCharterStepsInDefaults.test_charter_freshness_precedes_version_analyze` (method) — Asserts VERSION_ANALYZE immediately follows CHARTER_FRESHNESS across commit-bearing flows. <!--#ea70f86e691cd139-->
  - `TestCharterStepsInDefaults.test_review_has_invariant_check_no_charter_freshness` (method) — Asserts the review flow includes INVARIANT_CHECK but omits CHARTER_FRESHNESS. <!--#ec81c4a20e4f6e85-->
  - `TestCharterStepsInDefaults.test_survey_has_no_code_changing_or_gate_steps` (method) — Asserts the survey sequence omits every code-changing and gate step (IMPLEMENT, TEST, SELF_CHECK, INVARIANT_CHECK, CHARTER_FRESHNESS, VERSION_ANALYZE, COMMIT) because survey produces no code change. <!--#46fbc655047fdae0-->
  - `TestCharterStepsInDefaults.test_lightweight_flows_have_charter_freshness_only` (method) — Asserts small/directive flows include CHARTER_FRESHNESS but not INVARIANT_CHECK. <!--#a3c1e11683c79f5f-->
- `TestStepConfig` (class) — Test class verifying `StepConfig` loading from `tianluo.yaml`, covering the default (no append steps), a valid `steps.append` list, a missing file, an empty `steps` section, and an invalid non-list `append` value. <!--#a7498653c8141de0-->

### `tests/engine/test_survey_sequence.py` (python) — Test suite for the read-only `survey` task type, covering its exact ANALYZE → INVESTIGATE → SUMMARIZE default sequence (with no code-change or version steps), an end-to-end sync-mode flow that leaves git HEAD and the version untouched with a single bounded INVESTIGATE round, propagation of the investigation report into SUMMARIZE inputs/prompt/fallback text without leaking into the task description, and worktree-mode preservation of the MERGE_INTEGRATE → VERSION_RECONCILE tail including graceful no-op behaviour on a zero-commit survey branch. <!--#abb8331c71a30d53|d035d867937f3b98-->

  - `TestSurveyDefaultSequence.test_sequence_is_exactly_analyze_investigate_summarize` (method) — Asserts `get_default_step_sequence("survey")` is exactly [ANALYZE, INVESTIGATE, SUMMARIZE]. <!--#2e43f36027232cf2-->
  - `TestSurveyDefaultSequence.test_sequence_excludes_code_change_and_version_steps` (method) — Parametrized check that no code-change or version step (IMPLEMENT, TEST, COMMIT, VERSION_ANALYZE, SELF_CHECK, INVARIANT_CHECK) appears in the survey sequence. <!--#39bfc01545ce5db2-->
  - `TestSurveyDefaultSequence.test_survey_is_an_explicit_cli_type` (method) — Asserts `"survey"` is listed in EXPLICIT_TASK_TYPES so users can select it from the CLI. <!--#74d4d100a8b1c94d-->
  - `TestSurveyDefaultSequence.test_analyze_keeps_a_survey_classification` (method) — Asserts `_extract_task_type` and `_sanitize_analyzed_type` both preserve a `survey` classification rather than rewriting it. <!--#184bf8193201e2d1-->

  - `TestSurveySyncFlow.test_flow_completes_leaving_git_and_version_untouched` (method) — Runs a full survey flow and asserts it completes through ANALYZE/INVESTIGATE/SUMMARIZE without reaching COMMIT or VERSION_ANALYZE, leaving HEAD and pyproject.toml unchanged. <!--#8739c7890887cd08-->
  - `TestSurveySyncFlow.test_survey_investigate_round_is_bounded_not_endless` (method) — Asserts a conclusive root-cause report advances the flow immediately, so INVESTIGATE executes exactly once. <!--#c75fa50eef64b194-->
- `TestSurveyDeliverableReachesTheReport` (class) — Tests that the investigation report — the survey's only deliverable — reaches SUMMARIZE inputs, the rendered prompt, and the fallback summary text, without leaking into the task description. <!--#686c4bf10e8f5b43-->
  - `TestSurveyDeliverableReachesTheReport._survey_flow_with_report` (method) — Fixture-style helper that builds a survey flow advanced past a completed ANALYZE and a completed INVESTIGATE carrying a conclusive root-cause report. <!--#7826eef41feed8d3-->
  - `TestSurveyDeliverableReachesTheReport.test_summarize_inputs_carry_the_report` (method) — Asserts the SUMMARIZE step's inputs receive the root_cause_report and a one-entry investigation_history. <!--#4829b50ead6e9afc-->
  - `TestSurveyDeliverableReachesTheReport.test_report_stays_out_of_the_summarize_task_description` (method) — Asserts the root cause text is not spliced into the SUMMARIZE task_description, preserving intent-chain isolation. <!--#05108771925d8657-->
  - `TestSurveyDeliverableReachesTheReport.test_summarize_prompt_renders_the_report` (method) — Asserts `_build_investigation_section` renders the root cause, evidence and confidence, and that SUMMARIZE_PROMPT has an `{investigation_section}` slot for it. <!--#a6ac11d4c0e95da3-->
  - `TestSurveyDeliverableReachesTheReport.test_prompt_is_unchanged_when_nothing_was_investigated` (method) — Asserts `_build_investigation_section` returns an empty string for a bare SUMMARIZE step with no investigation inputs. <!--#19307225ccb9ae93-->
  - `TestSurveyDeliverableReachesTheReport.test_fallback_summary_still_carries_the_finding` (method) — Asserts the non-LLM fallback `_create_basic_summary_text` still includes the root cause, evidence and involved files so an LLM failure doesn't lose the answer. <!--#4aa2e3b0344c1463-->
- `TestSurveyWorktreeMerge` (class) — Tests that worktree-mode surveys keep the MERGE_INTEGRATE → VERSION_RECONCILE tail across sequence derivation and rebuild, and that the real merge/reconcile handlers no-op gracefully on a zero-commit survey branch. <!--#4f3ed61696cac646-->

  - `TestSurveyWorktreeMerge.test_append_worktree_merge_steps_tail_fallback` (method) — Asserts `append_worktree_merge_steps` appends the merge pair to the tail of the survey sequence when there is no COMMIT step to anchor on. <!--#f991880db16885db-->
  - `TestSurveyWorktreeMerge.test_zero_commit_merge_and_noop_reconcile_complete_gracefully` (method) — Runs the real integrate/reconcile handlers on a zero-commit survey branch and asserts the branch is reported already-ancestor, reconcile takes its `noop` channel, and HEAD and the version stay unchanged. <!--#f3aab194aaaf342a-->

### `tests/engine/test_task_description_composer.py` (python) — Unit tests for `compose_task_description_with_interjections`, verifying it deterministically appends a structured '## Additional Instructions' section of `[step@timestamp]`-prefixed bullets onto a base task description while handling edge cases like empty/whitespace text, missing step_type or timestamp, malformed non-dict entries, and empty bases. <!--#dc0ebfdcc78bc48b|003ab16606465f9b-->

- `test_all_entries_empty_returns_base_unchanged` (function) — Confirms that when every interjection has empty text, no section is appended and the base is returned unchanged. <!--#ed811cfb84fbfb1d-->
- `test_missing_step_or_timestamp_omits_prefix` (function) — Verifies an interjection lacking both step_type and timestamp renders a bare bullet with no bracketed prefix. <!--#4122e44fcc13d563-->
- `test_only_step_type_present` (function) — Checks that step_type without a timestamp produces the single-value [step] prefix form. <!--#d76c7505d1c1063d-->
- `test_only_timestamp_present` (function) — Checks that a timestamp without step_type produces the single-value [ts] prefix form. <!--#96df6bddfbc99c4b-->

### `tests/engine/test_test_baseline.py` (python) — Cross-module contract tests locking the agreement that the pre-implement baseline (BaselineCapture) and the per-iteration test step parse identical failing test-ID sets from the same runner output, so baseline-measured failures are correctly classified as inherited (exempt) rather than introduced (blocking). <!--#1ef826db9829ec3d|60ff3cd12dd77d60-->

  - `TestBaselineParsingMatchesTestStep.test_all_pass_output_agrees_on_empty_set` (method) — Verifies all-passing output produces an empty failing set from both BaselineCapture and the test step's parser. <!--#062d4b4c49aba098-->
- `TestBaselineRoundTripExemptsInheritedFailures` (class) — Cross-module contract test class asserting that failures measured by BaselineCapture, when injected as baseline_failures into the test step, round-trip correctly — measured failures are exempted as inherited (no fix loop) while failures absent from the baseline are flagged as introduced and block. <!--#502bb638564025a7-->
  - `TestBaselineRoundTripExemptsInheritedFailures._make_flow` (method) — Helper that builds a minimal FlowInstance with change_path pointed at a temp tianluo.yaml for use in the round-trip tests. <!--#a4ad7111788d4af6-->
  - `TestBaselineRoundTripExemptsInheritedFailures.test_measured_baseline_exempts_same_failures_in_test_step` (method) — Test that a baseline measured from runner output, when fed back into test_handler on the same output (with the baseline-fix budget disabled), classifies all failures as inherited so the step COMPLETEs and does not block. <!--#39f7b9f8687878b4-->
  - `TestBaselineRoundTripExemptsInheritedFailures.test_failure_absent_from_baseline_is_introduced` (method) — Verifies the negative half: failures absent from an empty measured baseline are classified as introduced and block, guarding against over-exemption. <!--#0cb10bb9045e9a38-->
